Tank volume from the inflator tank test or inflator canister volume.
LCVEL = 0 and TNKFINP is defined:
TNKVOL is the defined tank.  Inlet gas velocity is estimated by LS-DYNA method (testing).
LCVEL = 0 and TNKFINP is not defined:
TNKVOL is the estimated inflator canister volume inlet gas velocity is estimated automatically by the Lian-Bhalsod-Olovssonmethod.
LCVEL  0:
This must be left blank
充气器储气罐试验所用罐体的容积，或充气器罐体容积。

TNKVOL 为所定义的罐体容积。进气速度采用 LS-DYNA 方法估算；该方法仍处于测试阶段。

Tank final pressure from the inflator tank test data. Only define this parameter for option 1 of TNKVOL definition above.  See Remark 10
来自充气器罐体测试数据的罐体最终压力。仅在上述 TNKVOL 定义的选项 1 中需定义此参数。参见备注 10。

Number of (quadrature) coupling points for coupling Lagrangian parts to ALE master solid parts.
If NQUAD = n, then nxn coupling points will be parametrically distributed over the surface of each Lagrangian segment.
用于将拉格朗日部件与 ALE 主实体部件相连的（求积）耦合点数量。
若 NQUAD 等于 n，则将在每个拉格朗日段的表面上以参数化方式分布 nxn 个耦合点。

Coupling type (see Remark 12):
EQ.4: Penalty coupling with coupling in the normal direction under compression only(default).
EQ.6: Penalty coupling in which coupling is under both tension and compression in the normal direction for the unfolded regionand under only compression in the normal direction for folded region.
耦合类型（参见备注 12）：
EQ.4：仅在法向受压时采用罚函数耦合（默认）。
EQ.6：展开区域在法向受拉和受压时均采用罚函数耦合，折叠区域仅在法向受压时采用罚函数耦合。

Penalty factor.  PFAC is a scale factor for scaling the estimated stiffness of the interacting (coupling) system.  It is used to compute the coupling forces to be distributed on lagrangian and ALE parts.  See Remark 13.
GT.0: Fraction of estimated critical stiffness.
LT.0: -PFAC is a load curve ID.  The curve defines the relative coupling pressure (y-axis) as a function of the tolerable fluid penetration distance (x-axis)
罚因子。PFAC 是相互作用（耦合）系统估算刚度的比例因子，用于计算分配到拉格朗日部件和 ALE 部件上的耦合力。参见备注 13。
GT.0：估算临界刚度的比例。
LT.0：-PFAC 为载荷曲线 ID。该曲线定义相对耦合压力（y 轴）随允许流体穿透距离（x 轴）的变化。

Coupling coefficient of friction.

Vent orifice coefficient which applies to exit hole. Set to zero if LCC23 is defined below.
用于出口孔的排气孔系数。如果在下方定义了 LCC23，则将其设为零。

The absolute value, |LCC23|, is a load curve ID.  If the LCC23 is positive, the load curve defines the vent orifice coefficient which applies to the exit hole as a function of time.  If the LCC23 is negative, the vent orifice coefficient is defined as a function of relative pressure, P_air /P_bag ; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  In addition, LCC23 can be defined through *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION.  A nonzero value for C23 overrides LCC23.
|LCC23| 的绝对值为载荷曲线 ID。若 LCC23 为正，载荷曲线定义出口孔通气孔口系数随时间的变化；若 LCC23 为负，则定义其随相对压力 P_air/P_bag 的变化，参见 Anagonye 和 Wang [1999]。LCC23 也可通过 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION 定义。C23 的非零值会覆盖 LCC23。

If defined as a positive number, A23 is the vent orifice area which applies to the exit hole.  If defined as a negative number, with LCA23  -1, the absolute value |A23| is a part ID; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  With LCA23 = -1, a negative A23 represents venting holes by a part set |A23|.  The venting leakage through each venting hole represented by a part in part set |A23 | is output to abstat.  The area of this part/set becomes the vent orifice area.  With SIDTYP>0, airbag pressure will not be applied to part/set |A23 | representing venting holes if part/set |A23 | is not included in SID, the part set representing the airbag.  Set A23 to zero if a positive LCA23 is defined below.
若 A23 定义为正数，则 A23 是适用于出口孔的通气孔面积。若 A23 为负且 LCA23 = -1，则 |A23| 是部件 ID（见 Anagonye 和 Wang [1999]）；此时负 A23 也可通过部件集 |A23| 表示通气孔。部件集 |A23| 中每个通气孔部件的泄漏量输出到 abstat，该部件/部件集的面积成为通气孔面积。当 SIDTYP > 0 时，若表示通气孔的部件/部件集 |A23| 不包含在代表气囊的 SID 部件集中，则不向其施加气囊压力。若下方定义了正 LCA23，则将 A23 设为零。

Fabric venting option, if nonzero CP23, LCCP23, AP23, and LCAP23 are set to zero.
EQ.1: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage is not considered (default).
EQ.2: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.3: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.4: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.5: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.6: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.7: Simple porosity model. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.8: Simple porosity model. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
织物排气选项：若该选项非零，则 CP23、LCCP23、AP23 和 LCAP23 均设为 0。
EQ.1：采用通过孔口的 Wang-Nefske 排气公式。默认情况下不考虑堵塞现象。
EQ.2：采用通过孔口的 Wang-Nefske 排气公式，同时会考虑因接触而导致的排气区域堵塞。
EQ.3：采用 Graefe、Krummheuer 与 Siejak [1990] 提出的泄漏公式，不考虑堵塞现象。
EQ.4：采用 Graefe、Krummheuer 与 Siejak [1990] 提出的泄漏公式，同时会考虑因接触而导致的排气区域堵塞。
EQ.5：采用基于多孔介质流动的泄漏公式，不考虑堵塞现象。
EQ.6：采用基于多孔介质流动的泄漏公式，同时会考虑因接触而导致的排气区域堵塞。
EQ.7：简单的孔隙率模型，不考虑堵塞现象。
EQ.8：简单的孔隙率模型，同时会考虑因接触而导致的排气区域堵塞。

Vent orifice coefficient which applies to exit hole. Set to zero if LCC23 is defined below.
用于出口孔的排气孔系数。如果在下方定义了 LCC23，则将其设为零。

The absolute value, |LCC23|, is a load curve ID.  If the LCC23 is positive, the load curve defines the vent orifice coefficient which applies to the exit hole as a function of time.  If the LCC23 is negative, the vent orifice coefficient is defined as a function of relative pressure, P_air /P_bag ; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  In addition, LCC23 can be defined through *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION.  A nonzero value for C23 overrides LCC23.
|LCC23| 的绝对值为载荷曲线 ID。若 LCC23 为正，载荷曲线定义出口孔通气孔口系数随时间的变化；若 LCC23 为负，则定义其随相对压力 P_air/P_bag 的变化，参见 Anagonye 和 Wang [1999]。LCC23 也可通过 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION 定义。C23 的非零值会覆盖 LCC23。

If defined as a positive number, A23 is the vent orifice area which applies to the exit hole.  If defined as a negative number, with LCA23  -1, the absolute value |A23| is a part ID; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  With LCA23 = -1, a negative A23 represents venting holes by a part set |A23|.  The venting leakage through each venting hole represented by a part in part set |A23 | is output to abstat.  The area of this part/set becomes the vent orifice area.  With SIDTYP>0, airbag pressure will not be applied to part/set |A23 | representing venting holes if part/set |A23 | is not included in SID, the part set representing the airbag.  Set A23 to zero if a positive LCA23 is defined below.
若 A23 定义为正数，则 A23 是适用于出口孔的通气孔面积。若 A23 为负且 LCA23 = -1，则 |A23| 是部件 ID（见 Anagonye 和 Wang [1999]）；此时负 A23 也可通过部件集 |A23| 表示通气孔。部件集 |A23| 中每个通气孔部件的泄漏量输出到 abstat，该部件/部件集的面积成为通气孔面积。当 SIDTYP > 0 时，若表示通气孔的部件/部件集 |A23| 不包含在代表气囊的 SID 部件集中，则不向其施加气囊压力。若下方定义了正 LCA23，则将 A23 设为零。

Fabric venting option, if nonzero CP23, LCCP23, AP23, and LCAP23 are set to zero.
EQ.1: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage is not considered (default).
EQ.2: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.3: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.4: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.5: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.6: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.7: Simple porosity model. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.8: Simple porosity model. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
织物排气选项：若该选项非零，则 CP23、LCCP23、AP23 和 LCAP23 均设为 0。
EQ.1：采用通过孔口的 Wang-Nefske 排气公式。默认情况下不考虑堵塞现象。
EQ.2：采用通过孔口的 Wang-Nefske 排气公式，同时会考虑因接触而导致的排气区域堵塞。
EQ.3：采用 Graefe、Krummheuer 与 Siejak [1990] 提出的泄漏公式，不考虑堵塞现象。

The absolute value, |LCC23|, is a load curve ID.  If the LCC23 is positive, the load curve defines the vent orifice coefficient which applies to the exit hole as a function of time. If the LCC23 is negative, the vent orifice coefficient is defined as a function of relative pressure, P_air /P_bag ; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  In addition, LCC23 can be defined through *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION.  A nonzero value for C23 overrides LCC23.
|LCC23| 的绝对值为载荷曲线 ID。若 LCC23 为正，载荷曲线定义出口孔通气孔口系数随时间的变化；若 LCC23 为负，则定义其随相对压力 P_air/P_bag 的变化，参见 Anagonye 和 Wang [1999]。LCC23 也可通过 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION 定义。C23 的非零值会覆盖 LCC23。

If defined as a positive number, A23 is the vent orifice area which applies to the exit hole.  If defined as a negative number, with LCA23  -1, the absolute value |A23| is a part ID; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  With LCA23 = -1, a negative A23 represents venting holes by a part set |A23|.  The venting leakage through each venting hole represented by a part in part set |A23 | is output to abstat.  The area of this part/set becomes the vent orifice area.  With SIDTYP>0, airbag pressure will not be applied to part/set |A23 | representing venting holes if part/set |A23 | is not included in SID, the part set representing the airbag.  Set A23 to zero if a positive LCA23 is defined below.

The absolute value, |LCC23|, is a load curve ID.  If the LCC23 is positive, the load curve defines the vent orifice coefficient which applies to the exit hole as a function of time. If the LCC23 is negative, the vent orifice coefficient is defined as a function of relative pressure, P_air /P_bag ; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999]. If defined as a positive number, A23 is the vent orifice area which applies to the exit hole.  If defined as a negative number, with LCA23  -1, the absolute value |A23| is a part ID; see [Anagonye and Wang 1999].  With LCA23 = -1, a negative A23 represents venting holes by a part set |A23|.  The venting leakage through each venting hole represented by a part in part set |A23 | is output to abstat.  The area of this part/set becomes the vent orifice area.  With SIDTYP>0, airbag pressure will not be applied to part/set |A23 | representing venting holes if part/set |A23 | is not included in SID, the part set representing the airbag. Blocking.  Block must be set to a two-digit number BLOCK=Mx10+N,
The 10s digit controls the treatment of particles that escape due to deleted elements (particles are always tracked and marked).
M.EQ.0: Active particle method which causes particles to be put back into the bag.
M.EQ.1: Particles are leaked through unmeshed vents. See Remark 3.
M.EQ.2: Blockage logic is turned on when the contact pressure is greater than bag/chamger pressure for external vents.
The 1s digit controls the treatment of leakage.
N.EQ.0: Always consider porosity leakage without considering blockage due to contact.
N.EQ.1: Check if airbag node is in contact or not. If yes, 1/4 (quad) or 1/3 (tri) of the segment surface will not have porosity leakage due to contact.
N.EQ.2: Same as 1 but no blockage for external vents
N.EQ.3: Same as 1 but no blockage for internal vents
N.EQ.4: Same as 1 but no blockage for all vents.
堵塞选项。BLOCK 必须设置为两位数 BLOCK=M×10+N。十位 M 控制因单元删除而逸出的粒子（粒子始终被跟踪并标记）的处理：
M.EQ.0：启用粒子方法，将粒子放回气囊

个位 N 控制泄漏处理：

Flag for checking folding logic (default=0=off).  If NFOLD=1=on, then LS-DYNA will check if the monitoring segment is in the fold, applicable to airbag.  If the monitoring segment is still located within a folded (shell) region, then no switching is allowed yet until it has unfolded.

This is an absolute distance for distributing the flow sensor points over over the ALE elements.  To make sure that at least 1 sensor point, defined on each Lagrangian segment, is present in each ALE element to track the flow of an AMMG, XLEN may be estimated as roughly half the length of the smallest ALE element in the mesh. EQ.2: Normal ALE mesh smoothing,
EQ.3: Prescribed motion following load curves, see *ALE_REFERENCE_ SYSTEM_CURVE,
EQ.4: Automatic mesh motion following mass weighted average velocity in ALE mesh,
EQ.5: Automatic mesh motion following a local coordinate system defined by three user defined nodes, see *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE,
EQ.6: Switching in time between different reference system types, see *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_SWITCH,
EQ.7: Automatic mesh expansion in order to enclose up to twelve user defined nodes, see *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE.
EQ.8: Mesh smoothing option for shock waves, where the element grid contracts in the vicinity of the shock front.  This may be referred to as the Delayed-ALE option.  It controls how much the mesh is to be moved during the remap step.  This option requires the definition of the 5th parameter in the 2nd card, EFAC; see below for definition.
EQ.9: Allowing the ALE mesh(es) to:
-Translate and/or rotate to follow a local Lagrangian reference coordinate system (whose *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE card ID is defined by the BCTRAN parameter)
-Expand or contract to enclose a Lagrangian part-set ID defined by the PRID parameter.
-Has a Lagrangian node ID be defined by the ICR/NID parameter to be the center of the ALE mesh expansion.
参考系统类型：EQ.0 欧拉；EQ.1 拉格朗日；EQ.2 普通 ALE 网格平滑；EQ.3 按载荷曲线规定运动（见 *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_CURVE）；EQ.4 按 ALE 网格中的质量加权平均速度自动移动网格；EQ.5 按三个用户定义节点建立的局部坐标系自动移动网格（见 *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE）；EQ.6 随时间在不同参考系统类型之间切换（见 *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_SWITCH）；EQ.7 自动扩展网格以包围最多 12 个用户节点（见 *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE）。
EQ.8：冲击波网格平滑选项，冲击前沿附近单元网格收缩，即 Delayed-ALE；控制重映射步中的网格移动量，需要在第二张卡片定义第 5 个参数 EFAC。
EQ.9：允许 ALE 网格平移/旋转以跟随局部拉格朗日参考坐标系（其 *ALE_REFERENCE_SYSTEM_NODE 卡片 ID 由 BCTRAN 定义）；扩张/收缩以包围 PRID 定义的拉格朗日部件集；并以 ICR/NID 定义的拉格朗日节点为网格扩展中心。

Ratio for progressive mesh spacing.  A progressively larger or smaller mesh will be generated between the control point that has a nonzero ratio specified and the control point following it.. If a control point and the one following it both have RATIO as zero, the mesh is uniform between them. See Remarks 2 and 3.
GT.0.0: mesh size increases; dl(n+1)=dl_n*(1+ratio)
LT.0.0: mesh size decreases; dl(n+1)=dl_n/(1-ratio).
XL: Length of element at the control. For ICASE = 1, see Remark 4 for details about when to enter this value. This input is required for ICASE = 2.
渐变网格间距的比值。在指定非零比值的控制点与其后一个控制点之间生成逐渐变大或变小的网格。如果相邻两个控制点的 RATIO 均为 0，则两者之间的网格均匀。见备注 2 和 3。
GT.0.0：网格尺寸增大，`dl(n+1) = dl_n * (1 + RATIO)`。
LT.0.0：网格尺寸减小，`dl(n+1) = dl_n / (1 - RATIO)`。

A three digit number, [X,Y,Z],to define symmetry:ISYM = 100*X+10*Y+Z.Each digit specifies one direction, X for the local x, Y for local y, and Z for local z(local x, y and z are defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH).Each digit can have the following values:
EQ.0:No symmetry.
EQ.1:Symmetry plane along the face with a normal vector in the negative direction.
EQ.2:Symmetry plane along the face with a normal vector in the positive direction.
For example, ISYM = 201 means quarter symmetry with symmetry planes at the faces with normal vectors +x and -z.111 means 1/8 symmetry with symmetry planes at the faces with normal vectors -x,-y and -z.
用三位数 [X,Y,Z] 定义对称性：ISYM = 100×X + 10×Y + Z。每一位指定一个方向，X、Y、Z 分别对应局部 x、y、z（局部轴在 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH 中定义）。每一位可取：
EQ.0：无对称。
EQ.1：对称面位于法向量指向负方向的面。
EQ.2：对称面位于法向量指向正方向的面。
例如，ISYM = 201 表示四分之一对称，对称面法向量为 +x 和 -z；111 表示八分之一对称，对称面法向量为 -x、-y 和 -z。

Curve ID or function ID to describe motion value as a function of time; see *DEFINE_CURVE, *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION, or *DEFINE_FUNCTION. If LCID refers to *DEFINE_FUNCTION, the function has four arguments: time and x, y and z coordinates of the node or rigid body, such as f(t,x,y,z)=10.0t+max(x-100,0.). If VAD = 2, the function has one argument which is time, such as f(t)=10.0t (see Remark 2). See BIRTH below.

Activation time for the imposed motion/constraint. The prescribed motion begins acting at time = BIRTH but with the motion from the zero abscissa value of the curve or function (*DEFINE_FUNCTION). 施加运动/约束的激活时间。规定运动从时间 = BIRTH 开始，但使用曲线或函数（*DEFINE_FUNCTION）的零横坐标值；横坐标平移 BIRTH，效果等同于在 *DEFINE_CURVE 中设置 OFFA=BIRTH。警告：若 LCID 定义为函数（如 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION），则忽略 BIRTH。

EQ.10：绕平行于 y 轴且经过 zx 平面中 z=OFFSET1、x=OFFSET2 的轴转动；不允许径向运动。不适用于刚体。
EQ.-10：与 EQ.10 相同，但允许径向运动。不适用于刚体。

EQ.-11：与 EQ.11 相同，但允许径向运动。不适用于刚体。
EQ.12：沿段法向的平移运动；仅当使用 SET_SEGMENT 关键字选项时可用。

Optional load curve allowing more flexible and efficient use of SET_BOX option. Instead of performing box-check at every time
step, discrete box-check times could be given as x-values of LCBCHK. LCBCHKs y-values specify corresponding death times.
For example, a curve with points (20, 30) and (50, 70) will result in two box checks. The first will occur at 20, and the prescribed motion
will be active from 20 to 30. The second will occur at 50, and the prescribed motion will be active from 50 to 70. A y-value of  0
means the prescribed motion will stay active until next box-check. For example, an additional 3 rd point of (90, 0) will lead to another
box-check at 90, and the prescribed motion will be active from 90 until the end of the simulation..
可选载荷曲线，用于更灵活、高效地使用 SET_BOX 选项。无需在每个时间步执行盒体检查，可将离散盒体检查时刻作为 LCBCHK 的 x 值，将对应停用时间作为 y 值。例如，点 (20, 30) 和 (50, 70) 会产生两次检查，规定运动分别在 20 到 30、50 到 70 之间生效。y=0 表示规定运动保持生效，直到下一次检查。例如增加第 3 个点 (90, 0)，会在 90 时再检查一次，并使规定运动从 90 持续到仿真结束。

Available boundary conditions:
EQ.FIXED: All nodes at the face are fixed in all directions. (Applied with with *BOUNDARY_SPC_SET)
EQ.NOFLOW: No flow allowed through the face.                     (Applied with * BOUNDARY_SPC_SET)
EQ.SYM: The face is a symmetric plane(same as NOFLOW). (Applied with * BOUNDARY_SPC_SET)
EQ.NONREFL: Non - reflective boundary condition.                (Applied with * BOUNDARY_NON_REFLECTING)
EQ.FLOWVEL: Nodes constrained by time - dependent velocities. (Applied with * BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION)
EQ.PRES: Faces loaded by time - dependent pressures.    (Applied with * LOAD_SEGMENT_SET)
EQ.AMBIENT: Ambient elements attached to the faces.See Remarks 1 and 2.                                           (Applied with * BOUNDARY_AMBIENT)
可用边界条件：
EQ.FIXED：面上的所有节点在各方向固定（通过 *BOUNDARY_SPC_SET 施加）。
EQ.NOFLOW：不允许流体通过该面（通过 *BOUNDARY_SPC_SET 施加）。
EQ.SYM：对称面（同 NOFLOW，通过 *BOUNDARY_SPC_SET 施加）。
EQ.NONREFL：非反射边界条件（通过 *BOUNDARY_NON_REFLECTING 施加）。
EQ.FLOWVEL：由随时间变化的速度约束节点（通过 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION 施加）。
EQ.PRES：由随时间变化的压力加载面（通过 *LOAD_SEGMENT_SET 施加）。
EQ.AMBIENT：连接到面的环境单元（参见备注 1 和 2，通过 *BOUNDARY_AMBIENT 施加）。

Determine where the boundary condition is applied to the mesh. NEGX, POSX, NEGY, POSY, NEGZ, or POSZ means the mesh faces with an outward normal vector in the local -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, or +z-directions, respectively.
For BCTYPE != PRES, FLOWVEL, or AMBIENT:

EQ.0: The boundary condition is not applied to faces with this outward normal.
GT.0: The boundary condition is applied to faces with this outward normal and is controlled by a time - dependent curve(*DEFINE_CURVE), whose ID is referred to with this

Number of coupling points generated in one beam element. If set to 0, coupling only happens at beam nodes. Otherwise, coupling is done at both the beam nodes and those automatically generated coupling points.NCOUP > 0 works only in explicit analysis; it will be set to zero in implicit analysis.
每个梁单元中生成的耦合点数量。若设为 0，则仅在梁节点处耦合；否则在梁节点和自动生成的耦合点处都进行耦合。NCOUP > 0 仅适用于显式分析；在隐式分析中将被设为 0。

Coupling direction.
EQ.0: default, constraint applied along all directions.
EQ.1: Constraint only applied along normal directions; along the beam axial direction there is no constraint

EQ.0：默认，沿所有方向施加约束。
EQ.1：仅沿法向施加约束；沿梁的轴向不施加约束。

Start time to activate the coupling
LT.0: Start time is set to |START|.  When negative, start time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.  After dynamic relaxation has completed, coupling is activated regardless of the value of END.EQ.0: Start time is inactive, meaning coupling is always active
GT.0: If END = -9999, START is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of start - time and end - time.Otherwise, if END > 0, the start time applies duringand after dynamic relaxation.
耦合激活开始时间：
LT.0：开始时间设为 |START|；为负时，在动态松弛阶段跟踪开始时间，动态松弛结束后无论 END 取值均激活耦合。
EQ.0：开始时间不活动，即耦合始终激活。
GT.0：若 END = -9999，START 为定义多组开始/结束时间对的曲线或表 ID；否则 END > 0 时开始时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

End time to deactive the coupling
LT.0: If END = -9999, START is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of start-time and end-time.  Otherwise, negative END indicates that coupling is inactive during dynamic relaxation.  After dynamic relaxation the start and end times are followed and set to |START| and |END|, respectively.EQ.0: END defaults to 1020.
GT.0: END sets the time at which the coupling is deactivated.
耦合停用时间：
LT.0：若 END = -9999，则 START 被解释为定义多组开始时间/结束时间对的曲线或表 ID；否则，负 END 表示耦合在动态松弛期间不活动。动态松弛结束后，跟踪开始时间和结束时间，并分别设为 |START| 和 |END|。
EQ.0：END 默认值为 1020。
GT.0：END 设置耦合停用时间。

A flag to turn on or off (0=OFF or 1=ON) the output of ALE coupling pressure and forces on the Lagrangian segments (or surfaces). This interface force file is activated by executing ls971 as follows (3): ls971 i=inputfilename.k   h=interfaceforcefilename The time interval between output is defined by  dt  in the DBF card. An optional node (a massless node is allowed) used for post-processing rigid body data. If PNODE is not located at the rigid bodys center of mass, LS-DYNA resets the initial coordinates of PNODE to the center of mass. 用于后处理刚体数据的可选节点（允许无质量节点）。如果 PNODE 不位于刚体质心，LS-DYNA 会将 PNODE 初始坐标重置为质心。如果定义 CID，LS-DYNA 将 PNODE 的速度和加速度以局部坐标系输出到 d3plot 和 d3thdt 文件；若 PNODE 为负数，则使用全局坐标系。

EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.

EQ.2：与 IPSM = 1 相同，但当不属于 PID 的边界条件开启时不进行时间偏移。

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。

An optional node (a massless node is allowed) used for post-processing rigid body data. If PNODE is not located at the rigid bodys center of mass, LS-DYNA resets the initial coordinates of PNODE to the center of mass.  If CID is defined, LS-DYNA outputs the velocities and accelerations of PNODE in the local system to the d3plot and d3thdt files unless you specify PNODE as a negative number, in which case the global system is used.
用于后处理刚体数据的可选节点（允许无质量节点）。如果 PNODE 不位于刚体质心，LS-DYNA 会将 PNODE 初始坐标重置为质心。如果定义 CID，LS-DYNA 将 PNODE 的速度和加速度以局部坐标系输出到 d3plot 和 d3thdt 文件；若 PNODE 为负数，则使用全局坐标系。

Flag for contact synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since there exists no contact when both tracked and reference sides belong to the same rigid body,
setting ICNT = 1 will turn off / on all contact definitions of which the tracked and reference sides belong to
the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is turned on / off by *SENSOR_CONTROL.With ICNT=1, all related contact definitions need the optional ID, see *CONTACT.
接触同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：跟踪侧和参考侧属于同一节点刚体 PID 时，两侧之间不存在接触；当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 打开/关闭该 PID 时，ICNT = 1 会打开/关闭所有此类接触定义。ICNT = 1 时，相关接触定义都需要可选 ID，参见 *CONTACT。

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since airbag pressure will not change when all segments constituting the airbag belong to
the same rigid body, setting IBAG = 1 will skip calculation of control volume airbags of
which all the segments belong to the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is on.The airbag calculation will be resumed,
with time offset to related airbag time - dependent curves, when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.The related airbag time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IBAG=1, all associated airbags need the optional ID, see *AIRBAG.
控制体积气囊同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当组成气囊的所有段属于同一刚体时，气囊压力不会变化；设置 IBAG = 1 可在 PID 开启时跳过所有段属于同一节点刚体 PID 的控制体积气囊计算。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 后恢复气囊计算，并相对于相关气囊时间相关曲线施加时间偏移；曲线偏移不包含 PID 开启的时间。IBAG = 1 时，所有关联气囊都需要可选 ID，见 *AIRBAG。

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。
EQ.2：与 IPSM = 1 相同，但当不属于 PID 的边界条件开启时不进行时间偏移。

EQ.0: No synchronization,

Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,

the same rigid body, setting IBAG = 1 will skip calculation of control volume airbags of

with time offset to related airbag time - dependent curves, when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.The related airbag time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IBAG=1, all associated airbags need the optional ID, see *AIRBAG.

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。

接触同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：跟踪侧和参考侧属于同一节点刚体 PID 时，两侧之间不存在接触；当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 打开/关闭该 PID 时，ICNT = 1 会打开/关闭所有此类接触定义。ICNT = 1 时，相关接触定义都需要可选 ID，参见 *CONTACT。

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since airbag pressure will not change when all segments constituting the airbag belong to
the same rigid body, setting IBAG = 1 will skip calculation of control volume airbags of
which all the segments belong to the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is on.The airbag calculation will be resumed,
with time offset to related airbag time - dependent curves, when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.The related airbag time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IBAG=1, all associated airbags need the optional ID, see *AIRBAG.
控制体积气囊同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当组成气囊的所有段属于同一刚体时，气囊压力不会变化；设置 IBAG = 1 可在 PID 开启时跳过所有段属于同一节点刚体 PID 的控制体积气囊计算。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 后恢复气囊计算，并相对于相关气囊时间相关曲线施加时间偏移；曲线偏移不包含 PID 开启的时间。IBAG = 1 时，所有关联气囊都需要可选 ID，见 *AIRBAG。

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。
EQ.2：与 IPSM = 1 相同，但当不属于 PID 的边界条件开启时不进行时间偏移。

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since airbag pressure will not change when all segments constituting the airbag belong to
the same rigid body, setting IBAG = 1 will skip calculation of control volume airbags of
which all the segments belong to the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is on.The airbag calculation will be resumed,
with time offset to related airbag time - dependent curves, when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.The related airbag time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IBAG=1, all associated airbags need the optional ID, see *AIRBAG.
控制体积气囊同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当组成气囊的所有段属于同一刚体时，气囊压力不会变化；设置 IBAG = 1 可在 PID 开启时跳过所有段属于同一节点刚体 PID 的控制体积气囊计算。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 后恢复气囊计算，并相对于相关气囊时间相关曲线施加时间偏移；曲线偏移不包含 PID 开启的时间。IBAG = 1 时，所有关联气囊都需要可选 ID，见 *AIRBAG。

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。
EQ.2：与 IPSM = 1 相同，但当不属于 PID 的边界条件开启时不进行时间偏移。

Flag for contact synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since there exists no contact when both tracked and reference sides belong to the same rigid body,
setting ICNT = 1 will turn off / on all contact definitions of which the tracked and reference sides belong to
the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is turned on / off by *SENSOR_CONTROL.With ICNT=1, all related contact definitions need the optional ID, see *CONTACT.
接触同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：跟踪侧和参考侧属于同一节点刚体 PID 时，两侧之间不存在接触；当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 打开/关闭该 PID 时，ICNT = 1 会打开/关闭所有此类接触定义。ICNT = 1 时，相关接触定义都需要可选 ID，参见 *CONTACT。

Flag for control volume airbag synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1: Since airbag pressure will not change when all segments constituting the airbag belong to
the same rigid body, setting IBAG = 1 will skip calculation of control volume airbags of
which all the segments belong to the same nodal rigid body PID when PID is on.The airbag calculation will be resumed,
with time offset to related airbag time - dependent curves, when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.The related airbag time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IBAG=1, all associated airbags need the optional ID, see *AIRBAG.
控制体积气囊同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当组成气囊的所有段属于同一刚体时，气囊压力不会变化；设置 IBAG = 1 可在 PID 开启时跳过所有段属于同一节点刚体 PID 的控制体积气囊计算。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 后恢复气囊计算，并相对于相关气囊时间相关曲线施加时间偏移；曲线偏移不包含 PID 开启的时间。IBAG = 1 时，所有关联气囊都需要可选 ID，见 *AIRBAG。

Flag for prescribed-motion synchronization:
EQ.0: No synchronization,
EQ.1:Prescribed boundary conditions (*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION) for PID are turned off automatically when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID.  A prescribed boundary condition not for PID and not for all nodes belonging to PID, that is, boundary conditions that only apply to some of the nodes belonging to PID, are turned off when PID is active to avoid boundary condition conflict.  Those boundary conditions are turned on when *SENSOR_CONTROL turns off PID. The related time-dependent curves will be offset to not include the time that PID is on.  With IPSM > 0, all related boundary prescribed motion cards need the optional ID; see *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED.
EQ.2: Same as IPSM = 1, however, without time offset when those boundary conditions not for PID are turned on.
预定义运动同步标志：
EQ.0：不同步。
EQ.1：当 *SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，PID 的预定义边界条件（*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION）自动关闭。对于不属于 PID 且不适用于 PID 所有节点的预定义边界条件（即仅适用于 PID 部分节点的边界条件），当 PID 处于活动状态时会关闭，以避免边界条件冲突。*SENSOR_CONTROL 关闭 PID 时，这些边界条件重新开启。相关的时变曲线将进行时间偏移，不包含 PID 开启期间的时间。当 IPSM > 0 时，所有相关的边界预定义运动卡都需要可选 ID；参见 *BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED。
EQ.2：与 IPSM = 1 相同，但当不属于 PID 的边界条件开启时不进行时间偏移。

Thermal conductivity (k) of fluid between the slide surfaces. If a gap with a thickness l-gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the conductance due to thermal conductivity between the slide surfaces is
h-cond = k/l-gap
Note: LS- DYNA calculates l-gap based on deformation.
滑动表面之间流体的热导率（k）。若滑动表面之间存在厚度为 l-gap 的间隙，则该间隙带来的热导效应为：
h-cond = k/l-gap
注：LS-DYNA 会根据变形情况来计算 l-gap 的值。

Radiation factor (f) between the slide surfaces. A radient-heat-transfer coefficient (h-rad) is calculated (see *BOUNDARY_RADIATION). If a gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the contact conductance is calculated by
h = h-cond + h-rad.
滑动表面之间的辐射因子（f）。系统会先计算辐射传热系数（h-rad）（参见 *BOUNDARY_RADIATION）。若滑动表面之间存在间隙，则接触热导率将通过以下公式计算：
h = h-cond + h-rad。

Heat transfer conductance (h-cont) for closed gaps. Use this heat transfer conductance for gaps in the range
0 <= l-gap <= l-min
where l-min is defined below.
闭合间隙的传热系数（h-cont）。对于满足下式的间隙，应使用该传热系数：
0 ≤ l-gap ≤ l-min
其中 l-min 的定义见下文。

Critical gap (l-min), use the heat transfer conductance defined (HTC) for gap thicknesses less than this value.
临界间隙 l-min；间隙厚度小于该值时，采用已定义的接触传热系数 HTC。

No thermal contact if gap is greater than this value (l-max).
当间隙大于该值（l-max）时，不建立热接触。

Time span of penetration removal for 2D Mortar contacts.
Each initial penetration will be gradually reduced linearly in time, so that it is removed by time TDPEN.
This is the interference option analogue to MPAR1 for IGNORE = 3 in 3D automatic Mortar contacts.
2D Mortar 接触穿透消除的时间跨度。每处初始穿透将在时间上线性减小，到 TDPEN 时完全消除。这是 3D 自动 Mortar 接触中 IGNORE = 3 时 MPAR1 干涉选项的等效选项。

Set ID for SURFA.  If SURFA > 0, a part set is assumed; see *SET_PART.  If SURFA < 0, a node set with ID equal to the absolute value of SURFA is assumed; see *SET_NODE. For nonsymmetric contact, this surface is the tracked surface.
SURFA 的集合 ID。如果 SURFA > 0，则假定为部件集（参见 *SET_PART）。如果 SURFA < 0，则假定为 ID 等于 |SURFA| 的节点集（参见 *SET_NODE）。对于非对称接触，该表面为跟踪面。

Set ID to define the SURFB surface.  If SURFB > 0, a part set is assumed; see *SET_PART.  If SURFB < 0, a node set with ID equal to the absolute value of SURFB is assumed; see *SET_NODE.  Do not define for single surface contact. For nonsymmetric contact, this surface is the reference surface.
定义 SURFB 表面的集合 ID。如果 SURFB > 0，则假定为部件集（参见 *SET_PART）；如果 SURFB < 0，则假定为 ID 等于 |SURFB| 的节点集（参见 *SET_NODE）。单面接触不得定义此字段。对于非对称接触，该表面为参考面。

Scale factor for the penalty force stiffness (default=1.0).
罚函数作用力刚度的比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。

Search frequency. The number of time steps between bucket sorts (default=50).
搜索频率。两次桶排序之间的时间步长数量（默认值为 50）。

Static coefficient of friction (default=0.0).
静态摩擦系数（默认值为 0.0）。

Dynamic coefficient of friction (default=0.0).
动态摩擦系数（默认值为 0.0）。

Exponential decay coefficient (default=0.0).
指数衰减系数（默认值为 0.0）。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):
LT.0.0: Birth time is set to | TBIRTH | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After dynamic relaxation has completed, contact is activated regardless of the value of TBIRTH.
EQ.0.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always active
GT.0.0: If TDEATH = -9999, TBIRTH is interpreted as the curve defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, if TDEATH > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0.0：激活时间设为 |TBIRTH|。TBIRTH 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 TBIRTH 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。
GT.0.0：若 TDEATH = -9999，TBIRTH 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线；否则，当 TDEATH > 0 时，激活时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):
LT.0.0: If TDEATH = -9999, TBIRTH is interpreted as the curve ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative TDEATH indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birthand death times are followedand set to |TBIRTH| and |TDEATH| , respectively.
EQ.0.0: TDEATH defaults to 1020.
GT.0.0: TDEATH sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.
接触面停用时间（此时停用接触面）：
LT.0.0：若 TDEATH = -9999，则 TBIRTH 被解释为定义多组激活时间/停用时间对的曲线 ID；否则负 TDEATH 表示动态松弛期间接触不活动。动态松弛后遵循激活/停用时间，并分别设为 |TBIRTH| 和 |TDEATH|。
EQ.0.0：TDEATH 默认值为 1020。
GT.0.0：TDEATH 设置接触停用时间。

Surface offset from midline for 2D shells of SURFA surface:
GT.0.0: scale factor applied to actual thickness,
LT.0.0: absolute value is used as the offset.
Default is set to 1.0.
SURFA 面的二维壳相对中面偏置：
GT.0.0：作为实际厚度的比例因子
LT.0.0：绝对值用作偏置量默认值为 1.0。

Surface offset from midline for 2D shells of SURFB surface:

LT.0.0: absolute value is used as the offset.

GT.0.0：作为实际厚度的比例因子
LT.0.0：绝对值用作偏置量默认值为 1.0。

EQ.0: Normal direction is determined automatically (default),

EQ.-1：法向方向为负方向。

Normal direction flag for 2D shells of SURFB surface:

COF: Closing/opening flag for implicit analysis.
EQ.0: Recommended for most problems where gaps are only closing (default),
EQ.1: Recommended when gaps are opening to avoid sticking.
COF：隐式分析中的闭合/开启标志。
EQ.0：适用于间隙仅闭合的大多数问题（默认）。
EQ.1：当间隙开启时推荐使用，以避免粘连。

Special processing during initialization.
EQ.0: No special processing,
EQ.1: Forming option.
初始化过程中的特殊处理：
EQ.0：无特殊处理。
EQ.1：成形选项。

Viscous damping coefficient in percent of critical for explicit contact.
显式接触下的黏性阻尼系数，以临界值的百分比表示。

Initial penetration flag for explicit contact.
EQ.0: Allow initial penetrations to remain
EQ.1: Push apart initially penetrated surfaces.
显式接触的初始穿透标志。
EQ.0：允许初始穿透状态保持不变。
EQ.1：将已发生初始穿透的界面推开。

Sliding option.
EQ:0. Off.
EQ.1: On.
滑动选项。
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。

Stiffness scaling option.
EQ.0: Use default option.
EQ.1: Scale stiffness using segment masses and explicit time step (default for explicit contact).
EQ.2: Scale stiffness using segment stiffness and dimensions (default for implicit contact)
刚度比例调整选项：
EQ.0：使用默认选项。
EQ.1：根据段质量和显式时间步按比例调整刚度（显式接触的默认设置）。
EQ.2：根据段刚度和尺寸按比例调整刚度（隐式接触的默认设置）。

Search gap for tied contacts.
EQ.0: Default, use 1% of the SURFB segment length
GT.0: Use the input value
LT.0: Use n% of the SURFB segment length where n=|TIEDGAP|.
查找绑定接触的间隙：
EQ.0：默认值，使用 SURFB 段长度的 1%。
GT.0：使用输入值。
LT.0：使用 SURFB 段长度的 n%，其中 n = |TIEDGAP|。

Flag to close gaps in tied contact:
EQ.0: Default, allow gaps to remain
EQ.1: Move SURFA nodes to SURFB segment to close gaps.
用于关闭绑定接触中间隙的标志：
EQ.0：默认值，允许间隙存在。
EQ.1：将 SURFA 节点移至 SURFB 段以闭合间隙。

Flag to control constraint type of tied contact:
EQ.0: Default, use kinematic constraints when possible
EQ.1: Use only penalty type constraints.
用于控制绑定接触约束类型的标志：
EQ.0：默认值，尽可能使用运动学约束。
EQ.1：仅使用罚函数型约束。

Thermal conductivity (k) of fluid between the slide surfaces. If a gap with a thickness l-gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the conductance due to thermal conductivity between the slide surfaces is
h-cond = k/l-gap
Note: LS- DYNA calculates l-gap based on deformation.
滑动表面之间流体的热导率（k）。若滑动表面之间存在厚度为 l-gap 的间隙，则该间隙带来的热导效应为：
h-cond = k/l-gap
注：LS-DYNA 会根据变形情况来计算 l-gap 的值。

Radiation factor (f) between the slide surfaces. A radient-heat-transfer coefficient (h-rad) is calculated (see *BOUNDARY_RADIATION). If a gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the contact conductance is calculated by
h = h-cond + h-rad.
滑动表面之间的辐射因子（f）。系统会先计算辐射传热系数（h-rad）（参见 *BOUNDARY_RADIATION）。若滑动表面之间存在间隙，则接触热导率将通过以下公式计算：
h = h-cond + h-rad。

Heat transfer conductance (h-cont) for closed gaps. Use this heat transfer conductance for gaps in the range
0 <= l-gap <= l-min
where l-min is defined below.
闭合间隙的传热系数（h-cont）。对于满足下式的间隙，应使用该传热系数：
0 ≤ l-gap ≤ l-min
其中 l-min 的定义见下文。

Critical gap (l-min), use the heat transfer conductance defined (HTC) for gap thicknesses less than this value.
临界间隙 l-min；间隙厚度小于该值时，采用已定义的接触传热系数 HTC。

No thermal contact if gap is greater than this value (l-max).
当间隙大于该值（l-max）时，不建立热接触。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):

EQ.0.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always active

EQ.0.0: TDEATH defaults to 1020.
GT.0.0: TDEATH sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.

EQ.0.0：TDEATH 默认值为 1020。
GT.0.0：TDEATH 设置接触停用时间。

Thermal conductivity (k) of fluid between the slide surfaces. If a gap with a thickness l-gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the conductance due to thermal conductivity between the slide surfaces is
h-cond = k/l-gap

h-cond = k/l-gap
注：LS-DYNA 会根据变形情况来计算 l-gap 的值。

h = h-cond + h-rad.

Thermal conductivity (k) of fluid between the slide surfaces. If a gap with a thickness l-gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the conductance due to thermal conductivity between the slide surfaces is
h-cond = k/l-gap
Note: LS- DYNA calculates l-gap based on deformation.

h-cond = k/l-gap
注：LS-DYNA 会根据变形情况来计算 l-gap 的值。

Radiation factor (f) between the slide surfaces. A radient-heat-transfer coefficient (h-rad) is calculated (see *BOUNDARY_RADIATION). If a gap exists between the slide surfaces, then the contact conductance is calculated by
h = h-cond + h-rad.
滑动表面之间的辐射因子（f）。系统会先计算辐射传热系数（h-rad）（参见 *BOUNDARY_RADIATION）。若滑动表面之间存在间隙，则接触热导率将通过以下公式计算：
h = h-cond + h-rad。

0 ≤ l-gap ≤ l-min

If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
接触搜索的小穿透选项。若跟踪节点的穿透量超过段厚度乘 XPENE（见 *CONTROL_CONTACT），则忽略穿透并释放跟踪节点。若段属于壳单元，厚度取壳厚度；若属于实体单元，取其最短对角线的 1/20。适用于面—面接触算法，参见表 0-17。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0：激活时间设为 |BT|。BT 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 BT 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。
GT.0：若 DT = -9999，BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID（见备注 2）；否则，当 DT > 0 时，激活时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.
接触面失活时间（此时停用接触面）：
LT.0：若 DT=-9999，则 BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID；否则负 DT 表示动态松弛期间接触不活动。动态松弛后跟踪激活和失活时间，并分别设为 |BT| 和 |DT|。
EQ.0：DT 默认值为 10e20。
GT.0：DT 设置接触失活时间。

Scale factor on default SURFA penalty stiffness when SOFT = 0 or SOFT = 2; see also *CONTROL_CONTACT.For MORTAR frictional contact this is the stiffness scale factor for the entire contact, and SFSB does not apply.
LT.0: -SFSA gives the load curve ID for contact pressure as a function of penetration depth. This is supported for Mortar contact only.
当 SOFT = 0 或 SOFT = 2 时默认 SURFA 罚刚度的比例因子，参见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。对于 Mortar 摩擦接触，该值是整个接触的刚度比例因子，SFSB 不适用。
LT.0：-SFSA 为定义接触压力随穿透深度变化的载荷曲线 ID；仅 Mortar 接触支持。

Scale factor on default SURFB penalty stiffness when SOFT = 0 or SOFT = 2; see also *CONTROL_CONTACT.For MORTAR tied contact, this is an additional stiffness scale factor, resulting in a total stiffness scale of SFSA*SFSB.
SOFT = 0 或 SOFT = 2 时默认 SURFB 穿透罚刚度的比例因子；另见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。对于 MORTAR 绑定接触，这是额外的刚度比例因子，总刚度缩放为 SFSA*SFSB。

Optional thickness for SURFA surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. SAST has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface. For the *CONTACT_TIED_.. options, SAST and SBST below can be defined as negative values, which will cause the determination of whether or not a node is tied to depend only on the separation distance relative to the absolute value of these thicknesses. More information is given under General Remarks on *CONTACT following Optional Card C.
SURFA 表面的可选厚度，可替代实际厚度。此选项仅适用于与壳单元的接触。SAST 不影响单元的实际厚度，只影响接触面的位置。对于 *CONTACT_TIED_.. 系列选项，可将以下 SAST 和 SBST 定义为负值；此时，判断节点是否绑定仅取决于节点与接触面之间的分离距离相对于这些厚度绝对值的大小。更多信息见可选卡片 C 之后的 *CONTACT 通用备注。

Optional thickness for SURFB surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. True thickness is the element thickness of the shell elements. For the TIED options see SAST above.
SURFB 表面的可选厚度（替代实际厚度）。此选项仅适用于与壳单元的接触。实际厚度是壳单元的单元厚度。TIED 选项参见上方 SAST。

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFA surface.  This option applies to contact with shell and beam elements.  SFSAT has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface.  SFSAT is ignored if SAST is nonzero except in the case of MORTAR contact (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks: *Contact section).
SURFA 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳和梁单元接触；SFSAT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SAST 非零时忽略 SFSAT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFB surface.  This option applies only to contact with shell elements.  SFSBT has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface. SFSBT is ignored if SBST is nonzero except in the case of MORTAR contact (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks: *Contact section).
SURFB 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳单元接触；SFSBT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SBST 非零时忽略 SFSBT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Coulomb friction scale factor (default=1.0).The Coulomb friction value is scaled as _sc=FSF_c; see Mandatory Card 2.
库仑摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。库仑摩擦系数按 μ_sc = FSF×μ_c 缩放；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

Viscous friction scale factor (default=1.0).If this factor is defined, the limiting force becomes: F_lim =VSFVCA_cont ; see Mandatory Card 2.
黏性摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。若定义该因子，则极限力为 F_lim = VSF×VC×A_cont；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

ID keyword option
ID 关键字选项。

Interface descriptor. We suggest using unique descriptions.
接口描述符。建议使用唯一描述。

By setting this variable to 1, the "ignore initial penetrations" option is turned on for this contact.  Alternatively, this option may be turned on by setting IGNORE = 1 on Card 4 of *CONTROL_CONTACT or on Optional Card C of *CONTACT.  In other words, if IGNORE is set to 1 in any of three places, initial penetrations are tracked.
将此变量设置为 1 后，即可为该接触对启用“忽略初始穿透”选项。或者，也可以通过在 *CONTROL_CONTACT 的卡片 4 上或 *CONTACT 的可选卡片 C 上将 IGNORE 设置为 1 来启用该选项。换言之，只要在这三个位置中的任意一处将 IGNORE 设置为 1，就会对初始穿透现象进行记录。

Bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts. For these two exceptions, the BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
桶排序频率。当可选卡片 A 中 SOFT = 2 时或采用 MORTAR 接触时，此参数不适用；这两种情况下改用可选卡片 A 中的 BSORT 选项。

Load curve for bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts.  For the two exceptions, the negative BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
用于控制分桶排序频率的载荷曲线。当可选卡 A 上的 SOFT 参数设置为 2 时，或针对 MORTAR 类型的接触对时，此参数无效。对于这两种特殊情况，则适用可选卡 A 上的负值 BSORT 选项。

Number of potential contacts to track for each tracked node.  The normal input for this (DEPTH on Optional Card A) is ignored..
每个跟踪节点需跟踪的潜在接触对数量。忽略此参数在可选卡 A 上的常规输入 DEPTH。

Number of iterations to perform when trying to eliminate initial penetrations.  Note that an input of 0 means 0, not the default value (which is 2).  Leaving this field blank will set INITITR to 2.
用于消除初始接触穿透现象时的迭代次数。需注意，输入值为 0 表示真的为 0，而非默认值（即 2）。若不填写该字段，则 INITITR 的值将为 2。

The parametric extension distance for contact segments.  The MAXPAR parameter on Optional Card A is not used for MPP.  For non-tied contacts, the default is 1.0005. For tied contacts the default is 1.035 and, the actual extension used is computed as follows: see the manual
接触段的参数化延伸距离。可选卡 A 上的 MAXPAR 参数不适用于 MPP 模式。对于非绑定接触，其默认值为 1.0005；对于绑定接触，默认值为 1.035，实际采用的延伸距离按以下方式计算：详见手册。

Flag for behavior of AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.  CPARM8's value is interpreted as two separate flags: OPT1 and OPT2 according to the rule,
"CPARM8" = "OPT1" + "OPT2".
When OPT1 and OPT2 are both set, both options are active.

OPT1.Flag to exclude beam - to - beam contact from the same PID.
EQ.0:    Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1 : Flag is set.
EQ.2 : Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 additionally permits contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
OPT2.Flag to shift generated beam affecting only shell - edge - to - shell - edge treatment.See also SRNDE in Optional Card E.
EQ.10:    Beam generated on exterior shell edge will be shifted into the shell by half the shell thickness.Therefore, the shell - edge - to - shell - edge contact starts right at the shell edge and not at an extension of the shell edge.
用于控制 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触行为的标志位。CPARM8 的值会根据“CPARM8” = “OPT1” + “OPT2”这一规则被解析为两个独立的标志位：OPT1 和 OPT2。当 OPT1 和 OPT2 均被设置时，这两个选项都会生效。

OPT1：用于排除同一 PID 下的梁-梁接触的标志位。
EQ.0：未设置该标志位（默认状态）。
EQ.1：已设置该标志位。
EQ.2：已设置该标志位。此外，当 CPARM8 设置为 2 时，AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触还会对点焊（类型 9）梁进行特殊处理；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略这类梁。

OPT2：用于调整生成的梁，使其仅影响壳边-壳边接触处理。相关内容也可参见可选卡 E 中的 SRNDE。
EQ.10：在外部壳边缘生成的梁会被移入壳单元内部，位移量为壳厚的一半。因此，壳边-壳边接触始于壳边缘本身，而非壳边缘的延伸部分。

Flag whether this is the MPP card.
标记该卡片是否为 MPP 卡片。

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

Soft constraint option:
EQ.0: Standard penalty formulation,
EQ.1: soft constraint penalty formulation,
EQ.2: pinball segment based contact penalty formulation.
EQ.4: Constraint approach for FORMING contacts. This formulation only applies to one-way forming contacts. You should use it when the penalty formulations result in large penetrations. The results, however, are sensitive to damping.
EQ.6:Special contact algorithm to handle sheet blank edge(deformable) to gage pin(rigid shell) contact during implicit gravity loading.This applies to * CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE only.See remarks under About SOFT = 6
软约束选项：
EQ.0：标准罚函数算法。
EQ.1：软约束罚函数算法。
EQ.2：基于段的 pinball 接触罚函数算法。
EQ.4：成形接触的约束算法，仅适用于单向成形接触。罚函数算法导致较大穿透时应采用此项，但计算结果对阻尼较为敏感。
EQ.6：用于处理隐式重力加载期间可变形板料边缘与刚性壳单元定位销接触的特殊算法。仅适用于 *CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE；参见 SOFT = 6 的相关备注。

Scale factor for constraint forces of soft constraint option invoked with SOFT = 1(default=.10). Values greater than .5 for single surface contact and 1.0 for a one way treatment are inadmissible.
SOFT = 1 时启用的软约束选项中，约束力的比例因子（默认值为 0.10）。单面接触不得大于 0.5，单向接触不得大于 1.0。

Load curve ID defining airbag thickness as a function of time for type a13 contact (*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE).
用于定义 a13 类型接触（*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE）的安全气囊厚度随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Maximum parametric coordinate in segment search (values 1.025 and 1.20 recommended). Larger values can increase cost. If zero, the default is set to 1.025. This factor allows an increase in the size of the segments . May be useful at sharp corners.
段搜索中的最大参数坐标值（建议值为 1.025 和 1.20）。该数值越大，计算成本越高。若设置为零，则默认值为 1.025。此参数可用于增大段的大小，在处理尖角时可能较为有用。

Segment-based contact options (SOFT=2).
EQ.0: defaults to 2.
EQ.1: pinball edge-edge contact (not recommended).
EQ.2: assume planer segments (default).
EQ.3: warped segment checking.
EQ.4: sliding option,
EQ.5: do options 3 and 4.
基于段的接触选项（SOFT = 2）。
EQ.0：默认值为 2。
EQ.1：弹球式边对边接触（不推荐）。
EQ.2：假设为平面段（默认）。
EQ.3：检查变形段。
EQ.4：滑动选项。
EQ.5：同时执行选项 3 和 4。

Search depth in automatic contact. Value of 1 is sufficiently accurate for most crash applications and is much less expensive. LS-DYNA for improved accuracy sets this value to 2. If zero, the default is set to 2.
LT.0: |DEPTH| is the load curve ID defining searching depth versus time.
自动接触搜索深度。对于大多数碰撞分析而言，数值设为 1 即可获得足够精确的结果，且计算成本也更低。为提升精度，LS-DYNA 会将该值设置为 2。若设置为零，则会采用默认值 2。
LT.0：|DEPTH| 为定义搜索深度与时间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of cycles between bucket sorts.  Values of 25 and 100 are recommended for contact types 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) and 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE), respectively.  Values of 10-15 are okay for surface-to-surface and node-to-surface contact.  If zero, LS-DYNA determines the interval.  BSORT applies only to SMP (see BCKT on MPP 1 for MPP) except in the case of SOFT = 2 or for Mortar contact, in which case BSORT applies to both SMP and MPP. For Mortar contact the default is the value associated with NSBCS on *CONTROL_CONTACT.
LT.0: |BSORT| is the load curve ID defining bucket sorting frequency as a function of time.
桶排序之间的循环次数。接触类型 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) 和 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE) 分别建议使用 25 和 100。对于面-面接触和节点-面接触，10-15 均可。如果为 0，LS-DYNA 确定间隔。BSORT 仅适用于 SMP（参见 MPP 1 中的 BCKT），但在 SOFT = 2 或 Mortar 接触时，BSORT 同时适用于 SMP 和 MPP。对于 Mortar 接触，默认值为 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中 NSBCS 对应的值。
LT.0：|BSORT| 是载荷曲线 ID，用于定义随时间变化的桶排序频率。

Number of cycles between contact force updates for penalty contact formulations. This option can provide a significant speed-up of the contact treatment. If used, values exceeding 3 or 4 are dangerous. Considerable care must be exercised when using this option, as this option assumes that contact does not change FRCFRG cycles.
EQ.0: FRCFRG is set to 1 and force calculations are performed each cycle-strongly recommended.
罚函数接触算法中两次接触力更新之间的循环数。该选项可显著加快接触处理。若启用，取值超过 3 或 4 会带来风险，必须谨慎使用，因为该选项假定接触状态在 FRCFRG 个循环内不发生变化。
EQ.0：将 FRCFRG 设为 1，每个循环均计算接触力；强烈建议采用此设置。

For old types 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 (see Mapping of *CONTACT keyword option to contact type in d3hsp at the end of General Remarks) and Mortar contact, PENMAX is the maximum penetration distance. For contact types a3, a5, a10, 13, 15, and 26, the segment thickness multiplied by PENMAX defines the maximum penetration allowed (as a multiple of the segment thickness).  (See Table 0-2.):):
EQ.0.0 for old type contacts 3, 5, and 10: Use small penetration search and value calculated from thickness and XPENE, see *CONTROL_ CONTACT.
EQ.0.0 for contact types a 3, a 5, a10, 13, and 15: Default is 0.4, or 40 percent of the segment thickness
EQ.0.0 for contact type26: Default is 200.0 times the segment thickness
对于旧类型 3、5、8、9、10（见通用备注末尾 d3hsp 中 *CONTACT 关键字选项到接触类型的映射）以及 Mortar 接触，PENMAX 为最大穿透距离。对于接触类型 a3、a5、a10、13、15 和 26，段厚度乘以 PENMAX 定义允许的最大穿透量（以段厚度倍数表示）。（见表 0-2。）
EQ.0.0 且旧接触类型为 3、5 和 10：使用小穿透搜索以及由厚度和 XPENE 计算的值，见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 a3、a5、a10、13 和 15：默认值为 0.4，即段厚度的 40%。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 26：默认值为段厚度的 200.0 倍。

Thickness option for contact types 3, 5, and 10:
EQ.0: default is taken from control card, *CONTROL_CONTACT,
EQ.1: thickness offsets are included,
EQ.2: thickness offsets are not included (old way).
接触类型 3、5 和 10 的厚度选项：
EQ.0：采用控制卡中的默认值，即 *CONTROL_CONTACT；
EQ.1：包含厚度偏移量；
EQ.2：不包含厚度偏移量（旧方式）。

Define if and only if THKOPT above equals 1. Shell thickness considered in type surface to surface and node to surface type contact options, where options 1 and 2 below activate the new contact algorithms. The thickness offsets are always included in single surface and constraint method contact types:
EQ.0: thickness is not considered,
EQ.1: thickness is considered but rigid bodies are excluded,
EQ.2: thickness is considered including rigid bodies.
当且仅当上述 THKOPT 值等于 1 时才进行定义。在面-面以及节点-面类型的接触选项中会考虑壳厚，而下面的选项 1 和选项 2 则会启用新的接触算法。对于单面接触以及基于约束方法的接触类型，始终会包含厚度偏移量：
EQ.0：不考虑厚度，
EQ.1：考虑厚度，但不包括刚体，
EQ.2：考虑厚度，且包括刚体。

Disable shooting node logic in thickness offset contact. With the shooting node logic enabled, the first cycle that a tracked node penetrates a reference segment, that node is moved back to the reference surface without applying any contact force.
EQ.0: logic is enabled (default),
EQ.1: logic is skipped (sometimes recommended for metalforming calculations).
在厚度偏移接触中禁用节点投射逻辑。当该逻辑处于启用状态时，一旦被追踪的节点首次穿透参考段，该节点就会在无需施加任何接触力的情况下被移回参考表面。
EQ.0：逻辑处于启用状态（默认值），
EQ.1：跳过该逻辑（金属成形计算有时建议使用）。

Symmetry plane option:
EQ.0: off,
EQ.1: do not include faces with normal boundary constraints (e.g., segments of brick elements on a symmetry plane).
This option is important to retain the correct boundary conditions in the model with symmetry. For the _ERODING_ contacts this option may also be defined on card 4.
对称平面选项：
EQ.0：关闭。

For mortar contact IGAP is used to progressively increase contact stiffness for large penetrations, or use a linear relationship between penetration and contact pressure; see remarks on mortar contact below.
For other contacts it is a flag to improve implicit convergence behavior
at the expense of (1) creating some sticking if parts attempt to separate
and (2) possibly underreporting the contact force magnitude in the
output files rcforc and ncforc. (IMPLICIT ONLY.).

Optional thickness for SURFA surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. SURFA 表面的可选厚度，可替代实际厚度。此选项仅适用于与壳单元的接触。SAST 不影响单元的实际厚度，只影响接触面的位置。对于 *CONTACT_TIED_.. 系列选项，可将以下 SAST 和 SBST 定义为负值；此时，判断节点是否绑定仅取决于节点与接触面之间的分离距离相对于这些厚度绝对值的大小。更多信息见可选卡片 C 之后的 *CONTACT 通用备注。

Optional thickness for SURFB surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. True thickness is the element thickness of the shell elements. For the TIED options see SAST above.

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFB surface.  This option applies only to contact with shell elements. Small penetration in the contact search option. The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.

Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

For mortar contact IGAP is used to progressively increase contact stiffness for large penetrations, or use a linear relationship between penetration and contact pressure; see remarks on mortar contact below.
For other contacts it is a flag to improve implicit convergence behavior
at the expense of (1) creating some sticking if parts attempt to separate
and (2) possibly underreporting the contact force magnitude in the
output files rcforc and ncforc. (IMPLICIT ONLY.).

EQ.2: Do not apply method

对于其他接触，IGAP 是改善隐式收敛行为的标志，但代价是：(1) 当部件试图分离时可能产生一定粘连；(2) 可能低估输出文件 rcforc 和 ncforc 中的接触力大小。（仅限 IMPLICIT。）

EQ.2：不应用该方法。
GT.2：在前 IGAP-2 个收敛平衡状态中将 IGAP = 1。

Ignore initial penetrations for the *CONTACT_AUTOMATIC options:LT.0:Applies only to the Mortar contact.When less than zero, the behavior is the same as for | IGNORE| , but contact between segments belonging to the same part is ignored.

Scale factor for the computed volume of tetrahedral solid elements for the mass calculation in SOFT=2 contact. By default, half the mass of a solid element is considered for the contact segment, which is reasonable for hexahedrons. In contrast, for tetrahedrons, a larger value than 0.5 would be preferrable, because several tets fit into one hex. Therefore, a TETFAC value around 3.0 to 5.0 should make the contact stiffness more comparable with hex meshes.
SOFT = 2 接触中，用于质量计算的四面体实体单元计算体积比例因子。默认情况下，接触段计入实体单元一半的质量，这对六面体较为合理；对于四面体，由于一个六面体内可容纳多个四面体，宜采用大于 0.5 的值。因此，将 TETFAC 设为约 3.0～5.0，可使接触刚度更接近六面体网格。

Static coefficient of friction if FS > 0 and not equal to 2.

This option must be used in combination with the thickness offset option. See Figure 6.1.

Dynamic coefficient of friction. The frictional coefficient is assumed to be dependent on the relative velocity v-rel of the surfaces in contact. Give table ID if FS=2 (default=0.0).
Note: For the special contact option TIED_SURFACE_TO_SURFACE_ FAILURE only, the variables FD is Shear stress at failure
动摩擦系数。摩擦系数假定依赖于接触面的相对速度 v-rel。若 FS=2 则填写 DEFINE_TABLE ID（默认值 = 0.0）。

Exponential decay coefficient. The frictional coefficient is assumed to depend on the relative velocity v-rel of the surfaces in contact. (default=0.0).
指数衰减系数。该摩擦系数被设定为取决于接触表面之间的相对速度 v-rel。（默认值为 0.0）。

Coefficient for viscous friction. This is necessary to limit the friction force to a maximum.
黏性摩擦系数。该参数用于将摩擦力限制在最大值以内。

Viscous damping coefficient in percent of critical. To avoid undesirable oscillation in contact, e.g., for sheet forming simulation, a contact damping perpendicular to the contacting surfaces is applied.
临界阻尼百分比的黏性阻尼系数。为避免接触振荡（例如板材成形），在接触面法向施加接触阻尼。

Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
接触搜索的小穿透选项。若跟踪节点的穿透量超过段厚度乘 XPENE（见 *CONTROL_CONTACT），则忽略穿透并释放跟踪节点。若段属于壳单元，厚度取壳厚度；若属于实体单元，取其最短对角线的 1/20。适用于面—面接触算法，参见表 0-17。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0：激活时间设为 |BT|。BT 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 BT 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。
GT.0：若 DT = -9999，BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID（见备注 2）；否则，当 DT > 0 时，激活时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.
接触面失活时间（此时停用接触面）：

EQ.0：DT 默认值为 10e20。
GT.0：DT 设置接触失活时间。
