临界阻尼百分比的黏性阻尼系数。为避免接触振荡（例如板材成形），在接触面法向施加接触阻尼。

Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
接触搜索的小穿透选项。若跟踪节点的穿透量超过段厚度乘 XPENE（见 *CONTROL_CONTACT），则忽略穿透并释放跟踪节点。若段属于壳单元，厚度取壳厚度；若属于实体单元，取其最短对角线的 1/20。适用于面—面接触算法，参见表 0-17。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0：激活时间设为 |BT|。BT 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 BT 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。
GT.0：若 DT = -9999，BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID（见备注 2）；否则，当 DT > 0 时，激活时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.
接触面失活时间（此时停用接触面）：
LT.0：若 DT=-9999，则 BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID；否则负 DT 表示动态松弛期间接触不活动。动态松弛后跟踪激活和失活时间，并分别设为 |BT| 和 |DT|。
EQ.0：DT 默认值为 10e20。
GT.0：DT 设置接触失活时间。

Scale factor on default SURFA penalty stiffness when SOFT = 0 or SOFT = 2; see also *CONTROL_CONTACT.For MORTAR frictional contact this is the stiffness scale factor for the entire contact, and SFSB does not apply.
LT.0: -SFSA gives the load curve ID for contact pressure as a function of penetration depth. This is supported for Mortar contact only.
当 SOFT = 0 或 SOFT = 2 时默认 SURFA 罚刚度的比例因子，参见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。对于 Mortar 摩擦接触，该值是整个接触的刚度比例因子，SFSB 不适用。
LT.0：-SFSA 为定义接触压力随穿透深度变化的载荷曲线 ID；仅 Mortar 接触支持。

Scale factor on default SURFB penalty stiffness when SOFT = 0 or SOFT = 2; see also *CONTROL_CONTACT.For MORTAR tied contact, this is an additional stiffness scale factor, resulting in a total stiffness scale of SFSA*SFSB.
SOFT = 0 或 SOFT = 2 时默认 SURFB 穿透罚刚度的比例因子；另见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。对于 MORTAR 绑定接触，这是额外的刚度比例因子，总刚度缩放为 SFSA*SFSB。

Optional thickness for SURFA surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. SAST has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface. For the *CONTACT_TIED_.. options, SAST and SBST below can be defined as negative values, which will cause the determination of whether or not a node is tied to depend only on the separation distance relative to the absolute value of these thicknesses. More information is given under General Remarks on *CONTACT following Optional Card C.
SURFA 表面的可选厚度，可替代实际厚度。此选项仅适用于与壳单元的接触。SAST 不影响单元的实际厚度，只影响接触面的位置。对于 *CONTACT_TIED_.. 系列选项，可将以下 SAST 和 SBST 定义为负值；此时，判断节点是否绑定仅取决于节点与接触面之间的分离距离相对于这些厚度绝对值的大小。更多信息见可选卡片 C 之后的 *CONTACT 通用备注。

Optional thickness for SURFB surface (overrides true thickness). This option applies only to contact with shell elements. True thickness is the element thickness of the shell elements. For the TIED options see SAST above.
SURFB 表面的可选厚度（替代实际厚度）。此选项仅适用于与壳单元的接触。实际厚度是壳单元的单元厚度。TIED 选项参见上方 SAST。

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFA surface.  This option applies to contact with shell and beam elements.  SFSAT has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface.  SFSAT is ignored if SAST is nonzero except in the case of MORTAR contact (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks: *Contact section).
SURFA 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳和梁单元接触；SFSAT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SAST 非零时忽略 SFSAT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFB surface.  This option applies only to contact with shell elements.  SFSBT has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface. SFSBT is ignored if SBST is nonzero except in the case of MORTAR contact (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks: *Contact section).
SURFB 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳单元接触；SFSBT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SBST 非零时忽略 SFSBT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Coulomb friction scale factor (default=1.0).The Coulomb friction value is scaled as _sc=FSF_c; see Mandatory Card 2.
库仑摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。库仑摩擦系数按 μ_sc = FSF×μ_c 缩放；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

Viscous friction scale factor (default=1.0).If this factor is defined, the limiting force becomes: F_lim =VSFVCA_cont ; see Mandatory Card 2.
黏性摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。若定义该因子，则极限力为 F_lim = VSF×VC×A_cont；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

EQ.9: Discrete Crack Model with power law and B-K damage models. "_ONE_WAY_SURFACE_TO_SURFACE_TIEBREAK" definition is recommended for this option.
EQ.9：采用幂律及 B-K 损伤模型的离散裂纹模型。建议为此选项使用“_ONE_WAY_SURFACE_TO_SURFACE_TIEBREAK”定义。

Normal failure stress when OPTION=2 or 3.
NFLS:= plastic yield stress when OPTION=5.
OPTION = 2 或 3 时的法向破坏应力。
OPTION = 5 时，NFLS 为塑性屈服应力。

Shear failure stress when OPTION=2 or 4.
SFLS:=load curve ID of the damage model when OPTION=5.
当 OPTION = 2 或 4 时的剪切破坏应力。
SFLS：当 OPTION = 5 时对应损伤模型的载荷曲线 ID。

For option 2 above, a value of unity will cause the shell thickness offsets to be ignored. For option 6 above, PARAM is the critical distance at which the interface faulure is complete.
对于上述选项 2，取值为 1 时将忽略壳厚偏移量。对于上述选项 6，PARAM 为界面失效完全发生时的临界距离。

For OPTION=7,9,10,11 only.  Normal energy release rate used in damage calculation, see Lemmen and Meijer [2001].
仅适用于 OPTION = 7、9、10、11。损伤计算采用的法向能量释放率；参见 Lemmen 和 Meijer [2001]。

For OPTION=7,9,10,11 only.  Shear energy release rate used in damage calculation, see Lemmen and Meijer [2001].
仅适用于 OPTION = 7、9、10、11 的情况。用于损伤计算的剪切能量释放率参考 Lemmen 和 Meijer [2001] 的研究。

The ratio of the tangential stiffness to the normal stiffness for OPTION=9,11. The default is 1.0.
OPTION = 9 或 11 时，切向刚度与法向刚度之比。默认值为 1.0。

Normal stiffness for OPTION=9,11. If CN is not given explicitly, penalty stiffness is used (default). This optional stiffness should be used with care, since contact stability can get affected. A warning message with a recommended time step is given initially.
OPTION=9, 11 的法向刚度。如果未显式给出 CN，则使用罚刚度（默认值）。应谨慎使用此可选刚度，因为可能会影响接触稳定性。初始时会给出一个带有推荐时间步长的警告消息。

ID keyword option
ID 关键字选项。

Interface descriptor. We suggest using unique descriptions.
接口描述符。建议使用唯一描述。

By setting this variable to 1, the "ignore initial penetrations" option is turned on for this contact.  Alternatively, this option may be turned on by setting IGNORE = 1 on Card 4 of *CONTROL_CONTACT or on Optional Card C of *CONTACT.  In other words, if IGNORE is set to 1 in any of three places, initial penetrations are tracked.
将此变量设置为 1 后，即可为该接触对启用“忽略初始穿透”选项。或者，也可以通过在 *CONTROL_CONTACT 的卡片 4 上或 *CONTACT 的可选卡片 C 上将 IGNORE 设置为 1 来启用该选项。换言之，只要在这三个位置中的任意一处将 IGNORE 设置为 1，就会对初始穿透现象进行记录。

Bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts. For these two exceptions, the BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
桶排序频率。当可选卡片 A 中 SOFT = 2 时或采用 MORTAR 接触时，此参数不适用；这两种情况下改用可选卡片 A 中的 BSORT 选项。

Load curve for bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts.  For the two exceptions, the negative BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
用于控制分桶排序频率的载荷曲线。当可选卡 A 上的 SOFT 参数设置为 2 时，或针对 MORTAR 类型的接触对时，此参数无效。对于这两种特殊情况，则适用可选卡 A 上的负值 BSORT 选项。

Number of potential contacts to track for each tracked node.  The normal input for this (DEPTH on Optional Card A) is ignored..
每个跟踪节点需跟踪的潜在接触对数量。忽略此参数在可选卡 A 上的常规输入 DEPTH。

Number of iterations to perform when trying to eliminate initial penetrations.  Note that an input of 0 means 0, not the default value (which is 2).  Leaving this field blank will set INITITR to 2.
用于消除初始接触穿透现象时的迭代次数。需注意，输入值为 0 表示真的为 0，而非默认值（即 2）。若不填写该字段，则 INITITR 的值将为 2。

The parametric extension distance for contact segments.  The MAXPAR parameter on Optional Card A is not used for MPP.  For non-tied contacts, the default is 1.0005. For tied contacts the default is 1.035 and, the actual extension used is computed as follows: see the manual
接触段的参数化延伸距离。可选卡 A 上的 MAXPAR 参数不适用于 MPP 模式。对于非绑定接触，其默认值为 1.0005；对于绑定接触，默认值为 1.035，实际采用的延伸距离按以下方式计算：详见手册。

Flag for behavior of AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.  CPARM8's value is interpreted as two separate flags: OPT1 and OPT2 according to the rule,
"CPARM8" = "OPT1" + "OPT2".
When OPT1 and OPT2 are both set, both options are active.

OPT1.Flag to exclude beam - to - beam contact from the same PID.
EQ.0:    Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1 : Flag is set.
EQ.2 : Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 additionally permits contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
OPT2.Flag to shift generated beam affecting only shell - edge - to - shell - edge treatment.See also SRNDE in Optional Card E.
EQ.10:    Beam generated on exterior shell edge will be shifted into the shell by half the shell thickness.Therefore, the shell - edge - to - shell - edge contact starts right at the shell edge and not at an extension of the shell edge.
用于控制 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触行为的标志位。CPARM8 的值会根据“CPARM8” = “OPT1” + “OPT2”这一规则被解析为两个独立的标志位：OPT1 和 OPT2。当 OPT1 和 OPT2 均被设置时，这两个选项都会生效。

OPT1：用于排除同一 PID 下的梁-梁接触的标志位。
EQ.0：未设置该标志位（默认状态）。
EQ.1：已设置该标志位。
EQ.2：已设置该标志位。此外，当 CPARM8 设置为 2 时，AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触还会对点焊（类型 9）梁进行特殊处理；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略这类梁。

OPT2：用于调整生成的梁，使其仅影响壳边-壳边接触处理。相关内容也可参见可选卡 E 中的 SRNDE。
EQ.10：在外部壳边缘生成的梁会被移入壳单元内部，位移量为壳厚的一半。因此，壳边-壳边接触始于壳边缘本身，而非壳边缘的延伸部分。

Flag whether this is the MPP card.
标记该卡片是否为 MPP 卡片。

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

Soft constraint option:
EQ.0: Standard penalty formulation,
EQ.1: soft constraint penalty formulation,
EQ.2: pinball segment based contact penalty formulation.
EQ.4: Constraint approach for FORMING contacts. This formulation only applies to one-way forming contacts. You should use it when the penalty formulations result in large penetrations. The results, however, are sensitive to damping.
EQ.6:Special contact algorithm to handle sheet blank edge(deformable) to gage pin(rigid shell) contact during implicit gravity loading.This applies to * CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE only.See remarks under About SOFT = 6
软约束选项：
EQ.0：标准罚函数算法。
EQ.1：软约束罚函数算法。
EQ.2：基于段的 pinball 接触罚函数算法。
EQ.4：成形接触的约束算法，仅适用于单向成形接触。罚函数算法导致较大穿透时应采用此项，但计算结果对阻尼较为敏感。
EQ.6：用于处理隐式重力加载期间可变形板料边缘与刚性壳单元定位销接触的特殊算法。仅适用于 *CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE；参见 SOFT = 6 的相关备注。

Scale factor for constraint forces of soft constraint option invoked with SOFT = 1(default=.10). Values greater than .5 for single surface contact and 1.0 for a one way treatment are inadmissible.
SOFT = 1 时启用的软约束选项中，约束力的比例因子（默认值为 0.10）。单面接触不得大于 0.5，单向接触不得大于 1.0。

Load curve ID defining airbag thickness as a function of time for type a13 contact (*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE).
用于定义 a13 类型接触（*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE）的安全气囊厚度随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Maximum parametric coordinate in segment search (values 1.025 and 1.20 recommended). Larger values can increase cost. If zero, the default is set to 1.025. This factor allows an increase in the size of the segments . May be useful at sharp corners.
段搜索中的最大参数坐标值（建议值为 1.025 和 1.20）。该数值越大，计算成本越高。若设置为零，则默认值为 1.025。此参数可用于增大段的大小，在处理尖角时可能较为有用。

Segment-based contact options (SOFT=2).
EQ.0: defaults to 2.
EQ.1: pinball edge-edge contact (not recommended).
EQ.2: assume planer segments (default).
EQ.3: warped segment checking.
EQ.4: sliding option,
EQ.5: do options 3 and 4.
基于段的接触选项（SOFT = 2）。
EQ.0：默认值为 2。
EQ.1：弹球式边对边接触（不推荐）。
EQ.2：假设为平面段（默认）。
EQ.3：检查变形段。

Search depth in automatic contact. Value of 1 is sufficiently accurate for most crash applications and is much less expensive. LS-DYNA for improved accuracy sets this value to 2. If zero, the default is set to 2.

自动接触搜索深度。对于大多数碰撞分析而言，数值设为 1 即可获得足够精确的结果，且计算成本也更低。为提升精度，LS-DYNA 会将该值设置为 2。若设置为零，则会采用默认值 2。
LT.0：|DEPTH| 为定义搜索深度与时间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of cycles between bucket sorts.  Values of 25 and 100 are recommended for contact types 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) and 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE), respectively.  Values of 10-15 are okay for surface-to-surface and node-to-surface contact.  If zero, LS-DYNA determines the interval.  BSORT applies only to SMP (see BCKT on MPP 1 for MPP) except in the case of SOFT = 2 or for Mortar contact, in which case BSORT applies to both SMP and MPP. For Mortar contact the default is the value associated with NSBCS on *CONTROL_CONTACT.
LT.0: |BSORT| is the load curve ID defining bucket sorting frequency as a function of time.
桶排序之间的循环次数。接触类型 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) 和 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE) 分别建议使用 25 和 100。对于面-面接触和节点-面接触，10-15 均可。如果为 0，LS-DYNA 确定间隔。BSORT 仅适用于 SMP（参见 MPP 1 中的 BCKT），但在 SOFT = 2 或 Mortar 接触时，BSORT 同时适用于 SMP 和 MPP。对于 Mortar 接触，默认值为 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中 NSBCS 对应的值。

Number of cycles between contact force updates for penalty contact formulations. This option can provide a significant speed-up of the contact treatment. If used, values exceeding 3 or 4 are dangerous. Considerable care must be exercised when using this option, as this option assumes that contact does not change FRCFRG cycles.
EQ.0: FRCFRG is set to 1 and force calculations are performed each cycle-strongly recommended.
罚函数接触算法中两次接触力更新之间的循环数。该选项可显著加快接触处理。若启用，取值超过 3 或 4 会带来风险，必须谨慎使用，因为该选项假定接触状态在 FRCFRG 个循环内不发生变化。
EQ.0：将 FRCFRG 设为 1，每个循环均计算接触力；强烈建议采用此设置。

For old types 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 (see Mapping of *CONTACT keyword option to contact type in d3hsp at the end of General Remarks) and Mortar contact, PENMAX is the maximum penetration distance. For contact types a3, a5, a10, 13, 15, and 26, the segment thickness multiplied by PENMAX defines the maximum penetration allowed (as a multiple of the segment thickness).  (See Table 0-2.):):
EQ.0.0 for old type contacts 3, 5, and 10: Use small penetration search and value calculated from thickness and XPENE, see *CONTROL_ CONTACT.
EQ.0.0 for contact types a 3, a 5, a10, 13, and 15: Default is 0.4, or 40 percent of the segment thickness

SURFA 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳和梁单元接触；SFSAT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SAST 非零时忽略 SFSAT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Scale factor applied to the contact thickness of the SURFB surface.  This option applies only to contact with shell elements.  SFSBT has no bearing on the actual thickness of the elements; it only affects the location of the contact surface. SFSBT is ignored if SBST is nonzero except in the case of MORTAR contact (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks: *Contact section).
SURFB 表面接触厚度的比例因子。仅适用于壳单元接触；SFSBT 不影响单元实际厚度，只影响接触面位置。SBST 非零时忽略 SFSBT，但 MORTAR 接触除外（参见通用备注的 *CONTACT 部分的备注 14）。

Coulomb friction scale factor (default=1.0).The Coulomb friction value is scaled as _sc=FSF_c; see Mandatory Card 2.
库仑摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。库仑摩擦系数按 μ_sc = FSF×μ_c 缩放；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

Viscous friction scale factor (default=1.0).If this factor is defined, the limiting force becomes: F_lim =VSFVCA_cont ; see Mandatory Card 2.
黏性摩擦比例因子（默认值为 1.0）。若定义该因子，则极限力为 F_lim = VSF×VC×A_cont；参见第 2 张必选卡片。

User tiebreak type (101 - 105 inclusive). A number between 101 and 105
must be chosen.Corresponding subroutine utb<OPTION> in
dyn21cnt.f will be called for the non - Mortar option, for Mortar the
subroutine mortar_usrtbrk will be called.
用户定义的失效黏结类型（101 至 105，包含两端）。必须选择 101 到 105 之间的数值。对于非 MORTAR 类型的接触，将调用 dyn21cnt.f 文件中的 utb < OPTION>子程序；而对于 MORTAR 类型，则会调用 mortar_usrtbrk 子程序。

Number of history variables (max. 3 at the moment for non-Mortar, arbitrary for Mortar).
历史变量数量（目前非 MORTAR 类型最多为 3 个，MORTAR 类型数量可任意设定）。

Ratio of the tangential stiffness to the normal stiffness.
切向刚度与法向刚度的比值。

Normal stiffness (stress/length). If CN is not given explicitly, penalty
stiffness divided by segment area is used(default).This optional
stiffness should be used with care, since contact stability can get
affected.A warning message with a recommended time step is given initially.
法向刚度（应力/长度）。如果未明确指定 CN 值，则默认使用罚函数刚度除以段面积所得的值。该可选刚度需谨慎使用，因为它可能会影响接触稳定性。系统会首先给出提示信息，并建议合适的时间步长。

Flag for offset treatment, only for non-Mortar option
EQ.0: no offset
EQ.1: with offset for shell elements.
偏置处理标志，仅适用于非 MORTAR 选项：
EQ.0：无偏置。
EQ.1：壳单元采用偏置。

Number of material history variables to be read in the user tiebreak routine, Mortar option only.
在用户自定义的失效黏结处理程序中需读取的材料历史变量数量，仅适用于 MORTAR 选项。

Number of tied weld history variables to be read in the user tiebreak
routine, assuming they have been carried over from a previous simulation.See Remark 4.
用户自定义失效黏结子程序中要读取的绑定焊缝历史变量数量；这些变量应已从先前的仿真中继承。参见备注 4。

ID keyword option
ID 关键字选项。

Interface descriptor. We suggest using unique descriptions.
接口描述符。建议使用唯一描述。

By setting this variable to 1, the "ignore initial penetrations" option is turned on for this contact.  Alternatively, this option may be turned on by setting IGNORE = 1 on Card 4 of *CONTROL_CONTACT or on Optional Card C of *CONTACT.  In other words, if IGNORE is set to 1 in any of three places, initial penetrations are tracked.
将此变量设置为 1 后，即可为该接触对启用“忽略初始穿透”选项。或者，也可以通过在 *CONTROL_CONTACT 的卡片 4 上或 *CONTACT 的可选卡片 C 上将 IGNORE 设置为 1 来启用该选项。换言之，只要在这三个位置中的任意一处将 IGNORE 设置为 1，就会对初始穿透现象进行记录。

Bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts. For these two exceptions, the BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
桶排序频率。当可选卡片 A 中 SOFT = 2 时或采用 MORTAR 接触时，此参数不适用；这两种情况下改用可选卡片 A 中的 BSORT 选项。

Load curve for bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts.  For the two exceptions, the negative BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
用于控制分桶排序频率的载荷曲线。当可选卡 A 上的 SOFT 参数设置为 2 时，或针对 MORTAR 类型的接触对时，此参数无效。对于这两种特殊情况，则适用可选卡 A 上的负值 BSORT 选项。

Number of potential contacts to track for each tracked node.  The normal input for this (DEPTH on Optional Card A) is ignored..
每个跟踪节点需跟踪的潜在接触对数量。忽略此参数在可选卡 A 上的常规输入 DEPTH。

Number of iterations to perform when trying to eliminate initial penetrations.  Note that an input of 0 means 0, not the default value (which is 2).  Leaving this field blank will set INITITR to 2.
用于消除初始接触穿透现象时的迭代次数。需注意，输入值为 0 表示真的为 0，而非默认值（即 2）。若不填写该字段，则 INITITR 的值将为 2。

The parametric extension distance for contact segments.  The MAXPAR parameter on Optional Card A is not used for MPP.  For non-tied contacts, the default is 1.0005. For tied contacts the default is 1.035 and, the actual extension used is computed as follows: see the manual
接触段的参数化延伸距离。可选卡 A 上的 MAXPAR 参数不适用于 MPP 模式。对于非绑定接触，其默认值为 1.0005；对于绑定接触，默认值为 1.035，实际采用的延伸距离按以下方式计算：详见手册。

Flag for behavior of AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.  CPARM8's value is interpreted as two separate flags: OPT1 and OPT2 according to the rule,
"CPARM8" = "OPT1" + "OPT2".
When OPT1 and OPT2 are both set, both options are active.

OPT1.Flag to exclude beam - to - beam contact from the same PID.
EQ.0:    Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1 : Flag is set.
EQ.2 : Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 additionally permits contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
OPT2.Flag to shift generated beam affecting only shell - edge - to - shell - edge treatment.See also SRNDE in Optional Card E.
EQ.10:    Beam generated on exterior shell edge will be shifted into the shell by half the shell thickness.Therefore, the shell - edge - to - shell - edge contact starts right at the shell edge and not at an extension of the shell edge.
用于控制 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触行为的标志位。CPARM8 的值会根据“CPARM8” = “OPT1” + “OPT2”这一规则被解析为两个独立的标志位：OPT1 和 OPT2。当 OPT1 和 OPT2 均被设置时，这两个选项都会生效。

OPT1：用于排除同一 PID 下的梁-梁接触的标志位。
EQ.0：未设置该标志位（默认状态）。
EQ.1：已设置该标志位。
EQ.2：已设置该标志位。此外，当 CPARM8 设置为 2 时，AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触还会对点焊（类型 9）梁进行特殊处理；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略这类梁。

OPT2：用于调整生成的梁，使其仅影响壳边-壳边接触处理。相关内容也可参见可选卡 E 中的 SRNDE。
EQ.10：在外部壳边缘生成的梁会被移入壳单元内部，位移量为壳厚的一半。因此，壳边-壳边接触始于壳边缘本身，而非壳边缘的延伸部分。

Flag whether this is the MPP card.
标记该卡片是否为 MPP 卡片。

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

Soft constraint option:
EQ.0: Standard penalty formulation,
EQ.1: soft constraint penalty formulation,
EQ.2: pinball segment based contact penalty formulation.
EQ.4: Constraint approach for FORMING contacts. This formulation only applies to one-way forming contacts. You should use it when the penalty formulations result in large penetrations. The results, however, are sensitive to damping.
EQ.6:Special contact algorithm to handle sheet blank edge(deformable) to gage pin(rigid shell) contact during implicit gravity loading.This applies to * CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE only.See remarks under About SOFT = 6
软约束选项：
EQ.0：标准罚函数算法。
EQ.1：软约束罚函数算法。
EQ.2：基于段的 pinball 接触罚函数算法。
EQ.4：成形接触的约束算法，仅适用于单向成形接触。罚函数算法导致较大穿透时应采用此项，但计算结果对阻尼较为敏感。
EQ.6：用于处理隐式重力加载期间可变形板料边缘与刚性壳单元定位销接触的特殊算法。仅适用于 *CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE；参见 SOFT = 6 的相关备注。

Scale factor for constraint forces of soft constraint option invoked with SOFT = 1(default=.10). Values greater than .5 for single surface contact and 1.0 for a one way treatment are inadmissible.
SOFT = 1 时启用的软约束选项中，约束力的比例因子（默认值为 0.10）。单面接触不得大于 0.5，单向接触不得大于 1.0。

Load curve ID defining airbag thickness as a function of time for type a13 contact (*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE).
用于定义 a13 类型接触（*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE）的安全气囊厚度随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Maximum parametric coordinate in segment search (values 1.025 and 1.20 recommended). Larger values can increase cost. If zero, the default is set to 1.025. This factor allows an increase in the size of the segments . May be useful at sharp corners.
段搜索中的最大参数坐标值（建议值为 1.025 和 1.20）。该数值越大，计算成本越高。若设置为零，则默认值为 1.025。此参数可用于增大段的大小，在处理尖角时可能较为有用。

Segment-based contact options (SOFT=2).
EQ.0: defaults to 2.
EQ.1: pinball edge-edge contact (not recommended).
EQ.2: assume planer segments (default).
EQ.3: warped segment checking.
EQ.4: sliding option,
EQ.5: do options 3 and 4.
基于段的接触选项（SOFT = 2）。
EQ.0：默认值为 2。
EQ.1：弹球式边对边接触（不推荐）。
EQ.2：假设为平面段（默认）。
EQ.3：检查变形段。
EQ.4：滑动选项。
EQ.5：同时执行选项 3 和 4。

Search depth in automatic contact. Value of 1 is sufficiently accurate for most crash applications and is much less expensive. LS-DYNA for improved accuracy sets this value to 2. If zero, the default is set to 2.
LT.0: |DEPTH| is the load curve ID defining searching depth versus time.
自动接触搜索深度。对于大多数碰撞分析而言，数值设为 1 即可获得足够精确的结果，且计算成本也更低。为提升精度，LS-DYNA 会将该值设置为 2。若设置为零，则会采用默认值 2。
LT.0：|DEPTH| 为定义搜索深度与时间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of cycles between bucket sorts.  Values of 25 and 100 are recommended for contact types 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) and 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE), respectively.  Values of 10-15 are okay for surface-to-surface and node-to-surface contact.  If zero, LS-DYNA determines the interval.  BSORT applies only to SMP (see BCKT on MPP 1 for MPP) except in the case of SOFT = 2 or for Mortar contact, in which case BSORT applies to both SMP and MPP. For Mortar contact the default is the value associated with NSBCS on *CONTROL_CONTACT.
LT.0: |BSORT| is the load curve ID defining bucket sorting frequency as a function of time.
桶排序之间的循环次数。接触类型 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) 和 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE) 分别建议使用 25 和 100。对于面-面接触和节点-面接触，10-15 均可。如果为 0，LS-DYNA 确定间隔。BSORT 仅适用于 SMP（参见 MPP 1 中的 BCKT），但在 SOFT = 2 或 Mortar 接触时，BSORT 同时适用于 SMP 和 MPP。对于 Mortar 接触，默认值为 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中 NSBCS 对应的值。
LT.0：|BSORT| 是载荷曲线 ID，用于定义随时间变化的桶排序频率。

Number of cycles between contact force updates for penalty contact formulations. This option can provide a significant speed-up of the contact treatment. If used, values exceeding 3 or 4 are dangerous. Considerable care must be exercised when using this option, as this option assumes that contact does not change FRCFRG cycles.
EQ.0: FRCFRG is set to 1 and force calculations are performed each cycle-strongly recommended.
罚函数接触算法中两次接触力更新之间的循环数。该选项可显著加快接触处理。若启用，取值超过 3 或 4 会带来风险，必须谨慎使用，因为该选项假定接触状态在 FRCFRG 个循环内不发生变化。
EQ.0：将 FRCFRG 设为 1，每个循环均计算接触力；强烈建议采用此设置。

For old types 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 (see Mapping of *CONTACT keyword option to contact type in d3hsp at the end of General Remarks) and Mortar contact, PENMAX is the maximum penetration distance. For contact types a3, a5, a10, 13, 15, and 26, the segment thickness multiplied by PENMAX defines the maximum penetration allowed (as a multiple of the segment thickness).  (See Table 0-2.):):
EQ.0.0 for old type contacts 3, 5, and 10: Use small penetration search and value calculated from thickness and XPENE, see *CONTROL_ CONTACT.
EQ.0.0 for contact types a 3, a 5, a10, 13, and 15: Default is 0.4, or 40 percent of the segment thickness
EQ.0.0 for contact type26: Default is 200.0 times the segment thickness
对于旧类型 3、5、8、9、10（见通用备注末尾 d3hsp 中 *CONTACT 关键字选项到接触类型的映射）以及 Mortar 接触，PENMAX 为最大穿透距离。对于接触类型 a3、a5、a10、13、15 和 26，段厚度乘以 PENMAX 定义允许的最大穿透量（以段厚度倍数表示）。（见表 0-2。）
EQ.0.0 且旧接触类型为 3、5 和 10：使用小穿透搜索以及由厚度和 XPENE 计算的值，见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 a3、a5、a10、13 和 15：默认值为 0.4，即段厚度的 40%。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 26：默认值为段厚度的 200.0 倍。

Thickness option for contact types 3, 5, and 10:
EQ.0: default is taken from control card, *CONTROL_CONTACT,
EQ.1: thickness offsets are included,
EQ.2: thickness offsets are not included (old way).
接触类型 3、5 和 10 的厚度选项：
EQ.0：采用控制卡中的默认值，即 *CONTROL_CONTACT；
EQ.1：包含厚度偏移量；
EQ.2：不包含厚度偏移量（旧方式）。

Define if and only if THKOPT above equals 1. Shell thickness considered in type surface to surface and node to surface type contact options, where options 1 and 2 below activate the new contact algorithms. The thickness offsets are always included in single surface and constraint method contact types:
EQ.0: thickness is not considered,
EQ.1: thickness is considered but rigid bodies are excluded,
EQ.2: thickness is considered including rigid bodies.
当且仅当上述 THKOPT 值等于 1 时才进行定义。在面-面以及节点-面类型的接触选项中会考虑壳厚，而下面的选项 1 和选项 2 则会启用新的接触算法。对于单面接触以及基于约束方法的接触类型，始终会包含厚度偏移量：
EQ.0：不考虑厚度，
EQ.1：考虑厚度，但不包括刚体，
EQ.2：考虑厚度，且包括刚体。

Disable shooting node logic in thickness offset contact. With the shooting node logic enabled, the first cycle that a tracked node penetrates a reference segment, that node is moved back to the reference surface without applying any contact force.
EQ.0: logic is enabled (default),
EQ.1: logic is skipped (sometimes recommended for metalforming calculations).
在厚度偏移接触中禁用节点投射逻辑。当该逻辑处于启用状态时，一旦被追踪的节点首次穿透参考段，该节点就会在无需施加任何接触力的情况下被移回参考表面。
EQ.0：逻辑处于启用状态（默认值），
EQ.1：跳过该逻辑（金属成形计算有时建议使用）。

Symmetry plane option:
EQ.0: off,
EQ.1: do not include faces with normal boundary constraints (e.g., segments of brick elements on a symmetry plane).
This option is important to retain the correct boundary conditions in the model with symmetry. For the _ERODING_ contacts this option may also be defined on card 4.
对称平面选项：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：不包括具有法向边界约束的面，例如对称平面上的实体单元段。
该选项对于保持对称模型的正确边界条件十分重要。对于 _ERODING_ 接触，也可在第 4 张卡片上定义此选项。

Segment searching option:
EQ.0: search 2D elements (shells) before 3D elements (solids, thick shells) when locating segments.
EQ.1: search 3D (solids, thick shells) elements before 2D elements (shells) when locating segments.
段搜索选项：
EQ.0：定位段时先搜索 2D 单元（壳），再搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳）。
EQ.1：定位段时先搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳），再搜索 2D 单元（壳）。

Optional solid element thickness. A nonzero positive value will activate the contact thickness offsets in the contact algorithms where offsets apply. The contact treatment with then be equivalent to the case where null shell elements are used to cover the brick elements. The contact stiffness parameter below, SLDSTF, may also be used to override the default value.
可选的实体单元厚度。非零正值将会在适用偏移量的接触算法中启用接触厚度偏移功能。此时的接触处理方式等同于使用空壳单元来覆盖砖形实体单元的情况。下述的接触刚度参数 SLDSTF 也可用于替代默认值。

Optional solid element stiffness. A nonzero positive value overrides the bulk modulus taken from the material model referenced by the solid element.
可选的实体单元刚度。非零正值将覆盖由实体单元所引用的材料模型中的体积模量。

For mortar contact IGAP is used to progressively increase contact stiffness for large penetrations, or use a linear relationship between penetration and contact pressure; see remarks on mortar contact below.
For other contacts it is a flag to improve implicit convergence behavior
at the expense of (1) creating some sticking if parts attempt to separate
and (2) possibly underreporting the contact force magnitude in the
output files rcforc and ncforc. (IMPLICIT ONLY.).
LT.0: Like IGAP = 1 except the maximum distance between contact surfaces at which stickiness is on is sacled by IGAP/10.
EQ.1: Apply method to improve convergence (DEFAULT)
EQ.2: Do not apply method
GT.2: Set IGAP = 1 for first IGAP-2 converged equilibrium states,

Static coefficient of friction if FS > 0 and not equal to 2.

EQ.2：对于 SURFACE_TO_SURFACE 和 ONE_WAY_SURFACE_TO_SURFACE 接触类型，动摩擦系数指向表格（FD 给出 DEFINE_TABLE ID），定义摩擦系数随相对速度和压力的变化关系，须与厚度偏置选项配合使用，参见图 6.1。

Dynamic coefficient of friction. The frictional coefficient is assumed to be dependent on the relative velocity v-rel of the surfaces in contact. Give table ID if FS=2 (default=0.0).
Note: For the special contact option TIED_SURFACE_TO_SURFACE_ FAILURE only, the variables FD is Shear stress at failure
动摩擦系数。摩擦系数假定依赖于接触面的相对速度 v-rel。若 FS=2 则填写 DEFINE_TABLE ID（默认值 = 0.0）。

Exponential decay coefficient. The frictional coefficient is assumed to depend on the relative velocity v-rel of the surfaces in contact. (default=0.0).
指数衰减系数。该摩擦系数被设定为取决于接触表面之间的相对速度 v-rel。（默认值为 0.0）。

Coefficient for viscous friction. This is necessary to limit the friction force to a maximum.
黏性摩擦系数。该参数用于将摩擦力限制在最大值以内。

Viscous damping coefficient in percent of critical. To avoid undesirable oscillation in contact, e.g., for sheet forming simulation, a contact damping perpendicular to the contacting surfaces is applied.
临界阻尼百分比的黏性阻尼系数。为避免接触振荡（例如板材成形），在接触面法向施加接触阻尼。

Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
接触搜索的小穿透选项。若跟踪节点的穿透量超过段厚度乘 XPENE（见 *CONTROL_CONTACT），则忽略穿透并释放跟踪节点。若段属于壳单元，厚度取壳厚度；若属于实体单元，取其最短对角线的 1/20。适用于面—面接触算法，参见表 0-17。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0：激活时间设为 |BT|。BT 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 BT 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。
GT.0：若 DT = -9999，BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID（见备注 2）；否则，当 DT > 0 时，激活时间在动态松弛期间及之后均适用。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.
接触面失活时间（此时停用接触面）：
LT.0：若 DT=-9999，则 BT 被解释为定义多组激活时间—失活时间对的曲线或表 ID；否则负 DT 表示动态松弛期间接触不活动。动态松弛后跟踪激活和失活时间，并分别设为 |BT| 和 |DT|。
EQ.0：DT 默认值为 10e20。
GT.0：DT 设置接触失活时间。

Scale factor on default SURFA penalty stiffness when SOFT = 0 or SOFT = 2; see also *CONTROL_CONTACT.For MORTAR frictional contact this is the stiffness scale factor for the entire contact, and SFSB does not apply.

当 SOFT = 0 或 SOFT = 2 时默认 SURFA 罚刚度的比例因子，参见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。对于 Mortar 摩擦接触，该值是整个接触的刚度比例因子，SFSB 不适用。

将此变量设置为 1 后，即可为该接触对启用“忽略初始穿透”选项。或者，也可以通过在 *CONTROL_CONTACT 的卡片 4 上或 *CONTACT 的可选卡片 C 上将 IGNORE 设置为 1 来启用该选项。换言之，只要在这三个位置中的任意一处将 IGNORE 设置为 1，就会对初始穿透现象进行记录。

Bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts. For these two exceptions, the BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
桶排序频率。当可选卡片 A 中 SOFT = 2 时或采用 MORTAR 接触时，此参数不适用；这两种情况下改用可选卡片 A 中的 BSORT 选项。

Load curve for bucket sort frequency. This parameter does not apply when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A or to Mortar contacts.  For the two exceptions, the negative BSORT option on Optional Card A applies instead.
用于控制分桶排序频率的载荷曲线。当可选卡 A 上的 SOFT 参数设置为 2 时，或针对 MORTAR 类型的接触对时，此参数无效。对于这两种特殊情况，则适用可选卡 A 上的负值 BSORT 选项。

Number of potential contacts to track for each tracked node.  The normal input for this (DEPTH on Optional Card A) is ignored..
每个跟踪节点需跟踪的潜在接触对数量。忽略此参数在可选卡 A 上的常规输入 DEPTH。

Number of iterations to perform when trying to eliminate initial penetrations.  Note that an input of 0 means 0, not the default value (which is 2).  Leaving this field blank will set INITITR to 2.
用于消除初始接触穿透现象时的迭代次数。需注意，输入值为 0 表示真的为 0，而非默认值（即 2）。若不填写该字段，则 INITITR 的值将为 2。

The parametric extension distance for contact segments.  The MAXPAR parameter on Optional Card A is not used for MPP.  For non-tied contacts, the default is 1.0005. For tied contacts the default is 1.035 and, the actual extension used is computed as follows: see the manual
接触段的参数化延伸距离。可选卡 A 上的 MAXPAR 参数不适用于 MPP 模式。对于非绑定接触，其默认值为 1.0005；对于绑定接触，默认值为 1.035，实际采用的延伸距离按以下方式计算：详见手册。

Flag for behavior of AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.  CPARM8's value is interpreted as two separate flags: OPT1 and OPT2 according to the rule,
"CPARM8" = "OPT1" + "OPT2".
When OPT1 and OPT2 are both set, both options are active.

OPT1.Flag to exclude beam - to - beam contact from the same PID.
EQ.0:    Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1 : Flag is set.
EQ.2 : Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 additionally permits contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
OPT2.Flag to shift generated beam affecting only shell - edge - to - shell - edge treatment.See also SRNDE in Optional Card E.
EQ.10:    Beam generated on exterior shell edge will be shifted into the shell by half the shell thickness.Therefore, the shell - edge - to - shell - edge contact starts right at the shell edge and not at an extension of the shell edge.
用于控制 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触行为的标志位。CPARM8 的值会根据“CPARM8” = “OPT1” + “OPT2”这一规则被解析为两个独立的标志位：OPT1 和 OPT2。当 OPT1 和 OPT2 均被设置时，这两个选项都会生效。

OPT1：用于排除同一 PID 下的梁-梁接触的标志位。
EQ.0：未设置该标志位（默认状态）。
EQ.1：已设置该标志位。
EQ.2：已设置该标志位。此外，当 CPARM8 设置为 2 时，AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触还会对点焊（类型 9）梁进行特殊处理；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略这类梁。

OPT2：用于调整生成的梁，使其仅影响壳边-壳边接触处理。相关内容也可参见可选卡 E 中的 SRNDE。
EQ.10：在外部壳边缘生成的梁会被移入壳单元内部，位移量为壳厚的一半。因此，壳边-壳边接触始于壳边缘本身，而非壳边缘的延伸部分。

Flag whether this is the MPP card.
标记该卡片是否为 MPP 卡片。

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

Soft constraint option:
EQ.0: Standard penalty formulation,
EQ.1: soft constraint penalty formulation,
EQ.2: pinball segment based contact penalty formulation.
EQ.4: Constraint approach for FORMING contacts. This formulation only applies to one-way forming contacts. You should use it when the penalty formulations result in large penetrations. The results, however, are sensitive to damping.
EQ.6:Special contact algorithm to handle sheet blank edge(deformable) to gage pin(rigid shell) contact during implicit gravity loading.This applies to * CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE only.See remarks under About SOFT = 6
软约束选项：
EQ.0：标准罚函数算法。
EQ.1：软约束罚函数算法。
EQ.2：基于段的 pinball 接触罚函数算法。
EQ.4：成形接触的约束算法，仅适用于单向成形接触。罚函数算法导致较大穿透时应采用此项，但计算结果对阻尼较为敏感。
EQ.6：用于处理隐式重力加载期间可变形板料边缘与刚性壳单元定位销接触的特殊算法。仅适用于 *CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE；参见 SOFT = 6 的相关备注。

Scale factor for constraint forces of soft constraint option invoked with SOFT = 1(default=.10). Values greater than .5 for single surface contact and 1.0 for a one way treatment are inadmissible.
SOFT = 1 时启用的软约束选项中，约束力的比例因子（默认值为 0.10）。单面接触不得大于 0.5，单向接触不得大于 1.0。

Load curve ID defining airbag thickness as a function of time for type a13 contact (*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE).
用于定义 a13 类型接触（*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE）的安全气囊厚度随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Maximum parametric coordinate in segment search (values 1.025 and 1.20 recommended). Larger values can increase cost. If zero, the default is set to 1.025. This factor allows an increase in the size of the segments . May be useful at sharp corners.
段搜索中的最大参数坐标值（建议值为 1.025 和 1.20）。该数值越大，计算成本越高。若设置为零，则默认值为 1.025。此参数可用于增大段的大小，在处理尖角时可能较为有用。

Segment-based contact options (SOFT=2).
EQ.0: defaults to 2.
EQ.1: pinball edge-edge contact (not recommended).
EQ.2: assume planer segments (default).
EQ.3: warped segment checking.
EQ.4: sliding option,
EQ.5: do options 3 and 4.
基于段的接触选项（SOFT = 2）。
EQ.0：默认值为 2。
EQ.1：弹球式边对边接触（不推荐）。
EQ.2：假设为平面段（默认）。
EQ.3：检查变形段。
EQ.4：滑动选项。
EQ.5：同时执行选项 3 和 4。

Search depth in automatic contact. Value of 1 is sufficiently accurate for most crash applications and is much less expensive. LS-DYNA for improved accuracy sets this value to 2. If zero, the default is set to 2.
LT.0: |DEPTH| is the load curve ID defining searching depth versus time.
自动接触搜索深度。对于大多数碰撞分析而言，数值设为 1 即可获得足够精确的结果，且计算成本也更低。为提升精度，LS-DYNA 会将该值设置为 2。若设置为零，则会采用默认值 2。
LT.0：|DEPTH| 为定义搜索深度与时间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of cycles between bucket sorts.  Values of 25 and 100 are recommended for contact types 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) and 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE), respectively.  Values of 10-15 are okay for surface-to-surface and node-to-surface contact.  If zero, LS-DYNA determines the interval.  BSORT applies only to SMP (see BCKT on MPP 1 for MPP) except in the case of SOFT = 2 or for Mortar contact, in which case BSORT applies to both SMP and MPP. For Mortar contact the default is the value associated with NSBCS on *CONTROL_CONTACT.
LT.0: |BSORT| is the load curve ID defining bucket sorting frequency as a function of time.
桶排序之间的循环次数。接触类型 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) 和 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE) 分别建议使用 25 和 100。对于面-面接触和节点-面接触，10-15 均可。如果为 0，LS-DYNA 确定间隔。BSORT 仅适用于 SMP（参见 MPP 1 中的 BCKT），但在 SOFT = 2 或 Mortar 接触时，BSORT 同时适用于 SMP 和 MPP。对于 Mortar 接触，默认值为 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中 NSBCS 对应的值。
LT.0：|BSORT| 是载荷曲线 ID，用于定义随时间变化的桶排序频率。

Number of cycles between contact force updates for penalty contact formulations. This option can provide a significant speed-up of the contact treatment. If used, values exceeding 3 or 4 are dangerous. Considerable care must be exercised when using this option, as this option assumes that contact does not change FRCFRG cycles.
EQ.0: FRCFRG is set to 1 and force calculations are performed each cycle-strongly recommended.
罚函数接触算法中两次接触力更新之间的循环数。该选项可显著加快接触处理。若启用，取值超过 3 或 4 会带来风险，必须谨慎使用，因为该选项假定接触状态在 FRCFRG 个循环内不发生变化。
EQ.0：将 FRCFRG 设为 1，每个循环均计算接触力；强烈建议采用此设置。

For old types 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 (see Mapping of *CONTACT keyword option to contact type in d3hsp at the end of General Remarks) and Mortar contact, PENMAX is the maximum penetration distance. For contact types a3, a5, a10, 13, 15, and 26, the segment thickness multiplied by PENMAX defines the maximum penetration allowed (as a multiple of the segment thickness).  (See Table 0-2.):):
EQ.0.0 for old type contacts 3, 5, and 10: Use small penetration search and value calculated from thickness and XPENE, see *CONTROL_ CONTACT.
EQ.0.0 for contact types a 3, a 5, a10, 13, and 15: Default is 0.4, or 40 percent of the segment thickness
EQ.0.0 for contact type26: Default is 200.0 times the segment thickness
对于旧类型 3、5、8、9、10（见通用备注末尾 d3hsp 中 *CONTACT 关键字选项到接触类型的映射）以及 Mortar 接触，PENMAX 为最大穿透距离。对于接触类型 a3、a5、a10、13、15 和 26，段厚度乘以 PENMAX 定义允许的最大穿透量（以段厚度倍数表示）。（见表 0-2。）
EQ.0.0 且旧接触类型为 3、5 和 10：使用小穿透搜索以及由厚度和 XPENE 计算的值，见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 a3、a5、a10、13 和 15：默认值为 0.4，即段厚度的 40%。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 26：默认值为段厚度的 200.0 倍。

Thickness option for contact types 3, 5, and 10:
EQ.0: default is taken from control card, *CONTROL_CONTACT,
EQ.1: thickness offsets are included,
EQ.2: thickness offsets are not included (old way).
接触类型 3、5 和 10 的厚度选项：
EQ.0：采用控制卡中的默认值，即 *CONTROL_CONTACT；
EQ.1：包含厚度偏移量；
EQ.2：不包含厚度偏移量（旧方式）。

Define if and only if THKOPT above equals 1. Shell thickness considered in type surface to surface and node to surface type contact options, where options 1 and 2 below activate the new contact algorithms. The thickness offsets are always included in single surface and constraint method contact types:
EQ.0: thickness is not considered,
EQ.1: thickness is considered but rigid bodies are excluded,
EQ.2: thickness is considered including rigid bodies.
当且仅当上述 THKOPT 值等于 1 时才进行定义。在面-面以及节点-面类型的接触选项中会考虑壳厚，而下面的选项 1 和选项 2 则会启用新的接触算法。对于单面接触以及基于约束方法的接触类型，始终会包含厚度偏移量：
EQ.0：不考虑厚度，
EQ.1：考虑厚度，但不包括刚体，
EQ.2：考虑厚度，且包括刚体。

Disable shooting node logic in thickness offset contact. With the shooting node logic enabled, the first cycle that a tracked node penetrates a reference segment, that node is moved back to the reference surface without applying any contact force.
EQ.0: logic is enabled (default),
EQ.1: logic is skipped (sometimes recommended for metalforming calculations).
在厚度偏移接触中禁用节点投射逻辑。当该逻辑处于启用状态时，一旦被追踪的节点首次穿透参考段，该节点就会在无需施加任何接触力的情况下被移回参考表面。
EQ.0：逻辑处于启用状态（默认值），
EQ.1：跳过该逻辑（金属成形计算有时建议使用）。

Symmetry plane option:
EQ.0: off,
EQ.1: do not include faces with normal boundary constraints (e.g., segments of brick elements on a symmetry plane).
This option is important to retain the correct boundary conditions in the model with symmetry. For the _ERODING_ contacts this option may also be defined on card 4.
对称平面选项：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：不包括具有法向边界约束的面，例如对称平面上的实体单元段。
该选项对于保持对称模型的正确边界条件十分重要。对于 _ERODING_ 接触，也可在第 4 张卡片上定义此选项。

Segment searching option:
EQ.0: search 2D elements (shells) before 3D elements (solids, thick shells) when locating segments.
EQ.1: search 3D (solids, thick shells) elements before 2D elements (shells) when locating segments.
段搜索选项：
EQ.0：定位段时先搜索 2D 单元（壳），再搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳）。
EQ.1：定位段时先搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳），再搜索 2D 单元（壳）。

Optional solid element thickness. A nonzero positive value will activate the contact thickness offsets in the contact algorithms where offsets apply. The contact treatment with then be equivalent to the case where null shell elements are used to cover the brick elements. The contact stiffness parameter below, SLDSTF, may also be used to override the default value.
可选的实体单元厚度。非零正值将会在适用偏移量的接触算法中启用接触厚度偏移功能。此时的接触处理方式等同于使用空壳单元来覆盖砖形实体单元的情况。下述的接触刚度参数 SLDSTF 也可用于替代默认值。

Optional solid element stiffness. A nonzero positive value overrides the bulk modulus taken from the material model referenced by the solid element.
可选的实体单元刚度。非零正值将覆盖由实体单元所引用的材料模型中的体积模量。

For mortar contact IGAP is used to progressively increase contact stiffness for large penetrations, or use a linear relationship between penetration and contact pressure; see remarks on mortar contact below.
For other contacts it is a flag to improve implicit convergence behavior
at the expense of (1) creating some sticking if parts attempt to separate
and (2) possibly underreporting the contact force magnitude in the
output files rcforc and ncforc. (IMPLICIT ONLY.).
LT.0: Like IGAP = 1 except the maximum distance between contact surfaces at which stickiness is on is sacled by IGAP/10.
EQ.1: Apply method to improve convergence (DEFAULT)
EQ.2: Do not apply method
GT.2: Set IGAP = 1 for first IGAP-2 converged equilibrium states,
对于 mortar 接触，IGAP 用于在发生较大穿透时逐步增大接触刚度，或在穿透量与接触压力之间采用线性关系；参见下文关于 mortar 接触的说明。
对于其他接触，IGAP 是改善隐式收敛行为的标志，但代价是：(1) 当部件试图分离时可能产生一定粘连；(2) 可能低估输出文件 rcforc 和 ncforc 中的接触力大小。（仅限 IMPLICIT。）
LT.0：与 IGAP = 1 类似，但发生粘连时接触面之间的最大距离按 IGAP/10 缩放。
EQ.1：应用该方法以改善收敛（默认值）。
EQ.2：不应用该方法。
GT.2：在前 IGAP-2 个收敛平衡状态中将 IGAP = 1。

Ignore initial penetrations for the *CONTACT_AUTOMATIC options:LT.0:Applies only to the Mortar contact.When less than zero, the behavior is the same as for | IGNORE| , but contact between segments belonging to the same part is ignored.
The main purpose of this option is to avoid spurious contact detections that otherwise could result for complicated geometries in a single surface contact, typically, when eliminating initial penetrations by interference.See IGNORE = 3 and IGNORE = 4.
EQ.0 : Take the default value from the fourth card of the* CONTROL_CONTACT input.
EQ.1 : Allow initial penetrations to exist by tracking the initial penetrations.
EQ.2 : Allow initial penetrations to exist by tracking the initial penetrations.However, penetration warning messages are printed with the original coordinates, and the recommended coordinates of each penetrating node are given.For Mortar contact, this is the default (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks section).
EQ.3 : Applies only to the Mortar contact.With this option initial penetrations are eliminated between time zero and the time specified by MPAR1.Intended for small initial penetrations.See Remark 14 in the General Remarks section.
EQ.4 : Applies only to the Mortar contact.With this option initial penetrations are eliminated between time zero and the time specified by MPAR1.In addition, a maximum penetration distance can be given as MPAR2, intended for large initial penetrations.See Remark 14 in the General Remarks section.
针对 *CONTACT_AUTOMATIC 选项，忽略初始穿透现象：LT.0：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。当该值为负数时，其行为与 |IGNORE| 选项相同，但会忽略属于同一部件的各段之间的接触。
设置此选项的主要目的是避免在几何结构较为复杂的情况下出现错误的接触检测，这类情况通常发生在通过干涉消除初始穿透现象时。详情请参见 IGNORE = 3 和 IGNORE = 4 的相关说明。
EQ.0：采用 *CONTROL_CONTACT 输入参数中第四张卡片所指定的默认值。
EQ.1：通过追踪初始穿透现象来允许其存在。
EQ.2：通过追踪初始穿透现象来允许其存在。不过，系统会输出包含原始坐标及每个穿透节点推荐坐标的警告信息。对于 MORTAR 接触类型，这是默认设置（详见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14）。
EQ.3：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。通过该选项，可在时间零点至 MPAR1 指定的时间之间消除初始穿透现象，适用于初始穿透程度较小的情况。详情请参见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14。
EQ.4：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。通过该选项，可在时间零点至 MPAR1 指定的时间之间消除初始穿透现象。此外，还可通过 MPAR2 设定最大穿透距离，适用于初始穿透程度较大的情况。详情请参见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14。

Applies to the SOFT=2 and Mortar contacts. Depth of penetration reduction factor for SOFT=2 contact.
EQ.0.0:Initial penetrations are always ignored.
GT.0.0: Initial penetrations are penalized over time.
LT.0.0:|DPRFAC| is the load curve ID defining DPRFAC versus time.
For the mortar conatact MPAR1 corresponds to initial contact pressure in interfaces with initial penetrations if IGNORE=2, for IGNORE=3,4 it corresponds to the time of closure of initial penetrations.
适用于 SOFT = 2 及 MORTAR 类型的接触对。用于计算 SOFT = 2 类型接触对的穿透深度缩减因子。
EQ.0.0：始终忽略初始穿透量。
GT.0.0：随时间对初始穿透量施加罚值。
LT.0.0：|DPRFAC| 即为定义 DPRFAC 随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。
对于 MORTAR 类型接触对，当 IGNORE = 2 时，MPAR1 对应具有初始穿透量的界面处的初始接触压力；而当 IGNORE = 3、4 时，它对应初始穿透量消失的时间。

Applies to the SOFT=1 and SOFT=2 and Mortar contacts. Time step used in stiffness calculation for SOFT=1 and SOFT=2 contact.
EQ.0.0:Use the initial value that is used for time integration.

Viscous damping coefficient in percent of critical. To avoid undesirable oscillation in contact, e.g., for sheet forming simulation, a contact damping perpendicular to the contacting surfaces is applied.
临界阻尼百分比的黏性阻尼系数。为避免接触振荡（例如板材成形），在接触面法向施加接触阻尼。

Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
接触搜索的小穿透选项。若跟踪节点的穿透量超过段厚度乘 XPENE（见 *CONTROL_CONTACT），则忽略穿透并释放跟踪节点。若段属于壳单元，厚度取壳厚度；若属于实体单元，取其最短对角线的 1/20。适用于面—面接触算法，参见表 0-17。

Birth time (contact surface becomes active at this time):LT.0: Birth time is set to | "BT" | .When negative, birth time is followed during the dynamic relaxation phase of the calculation.After the completion of dynamic relaxation, contact is activated regardless of the value of BT.EQ.0: Birth time is inactive, meaning contact is always activeGT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time; see Remark 2 below.Otherwise, if "DT" > 0, birth time applies both duringand after dynamic relaxation.
接触面激活时间：
LT.0：激活时间设为 |BT|。BT 为负时，在计算的动态松弛阶段跟踪激活时间；动态松弛完成后，无论 BT 取值如何均激活接触。
EQ.0：激活时间无效，即接触始终激活。

Death time (contact surface is deactivated at this time):LT.0: If DT = -9999, BT is interpreted as the curve or table ID defining multiple pairs of birth - time / death - time.Otherwise, negative DT indicates that contact is inactive during dynamic relaxation.After dynamic relaxation the birth and death times are followed and set to | "BT" | and | "DT" | , respectively.EQ.0: DT defaults to 10e20.GT.0: DT sets the time at which the contact is deactivated.

EQ.0：DT 默认值为 10e20。
GT.0：DT 设置接触失活时间。

EQ.2：已设置该标志位。此外，当 CPARM8 设置为 2 时，AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触还会对点焊（类型 9）梁进行特殊处理；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略这类梁。

OPT2：用于调整生成的梁，使其仅影响壳边-壳边接触处理。相关内容也可参见可选卡 E 中的 SRNDE。
EQ.10：在外部壳边缘生成的梁会被移入壳单元内部，位移量为壳厚的一半。因此，壳边-壳边接触始于壳边缘本身，而非壳边缘的延伸部分。

Flag whether this is the MPP card.
标记该卡片是否为 MPP 卡片。

If this value is non-zero, then for the node-to-surface and surface-to-surface contacts LS-DYNA performs a special check at time 0 for elements that are inverted (or nearly so), These elements are removed from contact.  These poorly formed elements have been known to occur on the tooling in metalforming problems, which allows these problems to run.  It should not normally be needed for reasonable meshes.
若该值非零，对于节点–面接触和面–面接触，LS-DYNA 会在时间 0 对倒置或接近倒置的单元进行专项检查，并将其从接触中移除。金属成形问题的模具中可能出现这类质量较差的单元；移除它们可使计算继续进行。对于质量正常的网格，通常无需启用此选项。

This option is used together with IGNORE for 3D forging problems.  If non-zero, the IGNORE penetration distance is multiplied by this value each cycle, effectively pushing the tracked node back out to the surface.  This is useful for nodes that might get generated below the reference surface during 3D remeshing.  Care should be exercised, as energy may be generated and stability may be effected for values lower than 0.95.  A value in the range of 0.98 to 0.99 or higher (but < 1.0) is recommended
该选项在 3D 锻造问题中与 IGNORE 配合使用。若为非零，每个循环中 IGNORE 穿透距离都会乘以该值，从而有效地将跟踪节点推回表面。对于 3D 重网格过程中可能生成在参考面以下的节点，该选项很有用。使用时需谨慎，因为低于 0.95 的值可能产生能量并影响稳定性。建议取 0.98 到 0.99 或更高（但小于 1.0）。

Set to 1 to invoke an alternate MPP communication algorithm for various SINGLE_SURFACE (including AUTOMATIC_GEN-ERAL), NODES_TO_SURFACE, SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, ERODING and SOFT = 2 contacts.  This groupable algorithm does not support all contact options, including MORTAR. It is still under development.  It can be significantly faster and scale better than the normal algorithm when there are more than two or three applicable contact types defined in the model. It is intended for speeding up the contact processing without changing the behavior of the contact.  See also *CONTROL_MPP_-CONTACT_GROUPABLE.
将其设为 1，可为多种 SINGLE_SURFACE（包括 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL）、NODES_TO_SURFACE、SURFACE_TO_SURFACE、ERODING 及 SOFT = 2 接触启用另一种 MPP 通信算法。该可分组算法尚在开发中，并不支持包括 MORTAR 在内的所有接触选项。当模型中定义了两三种以上的适用接触类型时，该算法可能显著快于常规算法，且并行扩展性更好。其目的是在不改变接触行为的情况下加快接触处理。另见 *CONTROL_MPP_CONTACT_GROUPABLE。

Soft constraint option:
EQ.0: Standard penalty formulation,
EQ.1: soft constraint penalty formulation,
EQ.2: pinball segment based contact penalty formulation.
EQ.4: Constraint approach for FORMING contacts. This formulation only applies to one-way forming contacts. You should use it when the penalty formulations result in large penetrations. The results, however, are sensitive to damping.
EQ.6:Special contact algorithm to handle sheet blank edge(deformable) to gage pin(rigid shell) contact during implicit gravity loading.This applies to * CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE only.See remarks under About SOFT = 6
软约束选项：
EQ.0：标准罚函数算法。
EQ.1：软约束罚函数算法。
EQ.2：基于段的 pinball 接触罚函数算法。
EQ.4：成形接触的约束算法，仅适用于单向成形接触。罚函数算法导致较大穿透时应采用此项，但计算结果对阻尼较为敏感。
EQ.6：用于处理隐式重力加载期间可变形板料边缘与刚性壳单元定位销接触的特殊算法。仅适用于 *CONTACT_FORMING_NODES_TO_SURFACE；参见 SOFT = 6 的相关备注。

Scale factor for constraint forces of soft constraint option invoked with SOFT = 1(default=.10). Values greater than .5 for single surface contact and 1.0 for a one way treatment are inadmissible.
SOFT = 1 时启用的软约束选项中，约束力的比例因子（默认值为 0.10）。单面接触不得大于 0.5，单向接触不得大于 1.0。

Load curve ID defining airbag thickness as a function of time for type a13 contact (*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE).
用于定义 a13 类型接触（*CONTACT_AIRBAG_SINGLE_SURFACE）的安全气囊厚度随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Maximum parametric coordinate in segment search (values 1.025 and 1.20 recommended). Larger values can increase cost. If zero, the default is set to 1.025. This factor allows an increase in the size of the segments . May be useful at sharp corners.
段搜索中的最大参数坐标值（建议值为 1.025 和 1.20）。该数值越大，计算成本越高。若设置为零，则默认值为 1.025。此参数可用于增大段的大小，在处理尖角时可能较为有用。

Segment-based contact options (SOFT=2).
EQ.0: defaults to 2.
EQ.1: pinball edge-edge contact (not recommended).
EQ.2: assume planer segments (default).
EQ.3: warped segment checking.
EQ.4: sliding option,
EQ.5: do options 3 and 4.
基于段的接触选项（SOFT = 2）。
EQ.0：默认值为 2。
EQ.1：弹球式边对边接触（不推荐）。
EQ.2：假设为平面段（默认）。
EQ.3：检查变形段。
EQ.4：滑动选项。
EQ.5：同时执行选项 3 和 4。

Search depth in automatic contact. Value of 1 is sufficiently accurate for most crash applications and is much less expensive. LS-DYNA for improved accuracy sets this value to 2. If zero, the default is set to 2.
LT.0: |DEPTH| is the load curve ID defining searching depth versus time.
自动接触搜索深度。对于大多数碰撞分析而言，数值设为 1 即可获得足够精确的结果，且计算成本也更低。为提升精度，LS-DYNA 会将该值设置为 2。若设置为零，则会采用默认值 2。
LT.0：|DEPTH| 为定义搜索深度与时间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of cycles between bucket sorts.  Values of 25 and 100 are recommended for contact types 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) and 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE), respectively.  Values of 10-15 are okay for surface-to-surface and node-to-surface contact.  If zero, LS-DYNA determines the interval.  BSORT applies only to SMP (see BCKT on MPP 1 for MPP) except in the case of SOFT = 2 or for Mortar contact, in which case BSORT applies to both SMP and MPP. For Mortar contact the default is the value associated with NSBCS on *CONTROL_CONTACT.
LT.0: |BSORT| is the load curve ID defining bucket sorting frequency as a function of time.
桶排序之间的循环次数。接触类型 4 (SINGLE_SURFACE) 和 13 (AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE) 分别建议使用 25 和 100。对于面-面接触和节点-面接触，10-15 均可。如果为 0，LS-DYNA 确定间隔。BSORT 仅适用于 SMP（参见 MPP 1 中的 BCKT），但在 SOFT = 2 或 Mortar 接触时，BSORT 同时适用于 SMP 和 MPP。对于 Mortar 接触，默认值为 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中 NSBCS 对应的值。
LT.0：|BSORT| 是载荷曲线 ID，用于定义随时间变化的桶排序频率。

Number of cycles between contact force updates for penalty contact formulations. This option can provide a significant speed-up of the contact treatment. If used, values exceeding 3 or 4 are dangerous. Considerable care must be exercised when using this option, as this option assumes that contact does not change FRCFRG cycles.
EQ.0: FRCFRG is set to 1 and force calculations are performed each cycle-strongly recommended.
罚函数接触算法中两次接触力更新之间的循环数。该选项可显著加快接触处理。若启用，取值超过 3 或 4 会带来风险，必须谨慎使用，因为该选项假定接触状态在 FRCFRG 个循环内不发生变化。
EQ.0：将 FRCFRG 设为 1，每个循环均计算接触力；强烈建议采用此设置。

For old types 3, 5, 8, 9, 10 (see Mapping of *CONTACT keyword option to contact type in d3hsp at the end of General Remarks) and Mortar contact, PENMAX is the maximum penetration distance. For contact types a3, a5, a10, 13, 15, and 26, the segment thickness multiplied by PENMAX defines the maximum penetration allowed (as a multiple of the segment thickness).  (See Table 0-2.):):
EQ.0.0 for old type contacts 3, 5, and 10: Use small penetration search and value calculated from thickness and XPENE, see *CONTROL_ CONTACT.
EQ.0.0 for contact types a 3, a 5, a10, 13, and 15: Default is 0.4, or 40 percent of the segment thickness
EQ.0.0 for contact type26: Default is 200.0 times the segment thickness
对于旧类型 3、5、8、9、10（见通用备注末尾 d3hsp 中 *CONTACT 关键字选项到接触类型的映射）以及 Mortar 接触，PENMAX 为最大穿透距离。对于接触类型 a3、a5、a10、13、15 和 26，段厚度乘以 PENMAX 定义允许的最大穿透量（以段厚度倍数表示）。（见表 0-2。）
EQ.0.0 且旧接触类型为 3、5 和 10：使用小穿透搜索以及由厚度和 XPENE 计算的值，见 *CONTROL_CONTACT。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 a3、a5、a10、13 和 15：默认值为 0.4，即段厚度的 40%。
EQ.0.0 且接触类型为 26：默认值为段厚度的 200.0 倍。

Thickness option for contact types 3, 5, and 10:
EQ.0: default is taken from control card, *CONTROL_CONTACT,
EQ.1: thickness offsets are included,
EQ.2: thickness offsets are not included (old way).
接触类型 3、5 和 10 的厚度选项：
EQ.0：采用控制卡中的默认值，即 *CONTROL_CONTACT；
EQ.1：包含厚度偏移量；
EQ.2：不包含厚度偏移量（旧方式）。

Define if and only if THKOPT above equals 1. Shell thickness considered in type surface to surface and node to surface type contact options, where options 1 and 2 below activate the new contact algorithms. The thickness offsets are always included in single surface and constraint method contact types:
EQ.0: thickness is not considered,
EQ.1: thickness is considered but rigid bodies are excluded,
EQ.2: thickness is considered including rigid bodies.
当且仅当上述 THKOPT 值等于 1 时才进行定义。在面-面以及节点-面类型的接触选项中会考虑壳厚，而下面的选项 1 和选项 2 则会启用新的接触算法。对于单面接触以及基于约束方法的接触类型，始终会包含厚度偏移量：
EQ.0：不考虑厚度，
EQ.1：考虑厚度，但不包括刚体，
EQ.2：考虑厚度，且包括刚体。

Disable shooting node logic in thickness offset contact. With the shooting node logic enabled, the first cycle that a tracked node penetrates a reference segment, that node is moved back to the reference surface without applying any contact force.
EQ.0: logic is enabled (default),
EQ.1: logic is skipped (sometimes recommended for metalforming calculations).
在厚度偏移接触中禁用节点投射逻辑。当该逻辑处于启用状态时，一旦被追踪的节点首次穿透参考段，该节点就会在无需施加任何接触力的情况下被移回参考表面。
EQ.0：逻辑处于启用状态（默认值），
EQ.1：跳过该逻辑（金属成形计算有时建议使用）。

Symmetry plane option:
EQ.0: off,
EQ.1: do not include faces with normal boundary constraints (e.g., segments of brick elements on a symmetry plane).
This option is important to retain the correct boundary conditions in the model with symmetry. For the _ERODING_ contacts this option may also be defined on card 4.
对称平面选项：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：不包括具有法向边界约束的面，例如对称平面上的实体单元段。
该选项对于保持对称模型的正确边界条件十分重要。对于 _ERODING_ 接触，也可在第 4 张卡片上定义此选项。

Segment searching option:
EQ.0: search 2D elements (shells) before 3D elements (solids, thick shells) when locating segments.
EQ.1: search 3D (solids, thick shells) elements before 2D elements (shells) when locating segments.
段搜索选项：
EQ.0：定位段时先搜索 2D 单元（壳），再搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳）。
EQ.1：定位段时先搜索 3D 单元（实体、厚壳），再搜索 2D 单元（壳）。

Optional solid element thickness. A nonzero positive value will activate the contact thickness offsets in the contact algorithms where offsets apply. The contact treatment with then be equivalent to the case where null shell elements are used to cover the brick elements. The contact stiffness parameter below, SLDSTF, may also be used to override the default value.
可选的实体单元厚度。非零正值将会在适用偏移量的接触算法中启用接触厚度偏移功能。此时的接触处理方式等同于使用空壳单元来覆盖砖形实体单元的情况。下述的接触刚度参数 SLDSTF 也可用于替代默认值。

Optional solid element stiffness. A nonzero positive value overrides the bulk modulus taken from the material model referenced by the solid element.
可选的实体单元刚度。非零正值将覆盖由实体单元所引用的材料模型中的体积模量。

For mortar contact IGAP is used to progressively increase contact stiffness for large penetrations, or use a linear relationship between penetration and contact pressure; see remarks on mortar contact below.
For other contacts it is a flag to improve implicit convergence behavior
at the expense of (1) creating some sticking if parts attempt to separate
and (2) possibly underreporting the contact force magnitude in the
output files rcforc and ncforc. (IMPLICIT ONLY.).
LT.0: Like IGAP = 1 except the maximum distance between contact surfaces at which stickiness is on is sacled by IGAP/10.
EQ.1: Apply method to improve convergence (DEFAULT)
EQ.2: Do not apply method
GT.2: Set IGAP = 1 for first IGAP-2 converged equilibrium states,
对于 mortar 接触，IGAP 用于在发生较大穿透时逐步增大接触刚度，或在穿透量与接触压力之间采用线性关系；参见下文关于 mortar 接触的说明。
对于其他接触，IGAP 是改善隐式收敛行为的标志，但代价是：(1) 当部件试图分离时可能产生一定粘连；(2) 可能低估输出文件 rcforc 和 ncforc 中的接触力大小。（仅限 IMPLICIT。）
LT.0：与 IGAP = 1 类似，但发生粘连时接触面之间的最大距离按 IGAP/10 缩放。
EQ.1：应用该方法以改善收敛（默认值）。
EQ.2：不应用该方法。
GT.2：在前 IGAP-2 个收敛平衡状态中将 IGAP = 1。

Ignore initial penetrations for the *CONTACT_AUTOMATIC options:LT.0:Applies only to the Mortar contact.When less than zero, the behavior is the same as for | IGNORE| , but contact between segments belonging to the same part is ignored.
The main purpose of this option is to avoid spurious contact detections that otherwise could result for complicated geometries in a single surface contact, typically, when eliminating initial penetrations by interference.See IGNORE = 3 and IGNORE = 4.
EQ.0 : Take the default value from the fourth card of the* CONTROL_CONTACT input.
EQ.1 : Allow initial penetrations to exist by tracking the initial penetrations.
EQ.2 : Allow initial penetrations to exist by tracking the initial penetrations.However, penetration warning messages are printed with the original coordinates, and the recommended coordinates of each penetrating node are given.For Mortar contact, this is the default (see Remark 14 in the General Remarks section).
EQ.3 : Applies only to the Mortar contact.With this option initial penetrations are eliminated between time zero and the time specified by MPAR1.Intended for small initial penetrations.See Remark 14 in the General Remarks section.
EQ.4 : Applies only to the Mortar contact.With this option initial penetrations are eliminated between time zero and the time specified by MPAR1.In addition, a maximum penetration distance can be given as MPAR2, intended for large initial penetrations.See Remark 14 in the General Remarks section.
针对 *CONTACT_AUTOMATIC 选项，忽略初始穿透现象：LT.0：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。当该值为负数时，其行为与 |IGNORE| 选项相同，但会忽略属于同一部件的各段之间的接触。
设置此选项的主要目的是避免在几何结构较为复杂的情况下出现错误的接触检测，这类情况通常发生在通过干涉消除初始穿透现象时。详情请参见 IGNORE = 3 和 IGNORE = 4 的相关说明。
EQ.0：采用 *CONTROL_CONTACT 输入参数中第四张卡片所指定的默认值。
EQ.1：通过追踪初始穿透现象来允许其存在。
EQ.2：通过追踪初始穿透现象来允许其存在。不过，系统会输出包含原始坐标及每个穿透节点推荐坐标的警告信息。对于 MORTAR 接触类型，这是默认设置（详见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14）。
EQ.3：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。通过该选项，可在时间零点至 MPAR1 指定的时间之间消除初始穿透现象，适用于初始穿透程度较小的情况。详情请参见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14。
EQ.4：仅适用于 MORTAR 接触类型。通过该选项，可在时间零点至 MPAR1 指定的时间之间消除初始穿透现象。此外，还可通过 MPAR2 设定最大穿透距离，适用于初始穿透程度较大的情况。详情请参见“一般说明”章节中的备注 14。

Applies to the SOFT=2 and Mortar contacts. Depth of penetration reduction factor for SOFT=2 contact.
EQ.0.0:Initial penetrations are always ignored.
GT.0.0: Initial penetrations are penalized over time.
LT.0.0:|DPRFAC| is the load curve ID defining DPRFAC versus time.
For the mortar conatact MPAR1 corresponds to initial contact pressure in interfaces with initial penetrations if IGNORE=2, for IGNORE=3,4 it corresponds to the time of closure of initial penetrations.
适用于 SOFT = 2 及 MORTAR 类型的接触对。用于计算 SOFT = 2 类型接触对的穿透深度缩减因子。
EQ.0.0：始终忽略初始穿透量。
GT.0.0：随时间对初始穿透量施加罚值。
LT.0.0：|DPRFAC| 即为定义 DPRFAC 随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。
对于 MORTAR 类型接触对，当 IGNORE = 2 时，MPAR1 对应具有初始穿透量的界面处的初始接触压力；而当 IGNORE = 3、4 时，它对应初始穿透量消失的时间。

Applies to the SOFT=1 and SOFT=2 and Mortar contacts. Time step used in stiffness calculation for SOFT=1 and SOFT=2 contact.
EQ.0.0:Use the initial value that is used for time integration.
GT.0.0: Use the value specified.
LT.-0.01 and GT.-1.0: use a moving average of the solution time step. (SOFT=2 only).
LT.-1.0: |DTSTIF| is the load curve ID defining DTSTIF versus time.
For the mortar contact and IGNORE=4, MPAR2 corresponds a penetration depth that must be at least the penetration occurring in the contact interface.
适用于 SOFT = 1、SOFT = 2 和 Mortar 接触。该时间步用于计算 SOFT = 1 和 SOFT = 2 接触刚度。
EQ.0.0：采用时间积分所用的初始值。
GT.0.0：采用指定值。
LT.-0.01 且 GT.-1.0：即 -1.0 < DTSTIF < -0.01 时，采用求解时间步的移动平均值（仅适用于 SOFT = 2）。
LT.-1.0：|DTSTIF| 为定义 DTSTIF 随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。
对于 Mortar 接触且 IGNORE = 4，MPAR2 为穿透深度，其值必须至少达到接触界面中发生的穿透深度。

Scale factor for penalty stiffness of edge to edge contact when SOFT = 2 and DEPTH = 5, 15, 25, or 35:
EQ.0.0: Use the default penalty stiffness.
GT.0.0: Scale the stiffness by EDGEK.
当 SOFT 设为 2 且 DEPTH 设为 5、15、25 或 35 时，边缘对边缘接触的罚函数刚度比例因子：
EQ.0.0：使用默认的罚函数刚度。

Angle tolerance in radians for feature lines option in smooth contact.
EQ.0.0:No feature line is considered for surface fitting in smooth contact.

“平滑接触”模式中特征线选项所对应的角度容差（单位为弧度）。
EQ.0.0：在“平滑接触”模式的表面拟合过程中，不考虑任何特征线。

Coordinate system ID to output RCFORC force resultants in a local system.
坐标系 ID，用于在局部坐标系中输出 RCFORC 合力。

Option to split quadrilateral contact segments into two triangles (only available when SOFT=2).
EQ.0:Off (default).
EQ.1:On for all SURFA shell segments.
EQ.2:On for all SURFB shell segments.
EQ.3:On for all shell segments.
EQ.4:On for all shell segments of material type 34.
将四边形接触段拆分为两个三角形的选项（仅当 SOFT = 2 时可用）。
EQ.0：关闭（默认值）。
EQ.1：对所有 SURFA 壳单元段启用该功能。
EQ.2：对所有 SURFB 壳单元段启用该功能。

Time interval between shell penetration reports (only available for segment based contact)
EQ.0.0:Off (default).
GT.0.0:  Check and report segment penetrations at time intervals equal to DTPCHK.
LT.0.0:Check and report segment penetrations at time intervals equal to |DTPCHK|. In addition, calculation stops with an error at t=0 if any intersections are initially present
壳单元穿透报告的时间间隔（仅适用于基于段的接触）：
EQ.0.0：关闭（默认值）。

Small penetration in the contact search option. The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element. Small penetration in the contact search option.  If the tracked node penetrates more than the segment thickness times the factor XPENE (see *CONTROL_CONTACT), the penetration is ignored, and the tracked node is set free.  The thickness is taken as the shell thickness if the segment belongs to a shell element or it is taken as 1/20 of its shortest diagonal if the segment belongs to a solid element.  This option applies to the surface-to-surface contact algorithms.  See Table 0-17 for contact types and more details.
