Type of regions defined by the parameters PARi:
EQ.1: Box.PAR1 is the ID of *DEFINE_BOX that defines the region to remesh.The other parameters are not used.
EQ.2: Part set.PAR1 is the ID of *SET_PART that selects the parts to remesh.The other parameters are not used.
EQ.3: Region around elements in contact from a specified contact.To specify the desired contact, set PAR1 to its order of appearance in the input deck.For instance, PAR1 = 5 if the desired contact is the 5th contact keyword to appear in the input deck.A box is created around each element in contact for the remeshing.PAR2 through PAR4 add padding around the box to increase the remeshing region.PAR2 > 0 is the length subtracted from the x - coordinate of the boxs lower corner.PAR3 > 0 is the length added to the x - coordinate of the boxs upper corner.PAR4 > 0 is the length subtracted from the y - coordinate of the boxs lower corner.PAR5 > 0 is the length added to the y - coordinate of the boxs upper corner.The last 2 parameters are not used.
EQ.4: PAR1 is the ID of *DEFINE_BOX that selects mesh boundaries (edges) of remeshing regions along which nodes added after remeshing(Hanging nodes between edge ends) keep their initial parametric positions between the boundary corner nodesedge-end constraining nodes).The other parameters are not used.By default, when nodes are added to the edges of elements in the regionand the edges are not on the mesh boundary, the positionsand velocities of the hanging nodes are interpolated from the positionsand velocities of the original constraining nodes along these edges(constraining nodes are nodes that existed before remeshing).If the edge of a remeshed element is on the mesh boundaries, the positionsand velocities of the hanging nodes on the edge are, by default, not interpolated because they are likely to be subject to boundary conditions.With LTYP = 4, the hanging nodes on the boundary of the mesh are interpolated.
EQ.5: PAR1 is the ID of *SET_NODE that selects nodes along shell edges. After remeshing, the node set is recreated with nodes along the same shell edges. PAR2>0 is a thickness for the shell edges to select the new nodes after remeshing. The other parameters are not used.
EQ.6: PAR1 is the ID of *SET_PART that selects the parts for which the total displacements are output in D3PLOT after remeshings.
EQ.7: PAR1 is the ID of *SET_SHELL that selects the shells to remesh.The other parameters are not used.
EQ.8: PAR1 is the ID of a 2D *SET_SEGMENT that selects the shells to remesh. A 2D *SET_SEGMENT is a list of segments with 2 nodes (the 2nd node is repeated for the 3rd and 4th node IDs). A 2D segment normal points to right when going from the 1st to the 2nd node. A shell is in the region if nominally all the segment normal point towards it (see Figure 0-1 for illustration). The other parameters are not used
EQ.9: PAR1 is the ID of a *SET_PART that selects the shell parts for which an area-weighted mapping of the element data  is applied. The other parameters are not used.If PAR1 is 0, all parts are selected to be mapped.
EQ.10: PAR1 is the ID of *DEFINE_CURVE that lists coordinate couples (x,y) to make a closed curve (the last point in this list is the same as the first one). The region of shells to remesh is on the right when moving along the curve from its 1st to last point.
参数 PARi 定义的区域类型：
EQ.1：框。PAR1 是定义待重网格区域的 *DEFINE_BOX 的 ID；其他参数未使用。
EQ.2：部件集。PAR1 是选择待重网格部件的 *SET_PART 的 ID；其他参数未使用。
EQ.3：指定接触中接触单元周围的区域。要指定目标接触，将 PAR1 设为其在输入文件中的出现顺序。例如，若目标接触是输入文件中出现的第 5 个接触关键字，则 PAR1 = 5。重网格时，在每个接触单元周围创建一个框。PAR2 至 PAR5 在框周围增加余量，以扩大重网格区域。PAR2 > 0 表示从框下角的 x 坐标减去的长度；PAR3 > 0 表示加到框上角 x 坐标的长度；PAR4 > 0 表示从框下角 y 坐标减去的长度；PAR5 > 0 表示加到框上角 y 坐标的长度。最后两个参数未使用。
EQ.4：PAR1 是 *DEFINE_BOX 的 ID，用于选择重网格区域的网格边界（边）；重网格后添加的节点（边端之间的悬挂节点）在边界角点/边端约束节点之间保持初始参数位置。其他参数未使用。默认情况下，当在区域内单元的边上添加节点且这些边不在网格边界上时，悬挂节点的位置和速度沿这些边由原约束节点（重网格前已存在的节点）插值得到。如果重网格单元的边位于网格边界上，默认不对该边上的悬挂节点插值，因为它们可能受边界条件约束。LTYP = 4 时，会对网格边界上的悬挂节点进行插值。
EQ.5：PAR1 是选择壳边节点的 *SET_NODE 的 ID。重网格后，将用同一壳边上的节点重新创建节点集。PAR2 > 0 是用于选择重网格后新节点的壳边厚度；其他参数未使用。
EQ.6：PAR1 是选择部件的 *SET_PART 的 ID；重网格后，这些部件的总位移将输出到 D3PLOT。
EQ.7：PAR1 是选择待重网格壳单元的 *SET_SHELL 的 ID；其他参数未使用。
EQ.8：PAR1 是选择待重网格壳单元的二维 *SET_SEGMENT 的 ID。二维 *SET_SEGMENT 是由 2 节点段组成的列表（第 2 个节点会重复作为第 3、4 个节点 ID）。沿从第 1 个节点到第 2 个节点的方向行进时，二维段法向指向右侧。若名义上所有段法向都指向某壳，则该壳位于区域内（参见图 0-1）；其他参数未使用。
EQ.9：PAR1 是选择壳部件的 *SET_PART 的 ID，对这些部件应用按面积加权的单元数据映射；其他参数未使用。若 PAR1 = 0，则选择所有部件进行映射。
EQ.10：PAR1 是 *DEFINE_CURVE 的 ID，该曲线列出坐标对 (x,y) 以构成闭合曲线（列表中的最后一点与第一点相同）。沿曲线从第一点移动到最后一点时，待重网格的壳区域位于右侧。

This flag can have two meanings depending on whether the memory environmental variable is or is not set.  The command setenv LSTC_MEMORY auto (or for bourne shell export LSTC_MEMORY=auto) sets the memory environmental variable which causes LS-DYNA to expand memory automatically.  Note that automatic memory expansion is not always 100% reliable depending on the machine and operating system level; consequently, it is not yet the default.  To see if this is set on a particular machine type the command env.  If the environmental variable is not set then when memory usage reaches this percentage, MEMORY, further adaptivity is prevented to avoid exceeding the memory specified at execution time.  Caution is necessary since memory usage is checked after each adaptive step, and, if the memory usage increases by more than the residual percentage, 100-PERCENT, the calculation will terminate.
If the memory environmental variable is set then when the number of words of memory allocated reaches or exceeds this value, MEMORY, further adaptivity is stopped.
该标志的含义取决于是否设置内存环境变量。执行 setenv LSTC_MEMORY auto（或 Bourne 壳中 export LSTC_MEMORY=auto）可设置该变量，使 LS-DYNA 自动扩展内存；由于受机器和操作系统影响并非始终可靠，故不是默认行为。可输入 env 检查变量是否设置。若未设置，当内存使用达到 MEMORY 百分比时，停止进一步自适应以避免超过执行时指定内存；内存使用在每个自适应步后检查，若增加量超过剩余百分比 100−MEMORY，计算将终止。若已设置环境变量，当分配的内存字数达到或超过 MEMORY 值时停止进一步自适应。

This option applies to the FORMING contact option only.  If this flag is set to one (1), the user orientation for the contact interface is used.  If this flag is set to zero (0), LS-DYNA sets the global orientation of the contact surface the first time a potential contact is observed after the birth time.   If tracked nodes are found on both sides of the contact surface, the orientation is set based on the principle of majority rules. Experience has shown that this principle is not always reliable.

Note that automatic memory expansion is not always 100% reliable depending on the machine and operating system level; consequently, it is not yet the default.  To see if this is set on a particular machine type the command env.  If the environmental variable is not set then when memory usage reaches this percentage, MEMORY, further adaptivity is prevented to avoid exceeding the memory specified at execution time.  Caution is necessary since memory usage is checked after each adaptive step, and, if the memory usage increases by more than the residual percentage, 100-PERCENT, the calculation will terminate.
If the memory environmental variable is set then when the number of words of memory allocated reaches or exceeds this value, MEMORY, further adaptivity is stopped.
该标志的含义取决于是否设置内存环境变量。执行 setenv LSTC_MEMORY auto（或 Bourne 壳中 export LSTC_MEMORY=auto）可设置该变量，使 LS-DYNA 自动扩展内存；由于受机器和操作系统影响并非始终可靠，故不是默认行为。可输入 env 检查变量是否设置。若未设置，当内存使用达到 MEMORY 百分比时，停止进一步自适应以避免超过执行时指定内存；内存使用在每个自适应步后检查，若增加量超过剩余百分比 100−MEMORY，计算将终止。若已设置环境变量，当分配的内存字数达到或超过 MEMORY 值时停止进一步自适应。

This option applies to the FORMING contact option only.  If this flag is set to one (1), the user orientation for the contact interface is used.  If this flag is set to zero (0), LS-DYNA sets the global orientation of the contact surface the first time a potential contact is observed after the birth time.   If tracked nodes are found on both sides of the contact surface, the orientation is set based on the principle of majority rules. Experience has shown that this principle is not always reliable.

This option controls the behavior of spot welds when the parent element erodes.  When SPOTDEL is set to 1, the beam or solid spot weld is deleted, and the tied constraint is removed when the parent element erodes.  The parent element is the element to which the SURFA node is attached using the TIED interface.  This option also works for SPRs, namely, they automatically fail if at least one of the parent elements fails.  To avoid instabilities, this option should be set to 1 whenever the parent element is expected to erode.
EQ.0:    Do not delete the spot weld beam, solid element, or SPR.
EQ.1 : Delete the spot weld elements or SPRs when the attached shells on one side of the element fail.
GT.1 : Delete the SPR when SPOTDEL nodes are attached to failed elements in the search radius.
On vector processors, this option can significantly slow down the calculation if many weld elements fail since the vector lengths are reduced.On non - vector processors, the cost penalty is minimal.
此选项控制父单元侵蚀时点焊的行为。SPOTDEL=1 时，父单元侵蚀后删除梁或实体点焊，并移除固连约束；父单元是通过 TIED 界面连接 SURFA 节点的单元。对 SPR 也有效：至少一个父单元失效时 SPR 自动失效。为避免不稳定，只要预计父单元会侵蚀就应设为 1。

Optional thickness scale factor. If active, define a factor greater than zero, but less than one. Premature failure of spot welds can occur
due to contact of the spot welded parts in the vicinity of the spot weld. This contact creates tensile forces in the spot weld.
Although this may seem physical, the compressive forces generated in the contact are large enough to fail the weld in tension before failure is observed in an
experimental test. With this option, the thickness of the parts in the vicinity of the weld is automatically scaled, the contact forces do not develop, and the problem is avoided.
We recommend setting the IGNORE option to 1 or 2 if SPOTHIN is active. In MPP, this option applies to all non-Mortar contacts that have SINGLE_SURFACE, AUTOMATIC_GENERAL,
SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, or NODES_TO_SURFACE in the name. In SMP it only applies to the AUTOMATIC_SINGLE_SURFACE option. See Remark 5.

Directional tie for MPP non-groupable tied contacts. If this flag is set to 1, then each node in the SURFA side of a tied contact is associated with outward normal vectors. A node belonging to the surface of a shell, solid, or thick shell surface is associated with one or more vectors depending on the angle between adjacent segments. Typically the node of a flat surface will have one normal vector, the node of an edge will have two normal vectors, and the node of a corner will have three normal vectors. Nodes on a cylinder may have one or two normal vectors, depending on the mesh resolution of the faceted surface. When deciding which SURFB segment to tie to, the algorithm gives preference to those segments for which the direction from the SURFA node to the SURFB segment has a positive dot product with at least one of the aforementioned normal vectors. Therefore, a SURFA node will not necessarily tie to the closest SURFB segment, but to the correct segment. This feature avoids nonphysical tie situations or even zero solid element volumes as a result.
MPP 不可分组绑定接触的方向性绑定。若标志设为 1，SURFA 侧每个节点都关联指向外侧的法向向量。壳、实体或厚壳表面节点根据相邻段夹角关联一个或多个向量：平面节点通常一个，边缘节点两个，角点节点三个；圆柱节点根据面片网格分辨率可能一个或两个。选择要绑定的 SURFB 段时，算法优先选择从 SURFA 节点到 SURFB 段的方向与至少一个上述法向量点积为正的段。因此不一定绑定最近段，而是绑定正确段，从而避免非物理绑定甚至实体单元体积为零。

Tool mesh checking/fixing flag:
ICHECK.EQ.0: Do not activate mesh checking/fixing feature.
ICHECK.EQ.1: Activate comprehensive mesh check and fix those problematic tool meshes which cause unreasonable forming results and/or error termination.  The keyword with this variable only can be inserted in any regular forming simulation; the simulation will continue after tool mesh checking/fixing is done, see Example 1.  The fixed tool meshes can be viewed and recovered from the resulting D3PLOT files.  If the termination time is set to 0.0 or the keyword *CONTROL_TERMINATION is absent all together, the simulation will terminate as soon as  checking/fixing is completed, and fixed tool meshes can be extracted from the D3PLOT files.

Not used.

EQ.1: Perform rigid tool mesh offset using the variable SBST(see Figure 0 - 1) as specified on a *CONTACT_FORMING_ card.The blank must be definedand positioned completely above or below the rigid tool to be offset.Both part ID and part SID(SURFBTYP) can be used in defining SURFB.IOUTPUT must also be defined.

Number of nodes to skip in bucket searching.  NSKIP of 1 does not skip any nodes in searching therefore computing speed is the slowest but accuracy is the highest. Optional flag to define a node set to be included or excluded in the best fitting.  The node set can be defined in a file that also includes the part to be best fitted to the target mesh.  Only keyword cards *NODE, *ELEMENT_SHELL and *CONSTRAINED_ADAPTIVITY (if applicable) need to be present in the file. The file can be included in an input deck (Example 1) using *INCLUDE.  A node set can be defined using LS-PrePost via menu options ModelCreEntSet Data*SET_NODECre.
IFSET.EQ.0: all nodes in the included file will be best fitted.
IFSET.GT.0: the input value is a node set ID; only the nodes in the set will be best fitted.
IFSET.LT.0: the absolute value is a node set ID; all nodes excluding those in the set will be best fitted.
用于定义纳入或排除最佳拟合节点集的可选标志。节点集可在一个文件中定义，该文件还包含要与目标网格进行最佳拟合的部件。文件中只需包含关键字卡片 *NODE、*ELEMENT_SHELL 和 *CONSTRAINED_ADAPTIVITY（如适用）。可以在输入文件中使用 *INCLUDE 包含该文件（示例 1）。也可通过 LS-PrePost 的菜单选项 ModelCreEntSet Data*SET_NODECre 定义节点集。
IFSET.EQ.0：包含文件中的所有节点都将参与最佳拟合。
IFSET.GT.0：输入值为节点集 ID；只有集合中的节点参与最佳拟合。
IFSET.LT.0：绝对值为节点集 ID；除集合中节点之外的所有节点参与最佳拟合。

An optional node set ID of three nodes from the source mesh.  The nodes should be selected based on distinctive geometry features, such as, the center of an arc, the center of a dart, or the end node of a take-up bead (see Example 3 and Figure 0-2).  The three nodes must not be aligned in one straight line.  Define NSETS only if the orientation of the source mesh deviates from the target is large (>~more than 30 degrees in any direction).  This is the recommended method.
可选的源网格中三个节点对应的节点集 ID。这些节点应依据明显的几何特征来选取，例如弧线的中点、突起的中点，或是卷边筋的末端节点（参见示例 3 与图 0-2）。这三个节点绝不能共线。仅当源网格与目标网格的姿态差异较大（任意方向上超过约 30 度）时才需定义 NSETS。这是推荐的方法。注意。

An optional node set ID from the target mesh, consists of the corresponding three nodes from the same geometry features of the source mesh.  The three nodes should be input in the same order as those from the source mesh.  Approximate locations are acceptable.  Define NSETT only if NSETS is defined.  See Example 3 and Figure 0-2 for details.  This is the recommended method.
可选的目标网格节点集 ID，由源网格中具有相同几何特征的三个对应节点组成。这三个节点的输入顺序应与源网格中的顺序一致，位置近似即可。仅当定义了 NSETS 时才需要定义 NSETT。详细内容请参见示例 3 与图 0-2。这是推荐的实现方法。

A node set can be defined using LS-PrePost via menu options ModelCreEntSet Data*SET_NODECre.
IFSET.EQ.0: all nodes in the included file will be best fitted.
IFSET.GT.0: the input value is a node set ID; only the nodes in the set will be best fitted.
IFSET.LT.0: the absolute value is a node set ID; all nodes excluding those in the set will be best fitted.
用于定义纳入或排除最佳拟合节点集的可选标志。节点集可在一个文件中定义，该文件还包含要与目标网格进行最佳拟合的部件。文件中只需包含关键字卡片 *NODE、*ELEMENT_SHELL 和 *CONSTRAINED_ADAPTIVITY（如适用）。可以在输入文件中使用 *INCLUDE 包含该文件（示例 1）。也可通过 LS-PrePost 的菜单选项 ModelCreEntSet Data*SET_NODECre 定义节点集。
IFSET.EQ.0：包含文件中的所有节点都将参与最佳拟合。
IFSET.GT.0：输入值为节点集 ID；只有集合中的节点参与最佳拟合。
IFSET.LT.0：绝对值为节点集 ID；除集合中节点之外的所有节点参与最佳拟合。

An optional node set ID of three nodes from the source mesh.  The nodes should be selected based on distinctive geometry features, such as, the center of an arc, the center of a dart, or the end node of a take-up bead (see Example 3 and Figure 0-2).  The three nodes must not be aligned in one straight line.  Define NSETS only if the orientation of the source mesh deviates from the target is large (>~more than 30 degrees in any direction).  This is the recommended method.
可选的源网格中三个节点对应的节点集 ID。这些节点应依据明显的几何特征来选取，例如弧线的中点、突起的中点，或是卷边筋的末端节点（参见示例 3 与图 0-2）。这三个节点绝不能共线。仅当源网格与目标网格的姿态差异较大（任意方向上超过约 30 度）时才需定义 NSETS。这是推荐的方法。注意。

An optional node set ID from the target mesh, consists of the corresponding three nodes from the same geometry features of the source mesh.  The three nodes should be input in the same order as those from the source mesh.  Approximate locations are acceptable.  Define NSETT only if NSETS is defined.  See Example 3 and Figure 0-2 for details.  This is the recommended method.
可选的目标网格节点集 ID，由源网格中具有相同几何特征的三个对应节点组成。这三个节点的输入顺序应与源网格中的顺序一致，位置近似即可。仅当定义了 NSETS 时才需要定义 NSETT。详细内容请参见示例 3 与图 0-2。这是推荐的实现方法。

EQ.1: Rectangle shape.
Find the smallest possible untrimmed rectangle depending on the requested element length and edge size in z and y, create quad elements with the same edge length and afterwards trim the elements at the requested edge size in z and y (like *ELEMENT_BALNKING). In order to make sure that the last row of elements does not have a smaller element lenght (bad time step size) after trimming than the requested eleng the last two wlement rows will be optimized and then the element size can be even larger;
.EQ.2: import blank outline as IGES-Curve.
Import an iges file of the desired blank shape as a curve. Find the smallest possible untrimmed rectangle depending on the requested element lenght and the blank outline, create quad elements with the same edge elength and afterwards trim the elements at the blank outline ( like *ELEMENT_BLANKING). In order to make sure that the last row of elements geoes not have a smaller wlement lenght (bad time step size) after trimming than the requested eleng the last two wlement rows will be optimized and then the element size can be even larger
EQ.1：矩形形状。
根据所需的单元长度以及 z 和 y 方向上的边长，确定最小的未修剪矩形，然后创建具有相同边长的四边形单元，最后按照要求的 z 和 y 方向边长对单元进行修剪（类似于 *ELEMENT_BALNKING）。为确保修剪后最后一行的单元长度不会小于所需长度（即避免出现过小的时间步长），会对最后两行单元进行优化处理，从而使单元尺寸更大。
EQ.2：将板料轮廓作为 IGES 曲线导入。
将具有所需板料形状的 IGES 文件作为曲线导入。根据所需的单元长度以及板料轮廓，确定最小的未修剪矩形，然后创建具有相同边长的四边形单元，最后按照板料轮廓对单元进行修剪（类似于 *ELEMENT_BLANKING）。为确保修剪后最后一行的单元长度不会小于所需长度（即避免出现过小的时间步长），会对最后两行单元进行优化处理，从而使单元尺寸更大。注意。

Setting I2DYNAIN to 1 will cause this keyword to be output to a dynain file with the updated maximum node and element IDs. This output simplifies post-processing for multi-step processes since it ensures that element and node IDs generated in subsequent steps are larger than those in previous steps. By default, this keyword is not output to a dynain file.
将 I2DYNAIN 设为 1 后，该关键字会连同更新后的最大节点和单元 ID 输出到 dynain 文件。这样可确保后续步骤生成的单元和节点 ID 大于先前步骤，从而简化多步工艺的后处理。默认不将该关键字输出到 dynain 文件。

If nonzero, it defines a thickness scale factor limiting the maximum thickness in the part.  See Remark 12. For example, if the maximum thickness allowed is 0.8 mm for a blank with an initial thickness of 0.75 mm, TSCLMAX can be set to 1.0667.  All thicknesses that are computed as more than 0.8 mm in the sheet blank will be reset to 0.8 mm.  The scale factor is useful in advance feasibility analysis, where part design and stamping process have not been finalized, and could potentially cause large splits or severe wrinkles during unfolding, rendering the forming results unusable for crash/safety simulation.
若非零，定义限制部件最大厚度的厚度比例因子（见备注 12）。例如，初始厚度为 0.75 mm 的板坯允许最大厚度为 0.8 mm 时，可将 TSCLMAX 设为 1.0667。板坯中计算超过 0.8 mm 的所有厚度均重置为 0.8 mm。该因子适用于前期可行性分析；部件设计和冲压工艺尚未最终确定时，展开可能产生较大开裂或严重起皱，使成形结果无法用于碰撞/安全仿真。

Apply a fraction of a fully locked bead force along the entire periphery of the blank.  The fully locked bead force is automatically calculated based on a material hardening curve input.  AUTOBD can be increased to easily introduce more thinning and effective plastic strain in the part.
LT.0.0: Turns off the auto-bead feature.
EQ.0.0: Automatically applies 30% of fully locked force.
GT.0.0: Fraction input will be used to scale the fully locked force.
沿坯料整个周边施加一部分完全锁定的拉延筋力。完全锁定的拉延筋力根据材料硬化曲线输入自动计算；增大 AUTOBD 可在部件中引入更多减薄和等效塑性应变。
LT.0.0：关闭自动拉延筋功能。
EQ.0.0：自动施加完全锁定力的 30%。
GT.0.0：使用输入分数缩放完全锁定力。

If not zero, defines a thickness scale factor limiting the maximum thickness reduction.  See Remark 12. All thicknesses that are computed as less than 0.6 mm in the sheet blank will be reset to 0.6 mm. 若非零，定义限制最大减薄量的厚度比例因子（见备注 12）。例如，初始厚度为 0.75 mm 的板坯允许最小厚度为 0.6 mm 时，可将 TSCLMIN 设为 0.8。板坯中计算小于 0.6 mm 的所有厚度都重置为 0.6 mm。该因子适用于前期可行性分析；部件设计和冲压工艺尚未最终确定时，展开可能产生较大开裂或严重起皱，使成形结果无法用于碰撞/安全仿真。

AUTOSPC tolerance.  The test for singularity is the ratio of the smallest singular value and the largest singular value.
If this ratio is less than AUTOTOL, then the triple of columns is declared singular and a constraint is generated.
Default values in single and double precision are 1e-4 and 10e-8, respectively.
AUTOSPC 容差。判断奇异性的依据是最小奇异值与最大奇异值之比。
若该比值小于 AUTOTOL，则该列三元组会被判定为奇异，并由此生成约束条件。
单精度和双精度的默认值分别为 1e-4 和 10e-8。

Matrix and right-hand-side dumping.  LS-DYNA has the option of dumping the globally assembled stiffness matrix and right-hand-side vector files in Harwell-Boeing sparse matrix format. Such output may help with comparing to other linear equation solution packages.
EQ.0: No dumping
GT.0: Dump all matrices and right-hand-side vectors every MTXDMP time steps.
Output is written as ASCII text and the involved filenames are of the following form: K_xxxx_yyy.mtx.rb
This file contains the stiffness matrix at step xxxx, iteration yyy.  M_xxxx_yyy.mtx.rb
This file contains the mass matrix at step xxxx, iteration yyy.  Only for eigenvalue analysis.  W_xxxx_yyy.mtx.rb
This file contains the damping matrix at step xxxx, iteration yyy.  Only for simulations with damping. K_xxxx_yyy_zzz.rhs.rb
This file contains the right hand side at step xxxx, iteration yyy, where yyyis the iteration at which a stiffness matrix is formed; and zzz is the cumulative iteration number for the step.

Starting with LS-DYNA R11, the memory for linear algebra has been moved from static to dynamic memory allocation.
For implicit applications we have found that some operating systems are not robust when queried about how much dynamic memory is free. This factor caps the amount of dynamic memory requested for linear algebra applications to RDCMEM times the amount the operating system declares available.
0.85 seems to work well for most systems. If you are using a workstation and starting up other applications while running LS-DYNA, you may need to use a number like 0.50
从 LS-DYNA R11 开始，线性代数内存由静态分配改为动态分配。对于隐式应用，某些操作系统在查询可用动态内存量时不够稳健。该因子将线性代数应用请求的动态内存上限限制为 RDCMEM 乘以操作系统声明的可用内存量。对大多数系统，0.85 通常效果良好；如果在工作站运行 LS-DYNA 时还启动其他应用程序，可能需要使用约 0.50 的值。

Absolute upper bound for the dynamic memory allocated for factorization. The allocated memory will be bounded above by the min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) where NWORDS is the number of available words determined by the operating system. If the predicted amount of required memory is less than this value, then less memory than this bound may be allocated.
为分解分配的动态内存的绝对上限。分配的内存上限将由 min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) 确定，其中 NWORDS 是操作系统确定的可用字数。如果预测所需内存量小于此值，则分配的内存可能少于该上限。

Only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. This field controls tasks performed in single precision (see Remark 10):
EQ.0: No single precision used.
EQ.1: The factors of the matrix, which are computed in double precision, are stored in single precision, reducing the storage required to solve the linear system.
EQ.2: Same as 1, but additionally some of the factorization operations are performed in single precision, reducing the runtime.
仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。此字段控制以单精度执行的任务（见备注 10）：
EQ.0：不使用单精度。
EQ.1：以双精度计算的矩阵因子以单精度存储，减少求解线性系统所需的存储空间。
EQ.2：与 EQ.1 相同，但部分分解操作也以单精度执行，减少运行时间。

Flag providing options for the block low-rank (BLR) computations. It is only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. As the value of IBLROPT increases, the treatment is increasingly aggressive. However, increasingly aggressive compression can introduce additional error into the factors of the linear system, which can slow down the convergence of the subsequent numerical solve or even prevent convergence. See Remark 10.
EQ.0: BLR is not used.
EQ.1: Factor, Solve, Update,and Compress algorithm(FSUC).A full - rank factorization is performed,and off - diagonal blocks of the factors are then subject to compression with BLR.This method should reduce the storage required to factor and solve the linear system.However, the additional BLR computations increase the runtime.
EQ.2: Factor, Solve, Compress,and Update algorithm(FSCU).FSUC is applied with the fully assembled equations of the frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank updates are performed to compute the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This method should reduce both storage and runtime.
EQ.3: Update, Factor, Solve,and Compress algorithm(UFSC).Low - rank approximations are used to update blocks within the fully assembled equations in a frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank computations are also performed when computing the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This option should reduce storage and further reduce runtime.
EQ.4: UFSC is performed: In addition, BLR is applied to the contribution blocks of low-rank frontal matrices before they are placed on the real stack. This step further reduces the working storage needed for the low-rank factorization. The additional BLR computations increase the runtime relative to UFSC.
为块低秩（BLR）计算提供选项的标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。IBLROPT 值越大，处理越激进；但更激进的压缩可能给线性系统的因子引入额外误差，从而减慢后续数值求解的收敛，甚至导致无法收敛。参见备注 10。
EQ.0：不使用 BLR。
EQ.1：因子分解、求解、更新和压缩算法（FSUC）。先执行满秩分解，再对因子的非对角块进行 BLR 压缩。可减少分解和求解线性系统所需的存储，但额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。
EQ.2：因子分解、求解、压缩和更新算法（FSCU）。将 FSUC 应用于完全组装的前端矩阵方程；应用 BLR 压缩的位置使用低秩更新计算前端矩阵的 Schur 补。可同时减少存储和运行时间。
EQ.3：更新、因子分解、求解和压缩算法（UFSC）。使用低秩近似更新前端矩阵完全组装方程中的块；应用 BLR 压缩的位置在计算 Schur 补时也执行低秩计算。可减少存储并进一步减少运行时间。
EQ.4：执行 UFSC；此外，在将低秩前端矩阵的贡献块放入实堆栈前对其应用 BLR。与 UFSC 相比，额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。

Symmetric positive definite flag. Only active when LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2.
EQ.0: The solver only assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite if the diagonals of the factorization are all positive.
EQ.1: The solver assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite and ignores spurious negative diagonal entries.
对称正定标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。
EQ.0：仅当分解后的对角线元素全部为正时，求解器才将线性系统视为对称正定。
EQ.1：求解器假定线性系统为对称正定，并忽略伪负对角元素。

Control the load-balancing behavior. Only active when LSOLVR = 7, LCPACK = 2, and ISINGLE > 0. The solver's default behavior is to load balance to reduce runtime. That behavior can cause a subset of processors to have a disproportionate share of the factor entries and drive such processors out-of-core, even when enough storage should be available. MEMLVL enables instructing the solver to consider storage as well.
EQ.0.0: Load balancing is entirely based on minimizing in - core runtime.
GT.1.0: Perform load balancing to reduce storage disparity among the processors.
GT.1.0: The first load balance is performed to reduce runtime.Then, it is adjusted to reduce any outlier cores, such that they have no more than MEMLVL times an equal share of the factor entries.In this case, MEMLVL is an aspirational target that the solver cannot always achieve.
控制负载均衡行为。仅当 LSOLVR=7、LCPACK=2 且 ISINGLE>0 时有效。求解器默认通过负载均衡减少运行时间，但可能使部分处理器承担过多因子项而转为核外运行，即使仍有足够存储空间。MEMLVL 允许求解器同时考虑存储使用。

Starting with LS-DYNA R11, the memory for linear algebra has been moved from static to dynamic memory allocation.
For implicit applications we have found that some operating systems are not robust when queried about how much dynamic memory is free. This factor caps the amount of dynamic memory requested for linear algebra applications to RDCMEM times the amount the operating system declares available.
0.85 seems to work well for most systems. If you are using a workstation and starting up other applications while running LS-DYNA, you may need to use a number like 0.50
从 LS-DYNA R11 开始，线性代数内存由静态分配改为动态分配。对于隐式应用，某些操作系统在查询可用动态内存量时不够稳健。该因子将线性代数应用请求的动态内存上限限制为 RDCMEM 乘以操作系统声明的可用内存量。对大多数系统，0.85 通常效果良好；如果在工作站运行 LS-DYNA 时还启动其他应用程序，可能需要使用约 0.50 的值。

Absolute upper bound for the dynamic memory allocated for factorization. The allocated memory will be bounded above by the min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) where NWORDS is the number of available words determined by the operating system. If the predicted amount of required memory is less than this value, then less memory than this bound may be allocated.
为分解分配的动态内存的绝对上限。分配的内存上限将由 min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) 确定，其中 NWORDS 是操作系统确定的可用字数。如果预测所需内存量小于此值，则分配的内存可能少于该上限。

Only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. This field controls tasks performed in single precision (see Remark 10):
EQ.0: No single precision used.
EQ.1: The factors of the matrix, which are computed in double precision, are stored in single precision, reducing the storage required to solve the linear system.
EQ.2: Same as 1, but additionally some of the factorization operations are performed in single precision, reducing the runtime.
仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。此字段控制以单精度执行的任务（见备注 10）：
EQ.0：不使用单精度。
EQ.1：以双精度计算的矩阵因子以单精度存储，减少求解线性系统所需的存储空间。
EQ.2：与 EQ.1 相同，但部分分解操作也以单精度执行，减少运行时间。

Flag providing options for the block low-rank (BLR) computations. It is only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. As the value of IBLROPT increases, the treatment is increasingly aggressive. However, increasingly aggressive compression can introduce additional error into the factors of the linear system, which can slow down the convergence of the subsequent numerical solve or even prevent convergence. See Remark 10.
EQ.0: BLR is not used.
EQ.1: Factor, Solve, Update,and Compress algorithm(FSUC).A full - rank factorization is performed,and off - diagonal blocks of the factors are then subject to compression with BLR.This method should reduce the storage required to factor and solve the linear system.However, the additional BLR computations increase the runtime.
EQ.2: Factor, Solve, Compress,and Update algorithm(FSCU).FSUC is applied with the fully assembled equations of the frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank updates are performed to compute the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This method should reduce both storage and runtime.
EQ.3: Update, Factor, Solve,and Compress algorithm(UFSC).Low - rank approximations are used to update blocks within the fully assembled equations in a frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank computations are also performed when computing the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This option should reduce storage and further reduce runtime.
EQ.4: UFSC is performed: In addition, BLR is applied to the contribution blocks of low-rank frontal matrices before they are placed on the real stack. This step further reduces the working storage needed for the low-rank factorization. The additional BLR computations increase the runtime relative to UFSC.
为块低秩（BLR）计算提供选项的标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。IBLROPT 值越大，处理越激进；但更激进的压缩可能给线性系统的因子引入额外误差，从而减慢后续数值求解的收敛，甚至导致无法收敛。参见备注 10。
EQ.0：不使用 BLR。
EQ.1：因子分解、求解、更新和压缩算法（FSUC）。先执行满秩分解，再对因子的非对角块进行 BLR 压缩。可减少分解和求解线性系统所需的存储，但额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。
EQ.2：因子分解、求解、压缩和更新算法（FSCU）。将 FSUC 应用于完全组装的前端矩阵方程；应用 BLR 压缩的位置使用低秩更新计算前端矩阵的 Schur 补。可同时减少存储和运行时间。
EQ.3：更新、因子分解、求解和压缩算法（UFSC）。使用低秩近似更新前端矩阵完全组装方程中的块；应用 BLR 压缩的位置在计算 Schur 补时也执行低秩计算。可减少存储并进一步减少运行时间。
EQ.4：执行 UFSC；此外，在将低秩前端矩阵的贡献块放入实堆栈前对其应用 BLR。与 UFSC 相比，额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。

Symmetric positive definite flag. Only active when LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2.
EQ.0: The solver only assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite if the diagonals of the factorization are all positive.
EQ.1: The solver assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite and ignores spurious negative diagonal entries.
对称正定标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。

EQ.1：求解器假定线性系统为对称正定，并忽略伪负对角元素。

Control the load-balancing behavior. Only active when LSOLVR = 7, LCPACK = 2, and ISINGLE > 0. The solver's default behavior is to load balance to reduce runtime. That behavior can cause a subset of processors to have a disproportionate share of the factor entries and drive such processors out-of-core, even when enough storage should be available. MEMLVL enables instructing the solver to consider storage as well.
EQ.0.0: Load balancing is entirely based on minimizing in - core runtime.
GT.1.0: Perform load balancing to reduce storage disparity among the processors.
GT.1.0: The first load balance is performed to reduce runtime.Then, it is adjusted to reduce any outlier cores, such that they have no more than MEMLVL times an equal share of the factor entries.In this case, MEMLVL is an aspirational target that the solver cannot always achieve.

Starting with LS-DYNA R11, the memory for linear algebra has been moved from static to dynamic memory allocation.
For implicit applications we have found that some operating systems are not robust when queried about how much dynamic memory is free. This factor caps the amount of dynamic memory requested for linear algebra applications to RDCMEM times the amount the operating system declares available.
0.85 seems to work well for most systems. If you are using a workstation and starting up other applications while running LS-DYNA, you may need to use a number like 0.50
从 LS-DYNA R11 开始，线性代数内存由静态分配改为动态分配。对于隐式应用，某些操作系统在查询可用动态内存量时不够稳健。该因子将线性代数应用请求的动态内存上限限制为 RDCMEM 乘以操作系统声明的可用内存量。对大多数系统，0.85 通常效果良好；如果在工作站运行 LS-DYNA 时还启动其他应用程序，可能需要使用约 0.50 的值。

Absolute upper bound for the dynamic memory allocated for factorization. The allocated memory will be bounded above by the min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) where NWORDS is the number of available words determined by the operating system. If the predicted amount of required memory is less than this value, then less memory than this bound may be allocated.
为分解分配的动态内存的绝对上限。分配的内存上限将由 min(RDCME NWORDS ,ABSMEM ) 确定，其中 NWORDS 是操作系统确定的可用字数。如果预测所需内存量小于此值，则分配的内存可能少于该上限。

Only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. This field controls tasks performed in single precision (see Remark 10):
EQ.0: No single precision used.
EQ.1: The factors of the matrix, which are computed in double precision, are stored in single precision, reducing the storage required to solve the linear system.
EQ.2: Same as 1, but additionally some of the factorization operations are performed in single precision, reducing the runtime.
仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。此字段控制以单精度执行的任务（见备注 10）：
EQ.0：不使用单精度。
EQ.1：以双精度计算的矩阵因子以单精度存储，减少求解线性系统所需的存储空间。
EQ.2：与 EQ.1 相同，但部分分解操作也以单精度执行，减少运行时间。

Flag providing options for the block low-rank (BLR) computations. It is only active if LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2. As the value of IBLROPT increases, the treatment is increasingly aggressive. However, increasingly aggressive compression can introduce additional error into the factors of the linear system, which can slow down the convergence of the subsequent numerical solve or even prevent convergence. See Remark 10.
EQ.0: BLR is not used.
EQ.1: Factor, Solve, Update,and Compress algorithm(FSUC).A full - rank factorization is performed,and off - diagonal blocks of the factors are then subject to compression with BLR.This method should reduce the storage required to factor and solve the linear system.However, the additional BLR computations increase the runtime.
EQ.2: Factor, Solve, Compress,and Update algorithm(FSCU).FSUC is applied with the fully assembled equations of the frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank updates are performed to compute the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This method should reduce both storage and runtime.
EQ.3: Update, Factor, Solve,and Compress algorithm(UFSC).Low - rank approximations are used to update blocks within the fully assembled equations in a frontal matrix.Where BLR compression is applied, low - rank computations are also performed when computing the Schur complement of the frontal matrix.This option should reduce storage and further reduce runtime.
EQ.4: UFSC is performed: In addition, BLR is applied to the contribution blocks of low-rank frontal matrices before they are placed on the real stack. This step further reduces the working storage needed for the low-rank factorization. The additional BLR computations increase the runtime relative to UFSC.
为块低秩（BLR）计算提供选项的标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。IBLROPT 值越大，处理越激进；但更激进的压缩可能给线性系统的因子引入额外误差，从而减慢后续数值求解的收敛，甚至导致无法收敛。参见备注 10。
EQ.0：不使用 BLR。
EQ.1：因子分解、求解、更新和压缩算法（FSUC）。先执行满秩分解，再对因子的非对角块进行 BLR 压缩。可减少分解和求解线性系统所需的存储，但额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。
EQ.2：因子分解、求解、压缩和更新算法（FSCU）。将 FSUC 应用于完全组装的前端矩阵方程；应用 BLR 压缩的位置使用低秩更新计算前端矩阵的 Schur 补。可同时减少存储和运行时间。
EQ.3：更新、因子分解、求解和压缩算法（UFSC）。使用低秩近似更新前端矩阵完全组装方程中的块；应用 BLR 压缩的位置在计算 Schur 补时也执行低秩计算。可减少存储并进一步减少运行时间。
EQ.4：执行 UFSC；此外，在将低秩前端矩阵的贡献块放入实堆栈前对其应用 BLR。与 UFSC 相比，额外 BLR 计算会增加运行时间。

Symmetric positive definite flag. Only active when LSOLVR = 7 and LCPACK = 2.
EQ.0: The solver only assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite if the diagonals of the factorization are all positive.
EQ.1: The solver assumes that the linear system is symmetric positive definite and ignores spurious negative diagonal entries.
对称正定标志。仅当 LSOLVR = 7 且 LCPACK = 2 时有效。
EQ.0：仅当分解后的对角线元素全部为正时，求解器才将线性系统视为对称正定。
EQ.1：求解器假定线性系统为对称正定，并忽略伪负对角元素。

Control the load-balancing behavior. Only active when LSOLVR = 7, LCPACK = 2, and ISINGLE > 0. The solver's default behavior is to load balance to reduce runtime. That behavior can cause a subset of processors to have a disproportionate share of the factor entries and drive such processors out-of-core, even when enough storage should be available. MEMLVL enables instructing the solver to consider storage as well.
EQ.0.0: Load balancing is entirely based on minimizing in - core runtime.
GT.1.0: Perform load balancing to reduce storage disparity among the processors.
GT.1.0: The first load balance is performed to reduce runtime.Then, it is adjusted to reduce any outlier cores, such that they have no more than MEMLVL times an equal share of the factor entries.In this case, MEMLVL is an aspirational target that the solver cannot always achieve.
控制负载均衡行为。仅当 LSOLVR=7、LCPACK=2 且 ISINGLE>0 时有效。求解器默认通过负载均衡减少运行时间，但可能使部分处理器承担过多因子项而转为核外运行，即使仍有足够存储空间。MEMLVL 允许求解器同时考虑存储使用。
EQ.0.0：负载均衡完全以最小化核内运行时间为目标。
GT.1.0：进行负载均衡以减小处理器之间的存储差异。
GT.1.0：第一次负载均衡用于减少运行时间；随后调整以减少异常核，使其因子项不超过平均份额的 MEMLVL 倍。MEMLVL 只是目标值，求解器不一定能完全达到。

Geometry for decomposition:
EQ.1: Use current geometry for decomposition.When applied to a model containing SPH, deactivated SPH elements are not considered in the partition.This will give better load balancing if SPH elements are deleted during the simulation.
EQ.2: Use current geometry for decomposition(same as 1 if applied to a non - SPH model).When applied to a model containing SPH, all SPH elements are considered in the partition.This will give better load balancing if SPH elements are reactivated during the simulation.
分解所用的几何体：
EQ.1：使用当前几何体进行分解。对于包含 SPH 的模型，不将已停用的 SPH 单元计入分区；如果仿真期间删除 SPH 单元，这样可获得更好的负载均衡。
EQ.2：使用当前几何体进行分解（用于非 SPH 模型时与 EQ.1 相同）。对于包含 SPH 的模型，将所有 SPH 单元计入分区；如果仿真期间重新激活 SPH 单元，这样可获得更好的负载均衡。

Element cost scale factor for element in contact or with plastic strain.
If the element is under contact and has plastic strain, the weight will be doubled.
Since the element cost is measured from calculated quantities, the results will remain consistent between runs with the same input and decomposition unlike using SAMPT option
存在接触或塑性应变的单元所采用的单元成本比例因子。
若该单元既处于接触状态又存在塑性应变，则其权重将会翻倍。
由于单元成本是根据计算量来确定的，因此在使用相同输入与分解方式的多次运行中，结果将保持一致，这与使用 SAMPT 选项的情况不同。

Geometry for decomposition:

Tolerance for output of *DEFINE_CURVE discretization warnings.  After each curve is discretized, the resulting curve is evaluated at each of the original definition points, and the values compared.  A warning will be issued for any curve where this comparison results in an error of more than CDETOL/100*M, where the curve specific value M is computed as the median of the absolute values of the non-zero curve values.
*DEFINE_CURVE 离散化警告输出的容差设置。在每条曲线完成离散化处理后，会在原有的定义点上对该离散化后的曲线进行数值求值，并将结果与原始值进行比较。若某条曲线因这种比较而产生的误差超过 CDETOL/100*M，就会发出警告，其中该曲线对应的参数 M 是其所有非零数值的绝对值的中位数。

Joint formulation flag for explicit analysis.  This flag can be used to switch to an implicit formulation for joints (*CONSTRAINED_JOINT_Option) which uses Lagrange multipliers to impose prescribed kinematic boundary conditions and joint constraints. Rotational stiffness is added to all joints in the model as a mean to model a small resistance, such as joint friction, or to avoid zero energy modes in implicit. This is equivalent to defining a *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED to the free rotational degrees of freedom of all joints, using a slope in LCIDPH, LCIDT, LCIDPS that equal to GJADSTF.  For models with many joints this field is advantageous since it only has to be defined once for all joints, whereas the equivalent keyword must be defined for each joint
将旋转刚度添加到模型所有关节，用于模拟关节摩擦等小阻力或避免隐式分析中的零能量模态。这等价于为所有关节自由旋转自由度定义 *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED，并在 LCIDPH、LCIDT、LCIDPS 中使用等于 GJADSTF 的斜率。关节较多时只需定义一次，比为每个关节定义等效关键字更方便。

Rotational damping is added to all joints in the model as a mean to model a small resistance, such as joint friction, or to avoid zero energy modes in implicit. This is equivalent to defining a *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED to the free rotational degrees of freedom of all joints, using a slope in DLCIDPH, DLCIDT, DLCIDPS that equal to GJADVSC.  Like GJADSTF, for models many joints this field is advantageous since it only has to be defined once for all joints, whereas the equivalent keyword must be defined for each joint.
作为模拟小阻力（例如关节摩擦）或避免隐式分析中零能量模态的方法，向模型中的所有关节添加转动阻尼。这等价于为所有关节的自由转动自由度定义 *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED，并在 DLCIDPH、DLCIDT、DLCIDPS 中使用等于 GJADVSC 的斜率。与 GJADSTF 类似，对于包含许多关节的模型，此字段只需为所有关节定义一次，而等效关键字必须为每个关节分别定义。

Translational stiffness is added to all joints in the model as a mean to model a small resistance, such as joint friction, or to avoid zero energy modes in implicit. This is equivalent to defining a *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_TRANSLATIONAL to the free translational degrees of freedom of all joints, using a slope in LCIDX, LCIDY, LCIDZ that equal to TJADSTF.  Like GJADSTF, for models many joints this field is advantageous since it only has to be defined once for all joints, whereas the equivalent keyword must be defined for each joint

Translational damping is added to all joints in the model as a mean to model a small resistance, such as joint friction, or to avoid zero energy modes in implicit. This is equivalent to defining a *CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_TRANSLATIONAL to the free translational degrees of freedom of all joints, using a slope in DLCIDX, DLCIDY, DLCIDZ that equal to TJADVSC.  Like GJADSTF, for models many joints this field is advantageous since it only has to be defined once for all joints, whereas the equivalent keyword must be defined for each joint

Flag to check for highly distorted under-integrated shell elements, print a
message, and delete the element or terminate. Generally, this flag is not
needed for one point elements that do not use the warping stiffness. A
distorted element is one where a negative Jacobian exist within the
domain of the shell, not just at integration points. The checks are made
away from the CPU requirements for one point elements. If nonzero,
NFAIL1 can be changed in a restart.
EQ.1: print message and delete element.
EQ.2: print message, write D3DUMP file, and terminate
GT.2: print message and delete element. When NFAIL1 elements
are deleted then write D3DUMP file and terminate. These NFAIL1
failed elements also include all shell elements that failed for other
reasons than distortion. Before the D3DUMP file is written, NFAIL1
is doubled, so the run can immediately be continued if desired.
用于检查严重畸变的减缩积分壳单元，并打印消息、删除单元或终止计算的标志。对于不采用翘曲刚度的单点积分单元，通常不需要此标志。畸变单元是指壳单元域内（而非仅在积分点处）存在负雅可比的单元。

Flag to check for highly distorted fully-integrated shell elements, print a
message and delete the element or terminate. Generally, this flag is
recommended. A distorted element is one where a negative Jacobian
exist within the domain of the shell, not just at integration points. The
checks are made away from the integration points to enable the bad
elements to be deleted before an instability leading to an error
termination occurs. If nonzero, NFAIL1 can be changed in a restart.
EQ.1: print message and delete element.
EQ.2: print message, write D3DUMP file, and terminate
GT.2: print message and delete element. When NFAIL4 elements
are deleted then write D3DUMP file and terminate. These NFAIL4
failed elements also include all shell elements that failed for other
reasons than distortion. Before the D3DUMP file is written,
NFAIL4 is doubled, so the run can immediately be continued if
desired.

Flag for time step handling for shell elements with offset. If the shell reference surface is offset by NLOC (*SECTION_SHELL) or OFFSET (*ELEMENT_SHELL), the time step size of those shell elements is reduced to fix instabilities. The reduction of the time step size is based on numerical tests which show a dependence on the offset distance and the ratio of shell thickness to edge length (T/L).
EQ.0: Reduce time step size up to 10 % to avoid instabilities.Care has to be taken since a smaller time step will lead to larger masses due to mass scaling.
EQ.1: No reduction of time step to restore prior behavior if necessary.Instabilities were most likely observed for aspect ratios of T / L > 0.5
带偏置壳单元的时间步长处理标志。若壳参考面由 NLOC（*SECTION_SHELL）或 OFFSET（*ELEMENT_SHELL）偏置，则减小这些壳单元的时间步长以修复不稳定性；减小量依据数值测试，取决于偏置距离和壳厚度与边长之比 T/L。
EQ.0：为避免不稳定性，时间步长最多减小 10%；需注意更小时间步会因质量缩放导致更大质量。
EQ.1：必要时不减小时间步，以恢复先前行为。不稳定性最可能出现在 T/L > 0.5 的长宽比下。

Flag for switching between formulations 16 and 30:
EQ.0: Do not convert the shell formulations.
EQ.1: Convert all formulation 16 shells to 30.
EQ.2: Convert all formulation 30 shells to 16.
壳单元公式 16 与 30 的转换标志：
EQ.0：不转换壳单元公式。
EQ.1：将所有采用公式 16 的壳单元转换为公式 30。
EQ.2：将所有采用公式 30 的壳单元转换为公式 16。

Automatic sorting of tetrahedron and pentahedron elements to avoid using degenerate formulation for thee shapes. See *SECTION_SOLID.
EQ.0: no sorting(default).
EQ.1: sort tetrahedron to type 10, pentahedron to type 15.
EQ.2: sort tetrahedron to type 10, 1-point integrated pentahedron to type 115, fully integrated pentahedron to type 15.
EQ.3: same as EQ.1 but also print switched elements in message file.
EQ.4: same as EQ.2 but also print switched elements in message file
EQ.11: Same as 1 except sort tetrahedron to type 13.
EQ.12: Same as 2 except sort tetrahedron to type 13
EQ.13: Same as 3 except sort tetrahedron to type 13
EQ.14: Same as 4 except sort tetrahedron to type 13
自动对四面体和五面体单元排序，避免这些形状使用退化公式（见 *SECTION_SOLID）。
EQ.0：不排序（默认）。
EQ.1：四面体排序为类型 10，五面体排序为类型 15。
EQ.2：四面体排序为类型 10；一点积分五面体排序为类型 115；完全积分五面体排序为类型 15。
EQ.3：与 EQ.1 相同，但将切换的单元打印到消息文件。
EQ.4：与 EQ.2 相同，但将切换的单元打印到消息文件。
EQ.11：与 EQ.1 相同，但四面体排序为类型 13。
EQ.12：与 EQ.2 相同，但四面体排序为类型 13。
EQ.13：与 EQ.3 相同，但四面体排序为类型 13。
EQ.14：与 EQ.4 相同，但四面体排序为类型 13。

Default method used in the calculation of the defomation gradient matrix.
EQ.1: Update incrementally in time. This is the default for explicit.
EQ.2: Directly compute F. This is the default for implicit and implicit/explicit switching.
用于计算变形梯度矩阵的默认方法。
EQ.1：随时间逐步更新。这是显式方法的默认设置。
EQ.2：直接计算 F 值。这是隐式方法以及隐式/显式切换模式的默认设置。

Number of integration points used in the quadratic tetrahedron elements. Either 4 or 5 can be specified. This option applies to the type 4 and type 16 tetrahedron elements.
二次四面体单元中使用的积分点数量。可指定为 4 或 5。此选项适用于类型 4 和类型 16 的四面体单元。

Output option for stresses in solid elements used as spot welds with material *MAT_SPOTWELD.
EQ.1: Stresses in the global coordinate system (default),
EQ.2: Stresses in the element coordinate system
使用 *MAT_SPOTWELD 的点焊实体单元应力输出：
EQ.1：全局坐标系（默认）
EQ.2：单元坐标系。

Solid element erosion from negative volume is limited only to solid elements in the part set indicated by PSFAIL.  This is similar to setting ERODE = 1 in *CONTROL_TIMESTEP, except that it is not global.
In other words, when PSFAIL is nonzero, the time - step - based criterion for erosion(TSMIN) applies to all solid elements(except formulations 11 and 12),and the negative volume criterion for erosion applies only to solids in part set PSFAIL.
由负体积导致的实体单元侵蚀仅限于 PSFAIL 指示部件集中的实体单元。这类似于在 *CONTROL_TIMESTEP 中设置 ERODE = 1，但不是全局设置。换言之，PSFAIL 非零时，基于时间步的侵蚀判据（TSMIN）适用于所有实体单元（公式 11 和 12 除外），负体积侵蚀判据仅适用于 PSFAIL 部件集中的实体。

Tolerance for jacobian in 4-point 10-noded quadratic tetrahedra (type 16).If the quotient between the minimum and maximum jacobian value falls below this tolerance, a warning message is issued in the messag file. This is useful for tracking badly shaped elements in implicit analysis that deteriorates convergence, a value of 1.0 indicates a perfectly shaped element.
类型为 16 的 4 点 10 节点二次四面体单元中雅可比矩阵的容差。若雅可比矩阵最小值与最大值之间的比值低于该容差，则会在消息文件中生成警告信息。这一设定有助于在隐式分析过程中识别那些形状异常从而影响收敛性的单元，数值 1.0 表示单元形状完美。

Flag for cohesive elements to control deletion, the time step estimate, and the element type used in implicit and explicit. Breaking LS-DYNA convention, ICOH is interpreted digit-wise, namely as,
ICOH = [MLK] = K + 10 * L + 100 * M .
The first digit(in the one's place), K, is interpreted as follows:
K.EQ.0: No cohesive element deletion due to neighbor failure.
K.EQ.1: Solid elements having ELFORM = 19 - 22 (or ELFORM = 1, 2, 15 being used with *MAT_169) are eroded when neighboring shell or solid elements fail.This works for nodewise connected partsand tied contacts.
The second digit(in the ten's place), L, controls how the mass used to estimate the element time step is computed.L defaults to zero if ICOH is less than 10 (having a single digit).See Remark 1.
L.EQ.0: The mass is the sum of the element nodes.Each node is assumed to be shared between two elements.
L.EQ.1: The mass is computed by integrating the cohesive density.
L.EQ.2: Same as the default (0), but each node is assumed to be shared by four elements.Compared to the default, the time step is reduced by a factor of 1 / sqrt(2).
L.EQ.3: The element connectivity is used to compute how much(nodal) mass is associated with each element, meaning no assumption regarding connectivity is made.This setting is recommended.
The third digit(in the hundred's place), M, is interpreted as follows:
M.EQ.0: Explicit element variants used in explicit calculations and higher - accuracy implicit element variants used in implicit calculations.
M.EQ.1: Higher - accuracy implicit element variants used in both implicit and explicit calculations.
内聚单元标志，用于控制删除、时间步估计以及隐式和显式分析中使用的单元类型。不同于 LS-DYNA 约定，ICOH 按位解释：
ICOH = [MLK] = K + 10×L + 100×M。
第一位（个位）K：
K.EQ.0：相邻单元失效不会导致内聚单元删除。
K.EQ.1：相邻壳或实体单元失效时，ELFORM = 19–22 的实体单元（或与 *MAT_169 一起使用的 ELFORM = 1、2、15）发生侵蚀。适用于按节点连接的部件和绑定接触。
第二位（十位）L 控制估计单元时间步时质量的计算方式。若 ICOH < 10（单个数字），L 默认为 0。参见备注 1。
L.EQ.0：质量为单元节点质量之和；假定每个节点由两个单元共享。
L.EQ.1：通过积分内聚材料密度计算质量。
L.EQ.2：与默认值 0 相同，但假定每个节点由四个单元共享。与默认值相比，时间步缩小 1/√2。
L.EQ.3：使用单元连接关系计算与每个单元关联的节点质量，不作连接关系假定。推荐此设置。
第三位（百位）M：
M.EQ.0：显式计算使用显式单元变体，隐式计算使用高精度隐式单元变体。
M.EQ.1：隐式和显式计算均使用高精度隐式单元变体。

Set to 1 to invoke a consistent tangent stiffness matrix for the pressure-averaged tetrahedron (type 13).  This feature is available only for the implicit integrator.  This element type averages the volumetric strain over adjacent elements to alleviate volumetric locking; therefore, the corresponding material tangent stiffness should be treated accordingly.  In contrast to a hexahedral mesh, where a node usually connects to fewer than eight elements, tetrahedral meshes offer no such regularity.  Consequently, matrix assembly is computationally expensive for nonlinear implicit analysis, so this option is recommended only for linear or eigenvalue analysis to exploit the stiffness characteristics of the type 13 tetrahedron.
设为 1，以便对压力平均四面体（类型 13）调用一致切线刚度矩阵。此功能仅适用于隐式积分器。该单元类型对相邻单元上的体积应变求平均，以缓解体积锁死；因此，相应的材料切线刚度也应据此处理。与六面体网格相比（在六面体网格中，一个节点通常连接少于八个单元），四面体网格没有这种规则性。因此，对于非线性隐式分析，矩阵组装的计算代价很高；所以建议仅在线性或特征值分析中使用此选项，以发挥类型 13 四面体的刚度特性。

Components of a permutation vector for nodes that define the 10-node tetrahedron. The nodal numbering of 10-node tetrahedron elements is somewhat arbitrary. The permutation vector allows other numbering schemes to be used. Unless defined, this permutation vector is not used. PM1-PM10 are unique number between 1 to 10 inclusive that reorders the input node ID s for a 10-node tetrahedron into the order used by LS-DYNA.
定义 10 节点四面体单元节点顺序的置换向量分量。10 节点四面体单元的节点编号并不唯一，该向量允许采用其他编号方案；未定义时不使用。PM1～PM10 是 1～10 范围内互不相同的编号，用于将 10 节点四面体单元的输入节点 ID 重排为 LS-DYNA 所用顺序。

Choice of implementation for solid element types 10 and 13: If EXACC on *CONTROL_ACCURAY is greater than zero, TET13V is set to one.
EQ.0:    Efficient version for type 10 and more accurate version for type 13 (default).With the single precision version, a little noise could be observed in the solution for elements moving long distances with rigid body motion.
EQ.1 : More accurate version for both types 10 and 13(smoother results) with an additional cost of about 15 % .
EQ.2 : Efficient version for both types 10 and 13
实体单元类型 10 和 13 的实现方式选择：若 *CONTROL_ACCURAY 中 EXACC > 0，则 TET13V 设为 1。
EQ.0：类型 10 使用高效版本，类型 13 使用更精确版本（默认）；单精度版本中，刚体运动长距离移动的单元可能出现少量噪声。
EQ.1：两种类型均使用更精确版本（结果更平滑），额外成本约 15%。
EQ.2：两种类型均使用高效版本。

Option to compute rotational inertia for the nodes of solid elements. This ensures consistent results if the applied constraints assume rotational degrees of freedom, as with tied contacts using the option SHELL_EDGE_TO_SURFACE.
EQ.0: By default, an average of the existing rotational inertia from the shelland beam elements in the model is distributed to the nodes of the solid elements.This method is sufficient in most situations but might lead to inconsistencies between different model assemblies in the case of rotational motion.
EQ.1: Compute rotational inertia for each solid element based on its dimensionsand mass density to ensure consistency.
为实体单元节点计算转动惯量的选项。如果施加的约束假定存在转动自由度（例如使用 SHELL_EDGE_TO_SURFACE 选项的绑定接触），该选项可确保结果一致。
EQ.0：默认将模型中壳和梁单元现有转动惯量的平均值分配给实体单元节点。该方法在多数情况下足够，但转动运动时可能导致不同模型装配之间不一致。
EQ.1：根据每个实体单元的尺寸和质量密度计算其转动惯量，以确保一致性。

Flag for cohesive elements quality check. Note that this check is only performed for cohesive elements with materials that have ROFLG = 0.COHEQC is interpreted digit-wise, namely as,
COHEQC = [LK] = K + 10xL
The first digit, K, controls the behavior of LS - DYNA when cohesive elements with poor quality are detected at t = 0:
K.EQ.0: Error termination with a list of elements(default).
K.EQ.1: Issue a warning and continue.
K.EQ.2: Same as 1 but delete the concerned elements.
The second digit, L, controls the behavior of LS - DYNA when inconsistent cohesive elements connectivity is detected.
L.EQ.0: Error termination with a list of elements(default).
L.EQ.1: Issue a warning and continue.
内聚单元质量检查标志。仅对材料 ROFLG = 0 的内聚单元执行检查。COHEQC 按位解释：COHEQC = [LK] = K + 10×L。
第一位 K 控制 LS-DYNA 在 t = 0 检测到质量较差内聚单元时的行为：
K.EQ.0：列出单元并错误终止（默认）。
K.EQ.1：发出警告并继续。
K.EQ.2：与 K.EQ.1 相同，但删除相关单元。
第二位 L 控制检测到内聚单元连接关系不一致时的行为：
L.EQ.0：列出单元并错误终止（默认）。
L.EQ.1：发出警告并继续。

Analysis solution procedure:
EQ.0: Structural analysis only,
EQ.1: Thermal analysis only,
EQ.2: Coupled structural thermal analysis.
分析求解流程：
EQ.0：仅进行结构分析，
EQ.1：仅进行热分析，
EQ.2：进行结构与热分析的耦合分析。

Define the vector length used in solution.  This value must not exceed the vector length of the system which varies based on the machine manufacturer.  The default vector length is printed at termination in the MESSAG file.
定义求解所用的向量长度。该值不得超过系统的向量长度；系统向量长度因计算机制造商而异。计算终止时，MESSAG 文件会输出默认向量长度。

Flag to check for a NaN in the force and moment arrays after the assembly of these arrays is completed.  This option can be useful for debugging purposes.  A cost overhead of approximately 2% is incurred when this option is active.
EQ.0: No checking,
EQ.1: Checking is active.
在力数组和力矩数组组装完成后检查其中是否存在 NaN 的标志。该选项可用于调试；启用时会产生约 2% 的额外开销。
EQ.0：不检查。
EQ.1：启用检查。

Number of equally spaced points used in curve (*DEFINE_CURVE) rediscretization. A minimum number of 100 is always used, that is, only larger input values are possible. Curve rediscretization applies only to curves used in material models. Curves defining loads, motion, etc. are not rediscretized. Note that memory requirements increase as LCINT increases. Thus, extremely large values of LCINT should be avoided if possible
曲线（*DEFINE_CURVE）重新离散化所用的等间距点数。始终使用至少 100 个点，即仅可输入更大的值。曲线重新离散化仅适用于材料模型中使用的曲线。定义载荷、运动等的曲线不会重新离散化。注意，LCINT 增大时内存需求也会增加。因此，如有可能应避免为 LCINT 设置极大值。

Flag to truncate curves to 6 significant figures for single precision and 13 significant figures for double precision. The truncation is done after applying the offset and scale factors specified in *DEFINE_CURVE.  Truncation is intended to prevent curve values from deviating from the input value, e.g., 0.7 being stored as 0.69999999.  This small deviation was seen to have an adverse effect in a particular analysis using *MAT_083. In general, curve truncation is not necessary and is unlikely to have any effect on results.
EQ.0: No truncation.
NE.0: Truncate.
将曲线截断为单精度 6 位有效数字、双精度 13 位有效数字的标志。截断在应用 *DEFINE_CURVE 中指定的偏移和比例因子后进行，旨在避免曲线值偏离输入值（例如将 0.7 存为 0.69999999）。某次使用 *MAT_083 的分析发现这种微小偏差会产生不利影响。通常无需截断曲线，且其不太可能影响结果。
EQ.0：不截断。
NE.0：截断。

Global option to evaluate *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION every NCDCF:th cycle..
全局选项：每隔 NCDCF 个循环计算一次 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION。

This field is currently disabled with NOCOPY always set to zero. Avoid copying of material history variables to temporary buffers for constitutive evaluations.
EQ.0: Not active
EQ.1: Active
此字段目前已禁用，因为 NOCOPY 始终设为零。避免在本构计算时将材料历史变量复制到临时缓冲区。
EQ.0：未激活。

用于计算光滑长度的时间积分类型。EQ.0 和 EQ.1 的设置参见 v970 版 LS-DYNA 手册中的 7.99（CONTROL）章节。

Controls contact behavior for deactivated SPH particles:

EQ.1: Contact is inactive for deactivated particles
控制已停用的 SPH 颗粒的接触行为：

EQ.1：已停用的颗粒的接触关系处于无效状态。

Defines artificial viscosity formulation for SPH elements (Remark 3):
EQ.0: Monaghan type artificial viscosity formulation is used.
EQ.1: Standard type artificial viscosity formulation from solid element is used (this option is not supported in SPH 2D and 2D axisymmetric elements).

生成 SPH 对称平面幽灵节点时用于内存分配的原始 SPH 粒子百分比（默认 100%）。对于大型 SPH 粒子模型，建议设置该字段（范围 10–20），以控制 *BOUNDARY_SPH_SYMMETRY_PLANE 的幽灵粒子内存分配。

Contact thickness option:
EQ.0:    The contact thickness is set to zero(default).
EQ.1 : The contact thickness is automatically calculated based on the volume of each SPH particle.

接触厚度选项：
EQ.0：接触厚度设为 0（默认）。

EQ.1: total stabilization.Only recommended for hyperelastic materials.
稳定化类型，仅在 IFORM = 12 时使用：

对于隐式求解器，将 SPH 节点从 *NODE 列表中排序并移至列表末尾。
EQ.0：不排序（默认值）。
EQ.1：执行排序。

Flag for applying the shifting algorithm to SPH particles (available from R13.0). With the shifting algorithm, particles are advanced and then shifted slightly across streamlines. This process reduces particle clustering in the maximum compression and stretching directions.
EQ.0: Do not apply shifting algorithm applied(default).
EQ.1: Apply shifting algorithm applied.
对 SPH 粒子应用移位算法的标志（R13.0 起可用）。使用该算法时，粒子先前进，再沿流线略微移位，从而减少最大压缩和拉伸方向上的粒子聚集。
EQ.0：不应用移位算法（默认）。
EQ.1：应用移位算法。

Pressure treatment of boundary particles:
EQ.0: Pressure on boundary particles is extrapolated from fluid particles.
EQ.1: Pressure on boundary particles is explicitly calculated

EQ.1：显式计算边界粒子的压力。

Tolerance criteria for convergence. If the average relative density (/_0) of particles under compression is below TAVG, this condition is satisfied
收敛容差准则。若受压状态下颗粒的平均相对密度（ρ/ρ_0）低于 TAVG，则满足该条件。

Tolerance criteria for convergence. If the maximum relative density (/_0) of particles under compression is below TMAX, this condition is satisfied
收敛容差准则。若受压状态下颗粒的最大相对密度（ρ/ρ_0）低于 TMAX，则满足该条件。

Stuck particle detection criteria. In certain scenarios, some fluid particles can end up stuck between moving structures and as a result accumulate very large pressure values. If a particles relative density contribution from boundaries is above ROL, it is deactivated. Its displacement is prescribed from the interpolated structure motion until it is sufficiently away from the structure at which point it is activated again.
卡滞粒子检测准则。在某些情形下，一些流体粒子可能卡在运动结构之间，从而积累非常大的压力值。如果粒子从边界获得的相对密度贡献高于 ROL，则将其停用。其位移由插值后的结构运动规定，直到它充分远离该结构，此时再次将其激活。

Flag for Heat Transfer Coefficient calculation.
EQ.0: HTCs are not calculated.
EQ.1: HTCs are calculated based on fluid properties given in *MAT_SPH_INCOMPRESSIBLE_FLUID cards.
LT.0: |IHTC| is a function ID defining HTCs based on seven arguments: heat capacity, thermal conductivity, dynamic viscosity, density, tangential velocity relative to the closest segment, distance traveled along the surface, and the ratio of the distance from the closest segment to particle radius. (see *DEFINE_FUNCTION).
热传递系数计算标志：
EQ.0：不计算 HTC。
EQ.1：根据 *MAT_SPH_INCOMPRESSIBLE_FLUID 卡片中的流体属性计算 HTC。
LT.0：|IHTC| 为函数 ID，根据七个参数定义 HTC：热容、热导率、动态黏度、密度、相对最近段的切向速度、沿表面移动的距离，以及最近段到粒子距离与粒子半径之比（参见 *DEFINE_FUNCTION）。

Flag for MAT_SPH_INCOMPRESSIBLE_* formulations.
EQ.0: Surface tension and surface adhesion forces are calculated based on numerical parameters given in the material cards.
EQ.1: Surface tension and surface adhesion forces are calculated based on the physical properties given in the material cards.
用于 MAT_SPH_INCOMPRESSIBLE_* 公式的标志：
EQ.0：根据材料卡中给出的数值参数计算表面张力和表面黏附力。
EQ.1：根据材料卡中给出的物理属性计算表面张力和表面黏附力。

Remove initially interpenetrated particles. Fluid particles that are too close to structural particles will be deactivated on initialization:

EQ.1: Remove interpenetrated particles.
移除初始相互穿透的粒子。距离结构粒子过近的流体粒子将在初始化时停用：
EQ.0：不移除相互穿透的粒子。
EQ.1：移除相互穿透的粒子。

Artificial compressibility term. For an analysis with a time-varying time step, we strongly recommend adding artificial compressibility to avoid oscillations and instabilities. We typically recommend a small value of [1.0x10]**(-8)  Pa**(-1). Note that this parameter is unit sensitive. Thus, the recommended value needs to be converted to the unit system used in the model.
人工可压缩性项。对于时间步随时间变化的分析，强烈建议加入人工可压缩性，以避免振荡和不稳定。通常建议使用 [1.0x10]**(-8) Pa**(-1)。注意，该参数与单位制有关，必须将建议值换算为模型所用单位制。

Set this flag to 1 to print for each spotweld attachment: the beam, node, and shell IDs, the parametric coordinates that define the constraint location, the angle used in the table lookup, and the three scale factors obtained from the load curves and table lookup.
将此标志设为 1，可打印每个点焊连接的梁、节点和壳 ID、定义约束位置的参数坐标、查表所用角度，以及由载荷曲线和查表得到的三个比例因子。

可选的表 ID，用于根据梁节点相对于壳形心的位置来缩放剪切响应。

Replace each spot weld beam element with a cluster of RPBHX solid elements.  The net cross-section of the cluster of elements is dimensioned to have the same area as the replaced beam.  RPBHX may be set to 1, 4, or 8.  When RPBHX is set to 4 or 8, a table is generated to output the force and moment resultants into the SWFORC file if this file is active.  *DEFINE_HEX_SPOTWELD_ASSEMBLY describes this table.  LS-DYNA uses the IDs of the beam elements as the cluster spot weld IDs, so the IDs in the SWFORC file are unchanged.  The beam elements are automatically deleted from the calculation, and the section and material data are automatically changed to be used with solid elements.  See the relevant figure.
将每个点焊梁单元替换为由 RPBHX 个实体单元组成的簇。该簇的净截面积设置为与被替换梁相同。RPBHX 可设为 1、4 或 8；当设为 4 或 8 且 SWFORC 文件处于启用状态时，会生成表，将合力和合力矩输出到 SWFORC 文件（见 *DEFINE_HEX_SPOTWELD_ASSEMBLY）。LS-DYNA 使用梁单元 ID 作为簇点焊 ID，因此 SWFORC 文件中的 ID 不变。梁单元会自动从计算中删除，截面和材料数据会自动改为用于实体单元。

可选梁单元集 ID，用于指定要转换为六面体装配体的梁单元。若该值为零，则转换所有点焊梁单元。有关高效定义梁单元集的方法，参见 *SET_BEAM_GENERAL。

File output flag. WRT must be a two digit number:WRT = L + M10

L.EQ.0: Do not modify d3plot.

M.EQ.1: For each ALE element in the set SETID, write.xy file that stores values computed by FCT at a frequency DT. (See Remarks 3 and 4.)
M.EQ.0: Do not output this history file.

Time interval between outputs. If DT is zero, no output is printed, This field will be used for all selected ASCII_options that have no unique DT value specified

GT.0.0：DT、BEG 和 END 以时间单位给出；DT 为输出之间的时间间隔。

Flag for binary file
EQ.1: ASCII file is written. This is the default on serial and shared memory computers.
EQ.2:Data written to a binary database, which contains data that would otherwise be output to the ASCII file. The ASCII file in this case is not created. This is the default on distributed memory computers.
EQ.3: ASCII file is written and the data is also written to the binary database.
二进制文件标志：
EQ.1：写入 ASCII 文件；这是串行计算机和共享内存计算机的默认设置。
EQ.2：将原本输出到 ASCII 文件的数据写入二进制数据库，不创建 ASCII 文件；这是分布式内存计算机的默认设置。
EQ.3：写入 ASCII 文件，同时将数据写入二进制数据库。

Optional load curveid specifying time interval between dumps.
可选的载荷曲线 ID，用于指定数据输出之间的时间间隔。

Flag to govern behavior of the plot frequency load curve defined by LCUR:
EQ.1: At the time each plot is generated, the load curve value is added to the current time to determine the next plot time. (default)
EQ.2: At the time each plot is generated, the next plot time T is computed so that T = the current time plus the load curve value at time T.
EQ.3: A plot is generated for each abscissa point in the load curve definition. The actual value of the load curve is ignored.
控制 LCUR 所定义绘图频率载荷曲线的处理方式：
EQ.1：每次生成绘图时，将此时的载荷曲线值加到当前时间上，所得结果作为下一次绘图时间（默认值）。
EQ.2：每次生成绘图时，求解下一次绘图时间 T，使 T 等于当前时间与载荷曲线在 T 时刻的值之和。
EQ.3：载荷曲线定义中的每个横坐标点均生成一次绘图，忽略载荷曲线的实际纵坐标值。

Discrete element option flag (*DATABASE_BINARY_D3PLOT only):
EQ.0: Discrete spring and damper elements are added to the d3plot database where they are displayed as beam elements.The discrete elements' global x, global y, global zand resultant forces(moments) and change in length(rotation) are written to the database where LS - PrePost(incorrectly) labels them as though they were beam quantities, such as axial force, S - shear resultant, T - shear resultant, etc.
EQ.1: No discrete spring, damperand seatbelt elements are added to the d3plot database.This option is useful when translating old LS - DYNA input decks to KEYWORD input.In older input decks there is no requirement that beam and spring elements have unique IDs,and beam elements may be created for the springand dampers with identical IDs to existing beam elements causing a fatal error.However, this option comes with some limitationsand, therefore, should be used with caution.
Contact interfaces which are based on part IDs of seatbelt elements will not be properly generated if this option is used.
DEFORMABLE_TO_RIGID will not work if PID refers to discrete, damper, or seatbelt elements.
EQ.2: Discrete spring and damper elements are added to the d3plot database where they are displayed as beam elements(similar to option 0).In this option the element resultant force is written to its first database position allowing beam axial forces and spring resultant forces to be plotted at the same time.This can be useful during some post - processing applications.
This flag, set in *DATABASE_BINARY_D3PLOT, also affects the display of discrete elements in several other databases, such as d3drlfand d3part.
离散单元选项标志（仅限 *DATABASE_BINARY_D3PLOT）：
EQ.0：离散弹簧和阻尼器单元加入 d3plot 数据库并显示为梁单元。离散单元的全局 x、全局 y、全局 z 分量、合力（力矩）以及长度变化（转动）写入数据库；LS-PrePost 会（错误地）将其标记为梁量，例如轴向力、S 剪切合力、T 剪切合力等。
EQ.1：不将离散弹簧、阻尼器和安全带单元加入 d3plot 数据库。将旧版 LS-DYNA 输入文件转换为 KEYWORD 输入时，此选项有用。旧输入文件不要求梁和弹簧单元具有唯一 ID；并且可能为弹簧和阻尼器创建与现有梁单元 ID 相同的梁单元，从而导致致命错误。但此选项有局限，需谨慎使用。
若使用此选项，基于安全带单元部件 ID 的接触接口不会正确生成。
若 PID 指向离散、阻尼器或安全带单元，DEFORMABLE_TO_RIGID 将不起作用。
EQ.2：离散弹簧和阻尼器单元加入 d3plot 数据库并显示为梁单元（类似选项 0）。在此选项下，单元合力写入其第一个数据库位置，因此可同时绘制梁轴向力和弹簧合力。这可能有助于某些后处理应用。
在 *DATABASE_BINARY_D3PLOT 中设置的此标志也影响其他数据库中离散单元的显示，例如 d3drlf 和 d3part。

DT=ENDTIM/NPLTC.  Applies to D3PLOT, D3PART, D3DAT,DEMFOR, and INTFOR options only.  This overrides the DT specified in the first field. ENDTIM is specified in *CONTROL_TERMINATION
DT=ENDTIM/NPLTC。仅适用于 D3PLOT、D3PART、D3DAT、DEMFOR 和 INTFOR 选项。此设置覆盖第一个字段中指定的 DT。ENDTIM 在 *CONTROL_TERMINATION 中指定。

Part set ID for D3PART and D3PLOT options only. See *SET_PART. Parts in PSETID are excluded from the d3plot database.
The d3dat database also honors excluding the parts excluded from d3plot, but this option may not be provided to d3dat directly.
Only parts in PSETID are included in the d3part database.

For options D3DUMP and RUNRSF, MPP/HYBRID executables output both local and global restart files. Each processor creates its own local file for a small or simple restart. Then, processor 0 collects data from all processors and outputs the full deck restart file, but this output requires lots of data communication and disk space. This option provides a scale factor for CYCL (number of time steps between output states) to reduce the number of full deck restart output states to save CPU time. Thus, a full deck restart file is output every NSKIP x NCYCL time steps. The last full deck restart is always output with the regular restart file at the end of the job. The default value of NSKIP is 1.
D3DUMP 和 RUNRSF 选项下，MPP/HYBRID 可执行程序同时输出局部和全局重启动文件。每个处理器为小型或简单重启动创建自己的局部文件，然后处理器 0 收集所有处理器数据并输出完整全模型重启动文件；该输出需要大量数据通信和磁盘空间。此选项为 CYCL（输出状态之间的时间步数）提供比例因子，以减少完整全模型重启动状态数量并节省 CPU 时间。因此每经过 NSKIP × NCYCL 个时间步输出一个完整全模型重启动文件。作业结束时，最后一个完整全模型重启动始终与常规重启动文件一同输出。NSKIP 默认值为 1。

Flag to govern behavior of plot frequency load curve:
EQ.1: At the time each plot is generated, the load curve value is added to the current time to determine the next plot time.(this is the default behavior).
EQ 2: At the time each plot is generated, the next plot time T is computed so that T = the current time plus the load curve value at time T.
EQ 3: A plot is generated for each ordinate point in the load curve definition. The actual value of the load curve is ignored.
控制绘图输出频率载荷曲线处理方式的标志：
EQ.1：每次生成绘图状态时，将当前载荷曲线值加到当前时间，所得结果为下一绘图时刻（默认值）。
EQ.2：每次生成绘图状态时，求解下一绘图时刻 T，使 T 等于当前时间与载荷曲线在 T 时刻的值之和。
EQ.3：载荷曲线定义中的每个横坐标点均生成一个绘图状态，忽略载荷曲线的实际纵坐标值。

Time interval T between filter sampling.  See Remark 7
滤波采样之间的时间间隔 T。参见备注 7。

Frequency cut-off  in Hz.  See Remark 7
频率截止值，单位为赫兹。参见备注 7。

The width of the window W in units of time for storing the single, forward filtering required for the TYPE = 2 filter option.
Increasing the width of the window will increase the memory required for the analysis.
A window that is too narrow will reduce the amplitude of the filtered result significantly, and values below 15 are not recommended for that reason.
In general, the results for the TYPE = 2 option are sensitive to the width of the window and experimentation is required.  See Remark 7.
TYPE = 2 滤波选项所要求用于存储单次正向滤波结果的时间窗口宽度 W。
增加该窗口的宽度会提升分析所需的内存量。
过窄的窗口会显著降低滤波后结果的幅值，因此不建议将该数值设置低于 15。
总体而言，TYPE = 2 选项的计算结果对窗口宽度较为敏感，需要进行相关实验验证。详见备注 7。

Flag for filtering options.  See Remark 7.
EQ.0: No filtering (default).
EQ.1: Single pass, forward Butterworth filtering.
EQ.2: Two pass filtering over the specified time window. Backward Butterworth filtering is applied to the forward Butterworth results that have been stored.
This option improves the phase accuracy significantly at the expense of memory
筛选选项标志，参见备注 7：
EQ.0：不过滤（默认）。
EQ.1：单次正向 Butterworth 滤波。
EQ.2：在指定时间窗口执行双向滤波，对已存储的正向 Butterworth 结果执行反向 Butterworth 滤波。该选项以额外内存换取更高的相位精度。

Part set ID for filtering.  If no set is specified, all parts are included.  For each element integration point in the d3plot file,
24 words of memory are required in LS-DYNA for the single pass filtering, and more for the two pass filtering.
Specifying PSET is recommended to minimize the memory requirements.  See Remark 7.
用于过滤的部件集 ID。若未指定集合，则包括所有部件。对于 d3plot 文件中的每个单元积分点，LS-DYNA 进行单遍过滤需要 24 个机器字的内存，双遍过滤需要更多内存。建议指定 PSET，以尽量降低内存需求。参见备注 7。

EQ.2: Output data to the file d3prop.
指定用于 D3PROP 输出的文件。（也可通过在命令行中添加 d3prop = 1 或 d3prop = 2 来定义，该操作同时会将 IMATL 和 IWALL 设置为 1）
EQ.1：在第一个 d3plot 文件的末尾输出数据。
EQ.2：将数据输出到 d3prop 文件中。

This input field governs how the plot state frequency is determined from curve LCDT:
EQ.1: When a plot is generated at time t_n, then next plot time t_(n + 1) is computed as
t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCDT (t_n)  .
This is the default behavior.
EQ.2: When a plot is generated at time t_n, then next plot time t_(n + 1) is computed as
t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCDT (t_(n + 1))  .
EQ.3: A plot is generated for each abscissa point in the load curve definition.The actual value of the load curve is ignored
控制根据曲线 LCDT 确定绘图状态频率的输入字段：
EQ.1：t_(n+1) = t_n + LCDT(t_n)（默认）。
EQ.2：t_(n+1) = t_n + LCDT(t_(n+1))。
EQ.3：对载荷曲线定义中的每个横坐标点生成绘图，忽略曲线实际值。

For instance, if DTCHECK = 10-6, LS-DYNA will check and update the maximum values every 10-6 seconds (assuming for this example the time units are seconds). It will compare the current values (stress or strain) with the maximum values up to now. If the current values are larger, the maximum values will be replaced by the current values. For the ELOUT file OPTION2 is a integer variable that gives the number of additional history variables written into the ELOUT file for each integration point in the shell elements.

Number of shell integration points written to the LS-DYNA database, see also *INTEGRATION_SHELL. If the default value of 3 is used then results are output for the outermost (top) and innermost (bottom) integration points together with results for the neutral axis. If MAXINT is set to 3 and the element has 1 integration point then all three results will be the same. If a value other than 3 is used then the results for the first MAXINT integration points in the element will be output. NOTE: If the element has an even number of integration points and MAXINT is not set to 3 then you will not get mid-surface results. (See Remarks in user's manual).If MAXINT is set to a negative
number, MAXINT integration points are output for each in plane
integration point location and no averaging is used. This can greatly
increase the size of the binary databases d3plot, d3thdt, and d3part
写入 LS-DYNA 数据库的壳积分点数量，另见 *INTEGRATION_SHELL。若使用默认值 3，则输出最外侧（上表面）和最内侧（下表面）积分点结果，以及中性轴结果。若 MAXINT 设为 3 且单元只有 1 个积分点，则三个结果相同。若使用非 3 值，则输出单元中前 MAXINT 个积分点的结果。注意：若单元具有偶数个积分点且 MAXINT 未设为 3，则不会得到中面结果（见用户手册备注）。若 MAXINT 设为负数，则对每个面内积分点位置输出 MAXINT 个积分点，且不进行平均。这会显著增大二进制数据库 d3plot、d3thdt 和 d3part 的大小。

Flag to govern behavior of the plot frequency load curve defined by LCUR:
EQ.1: At the time each plot is generated, the load curve value is added to the current time to determine the next plot time. (default)
EQ.2: At the time each plot is generated, the next plot time T is computed so that T = the current time plus the load curve value at time T.

控制 LCUR 所定义绘图频率载荷曲线的处理方式：
EQ.1：每次生成绘图时，将此时的载荷曲线值加到当前时间上，所得结果作为下一次绘图时间（默认值）。
EQ.2：每次生成绘图时，求解下一次绘图时间 T，使 T 等于当前时间与载荷曲线在 T 时刻的值之和。

This input field governs how the plot state frequency is determined from curve LCDT:
EQ.1: When a plot is generated at time t_n, the next plot time t_(n + 1) is computed as
t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCDT(t_n)  .
This is the default behavior.
EQ.2: When a plot is generated at time t_n, the next plot time t_(n + 1) is computed as
t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCDT(t_(n + 1))  .
EQ.3: A plot is generated for each abscissa point in the load curve definition.The actual value of the load curve is ignored.
控制根据载荷曲线 LCDT 确定绘图状态频率的输入字段：
EQ.1：在时刻 t_n 生成绘图时，t_(n+1) = t_n + LCDT(t_n)（默认）。
EQ.2：t_(n+1) = t_n + LCDT(t_(n+1))。
EQ.3：对载荷曲线定义中的每个横坐标点生成绘图，忽略载荷曲线实际值。

EQ.0 : The birth time is in relation to the transient time.In other words,the dynamic relaxation time is ignored.For example,if BIRTH = 0.0 and DRTIME = 0,the feature is activated at time zero of the transient run.This is the default.
EQ.1 : The birth time is in relation to dynamic relaxation pseudo time.If the dynamic relaxation ends before BIRTH is reached,the feature is activated at time zero of the transient run.
控制是否计入动态松弛伪时间：
EQ.0：生效时间相对于瞬态时间，忽略动态松弛时间；例如 BIRTH = 0.0 且 DRTIME = 0 时，该功能在瞬态运行时间 0 激活（默认）。
EQ.1：生效时间相对于动态松弛伪时间；若动态松弛在达到 BIRTH 前结束，该功能在瞬态运行时间 0 激活。

Contact interface from which tied nodes are to be excluded. This
must be the ID of a SINGLE_SURFACE, NODE_TO_SURFACE, or
SURFACE_TO_SURFACE contact with SOFT 2..
要从中排除 tied 节点的目标接触界面。必须是 SOFT 2 的 SINGLE_SURFACE、NODE_TO_SURFACE 或 SURFACE_TO_SURFACE 接触 ID。

The IDs of TIED contacts: 7 on the first card and 8 per additional
card for as many cards as necessary.
Any node which is a tracked node in one of these interfaces, and is in
fact tied, will not be processed (as a tracked node) in the Target interface.
Note that if a node is excluded from the Target by this mechanism,
contact forces may still be applied to the node due to any tracked or
master nodes impacting the contact segments of which it is a part
(no contact SEGMENTS are deleted, only contact NODES).
If the Target contact is of type SURFACE_TO_SURFACE, any tied
tracked nodes are deleted from both the tracked side (for the normal
treatment) and the master side (for the symmetric treatment).
TIED 接触的 ID：第一张卡片填写 7 个，后续每张卡片填写 8 个，直至满足所需数量。
若某节点在这些界面中是跟踪节点且实际上已固连，则不会在目标界面中作为跟踪节点处理。通过此机制从 Target 排除的节点，仍可能因跟踪节点或主节点撞击其所属接触段而受到接触力（不会删除接触 SEGMENTS，只删除接触 NODES）。若目标接触类型为 SURFACE_TO_SURFACE，所有已固连的跟踪节点都会从跟踪侧（常规处理）和主侧（对称处理）删除。

PID1 and PID2 indicate parts for determining the local part pressures that can be used to evaluate the vent probability function. Depending on if a chamber is defined, how the local part pressures are evaluated changes (see *DEFINE_CPM_CHAMBER). PID1 and PID2 are optional if a chamber is defined, otherwise they are required input.
When a chamber is defined, specifying PID1and PID2 causes the vent probability function to be evaluated from the difference of local part pressures between PID1and PID2.Otherwise the calculation involves the chamber pressure.This option is usually used for vents near a long sleeve which causes unrealistic venting using chamber pressure alone.
When a chamber is not defined, the vent probability function is evaluated from the difference of local part pressures between PID1and PID2, using the location of the part centers to help determine vent direction..If the part is an external part, the part pressure will be used.If the part is an internal part, the pressure on the shells positive normal side will be used.If the vent is an external vent, PID1 should be the same as PID2 to avoid input error.

Continuous parameter for damage model.EQ.1.0: The bond breaks if the fracture energy in the bond
reaches the critical value. Microdamage is not calculated.
(0.5,1): Microdamage effects being once the fracture energy reaches DMGxFMG[K,S]. Upon the onset of microdamage,
the computed damage ratio will increase (monotonically) as the fracture energy grows. Bond
weakening from microdamage is modeled by reducing the bond stiffness in proportion to the damage ratio.
损伤模型连续参数：
EQ.1.0：键合断裂能达到临界值时断裂，不计算微损伤。
(0.5,1)：断裂能达到 DMGxFMG[K,S] 后开始产生微损伤；此后计算的损伤比随断裂能增加而单调增加，微损伤导致的键合弱化通过按损伤比降低键合刚度建模。

Fracture model:
EQ.1: Fracture energy of shear deformation is calculated based on deviatoric stresses.
EQ.2: Fracture energy of shear deformation is calculated based on deviatoric stresses, excluding the axial component (along the bond).
EQ.3,4: Same as 1&2, respectively, but FRGK and FRGS are read
as the total failure energy density and will be converted to the corresponding critical fracture energy release rate.
The total failure energy density is calculated as the total area under uniaxial tension stress-strain curve.
EQ.5,6: Same as 3&4, respectively, as FRGK and FRGS are read
as the total failure energy density but will not be converted. Instead, the failure energy within the bond will be
calculated. Models 1&2 are more suitable for brittle materials, and Models 5&6
are easier for ductile materials. Models 3&4 can be used for moderately ductile fracture accordingly.
This is the default fracture model and applied to all DES parts, even if they have different material models. More fracture models can be
defined for different materials by specifying an interface ID (ITFID) in the optional card.
断裂模型：
EQ.1：根据偏应力计算剪切变形断裂能。
EQ.2：根据偏应力计算剪切变形断裂能，但排除轴向（沿键）分量。
EQ.3、4：分别同 EQ.1、EQ.2，但 FRGK 和 FRGS 读作总失效能量密度，并转换为对应的临界断裂能释放率。
总失效能量密度按单轴拉伸应力–应变曲线下的总面积计算。
EQ.5、6：分别同 EQ.3、EQ.4，但 FRGK 和 FRGS 读作总失效能量密度且不进行转换，而是在键内计算失效能量。模型 1、2 更适合脆性材料，模型 5、6 更适合延性材料，模型 3、4 可用于中等延性断裂。
这是默认断裂模型，适用于所有 DES 部件，即使其采用不同材料模型。若要为不同材料定义更多断裂模型，可在可选卡片中指定接口 ID（ITFID）。
