点云 PCID 的每个点指定的数据数量。参见备注 1。

Flag to restrict the interpolation domain to a subset of data points of the point cloud PCID. This flag activate a search algorithm that restricts the interpolation domain based on a point-to-element distance criterion. For any element associated with a *PART_FIELD that references this field FID:
EQ.0: Perform global interpolation by interpolating field data from all data points of point cloud PCID.
EQ.1: Restrict the interpolation domain and search for all data points, of point cloud PCID, whose distance from centroid of the element is <= a distance determined by SRCRAD
将插值域限制为点云 PCID 数据点子集的标志。该标志启用基于点到单元距离判据的搜索算法。对于与引用此字段 FID 的 *PART_FIELD 关联的任何单元：
EQ.0：执行全局插值，使用点云 PCID 的所有数据点插值场数据。
EQ.1：限制插值域，搜索点云 PCID 中到单元质心距离不超过 SRCRAD 所确定距离的所有数据点。

Radius of the interpolation domain. If LMTSRC = 0, this parameter is disregarded. If LMTSRC = 1, this parameter allows to restrict the interpolation domain. Based on the value of SRCRAD, the interpolation domain is restricted to all data points whose distance from the element centroid is:
LT. 0.0: less than or equal to |SRCRAD| * REFLEN.
EQ.0.0: Less than or equal to REFLEN.
GT.0.0: Less than or equal to SRCRAD.
插值域半径。如果 LMTSRC=0，则忽略此参数。如果 LMTSRC=1，则此参数可用于限制插值域。根据 SRCRAD 的值，插值域限制为所有数据点，这些点到单元质心的距离为：
LT.0.0：小于或等于 |SRCRAD|×REFLEN。
EQ.0.0：小于或等于 REFLEN。
GT.0.0：小于或等于 SRCRAD。

Reference length used for scaling of radial basis functions and, if required, to restrict the interpolation domain:

GT.0.0: User - defined reference length.Any value can be specified.

Default value of the dynamic coefficient of friction. The frictional coefficient is assumed to be dependent on the relative velocity V of the surfaces in contact. Default values are used when part pair are undefined

Default value of the exponential decay coefficient. The frictional coefficient is assumed to be dependent on the relative velocity V of the surfaces in contact. Default values are used when part pair are undefined

Default value of the coefficient for viscous friction. This is necessary to limit the friction force to a maximum. A limiting force is computed F=VC*Acont. Acont being the area of the segment contacted by the node in contact. The suggested value for VC is to use the yield stress in shear VC=sigma/SQRT(3.0). Where sigma is the yield stress of the contacted material.Default values are used when part pair are undefined
黏性摩擦系数的默认值。设置该值是为了将摩擦力限制在最大值以内。限制力通过公式 F = VC*Acont 计算得出，其中 Acont 为发生接触的节点所对应的段面积。VC 的推荐取值为采用材料的屈服应力，即 VC = sigma/SQRT(3.0)，这里的 sigma 即为被接触材料的屈服应力。当未定义部件对时，将使用默认值。

In this example, two *DEFINE_ FUNCTION definitions are needed to define functions f and g.

Flag to activate an element coordinate system:
EQ.0: The forces are applied in the global directions.
EQ.1: The forces are applied in a local system attached to the
element. The system is consistent with DIREC = 1 and
CTYPE = 12 in *CONSTRAINED_LAGRANGE_IN_SOLID.
For CTYPE = 11, LOCAL is always 1 and the -axis is
aligned with the element normal while the -axis passes
through the element center and the first node in the element
connectivity (*ELEMENT_BEAM in 2D or *ELEMENT_SHELL in 3D).
启用单元坐标系的标志：
EQ.0：力沿全局方向施加。
EQ.1：力施加在附着于单元的局部坐标系中，该坐标系与 *CONSTRAINED_LAGRANGE_IN_SOLID 中 DIREC = 1、CTYPE = 12 时一致。对于 CTYPE = 11，LOCAL 始终为 1；其中一条局部轴与单元法向一致，另一条局部轴经过单元中心和连接关系中的第一个节点（2D 为 *ELEMENT_BEAM，3D 为 *ELEMENT_SHELL）。

*DEFINE_VECTOR IDs to define a specific coordinate system. VECID1
and VECID2 give the - and -direction respectively. The -
vector is a cross product of VECID1 and VECID2. If this latter is not
orthogonal to VECID1, its direction will be corrected with a crossproduct
of - and -vectors. The vectors are stored as isoparametric
locations to update their directions if the element deforms or rotates.
用于定义特定坐标系的 *DEFINE_VECTOR ID。VECID1 和 VECID2 分别给出 x 和 y 方向。z 向量为 VECID1 与 VECID2 的叉积。如果 VECID2 不与 VECID1 正交，其方向将通过 z 向量与 x 向量的叉积进行修正。这些向量以等参位置存储，以便在单元变形或旋转时更新方向。

Part ID of the tube. All connected beam elements in the part will model a tube. Only tubular beam elements are allowed, that is, ELFORM = 1, 4, 5, and 11 with CST = 1 on *SECTION_BEAM. 管道部件 ID。部件中所有相连梁单元均用于建模管道。仅允许管状梁单元，即 *SECTION_BEAM 上 CST = 1 且 ELFORM = 1、4、5 或 11。初始管道截面积使用 *SECTION_BEAM 关键字中的梁内径字段 TT1/TT2 计算；未给出内径时使用外径字段 TS1/TS2。梁单元不得包含连接点。两个定义了 *DEFINE_PRESSURE_TUBE 的不同部件不得共享节点。对于 MPP，部件中的所有单元位于同一处理器。

Solution method:

EQ.1: Discontinuous Galerkin
EQ.2: Discontinuous Galerkin on isothermal Euler equations

EQ.1： 间断 Galerkin 法

Tube elements:
Q.0:    The tube is entirely simulated with beam elements. The contact penetration of the beam elements gives the cross-sectional area. Contact stiffness governs the mechanical response in the radial direction of the beam elements. Only mortar contacts are supported.
EQ.1:    The tube is simulated by the automatic generation of shell elements, which are assigned the beam part ID and the beam material model.A new part ID is given to the beam elements, which are no longer part of the mechanical solution.Contacts and other properties associated with the old beam part ID apply to the new shell part.The shell element nodes give the cross - sectional area.The shells entirely govern the mechanical response.All contact definitions are supported.Constraints defined by * BOUNDARY_SPC,* BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION,* CONSTRAINED_EXTRA_NODES, and *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY and nodes that are shared with a rigid body are moved to the new shell tube.
EQ.2 : The tube is simulated by the automatic generation of solid elements, similarly to TYPE = 1 above.
LT.0 : Automatic generation of elements as above, but the beam nodes are given new nodal IDs.The old beam NIDs are moved to the automatically generated tube(one row of nodes along the length).Any nodal constraints thus apply to the new tube instead of the beam element tube.See Figure 0 - 1 for an example of different values of TYPE and how they affect nodal constraints.
管单元：
Q.0：管道完全采用梁单元模拟。梁单元的接触穿透量给出横截面积。接触刚度控制梁单元径向的力学响应。仅支持 MORTAR 接触。
EQ.1：管道通过自动生成壳单元进行模拟；这些壳单元分配梁部件 ID 和梁材料模型。系统为梁单元分配新的部件 ID，梁单元不再参与力学求解。与旧梁部件 ID 关联的接触及其他属性应用于新的壳部件。壳单元节点给出横截面积。壳单元完全控制力学响应。支持所有接触定义。由 *BOUNDARY_SPC、*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION、*CONSTRAINED_EXTRA_NODES 和 *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY 定义的约束，以及与刚体共享的节点，都会移至新的壳管道。
EQ.2：管道通过自动生成实体单元进行模拟，方式与上面的 TYPE = 1 类似。
LT.0：按上述方式自动生成单元，但梁节点会获得新的节点 ID。旧梁 NID 会移至自动生成的管道（沿长度方向的一排节点）。因此，任何节点约束都应用于新管道，而不是梁单元管道。示例见图 0-1，其中说明 TYPE 的不同取值及其对节点约束的影响。

Q.0:    The tube is entirely simulated with beam elements. The contact penetration of the beam elements gives the cross-sectional area. Contact stiffness governs the mechanical response in the radial direction of the beam elements. Only mortar contacts are supported.

EQ.1：管道通过自动生成壳单元进行模拟；这些壳单元分配梁部件 ID 和梁材料模型。系统为梁单元分配新的部件 ID，梁单元不再参与力学求解。与旧梁部件 ID 关联的接触及其他属性应用于新的壳部件。壳单元节点给出横截面积。壳单元完全控制力学响应。支持所有接触定义。由 *BOUNDARY_SPC、*BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED_MOTION、*CONSTRAINED_EXTRA_NODES 和 *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY 定义的约束，以及与刚体共享的节点，都会移至新的壳管道。
EQ.2：管道通过自动生成实体单元进行模拟，方式与上面的 TYPE = 1 类似。

If this option is nonzero, the node set provided in NSID is ignored. Instead, this parameter defines the radius of a circular injection surface centered at the origin of the coordinate system defined in CID, using the local Z-axis of CID as normal to the injection plane. Particles are uniformly generated with a spacing of PSIZE.
如果此选项非零，则忽略 NSID 中提供的节点集合。相反，该参数定义一个圆形注入表面的半径；该表面以 CID 所定义坐标系的原点为中心，并使用 CID 的局部 Z 轴作为注入平面的法向。粒子以 PSIZE 为间距均匀生成。

If this option is nonzero and RADIUS is zero, the node set provided in NSID is ignored. Instead, a rectangular injection surface is automatically created, centered at the origin of the coordinate system defined in CID, using the local Z-axis of CID as normal to the injection plane. This rectangular injection has dimensions of XLEN and YLEN in the local coordinate system defined by CID. Particles are uniformly generated with a spacing of PSIZE.
如果此选项非零且 RADIUS = 0，则忽略 NSID 中的节点集；自动创建矩形注入面，其中心为 CID 坐标系原点，CID 局部 Z 轴为注入面法向。矩形注入面在 CID 局部坐标系中的尺寸为 XLEN 和 YLEN。粒子按 PSIZE 间距均匀生成。

If this option is nonzero and RADIUS is zero, the node set provided in NSID is ignored. Instead, a rectangular injection surface is automatically created, centered at the origin of the coordinate system defined in CID, using the local Z-axis of CID as normal to the injection plane. This rectangular injection has dimensions of XLEN and YLEN in the local coordinate system defined by CID. Particles are uniformly generated with a spacing of PSIZE.
如果此选项非零且 RADIUS = 0，则忽略 NSID 中的节点集；自动创建矩形注入面，其中心为 CID 坐标系原点，CID 局部 Z 轴为注入面法向。矩形注入面在 CID 局部坐标系中的尺寸为 XLEN 和 YLEN。粒子按 PSIZE 间距均匀生成。

Segment set ID that can be used to removed generated SPH elements. segment set is used to split the box into two regions, one that has SPH elements and one without SPH (see Remark 2). The sign of IDSEG determines which region keeps the SPH elements. Also, to avoid sudden movement, elements that are "too close" to the segment set will be removed, regardless of the sign of IDSEG. Too close means the normal distance from the center of the SPH element to the nearest segment is smaller than the SPH smoothing length scaled by SFSP.
EQ.0: No generated elements are removed.
GT.0: Keep the SPH element if it lies nominally in the normal direction of the segments in the segment set.
LT.0: Keep the SPH element if it lies nominally in the reverse normal direction of segments in the segment set.
段集 ID，可用于移除生成的 SPH 单元。段集用于将盒体划分为两个区域：一个区域包含 SPH 单元，另一个不包含 SPH 单元（参见备注 2）。IDSEG 的符号决定保留 SPH 单元的区域。此外，为避免突然移动，无论 IDSEG 的符号如何，距离段集“过近”的单元都会被移除。“过近”是指 SPH 单元中心到最近段的法向距离小于按 SFSP 缩放后的 SPH 平滑长度。
EQ.0： 不移除生成的单元。
GT.0： 如果 SPH 单元名义上位于段集中各段的法向方向，则保留该 SPH 单元。
LT.0： 如果 SPH 单元名义上位于段集中各段的反法向方向，则保留该 SPH 单元。

Correlation between the yield stress and failure strain scaling.
EQ.0: Perfect correlation.
EQ.1: No correlation. The yield stress and failure strain are independently scaled.
屈服应力与失效应变缩放之间的相关性：
EQ.0：完全相关。
EQ.1：不相关；屈服应力和失效应变独立缩放。

Variation type for scaling the yield stress(or tensile strength for material 280).
EQ.0: The scale factor is 1.0 everywhere.
EQ.1: The scale factor is random number in the uniform random distribution in the interval defined by R1 and R2.
EQ.2: The scale factor is a random number obeying the Gaussian distribution defined by R1, R2, and R3.
EQ.3: The scale factor is defined by the probability distribution function defined by curve LCID.
EQ.4: The scale factor is defined by the cumulative distribution function defined by curve LCID.
用于缩放屈服应力（材料 280 为抗拉强度）的变化类型：
EQ.0：比例因子处处为 1.0。
EQ.1：比例因子是 R1 与 R2 定义区间内均匀随机分布的随机数。
EQ.2：比例因子是服从 R1、R2 和 R3 定义高斯分布的随机数。
EQ.3：比例因子由曲线 LCID 定义的概率分布函数给出。
EQ.4：比例因子由曲线 LCID 定义的累积分布函数给出。

Variation type for scaling failure strain.
EQ.0: The scale factor is 1.0 everywhere.
EQ.1: The scale factor is random number in the uniform random distribution in the interval defined by R1 and R2.
EQ.2: The scale factor is a random number obeying the Gaussian distribution defined by R1, R2, and R3.
EQ.3: The scale factor is defined by the probability distribution function defined by curve LCID.
EQ.4: The scale factor is defined by the cumulative distribution function defined by curve LCID.
用于确定失效应变比例因子的变化类型。
EQ.0：所有位置的比例因子均为 1.0。
EQ.1：比例因子为在 R1 与 R2 所定义区间内服从均匀随机分布的随机数。
EQ.2：比例因子为遵循由 R1、R2 和 R3 所定义的高斯分布的随机数。
EQ.3：比例因子由曲线 LCID 所对应的概率分布函数确定。
EQ.4：比例因子由曲线 LCID 所对应的累积分布函数确定。

Flag for random number generation.
EQ.0: Use deterministic(pseudo - ) random number generator.The same input always leads to the same distribution.

Option Parameters availble:MIRROR
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
Reflect about a mirror plane defined to contain the point (a1,a2,a3 ) having its normal pointing from point (a1,a2,a3) toward (a4,a5,a6). Setting a7 = 1 reflects the coordinate system as well, that this, the mirrored coordinate system uses the left-hand-rule to determine the local z-axis.
MATRIX
Mij in Cards 3 & 4
Direct input of a 4x4 space transformation matrix.  A node with coordinates (x,y,z) will be transformed according to (x,y,z,1)M.  In most cases M14 = M24 = M34 = 0 and M44 = 1.0.  The matrix can be equivalent to other options.  For example, TRANSL is equivalent to M41 = a1, M42 = a2 and M43 = a3, and SCALE is the same as M11 = a1, M22 = a2 and M33 = a3.
POINT
a1,a2,a3,a4
Define a point with ID, a1, with the initial coordinates a2, a3, and a4.
POS6Pa1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
Positioning by 6 points. Affine transformation (rotation and translation, no scaling) given by three start points a1, a2, and a3 and three target points a4, a5, and a6. The six POINTs must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 POS6P option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
POS6N
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
Positioning by 6 nodes. Affine transformation (rotation and translation, no scaling) given by three start nodes a1, a2, and a3 and three target nodes a4, a5, and a6. The six nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 POS6N option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
ROTATE
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
Rotate through an angle (deg), a7, about a line with direction cosines a1, a2, and a3 passing through the point with coordinates a4, a5, and a6.
If a4 through a7 are zero, then a1 and a2 are the IDs of two POINTs and a3 defines the rotation angle. The axis of rotation is defined by a vector going from point with ID a1 to point with ID a2.
ROTATE3NA
a1, a2, a3, a4
Rotate through an angle (deg), a4. The axis of rotation is defined by a vector going from the node with ID a1 to the node with ID a2 and passing through the node with ID a3 (a3 could be the same as a1 or a2). The three nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 ROTATE3NA option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
SCALE
a1, a2, a3
Scale the global x, y, and z coordinates of a point by a1, a2, and a3, respectively.  If zero, a default of unity is set.
TRANSL
a1, a2, a3
Translate the x, y, and z coordinates of a point by a1, a2, and a3, respectively.
TRANSL2ND
a1, a2, a3
Translate by distance a3. The direction is defined by a vector going from node with ID a1 to node with ID a2. The two nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 TRANSL2ND option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
选项参数（可用）：MIRROR
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
相对于镜像平面进行反射：该平面包含点 (a1,a2,a3 )，其法向量从点 (a1,a2,a3) 指向 (a4,a5,a6)。将 a7 = 1 设置为同时反射坐标系；也就是说，镜像后的坐标系使用左手定则确定局部 z 轴。
MATRIX
卡片 3 & 4 中的 Mij
直接输入 4x4 空间变换矩阵。坐标为 (x,y,z) 的节点将根据 (x,y,z,1)M 进行变换。在大多数情况下，M14 = M24 = M34 = 0 且 M44 = 1.0。该矩阵可以等效于其他选项。例如，TRANSL 等效于 M41 = a1、M42 = a2 和 M43 = a3，而 SCALE 等同于 M11 = a1、M22 = a2 和 M33 = a3。
POINT
a1,a2,a3,a4
定义一个点，其 ID 为 a1，初始坐标为 a2、a3 和 a4。
POS6P a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
使用 6 个点定位。仿射变换（旋转和平移，不缩放）由三个起始点 a1、a2 和 a3 以及三个目标点 a4、a5 和 a6 给出。这六个 POINT 必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 POS6P 选项。
POS6N
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
使用 6 个节点定位。仿射变换（旋转和平移，不缩放）由三个起始节点 a1、a2 和 a3 以及三个目标节点 a4、a5 和 a6 给出。六个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 POS6N 选项。
ROTATE
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
绕一条直线旋转角度 a7（单位：deg），该直线的方向余弦为 a1、a2 和 a3，并经过坐标为 a4、a5 和 a6 的点。
如果 a4 至 a7 均为零，则 a1 和 a2 是两个 POINT 的 ID，a3 定义旋转角度。旋转轴由从 ID 为 a1 的点指向 ID 为 a2 的点的向量定义。
ROTATE3NA
a1, a2, a3, a4
旋转角度 a4（单位：deg）。旋转轴由从 ID 为 a1 的节点指向 ID 为 a2 的节点、并经过 ID 为 a3 的节点的向量定义（a3 可以与 a1 或 a2 相同）。三个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 ROTATE3NA 选项。
SCALE
a1, a2, a3
分别按 a1、a2 和 a3 缩放点的全局 x、y 和 z 坐标。如果相应的缩放因子为零，则默认设置为 1。
TRANSL
a1, a2, a3
分别将点的 x、y 和 z 坐标平移 a1、a2 和 a3。
TRANSL2ND
a1, a2, a3
按距离 a3 平移。方向由从 ID 为 a1 的节点指向 ID 为 a2 的节点的向量定义。两个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 TRANSL2ND 选项。

Option Parameters availble:MIRROR
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
Reflect about a mirror plane defined to contain the point (a1,a2,a3 ) having its normal pointing from point (a1,a2,a3) toward (a4,a5,a6). Setting a7 = 1 reflects the coordinate system as well, that this, the mirrored coordinate system uses the left-hand-rule to determine the local z-axis.
MATRIX
Mij in Cards 3 & 4
Direct input of a 4x4 space transformation matrix.  A node with coordinates (x,y,z) will be transformed according to (x,y,z,1)M.  In most cases M14 = M24 = M34 = 0 and M44 = 1.0.  The matrix can be equivalent to other options.  For example, TRANSL is equivalent to M41 = a1, M42 = a2 and M43 = a3, and SCALE is the same as M11 = a1, M22 = a2 and M33 = a3.
POINT
a1,a2,a3,a4
Define a point with ID, a1, with the initial coordinates a2, a3, and a4.
POS6Pa1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
Positioning by 6 points. Affine transformation (rotation and translation, no scaling) given by three start points a1, a2, and a3 and three target points a4, a5, and a6. The six POINTs must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 POS6P option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
POS6N
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
Positioning by 6 nodes. Affine transformation (rotation and translation, no scaling) given by three start nodes a1, a2, and a3 and three target nodes a4, a5, and a6. The six nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 POS6N option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
ROTATE
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
Rotate through an angle (deg), a7, about a line with direction cosines a1, a2, and a3 passing through the point with coordinates a4, a5, and a6.
If a4 through a7 are zero, then a1 and a2 are the IDs of two POINTs and a3 defines the rotation angle. The axis of rotation is defined by a vector going from point with ID a1 to point with ID a2.
ROTATE3NA
a1, a2, a3, a4
Rotate through an angle (deg), a4. The axis of rotation is defined by a vector going from the node with ID a1 to the node with ID a2 and passing through the node with ID a3 (a3 could be the same as a1 or a2). The three nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 ROTATE3NA option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
SCALE
a1, a2, a3
Scale the global x, y, and z coordinates of a point by a1, a2, and a3, respectively.  If zero, a default of unity is set.
TRANSL
a1, a2, a3
Translate the x, y, and z coordinates of a point by a1, a2, and a3, respectively.
TRANSL2ND
a1, a2, a3
Translate by distance a3. The direction is defined by a vector going from node with ID a1 to node with ID a2. The two nodes must be defined before they are referenced. Only 1 TRANSL2ND option is permitted within a *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION definition.
选项参数（可用）：MIRROR
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
相对于镜像平面进行反射：该平面包含点 (a1,a2,a3 )，其法向量从点 (a1,a2,a3) 指向 (a4,a5,a6)。将 a7 = 1 设置为同时反射坐标系；也就是说，镜像后的坐标系使用左手定则确定局部 z 轴。
MATRIX
卡片 3 & 4 中的 Mij
直接输入 4x4 空间变换矩阵。坐标为 (x,y,z) 的节点将根据 (x,y,z,1)M 进行变换。在大多数情况下，M14 = M24 = M34 = 0 且 M44 = 1.0。该矩阵可以等效于其他选项。例如，TRANSL 等效于 M41 = a1、M42 = a2 和 M43 = a3，而 SCALE 等同于 M11 = a1、M22 = a2 和 M33 = a3。
POINT
a1,a2,a3,a4
定义一个点，其 ID 为 a1，初始坐标为 a2、a3 和 a4。
POS6P a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
使用 6 个点定位。仿射变换（旋转和平移，不缩放）由三个起始点 a1、a2 和 a3 以及三个目标点 a4、a5 和 a6 给出。这六个 POINT 必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 POS6P 选项。
POS6N
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6
使用 6 个节点定位。仿射变换（旋转和平移，不缩放）由三个起始节点 a1、a2 和 a3 以及三个目标节点 a4、a5 和 a6 给出。六个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 POS6N 选项。
ROTATE
a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
绕一条直线旋转角度 a7（单位：deg），该直线的方向余弦为 a1、a2 和 a3，并经过坐标为 a4、a5 和 a6 的点。
如果 a4 至 a7 均为零，则 a1 和 a2 是两个 POINT 的 ID，a3 定义旋转角度。旋转轴由从 ID 为 a1 的点指向 ID 为 a2 的点的向量定义。
ROTATE3NA
a1, a2, a3, a4
旋转角度 a4（单位：deg）。旋转轴由从 ID 为 a1 的节点指向 ID 为 a2 的节点、并经过 ID 为 a3 的节点的向量定义（a3 可以与 a1 或 a2 相同）。三个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 ROTATE3NA 选项。
SCALE
a1, a2, a3
分别按 a1、a2 和 a3 缩放点的全局 x、y 和 z 坐标。如果相应的缩放因子为零，则默认设置为 1。
TRANSL
a1, a2, a3
分别将点的 x、y 和 z 坐标平移 a1、a2 和 a3。
TRANSL2ND
a1, a2, a3
按距离 a3 平移。方向由从 ID 为 a1 的节点指向 ID 为 a2 的节点的向量定义。两个节点必须在被引用之前定义。在一个 *DEFINE_TRANSFORMATION 定义中只允许使用 1 个 TRANSL2ND 选项。

Method to update the density:
EQ.1: Automatic update determined by Efv.This update is either an incremental or a total update.
EQ.2: Incremental update.The density is computed from the change in volume relative to the last cycle.
EQ.3: Total update.The density is based on the current element mass and volume.
更新密度的方法：
EQ.1：由 Efv 自动确定，更新可以是增量更新或总量更新。
EQ.2：增量更新，根据相对于上一个循环的体积变化计算密度。
EQ.3：总量更新，根据当前单元的质量和体积确定密度。

Method to update the strain rate for Eulerian materials with strength. The strain rate is derived from the velocity gradients, which are obtained by an element surface integration of the velocity. The face velocity used in this integration is either density-weighted or a simple average of the element velocity on both sides of the face.
EQ.1: Weighted method
EQ.2: Averaged method
为具有强度的欧拉材料更新应变率的方法。应变率由速度梯度导出，速度梯度通过对单元表面速度积分获得；积分所用面速度可为按密度加权的速度，也可为单元两侧面速度的简单平均值。
EQ.1：加权法。
EQ.2：平均法。

Method to update Eulerian pressures:
EQ.1: Volume - weighted average.
EQ.2: Equilibrium.An iterative procedure is used for each material in an Eulerian cell to establish a single pressure consistent with the equation of stateand conditions of each material in the cell.This method is only applied if the cell contains two materialsand these materials are ideal or fully burnt JWL gases.If these conditions are not met, the pressure is averaged accounting for the volume fraction of each material(volume - weighted average).
更新欧拉压力的方法：
EQ.1：体积加权平均。
EQ.2：平衡态；对欧拉单元中每种材料迭代求解单一压力，使其与该材料状态方程和条件一致。仅当单元含两种材料且均为理想气体或完全燃烧的 JWL 气体时使用；否则考虑各材料体积分数进行压力平均（体积加权平均）。

Geometry types.See the table below for more details:
The "GEOM" column in the table below enumerates the allowed values for the geometry variable as well as describing E1, ..., E6 for each geometry type.  Each of the following operations accepts up to 6 arguments but may take fewer.  Values of En left unspecified are ignored.
CPT Mesh region defined by control points.E1 is the minimum control point along the x - axis.E2 is the maximum control point along the x - axis.E3 is the minimum control point along the y - axis.E4 is the maximum control point along the y - axis.E5 is the minimum control point along the z - axis.E6 is the maximum control point along the z - axis.
REPLACE Fill a part in an Eulerian mesh region with the material from a part that has a dummy mesh superimposed on the Eulerian mesh.The dummy mesh specifies the Eulerian mesh region.The dummy mesh has part ID PID.The dummy mesh should be made of shells in 2D and solids in 3D. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the material part in the Eulerian mesh region to be replaced by the material in PID.
BOX* DEFINE_BOX ID that defines a box to fill with the material from PID.*SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E2 is the material part in the box to be replaced by the material in PID.
CYLINDER Define a cylinder to fill with the material from PID.*SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1and E2 are the node IDs that locate the base centers.E3and E4 are the base radii.E5 is the number of nodes along the base circumferences.E6 is the material part in the cylinder to be replaced by the material in PID.
SPHERE Define a sphere or ellipsoid to fill with the material from PID. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the node ID giving the center of the sphere or ellipsoid.E6 is the ID of a local coordinate system(see * DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM).E2, E3,and E4 are the radii in each direction of this coordinate system.They can be different to form an ellipsoid.E5 is the number of nodes along the circumference.E6 is the material part in the sphere / ellipsoid to be replaced by the material in PID.
SEGSET Use segments to specify the boundary of a geometry to be filled with the material from PID. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the set ID of the segments(see * SET_SEGMENT) that define the boundary of the geometry to fill.E2 is the material part in the geometry to be replaced by the material in PID.
RECTANGLE In 2D, fill a rectangle defined between 2 corners with the smallest coordinates(XMIN, YMIN) and largest coordinates(XMAX, YMAX).E1 is a switching flag to determine whether to fill the interior or exterior of the rectangle.E1 = 0 means fill the interior while E1 = 1 means fill the exterior.E2, E3, E4,and E5 are XMIN, XMAX, YMIN,and YMAX, respectively.
QUAD In 2D, fill a quadrilateral defined by 4 nodes: E2, E3, E4,and E5.The node numbering of the quadrilateral must be counterclockwise around the boundary.E1 is a switching flag to determine whether to fill the interior or exterior of the rectangle.E1 = 0 means fill the interior while E1 = 1 means fill the exterior.
ELLIPSE In 2D, fill an ellipse centered at the point(XC, YC) with the semi - axis along the X - axis DX and the semi - axis along the Y - axis DY.E1 is a switching flag to flip the side to fill(by default E1 = 0, if E1 = 1 fill the other side).E2 = XC, E3 = YC, E4 = DX, E5 = DY.
PARABOLA In 2D, fill a side of a parabola defined by X = AY ** 2 + BY + C.E1 is a flag setting which side of the parabola to fill.For E1 = 0, the side of the parabola with convex geometry is filled, meaning any two points in region can be connected with a line segment that remains in the region.For E1 = 1, concave geometry side of the parabola is filled.See Figure 0 - 1. Here, E2, E3,and E4 specify A, B,and C, respectively.
HALFSPACE In 2D, fill the region on one side of a line defined by the points(E2, E3) and (E4, E5) in x - y space.E1 determines the region filled.When E1 = 0, the region on the left side of the line is filled when going along the line from the point(E2, E3) to the point(E4, E5).When E1 = 0, the region on the right side of the line is filled.
UNUSED Mesh region defined by control points where the elements are unused.E1 is the minimum control point along the x - axis.E2 is the maximum control point along the x - axis.E3 is the minimum control point along the y - axis.E4 is the maximum control point along the y - axis.E5 is the minimum control point along the z - axis.E6 is the maximum control point along the z - axis.PID is ignored for this case.Materials occupying the elements are removed.
几何类型。详见下表。
下表中的“GEOM”列列出几何变量允许的值，并描述每种几何类型的 E1、…、E6。以下每种操作最多接受 6 个参数，也可以少于 6 个；未指定的 En 值将被忽略。
CPT：由控制点定义的网格区域。E1 是 x 轴方向的最小控制点，E2 是最大控制点；E3、E4 分别是 y 轴方向的最小和最大控制点；E5、E6 分别是 z 轴方向的最小和最大控制点。
REPLACE：在欧拉网格区域中，用叠加在欧拉网格上的虚拟网格所属部件的材料填充一个部件。虚拟网格指定欧拉网格区域，部件 ID 为 PID。二维虚拟网格应由壳构成，三维虚拟网格应由实体构成。*SECTION_EFV（ELFORM = 9）和 *EFV_MAT 分别指定 PID 的部件截面和材料。E1 是欧拉网格区域中要由 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
BOX：使用 PID 中的材料填充由 *DEFINE_BOX 的 ID 定义的框。*SECTION_EFV（ELFORM = 9）和 *EFV_MAT 分别指定 PID 的部件截面和材料。E2 是框中要由 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
CYLINDER：定义要用 PID 材料填充的圆柱体。*SECTION_EFV（ELFORM = 9）和 *EFV_MAT 分别指定 PID 的部件截面和材料。E1、E2 是定位底面中心的节点 ID；E3、E4 是底面半径；E5 是底面圆周上的节点数；E6 是圆柱体中要由 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
SPHERE：定义要用 PID 材料填充的球体或椭球体。*SECTION_EFV（ELFORM = 9）和 *EFV_MAT 分别指定 PID 的部件截面和材料。E1 是给出球体或椭球体中心的节点 ID；E6 是局部坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM）；E2、E3、E4 是该坐标系各方向的半径，可取不同值以形成椭球体；E5 是圆周上的节点数。
SEGSET：使用段指定要用 PID 材料填充的几何边界。*SECTION_EFV（ELFORM = 9）和 *EFV_MAT 分别指定 PID 的部件截面和材料。E1 是定义待填充几何边界的段集 ID（参见 *SET_SEGMENT）；E2 是几何体中要由 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
RECTANGLE：在二维中，填充由最小坐标（XMIN、YMIN）和最大坐标（XMAX、YMAX）定义的矩形。E1 是决定填充内部还是外部的切换标志：E1 = 0 表示填充内部，E1 = 1 表示填充外部。E2、E3、E4、E5 分别为 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX。
QUAD：在二维中，填充由 4 个节点 E2、E3、E4、E5 定义的四边形。四边形节点必须沿边界逆时针编号。E1 是决定填充内部还是外部的切换标志：E1 = 0 表示填充内部，E1 = 1 表示填充外部。
ELLIPSE：在二维中，填充以（XC、YC）为中心的椭圆，其沿 x 轴和 y 轴的半轴分别为 DX、DY。E1 是翻转填充侧的切换标志（默认 E1 = 0；E1 = 1 时填充另一侧）。E2 = XC、E3 = YC、E4 = DX、E5 = DY。
PARABOLA：在二维中，填充由 X = AY ** 2 + BY + C 定义的抛物线一侧。E1 决定填充哪一侧：E1 = 0 时填充抛物线凸侧；E1 = 1 时填充抛物线凹侧。参见图 0-1。E2、E3、E4 分别指定 A、B、C。
HALFSPACE：在二维 x-y 空间中，填充由点（E2、E3）和（E4、E5）定义的直线一侧。E1 决定填充区域：E1 = 0 时，沿从（E2、E3）到（E4、E5）的方向行进，填充直线左侧。
UNUSED：由控制点定义的网格区域，其中单元未使用。E1、E2 分别是 x 轴方向的最小和最大控制点；E3、E4 分别是 y 轴方向的最小和最大控制点；E5、E6 分别是 z 轴方向的最小和最大控制点。此时忽略 PID，占据这些单元的材料将被移除。

This specifies the maximum number of convergence loops.  If the relative error obtained upon the completion of a run is not within the specified tolerances, LS-DYNA will rerun the model combining the results of all previous runs together with the results of the present run to obtain a more accurate result.  LS-DYNA will rerun the problem NLOOPS times to achieve error margins within the specified tolerances.  If the desired level of convergence is not obtained within NLOOPS iterations LS-DYNA error terminates.
该参数用于指定收敛循环的最大次数。若某次计算完成后的相对误差超出规定的容差范围，LS-DYNA 会将所有先前计算的结果与本次计算的结果相结合后重新运行模型，以获得更精确的数值。LS-DYNA 会重复运行该问题 NLOOPS 次，直至误差控制在规定容差范围内。如果在 NLOOPS 次迭代后仍未达到所需的收敛程度，程序将终止运行并报错。

Specifies that tolerance for convergence of the surface exchange fractions.  This may be overridden on a surface by surface basis with the ERRMAX setting. (see *BOUNDARY_RADIATION_SET_EF_CALCULATE)
指定表面交换分数收敛的容差。可按表面使用 ERRMAX 设置覆盖。（参见 *BOUNDARY_RADIATION_SET_EF_CALCULATE）

GT.0: use INSEED as seed.
LT.0: use a default seed.

EQ.0：使用日期和时间
GT.0：使用 INSEED
LT.0：使用默认种子。

每个收敛循环中每个波段、每个表面发射的光子基数。注意，*BOUNDARY_RADIATION_SET_EF_CALCULATE 中的 NPHT 也会影响每个收敛循环中每个表面、每个波段发射的光子数。

The maximum number of reflections allowed per photon before LS-DYNA issues a warning
在 LS-DYNA 发出警告之前，每个光子允许的最大反射次数。

The maximum number of warnings allowed per surface before the run is aborted
在程序终止之前，每个接触面允许出现的最大警告次数。

The maximum number of lost photons allowed per surface.  Round off error often causes the loss of photons, so this number ought not to be set too small (usually the default is reasonable).
每个表面允许丢失的光子最大数量。舍入误差常常会导致光子丢失，因此该数值不应设置得过小（通常默认值已较为合理）。

The mathematical algorithm underlying the ray tracer, involves gridding the enclosure.  NGX specify the number of grid divisions along the x axis.  This parameter does not affect LS-DYNAs ability to obtain a solution, but it does affect the amount of CPU time consumed to process each photon.  There is no fixed rule for picking NGX, NGY, and NGZ, however for large geometries involving 1,000 to 15,000 surfaces NGX = NGY = NGZ = 25 is often optimal.  For smaller geometries smaller values are recommended
射线追踪器所依据的数学算法涉及对围护体进行网格划分。NGX 指定沿 x 轴的网格划分数。该参数不影响 LS-DYNA 获取解的能力，但会影响处理每个光子所需 CPU 时间。选择 NGX、NGY、NGZ 没有固定规则；对于包含 1,000–15,000 个表面的大型几何体，NGX = NGY = NGZ = 25 往往最优；较小几何体建议使用更小值。

IRESTART should be set either to 1 or 0.  If IRESTART is set to 1 then LS-DYNA restarts the exchange factor solver.  If IRESTART is set to 1 and a .crh file exists, the Monte Carlo solver will pick up where it left off prior to a crash. IRESTART 应设置为 1 或 0。若将其设为 1，则 LS-DYNA 会重新启动交换因子求解器。如果 IRESTART 设为 1 且存在 .crh 文件，蒙特卡洛求解器将会从上次运行出错前的位置继续计算。若存在 .nij 文件但不存在 .crh 文件，LS-DYNA 将会沿用上一次交换因子计算的结果，并通过发射更多光子来提高精度。

Volume of discrete beam and scalar beam. If the mass density of the material model for the discrete beam is set to unity, the magnitude of the lumped mass can be defined here instead. This lumped mass is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The translational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the volume, mass density, and the translational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter. Defining the volume is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam controls the time step size.
离散梁与标量梁的体积。如果为离散梁设置的材料模型的质量密度为 1，则可在此处定义集总质量的大小。该集总质量会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的平动时间步长取决于其体积、质量密度以及平动刚度值，因此定义这一参数非常重要。此外，当类型 6 梁用于控制时间步长时，定义体积对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

Mass moment of inertia for the six degree of freedom discrete beam and scalar beam. This lumped inertia is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The rotational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the lumped inertia and the rotational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter if the rotational springs are active. Defining the rotational inertia is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam rotational stiffness controls the time step size.
六自由度离散梁与标量梁的质量转动惯量。该集中惯性值会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的旋转时间步长取决于该集中惯性值以及旋转刚度值，因此当启用旋转弹簧时，定义这一参数十分重要。此外，如果类型 6 梁的旋转刚度用于控制时间步长，则定义旋转惯量对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

Volume of discrete beam and scalar beam. If the mass density of the material model for the discrete beam is set to unity, the magnitude of the lumped mass can be defined here instead. This lumped mass is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The translational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the volume, mass density, and the translational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter. Defining the volume is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam controls the time step size.
离散梁与标量梁的体积。如果为离散梁设置的材料模型的质量密度为 1，则可在此处定义集总质量的大小。该集总质量会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的平动时间步长取决于其体积、质量密度以及平动刚度值，因此定义这一参数非常重要。此外，当类型 6 梁用于控制时间步长时，定义体积对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

Mass moment of inertia for the six degree of freedom discrete beam and scalar beam. This lumped inertia is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The rotational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the lumped inertia and the rotational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter if the rotational springs are active. Defining the rotational inertia is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam rotational stiffness controls the time step size.
六自由度离散梁与标量梁的质量转动惯量。该集中惯性值会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的旋转时间步长取决于该集中惯性值以及旋转刚度值，因此当启用旋转弹簧时，定义这一参数十分重要。此外，如果类型 6 梁的旋转刚度用于控制时间步长，则定义旋转惯量对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

This option is not defined for material types than act between two nodal points, such as cable elements. The coordinate system rotates with the discrete beam, see SCOOR above.
用于定位的坐标系 ID，材料类型 ID（66-69, 93, 95, 97, 121, 146），参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM。如果 CID=0，则在全局系统或梁的第三个节点上定义默认坐标系，用于定向。对于作用在两个节点之间的材料类型（如索单元），不定义此选项。坐标系随离散梁旋转，参见上文的 SCOOR。

Volume of discrete beam and scalar beam. If the mass density of the material model for the discrete beam is set to unity, the magnitude of the lumped mass can be defined here instead. This lumped mass is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The translational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the volume, mass density, and the translational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter. Defining the volume is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam controls the time step size.
离散梁与标量梁的体积。如果为离散梁设置的材料模型的质量密度为 1，则可在此处定义集总质量的大小。该集总质量会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的平动时间步长取决于其体积、质量密度以及平动刚度值，因此定义这一参数非常重要。此外，当类型 6 梁用于控制时间步长时，定义体积对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

Mass moment of inertia for the six degree of freedom discrete beam and scalar beam. This lumped inertia is partitioned to the two nodes of the beam element. The rotational time step size for the type 6 beam is dependent on the lumped inertia and the rotational stiffness values, so it is important to define this parameter if the rotational springs are active. Defining the rotational inertia is also essential for mass scaling if the type 6 beam rotational stiffness controls the time step size.
六自由度离散梁与标量梁的质量转动惯量。该集中惯性值会被分配到梁单元的两个节点上。类型 6 梁的旋转时间步长取决于该集中惯性值以及旋转刚度值，因此当启用旋转弹簧时，定义这一参数十分重要。此外，如果类型 6 梁的旋转刚度用于控制时间步长，则定义旋转惯量对于实现质量缩放也至关重要。

Flag giving the algorithm for determining the limiting force from the data points of curve LCFL.
EQ.0: Check the status of the sensor switches based on the sequence of data points.For example, this algorithm checks the switch of the 1st data point first.If its switch condition is met, the active force limit is the force of the 1st data point.That force level stays active until the 2nd switch meets the switch condition.
EQ.1: Check the status of all unfired switches in curve LCFL.The force of the most recently fired switch gives the active force limit.The algorithm does not check that switch again in the future.That force level remains active until any other switch fires.The input order of the data points is irrelevant.
EQ.2: Check the status of all switches of all data points in curve LCFL.The input order of the data points is irrelevant.The active force limit is the minimum of the forces of all fired switches.
给出由曲线 LCFL 数据点确定极限力的算法。
EQ.0：按数据点顺序检查传感器开关；先检查第一个数据点，若满足其切换条件，则该点的力为当前极限力；该力保持有效，直到第二个开关满足切换条件。

EQ.2：检查曲线 LCFL 所有数据点的全部开关；数据点输入顺序无关；当前极限力取所有已触发开关对应力的最小值。

Define the type of EOS:
EQ.1: Permeability defined by B as a function of H curve (B=mu*H). The abscissa of the curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.2: Permeability defined by a H function of B curve(H = B / mu).The abscissa of the curve is B, and the ordinate is H.
EQ.3 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H curves(B = mu*H) may be defined as a function of von Mises stress.The abscissa of the curve is von Mises stress, and the ordinate is a load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.4 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H load curves(B = mu*H) may be defined as a function of temperature.The abscissa of the curve is temperature, and the ordinate is load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.5 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H curves(B = mu*H) may be defined as a function of an equivalent stress model calculated from uniaxial stress.The abscissa of the curve is uniaxial stress; the ordinate is a load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.See Remark 4.
EQ.7: Permeability given by an analytical arctan law defining B as a function of H and optionally temperature.See Remark 1.
EQ.8 : Permeability given by the Froelich law defining B as a function of H and optionally temperature.See Remark 2.
EQ.31 : Same as 3, except the signed von Mises stress is used.
定义 EOS 类型：
EQ.1：通过 B-H 曲线定义磁导率（B=μH）。曲线横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.2：通过 H-B 曲线定义磁导率（H=B/μ）。曲线横坐标为 B，纵坐标为 H。
EQ.3：通过载荷曲线定义磁导率，其中 B-H 曲线（B=μH）可表示为 von Mises 应力的函数。该曲线横坐标为 von Mises 应力，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。每条 B-H 载荷曲线的横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.4：通过载荷曲线定义磁导率，其中 B-H 载荷曲线（B=μH）可表示为温度的函数。该曲线横坐标为温度，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。每条 B-H 载荷曲线的横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.5：通过载荷曲线定义磁导率，其中 B-H 曲线（B=μH）可表示为由单轴应力计算的等效应力模型的函数。曲线横坐标为单轴应力，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。每条 B-H 载荷曲线的横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。参见备注 4。
EQ.7：通过解析 arctan 定律给定磁导率，将 B 定义为 H 及可选温度的函数。参见备注 1。
EQ.8：通过 Froelich 定律给定磁导率，将 B 定义为 H 及可选温度的函数。参见备注 2。
EQ.31：与 EQ.3 相同，但使用带符号的 von Mises 应力。

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more detailed description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.The a - direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element.The b - direction is orthogonal to the a - direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2,and 4.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point in space, P,and the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR.
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector, v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.
材料轴选项（更详细说明参见 *MAT_002）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点确定。a 方向从单元的节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点与后四个节点定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定；二者定义中心线轴。

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more detailed description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.The a - direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element.The b - direction is orthogonal to the a - direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2,and 4.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point in space, P,and the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR.
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector, v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.
材料轴选项（更详细说明参见 *MAT_002）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点确定。a 方向从单元的节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点与后四个节点定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定；二者定义中心线轴。

Unloading option (See Volume II, Figure 119.1.):
EQ.0.0: Loading and unloading follow loading curve
EQ.1.0: Loading follows loading curve, unloading follows unloading curve. The unloading curve ID if undefined is taken as the loading curve.
EQ.2.0: Loading follows loading curve, unloading follows unloading stiffness, KT or KR, to the unloading curve.  The loading and unloading curves may only intersect at the origin of the axes.
EQ.3.0: Quadratic unloading from peak displacement value to a permanent offset..

卸载选项（参见第二卷，图 119.1）：
EQ.0.0：加载与卸载均遵循载荷曲线。
EQ.1.0：加载遵循载荷曲线，卸载遵循卸载曲线；若未定义卸载曲线编号，则以载荷曲线作为卸载曲线。
EQ.2.0：加载遵循载荷曲线，卸载则遵循卸载曲线对应的刚度、KT 或 KR 值。载荷曲线与卸载曲线仅能在坐标原点处相交。
EQ.3.0：从峰值位移值开始按二次函数规律进行卸载，直至达到恒定偏移量。

Compressive failure strain

当 UNLOAD = 3.0 时，该值为 0 到 1.0 之间的数值，用于确定卸载后的永久变形量。压缩状态和拉伸状态下的永久变形量分别等于该偏移值与最大压缩位移及最大拉伸位移的乘积。

Hourglass coefficient. Values of QM that exceed 0.15 (for IHQ<6) may cause instabilities. Values of QM that exceed .15 (for IHQ<6) may cause instabilities. The recommended default applies to all options. The stiffness forms, however, can stiffen the response especially if deformations are large and therefore should be used with care. For the shell and membrane elements QM is taken as the membrane hourglass coefficient, the bending as QB, and warping as QW. These coefficients can be specified independently, but generally, QM=QB=QW, is adequate. For type 6 solid element hourglass control, QM=1.0 gives an accurate coarse mesh bending stiffness that does not lock in the incompressible limit. For type 6 values such as 0.001-0.01 will avoid an overly stiff response.

Specify which variable is taken into account for the error calculation:
LT.0: Adaptive meshing is based only on the level-set function. Elements of size MINH are targeted over a length |VAR| on each side of the interface.
EQ.0: Velocity, pressureand level-set function are taken into account.
EQ.1: Remove the level-set function from the error calculation.
EQ.2: Remove the pressure from the error calculation.
EQ.3: Remove both the pressure and the level-set function from the error calculation.Only the fluid velocity will, therefore, remain.

EQ.10:    For species transport problems, use species concentrations and the velocity field for the error calculation.
指定误差计算中考虑的变量：

Indicates the thermal coupling type.
EQ.0: Robust and accurate monolithic coupling where the temperature field are solved simultaneously between the fluid and the structure.
EQ.1: Weak thermal coupling. The fluid passes the heat flux to the structure at the fluid-structure interface and the structure returns the temperature which is applied as a Dirichlet condition.
热耦合类型：

EQ.1：弱热耦合；流体将热通量传递给流固界面处的结构，结构返回温度并将其作为 Dirichlet 条件施加。

Thermal Speedup Factor. This factor multiplies all thermal parameters present in the heat equation with  units  of  time  in  the  denominator  (e.g.,  thermal  conductivity,  convection  heat  transfer  coefficients).    It  is  used  to artificially  time  scale  the thermal problem. A negative value refers to a time dependent load curve.
热加速因子。该因子将热方程中所有分母带有时间单位的热参数（例如热导率、对流传热系数）相乘。它用于对热问题进行人为时间缩放。负值表示与时间相关的载荷曲线。

用于缩放流体传递给结构的力的比例因子。

Maximal fluid velocity that can be used for the calculation of the fluid force passed on to the DEM particle. This is to avoid having spurious velocities in the fluid causing very high and unrealistic forces on the DEM particles which may lead to a crash.
用于计算作用在 DEM 颗粒上的流体力的最大流体速度。这样可避免流体中出现异常速度，从而防止对 DEM 颗粒产生过高且不真实的力，进而避免发生碰撞。

Drag calculation type:

Scale factor applied to the force transmitted by the structure to the fluid
结构传递给流体的力的比例因子。

Type of formulation used in the coupling:
EQ.0: The force at the particle is based on a velocity drag value

耦合公式类型：
EQ.0：颗粒处的力基于速度阻力值
EQ.1：使用流体压力梯度计算力。

Number of time steps between particle searches. The default is 50 in explicit analysis and 1 in implicit. Increasing this number can reduce the computational time at the expense of possible less accurate particle tracking.
粒子搜索之间的时间步数。显式分析中的默认值为 50，隐式分析中的默认值为 1。增大该数值可以减少计算时间，但可能降低粒子跟踪的准确性。

Gap type. Defines the criteria for selecting a distance to build the gap between the embedded nodes and the newly generated:

间隙类型，定义在嵌入节点与新生成节点之间构建间隙时选择距离的准则：

Distance value if GTYPE=1 or scale factor value if GTYPE=0
当 GTYPE = 1 时为距离值，当 GTYPE = 0 时为比例因子值。

Triple Point Seal. Allows to control the fluid escape through triple points
EQ.0: Off
EQ.1: On.The triple points of embedded shells in contact to walls or among each other are sealed and no flow goes through them
三重点密封，用于控制流体通过三重点的逸出。
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。与壁面或彼此接触的嵌入壳的三重点被密封，流体不会通过。

Indicates the coupling direction to the solver.
EQ.0: Two-way coupling. Loads and displacements are transferred across the FSI interface, and the full non-linear problem is solved. It gives weak FSI coupling when coupled to explicit mechanical solver and strong FSI coupling when coupled to implicit mechanical solver.
EQ.1: One - way coupling.The solid mechanics solver transfers displacements to the fluid solver.
EQ.2: One - way coupling.The fluid solver transfers stresses to the solid mechanics solver.
EQ.3: Two - way coupling. It causes weak coupling(no sub - stepping) with the implicit mechanical solver.
指示与求解器的耦合方向：
EQ.0：双向耦合。载荷和位移在 FSI 界面两侧传递，并求解完整非线性问题；与显式机械求解器耦合时为弱 FSI 耦合，与隐式机械求解器耦合时为强 FSI 耦合。
EQ.1：单向耦合，固体力学求解器向流体求解器传递位移。
EQ.2：单向耦合，流体求解器向固体力学求解器传递应力。
EQ.3：双向耦合；与隐式机械求解器耦合时产生弱耦合（无子步）。

Birth time for the FSI coupling. Before BT the fluid solver will not pass any loads to the structure but it will receive displacements from the solid solver.
FSI 耦合的激活时间。在 BT 之前，流体求解器不会向结构传递任何载荷，但会接收来自固体求解器的位移。

Death time for the FSI coupling. After DT the fluid solver will not trans# fer any loads to the solid solver but it will continue to deform with the solid.
流固耦合 (FSI) 的停用时间。DT 之后，流体求解器将不会向固体求解器传递任何载荷，但它会继续随固体变形。

Interaction detection coefficient.
相互作用检测系数。

Optional load curve ID to apply a scaling factor on the forces transferred to the solid:

LT.0: Load curve ID function of time.

LT.0：载荷曲线为时间的函数。

GT.0：每隔 IDETEC 个时间步检测界面。

Method used to represent the immersed interface. By default, the solver assumes that all interfaces of interest are body-fitted.
EQ.0: Immersed methods are not used in the model.
EQ.1: Method based on a discontinuous FEM approximation at the interface
EQ.2: Method based on the Resistive Immersed Implicit Surface(RIIS) method.This option needs DEM particles on the surface of immersed structural parts. See *DEFINE_DE_MESH_SURFACE.Note that prior to R17, using this method required *ICFD_CONTROL_DEM_COUPLING to specify the coupling between the DEM particles and fluid. With R17, *ICFD_CONTROL_IMMERSED_FSI controls the coupling for all immersed interfaces, and *ICFD_CONTROL_DEM_COUPLING is no longer needed
EQ.4:    Method based on the Resistive Immersed Implicit Surface (RIIS) method. The fluid solver detects structural parts and computes the interfaces automatically.
用于表示浸入界面的方法。默认情况下，求解器假设所有关注界面均为贴体界面。
EQ.0：模型中不使用浸入方法。

EQ.4：基于 Resistive Immersed Implicit Surface（RIIS）方法。流体求解器检测结构部件并自动计算界面。

Flag for specifying whether the immersed interface remains unchanged (static) during the simulation:
EQ.0:The immersed interface is dynamic. Frequent interface computations are needed.
EQ.1:The immersed interface is static. The interface is computed at the first time step or after re-meshing steps only. This option saves computation time.
指定浸入界面在仿真期间是否保持不变（静态）的标志：

Search radius.  LS-DYNA remaps history variables from the mesh of the stamped part to the mesh of the crash part with a spatial tolerance of RMAX.  If an element in the crash part lies within RMAX of the stamped part, data will be mapped to that element.  If set less than 0.001, RMAX automatically assumes the default value of 20.
搜索半径。LS-DYNA 会根据 RMAX 的空间容差，将冲压部件网格中的历史变量映射到碰撞部件的网格上。如果碰撞部件中的某个单元与冲压部件的距离在 RMAX 范围内，则数据会被映射到该单元上。若该值设定为小于 0.001，则 RMAX 会自动采用 20 这一默认值。

Flag to map part thickness.  The thickness direction is determined from the element normals, hence the need for consistency in the element normals.  The thicknesses of the target part elements are adjusted so the target part thickness matches the source part thickness at any given location.  Currently, this variable is hardwired so that thickness mapping is always on.
用于映射部件厚度的标志。厚度方向由单元法线确定，因此必须确保单元法线的一致性。系统会调整目标部件中各单元的厚度，使得在任何给定位置上目标部件的厚度都与源部件的厚度保持一致。目前，该变量被设置为固定值，即始终启用厚度映射功能。

Treatment of the elements and nodes that are out of the mapping bounds (meaning the coordinates of their projections on the previous mesh are outside this mesh).
SYM is a 6-digit parameter. Each digit represents a plane for a box that encloses the previous mesh.
These planes are parallel to the previous coordinate system:
EQ.00000p: Rule for the X - plane along the lower previous mesh bound
EQ.0000p0: Rule for the X - plane along the upper previous mesh bound
EQ.000p00: Rule for the Y - plane along the lower previous mesh bound
EQ.00p000: Rule for the Y - plane along the upper previous mesh bound
EQ.0p0000: Rule for the Z - plane along the lower previous mesh bound
EQ.p00000: Rule for the Z - plane along the upper previous mesh bound
The value of p defines the rule to apply in relation to the box plane:
EQ.0: Do nothing.
EQ.1: Translational symmetry(direction of translation orthogonal to the box plane)
EQ.2: Mirror - image symmetry about the box plane
EQ.3: Continuity of boundary elements and nodes along the box plane
处理超出映射边界的单元和节点，即其在前一网格上的投影坐标位于该网格之外。SYM 为 6 位参数，每位代表包围前一网格的盒体的一个平面，平面与前一坐标系平行：EQ.00000p 为下边界 X 平面，EQ.0000p0 为上边界 X 平面，EQ.000p00 为下边界 Y 平面，EQ.00p000 为上边界 Y 平面，EQ.0p0000 为下边界 Z 平面，EQ.p00000 为上边界 Z 平面。
p 的值定义相对于盒面要采用的规则：EQ.0 不做处理；EQ.1 平移对称（平移方向垂直于盒面）；EQ.2 相对于盒面的镜像对称；EQ.3 盒面上边界单元和节点连续。

IDs of vectors (see *DEFINE_VECTOR) for specifying the orientation and location of a cylinder or truncate cone with either circular or elliptical bases. The cylinder or truncated cone can also be oblique. For all cases, the tail of VID1 gives the center of one of the bases, the length of VID2 gives the length of the cylinder or truncated cones axis, and the direction of VID2 gives the direction of the cylinder or truncated cones axis.
For a cylinder with circular bases, the length of VID1 is the radius of the circle.The bases lie in planes formed by VID1and the cross product of VID1 with VID2.VID3 should not be input for this case.See Figure 0 - 1.
For a cylinder with elliptical bases, the lengths of VID1and VID3 are the lengths of the two axes.The direction of the axis with the length of VID1 is in the direction of VID1.The direction for the axis with the length given by VID3 is in the direction given by the cross product of VID1 with VID2.See Figure 0 - 2.
For a truncated cone, you must specify VID4 in addition to VID1and VID2.The bottom base determines if the bases are circular or elliptical based on whether you specify VID3 as previously discussed.VID4 gives the direction and length of the first axis of the second base.It does not need to be parallel to VID1.The second base is scaled uniformly from the first base.See Figure 0 - 3.
用于指定圆柱或截锥体方向和位置的向量 ID（参见 *DEFINE_VECTOR），底面可为圆形或椭圆形，圆柱/截锥体也可以是斜的。VID1 尾端给出一个底面中心，VID2 长度给出轴线长度，VID2 方向给出轴线方向。

Artificial stiffness. Simulates additional linearly elastic "ghost" elements in the cross section.
These elements prevent mesh distortion by stiffening up the structure.
GT.0: load curve ID defining stiffness fraction as a function of time.
The stiffness of the ghost elements is the load curve value times the stiffness of the material in the part.
Since the ghost element stress counteracts the preload stress the fraction should be low(1% or less).
The total section stress is the preload stress minus the ghost element stress.
LT.0: |ISTIFF| is the load curve ID for the stiffness fraction as a function of time.
The preload stress is here automatically adjusted(-/+10 % of original prestress values) such that the total section stress corresponds to the curve in LCID.
人工刚度。模拟截面中的附加线弹性“幽灵”单元。
这些单元通过提高结构刚度来防止网格畸变。
GT.0：定义刚度分数随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。
幽灵单元的刚度等于载荷曲线值乘以部件材料刚度。
由于幽灵单元应力抵消预载应力，该分数应较小（1% 或更低）。
截面总应力等于预载应力减去幽灵单元应力。
LT.0：|ISTIFF| 是刚度分数随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。
此处预载应力会自动调整（原始预应力值的 -/+10%），使截面总应力与 LCID 中的曲线一致。

Shape compensation scale factor. The value scales the spring back
amount of the blank and the scaled amount is used to compensate the tooling.
GT.0: compensate in the opposite direction of the spring back;
LT.0: compensate in the punch moving direction (for undercut).
This scale factor scales how much of the shape deviation is
compensated. For example, if 10 mm of spring back is predicted,
and the scale factor is chosen as 0.75, then the compensation in the
opposite direction will only be 7.5 mm.
Experience shows that the best scale factor for reaching a converged
solution (within part tolerance) is case dependent. In some cases, a
scale factor range of 0.5 to 0.75 is best; while in others, larger values
are indicated. Sometimes, the best value can be larger than 1.1.
Note that within an automatic compensation loop, this factor does  not need to be varied.

The smooth level parameter controls the smoothness of the modified surfaces. A large value makes the surface smoother. The commonly used value is between 5 and 10.  If springback is large, the transition region is expected to be large.  However, by using a smaller value of SL, the region of transition can be reduced

This scales how much of the shape deviation is compensated. For example, if 10 mm springback is predicted, and the scale factor is chosen as 0.75, then the compensation in the opposite direction will only be 7.5 mm.Through many parameter studies, it is found that the best scale factor is case dependent. For some cases, a scale factor of 0.75 is best, while for others, larger values are better. Sometimes, the best value can be larger than 1.1. Since it is impossible to choose the best value for each application it is suggested that for a new application, the initial trial is 0.75.  If the springback cannot be effectively compensated, more iterations must be used to compensate the remaining shape deviation.For channel with twisting, the scale factor is more important. It was found that a small change of the tool shape might change the twisting mode.  If this occurs, using a small value (<0.5) is suggested.
该因子决定形状偏差的补偿量。例如，若预测回弹为 10 mm，比例因子取 0.75，则相反方向的补偿量仅为 7.5 mm。大量参数研究表明，最佳比例因子取决于具体情况。有些情况下 0.75 最佳，另一些情况下更大值更好。有时最佳值可能大于 1.1。由于不可能为每个应用选择最佳值，建议新应用首次试验使用 0.75。如果回弹无法有效补偿，则必须增加迭代次数以补偿剩余形状偏差。对于具有扭转的槽形部件，比例因子更为重要。研究发现，工具形状的微小变化可能改变扭转模式。若发生这种情况，建议使用较小值（<0.5）。

If NHSV exceeds the number of integration point history variables required by the constitutive model, LS-DYNA only writes the number required. 确定 ISPG 节点是否自动与结构节点对齐，以及结构段中的划分是否按 NDIV_MIN 确定（参见备注 1）：
EQ.0 或 EQ.1：自动对齐。
NE.0 且 NE.1：不自动对齐。

EQ.0：
.OR.EQ.1：启用交错。
NE.0：
.AND.NE.1：禁用交错。

Scale factor for determining whether to add a new ISPG node. The adaptivity algorithm adds a node if the distance between two adjacent ISPG nodes is larger than RA_SCLxD_avg,. D_avg is the original average element edge length of an ISPG part
用于确定是否添加新 ISPG 节点的比例因子。当两个相邻 ISPG 节点之间的距离大于 RA_SCL×D_avg 时，自适应算法添加节点；D_avg 为 ISPG 部件的原始平均单元边长。

Scale factor for determining whether to delete an ISPG node. The adaptivity algorithm deletes a node if the distance between two adjacent ISPG nodes is smaller than RD_SCLxD_avg. D_avg is the original average element edge length of an ISPG part
用于确定是否删除 ISPG 节点的比例因子。当两个相邻 ISPG 节点之间的距离小于 RD_SCL×D_avg 时，自适应算法删除节点；D_avg 为 ISPG 部件的原始平均单元边长。

Critical angle (unit rad) between adjacent structural segments for ISPG edges to stagger (see IMOV defined above).
用于 ISPG 边交错的相邻结构段临界角（单位：rad；参见上文定义的 IMOV）。

Critical angle (unit rad) of adjacent structural segments for ISPG nodes to align to structural nodes (see IALIGN defined above).
ISPG 节点与结构节点对齐时相邻结构段的临界角（单位：rad）；参见上文定义的 IALIGN。

Minimum number of divisions of the structural segment for ISPG node alignment (see IALIGN above). The number of divisions in the local s (nodes 1->2 and 4->3 for a 4-node segment) and t-directions (nodes 2->3 and 1->4 for a 4-node segment) for a 4-node structural segment is determined by ndiv_s=max(ndiv_min,2 L_s/(D_avg)) and  ndiv_t=max(ndiv_min,2 L_t/(D_avg)), where L_s=max(L_12,L_34 ), L_t=max(L_23,L_14 ), and D_avg is the original average element edge length of an ISPG part.  For three-node segments, the segment's maximum length is used to determine the division number.
用于 ISPG 节点对齐的结构段最小分割数（见上文 IALIGN）。对于四节点结构段，局部 s 方向（节点 1→2 和 4→3）及 t 方向（节点 2→3 和 1→4）的分割数分别为 ndiv_s = max(ndiv_min, 2 L_s / D_avg) 和 ndiv_t = max(ndiv_min, 2 L_t / D_avg)，其中 L_s = max(L_12, L_34)，L_t = max(L_23, L_14)，D_avg 为 ISPG 部件原始平均单元边长。对于三节点段，使用该段最大长度确定分割数。

Control the number of quadrature points in the ISPG element used for the detection of ISPG element penetration into structural elements:
EQ.0: Use one quadrature point(center of the ISPG element) for the detection.
EQ.1: Use 5 points for the detection.
控制用于检测 ISPG 单元穿透结构单元的积分点数量：
EQ.0：使用 1 个积分点（ISPG 单元中心）进行检测。
EQ.1：使用 5 个积分点进行检测。

Minimum relative element height compared to the average element edge length D_avg. If the element's height (for the tetrahedral elements, whose 4 nodes are at the surface of the ISPG part) after adaptivity is smaller than HMINxD_avg, then this element is excluded from the ISPG part. The default value of HMIN is 0.001. We recommend values of HMIN between 0.001 and 0.05.
相对于平均单元边长 D_avg 的最小相对单元高度。自适应后，若单元高度（ISPG 部件表面上四节点四面体单元）小于 HMIN×D_avg，则从 ISPG 部件中排除该单元。HMIN 默认值为 0.001，建议取 0.001～0.05。

Scale factor for the element size at the regions near the contact edges (see Figure 0-1). The element size near the contact edges is SCL_CExD_avg for the refinement. Here, D_avg is the original average element edge length for the ISPG elements. The default value of SCL_CE is 1.0. If SCL_CE is smaller than 0.333, then it is reset to 0.333.
接触边缘附近区域的单元尺寸比例因子（参见图 0-1）。细化时接触边缘附近的单元尺寸为 SCL_CE×D_avg，其中 D_avg 为 ISPG 单元的原始平均单元边长。SCL_CE 默认值为 1.0；若小于 0.333，则重置为 0.333。

Flag to automatically merge parts that are sufficiently close together into one part:

Starting time for the fully implicit ISPG iteration. Before BIRTH, only one-way coupling occurs, meaning no forces from the solder return to the structure. The implicit time step for ISPG parts is DTIMP instead of the structural implicit step to guarantee that the fluid moves with the solid boundaries. After BIRTH, two-way coupling occurs, and the ISPG solver performs a full iteration with the structural implicit step. This option is very useful for cases where the structural simulation time is very long (e.g., in seconds or minutes) while the reflow process to steady state is very short.
完全隐式 ISPG 迭代的开始时间。BIRTH 之前仅进行单向耦合，即焊料不会向结构传回力。ISPG 部件使用 DTIMP 作为隐式时间步，而非结构隐式时间步，以确保流体随固体边界移动。BIRTH 之后进行双向耦合，ISPG 求解器与结构隐式步执行完整迭代。对于结构仿真时间很长（例如数秒或数分钟）而回流过程达到稳态很短的情况，此选项非常有用。

For TIEBREAK contacts, pressure is masked until the tie fails. Once the tie fails, the full pressure will be applied for the remainder of the
simulation. The values P1 and P2 are ignored. For other contact types, the contact forces, along with the nodal
contact surface areas, are used to compute the contact pressure at each node to determine any masking effect.

Flag for periodicity. The default (IOPTP=0) requires the load curve to be defined between 0 and 2  . This is useful, for example, for modeling an engine that is running at a steady state since each rotation will experience the same loading. To model a transient response, IOPTP=1 uses a load curve defined over the full range of angles, permitting a different response on the second and subsequent revolutions.
周期性标志。默认 IOPTP=0 要求载荷曲线定义在 0 到 2π 之间，适合稳态运行发动机等每转载荷相同的情况。瞬态响应时，IOPTP=1 使用覆盖完整角度范围的载荷曲线，使第二转及后续转次可有不同响应。

Minimum allowable value for load curve scale factor. To maintain a constant strain rate the pressure curve is scaled. In the case of a snap through buckling the pressure may be removed completely. By putting a value here the pressure will continue to act but at a value given by this scale factor multiplying the pressure curve.
载荷曲线比例因子的最小允许值。为保持恒定的应变率，压力曲线会进行比例缩放。在发生突然屈曲的情况下，压力可能会完全消失。通过设置该数值，压力仍会持续作用，但其数值将为压力曲线乘以该比例因子后的结果。

Maximum allowable value for load curve scale factor. Generally, it is a good idea to put a value here to keep the pressure from going to unreasonable values after full contact has been attained. When full contact is achieved the strain rates will approach zero and pressure will go to infinity unless it is limited or the calculation terminates.
载荷曲线比例因子的最大允许值。通常，设置该数值有助于在实现完全接触后防止压力出现异常升高。当达到完全接触状态时，应变率将趋近于零，而压力则会趋向无穷大，除非对其加以限制或终止计算。

Number of cycles for monotonic pressure after reversal.

tensor), and therefore does not depend upon any DOMID. Any
number of such variables may be specified with a given time
sequence. These variables are listed as having  global  domain
for SOLVER_NAME in a separate document. This document
(LSO_VARIABLES.TXT) is created by running the command: LSDYNA
print_lso_doc.
由 SOLVER_NAME 计算的全局输出变量名称。
该变量必须只有一个值（标量、向量或张量），因此不依赖任何 DOMID。给定时间序列可指定任意数量的此类变量。另一份文档将这些变量列为 SOLVER_NAME 的“全局”域变量。运行命令 LSDYNA print_lso_doc 可生成该文档（LSO_VARIABLES.TXT）。

Material axes option (see Figure 0-1 and the Material Directions section):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. The a - direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element.The b - direction is orthogonal to the a - direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2,and 4. When this option is used in two - dimensional planar and axisymmetric analysis, it is critical that the nodes in the element definition be numbered counterclockwise for this option to work correctly.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element(see Figure 0 - 1).The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: | AOPT | is a coordinate system ID(see *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（参见图 0-1 和“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由图 0-1 所示的单元节点确定。a 方向从单元节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。在二维平面和轴对称分析中使用此选项时，单元定义中的节点必须按逆时针编号，才能保证选项正确工作。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述输入的向量 a 和 d 确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定（参见图 0-1）。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：|AOPT| 为坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

EQ.3.0 : Shell elements are deleted when p < PC .
Solid Element Specific Behavior

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Load curve ID defining effective stress versus effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1-EPS8 and ES1-ES8 are ignored.
The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.

The absolute value of LCSS is a load curve ID for effective stress as a function of effective plastic or effective total strain depending on the first data point (this load curve is optional).
If the first data point has a positive ordinate value, it indicates the initial yield stress at zero plastic strain.If it is zero, it is a curve with respect to effective total strain.The first abscissa value must always be zero.
For a negative value of LCSS, negative values of SIG_ASS, SIG_ASF, SIG_SAS, and SIG_SAF indicate dependence on plastic strain; see below.
|LCSS| 是载荷曲线 ID，定义等效应力随等效塑性应变或有效总应变的变化，具体取决于第一个数据点（该载荷曲线可选）。若第一个数据点的纵坐标为正，表示零塑性应变下的初始屈服应力；若为零，则曲线以有效总应变为自变量。第一个横坐标值必须始终为零。
当 LCSS 为负时，SIG_ASS、SIG_ASF、SIG_SAS 和 SIG_SAF 的负值表示它们依赖塑性应变；见下文。

The absolute value of LCSSC  is a load curve ID for effective stress as a function of effective plastic or effective total strain (depending on the first data point) under compressive load (this load curve is optional).
If the first data point has a positive ordinate value, it indicates the initial yield stress at zero plastic strain.If it is zero, it is a curve with respect to effective total strain.The first abscissa value must always be zero.
A negative value of LCSSC scales the load curve with the parameter ALPHA.For example, LCSSC = -LCSS will give the same relation between compressive and tensile hardening as between compressive and tensile phase transformation stresses.
If LCSSC is undefined or zero, LCSS specifies the behavior in compression.
|LCSSC| 的绝对值是压缩载荷下等效应力随等效塑性应变或有效总应变（取决于第一数据点）变化的载荷曲线 ID（可选）。若第一数据点的纵坐标为正，表示零塑性应变下的初始屈服应力；若为零，则曲线以有效总应变为自变量。第一横坐标值必须始终为零。
LCSSC 为负值时，载荷曲线按 ALPHA 缩放。例如，LCSSC = -LCSS 将使压缩/拉伸强化应力与压缩/拉伸相变应力具有相同关系。若 LCSSC 未定义或为零，则 LCSS 定义压缩行为。

EQ.1：基于 Drucker-Prager 的塑性。

LT.0.0: -SIG_ASS is a load curve ID defining the starting value as a function of temperature.If LCSS is also negative, then -SIG_ASS is either a load curve specifying the starting value as a function of effective plastic strain or a table of such load curves for different temperatures

单轴拉伸应力状态下正向相变（奥氏体转变为马氏体）的最终值。

Parameter measuring the difference between material responses in tension and compression (set ALPHA = 0 for no difference). Also, see Remark 1.
用于衡量拉伸和压缩状态下材料响应差异的参数（无差异时设 ALPHA = 0）。另见备注 1。

Young's modulus for the martensite if it is different from the modulus for the austenite. Defaults to the austenite modulus if it is set to zero.
马氏体杨氏模量（若不同于奥氏体模量）。设为 0 时，默认采用奥氏体模量。

Load curve ID or table ID for the forward phase change (conversion of austenite into martensite).
1. When LCID_AS is a load curve ID the curve is taken to be effective stress as a function of martensite fraction(ranging from 0 to 1).
2. When LCID_AS is a table ID the table defines for each phase transition rate(derivative of martensite fraction) a load curve ID specifying the stress as a function of martensite fraction for that phase transition rate.
The stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the smallest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the largest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate exceeds the maximum value.
正向相变（奥氏体转变为马氏体）的载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
1. 当 LCID_AS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，该曲线定义等效应力随马氏体分数（0～1）的变化。
2. 当 LCID_AS 为表 ID 时，该表针对每个相变速率（马氏体分数的导数）指定一条载荷曲线，定义该相变速率下应力随马氏体分数的变化。相变速率低于最小值时使用最低速率对应曲线；超过最大值时使用最高速率对应曲线。

Load curve ID or table ID for reverse phase change (conversion of martensite into austenite).
1. When LCID_SA is a load curve ID, the curve is taken to be effective stress as a function of martensite fraction(ranging from 0 to 1).
2. When LCID_SA is a table ID, the table defines for each phase transition rate(derivative of martensite fraction) a load curve ID specifying the stress as a function of martensite fraction for that phase transition rate.
The stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the lowest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the highest value of phase transition rate is used if phase transition rate exceeds the maximum value.
3. The values of SIG_ASS and SIG_ASF are overwritten when this option is used..
用于逆相变（马氏体转变为奥氏体）的载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
1. 当 LCID_SA 为载荷曲线 ID 时，该曲线定义等效应力随马氏体分数（0～1）的变化。
2. 当 LCID_SA 为表 ID 时，该表针对每个相变速率（马氏体分数的导数）给出载荷曲线 ID，定义该相变速率下应力随马氏体分数的变化。相变速率低于最小值时采用最低速率对应曲线；超过最大值时采用最高速率对应曲线。
3. 使用此选项时覆盖 SIG_ASS 和 SIG_ASF。

LCSSC 为负值时，载荷曲线按 ALPHA 缩放。例如，LCSSC = -LCSS 将使压缩/拉伸强化应力与压缩/拉伸相变应力具有相同关系。若 LCSSC 未定义或为零，则 LCSS 定义压缩行为。

LT.0.0: -SIG_ASS is a load curve ID defining the starting value as a function of temperature.If LCSS is also negative, then -SIG_ASS is either a load curve specifying the starting value as a function of effective plastic strain or a table of such load curves for different temperatures

Final value for the forward phase transformation (conversion of austenite into martensite) in the case of a uniaxial tensile state of stress.
LT.0.0: -SIG_ASF is a load curve ID defining the final value as a function of temperature. If LCSS is also negative, -SIG_ASF is either a load curve specifying the final value as a function of effective plastic strain or a table of such load curves for different temperatures

单轴拉伸应力状态下反向相变（马氏体转变为奥氏体）的起始值。

单轴拉伸应力状态下反向相变（马氏体转变为奥氏体）的最终值。

Recoverable strain or maximum residual strain. It is a measure of the maximum deformation obtainable for all the martensite in one direction
可恢复应变或最大残差应变。它是衡量所有马氏体在某一方向上所能达到的最大变形量的指标。

Parameter measuring the difference between material responses in tension and compression (set ALPHA = 0 for no difference). Also, see Remark 1.
用于衡量拉伸和压缩状态下材料响应差异的参数（无差异时设 ALPHA = 0）。另见备注 1。

Young's modulus for the martensite if it is different from the modulus for the austenite. Defaults to the austenite modulus if it is set to zero.
马氏体杨氏模量（若不同于奥氏体模量）。设为 0 时，默认采用奥氏体模量。

Load curve ID or table ID for the forward phase change (conversion of austenite into martensite).
1. When LCID_AS is a load curve ID the curve is taken to be effective stress as a function of martensite fraction(ranging from 0 to 1).
2. When LCID_AS is a table ID the table defines for each phase transition rate(derivative of martensite fraction) a load curve ID specifying the stress as a function of martensite fraction for that phase transition rate.
The stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the smallest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the largest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate exceeds the maximum value.
正向相变（奥氏体转变为马氏体）的载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
1. 当 LCID_AS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，该曲线定义等效应力随马氏体分数（0～1）的变化。
2. 当 LCID_AS 为表 ID 时，该表针对每个相变速率（马氏体分数的导数）指定一条载荷曲线，定义该相变速率下应力随马氏体分数的变化。相变速率低于最小值时使用最低速率对应曲线；超过最大值时使用最高速率对应曲线。

Load curve ID or table ID for reverse phase change (conversion of martensite into austenite).
1. When LCID_SA is a load curve ID, the curve is taken to be effective stress as a function of martensite fraction(ranging from 0 to 1).
2. When LCID_SA is a table ID, the table defines for each phase transition rate(derivative of martensite fraction) a load curve ID specifying the stress as a function of martensite fraction for that phase transition rate.
The stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the lowest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the highest value of phase transition rate is used if phase transition rate exceeds the maximum value.
3. The values of SIG_ASS and SIG_ASF are overwritten when this option is used..
用于逆相变（马氏体转变为奥氏体）的载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
1. 当 LCID_SA 为载荷曲线 ID 时，该曲线定义等效应力随马氏体分数（0～1）的变化。
2. 当 LCID_SA 为表 ID 时，该表针对每个相变速率（马氏体分数的导数）给出载荷曲线 ID，定义该相变速率下应力随马氏体分数的变化。相变速率低于最小值时采用最低速率对应曲线；超过最大值时采用最高速率对应曲线。
3. 使用此选项时覆盖 SIG_ASS 和 SIG_ASF。

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
