Fabric venting option, see *MAT_FABRIC.
EQ.1: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.2: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.3: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.4: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.5: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.6: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.7: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian, 2000]. Blockage is not considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.
EQ.8: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian 2000]. Blockage of venting or porous area due to contact is considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.
LT.0: |"FVOPT"| defines the same fabric venting options as above, but a new formula for the leakage area is used to replace the element area.
织物排气选项，参见 *MAT_FABRIC。
EQ.1：使用 Wang–Nefske 孔口排气公式，不考虑堵塞。
EQ.2：同上，考虑接触导致排气面积堵塞。
EQ.3：使用 Graefe、Krummheuer 和 Siejak [1990] 泄漏公式，不考虑堵塞。
EQ.4：同上，考虑接触堵塞。
EQ.5：使用基于多孔介质流动的泄漏公式，不考虑堵塞。
EQ.6：同上，考虑接触堵塞。
EQ.7：泄漏依据气体体积流出量—压力载荷曲线 [Lian，2000]，不考虑堵塞；FAC 给出的多孔速度—压力曲线使用绝对压力。
EQ.8：同 EQ.7，但考虑接触造成的排气或多孔区域堵塞。
LT.0：|FVOPT| 定义上述相同织物排气选项，但用新公式计算泄漏面积以替代单元面积。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option:
EQ.0.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes N1, N2, and N4, and then,

EQ.2.0: globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR,
EQ.3.0: locally orthotropic material axes determined by rotating the material axes about the element normal by an angle
(MANGLE) from a line in the plane of the element defined by the cross product of the vector v with the element normal.
LT.0.0: the absolute value of AOPT is the coordinate system ID number (CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES,_SYSTEM or _VECTOR), Available in R3 version of 971 and later.
材料轴选项：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 N1、N2 和 N4 确定，之后（仅针对壳单元），还会绕壳单元法线方向旋转 MANGLE 角度。

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴是通过将材料轴绕单元法线方向旋转一定角度（该角度为向量 v 与单元法线的叉积在单元平面内所确定的直线对应的角度 MANGLE）来确定的。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值即为坐标系编号（在 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES,_SYSTEM 或_VECTOR 命令中对应的 CID），该选项适用于 971 版本 R3 及更高版本。

Maximum strain for matrix straining in tension or compression. The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum strain in the matrix direction is reached. The input value is always positive.
拉伸或压缩状态下基体应变的最大值。当基体方向达到该最大应变后，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。该输入值始终为正数。

Maximum shear strain. The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum shear strain is reached. The input value is always positive.
最大剪应变。当达到该值时，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。输入值始终为正数。

Time step size criteria for element deletion:
LT.0:no element deletion by time step size.
GT.0 and LT.0.1:element is deleted when its time step is smaller than the given value,
GT.1:element is deleted when the quotient of the actual time step and the original time step drops below the given value.
单元删除的时间步长判定标准：
LT.0：不因时间步长而删除任何单元。
GT.0 和 LT.0.1：当单元的实际时间步长小于给定值时，该单元将被删除。
GT.1：当实际时间步长与原始时间步长的比值低于给定值时，该单元将被删除。

Shear stress parameter for the nonlinear term, see Material 22.
非线性项的剪应力参数，详见材料 22。

Softening reduction factor for material strength in crashfront elements (default = 1.0). TFAIL must be greater than zero to activate this option.
碰撞前端单元中材料强度的软化折减因子（默认值为 1.0）。需使 TFAIL 的值大于零才能启用此选项。

Softening for fiber tensile strength:
EQ.0.0: tensile strength = Xt
GT:0.0: tensile strength = Xt , reduced to Xt*FBRT after failure has occurred in compressive matrix mode.
纤维抗拉强度软化：
EQ.0.0：抗拉强度为 Xt。
GT.0.0：抗拉强度初始为 Xt；发生基体压缩模式破坏后降为 Xt*FBRT。

Reduction factor for compressive fiber strength after matrix failure. The compressive strength in the fiber direction after compressive matrix failuire is reduced to: Xc=YCFAC* Yc (default YCFAC =2.0).
基体失效后纤维抗压强度的折减因子。基体发生压缩失效后，纤维方向上的抗压强度将按以下公式进行折减：Xc = YCFAC* Yc（默认值 YCFAC = 2.0）。

Maximum strain for fiber tension. (Maximum 1 = 100% strain). The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum tensile strain in the fiber direction is reached.
纤维拉伸的最大应变值。（最大值为 1 时对应 100% 的应变。）当纤维方向达到最大拉伸应变后，该单元中的对应层将被完全移除。

Maximum strain for fiber compression (Maximum -1 = 100% compression). The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum tensile strain in the fiber direction is reached. The input value must have a negative sign.
纤维压缩的最大应变（最大值为 -1 时表示 100% 压缩）。当纤维方向达到该最大压缩应变后，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。输入值必须为负数。

Effective failure strain.
有效失效应变。

Longitudinal compressive strength.
纵向抗压强度。

Longitudinal tensile strength.
纵向抗拉强度。

Transverse compressive strength, b-axis.
横向压缩强度，b 轴。

Transverse tensile strength, b-axis.
横向拉伸强度，b 轴。

Shear strength, ab plane.
ab 平面剪切强度。

EQ.54.0: Chang matrix failure criterion (as Material 22) (default),
EQ.55.0: Tsai-Wu criterion for matrix failure.

EQ.54.0：Chang 基体失效准则（对应材料 22）（默认值）。
EQ.55.0：用于基体失效的 Tsai-Wu 准则。

Weighting factor for shear term in tensile fiber mode (0.0 <= BETA <= 1.0).
拉伸纤维模式中剪切项的权重因子（0.0 ≤ BETA ≤ 1.0）。

Percentage of layers which must fail until crashfront is initiated. E.g. |PFL|=80.0, then 80 % of layers must fail until strengths are reduced in neighboring elements. Default: all layers must fail. A single layer fails if 1 in-plane IP fails (PFL>0) or if 4 in-plane IPs fail (PFL<0). (MAT_054 only).
在启动 crashfront 之前必须失效的层数百分比。例如，|PFL|=80.0，则在相邻单元的强度减小之前必须有 80% 的层失效。默认值：所有层都必须失效。如果 1 个面内 IP 失效 (PFL>0) 或 4 个面内 IP 失效 (PFL<0)，则单层失效。（仅限 MAT_054）。

Damage initiation transverser shear strain. (MAT_054 only).
损伤起始横向剪应变。（仅 MAT_054 使用）。

Final rupture transverse shear strain. (MAT_054 only)
LT.0.0: |EPSR| is final rupture transverse shear strain. In addition, the element erodes if transverse shear damage reaches TSMD.
最终断裂横向剪切应变。（仅 MAT_054）

Transverse shear maximum damage, default=0.90. (MAT_054 only).
横向剪切最大损伤值，默认值为 0.90。（仅适用于 MAT_054）。

Optional 'orthogonal' softening reduction factor for material strength in crashfront elements (default = 1.0). See remarks.
碰撞前沿单元材料强度的可选正交软化折减因子（默认值 = 1.0）。参见备注。

用于确定应力达到最大值后最小应力限值的因子（基体压缩）。

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element (see Figure 0-1). The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a, and c is the normal vector. Then an angle BETA, which you set in the elements keyword input or the input for this keyword, rotates a and b about c.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

Load curve ID, which defines orientation dependent failure strains.
The ordinate values in the load-curve define the various failure strains, in the following order:
1. EF_11T: tensile failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
2. EF_11C: compressive failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
3. EF_22T: tensile failure strain in transverse b-direction
4. EF_22C: compressive failure strain in transverse b-direction
5. EF_12: in-plane shear failure strain in ab-plane
6. EF_33T: tensile failure strain in transverse c-direction
7. EF_33C: compressive failure strain in transverse c-direction
8. EF_23: out-of plane shear failure strain in bc-plane
9. EF_31: out-of plane shear failure strain in ca-plane
Thus, the load curve to define these values must have either five (shells) or nine (solids) entries in its definition. You may input a load curve with nine entries for shells, but LS-DYNA ignores the last four entries. The ignored abscissa values need to be ascending, such as 1.0, 2.0, , 9.0.

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element (see Figure 0-1). The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a, and c is the normal vector. Then an angle BETA, which you set in the elements keyword input or the input for this keyword, rotates a and b about c.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

Load curve ID, which defines orientation dependent failure strains.
The ordinate values in the load-curve define the various failure strains, in the following order:
1. EF_11T: tensile failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
2. EF_11C: compressive failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
3. EF_22T: tensile failure strain in transverse b-direction
4. EF_22C: compressive failure strain in transverse b-direction
5. EF_12: in-plane shear failure strain in ab-plane
6. EF_33T: tensile failure strain in transverse c-direction
7. EF_33C: compressive failure strain in transverse c-direction
8. EF_23: out-of plane shear failure strain in bc-plane
9. EF_31: out-of plane shear failure strain in ca-plane
Thus, the load curve to define these values must have either five (shells) or nine (solids) entries in its definition. You may input a load curve with nine entries for shells, but LS-DYNA ignores the last four entries. The ignored abscissa values need to be ascending, such as 1.0, 2.0, , 9.0.

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element (see Figure 0-1). The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a, and c is the normal vector. Then an angle BETA, which you set in the elements keyword input or the input for this keyword, rotates a and b about c.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

Load curve ID, which defines orientation dependent failure strains.
The ordinate values in the load-curve define the various failure strains, in the following order:
1. EF_11T: tensile failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
2. EF_11C: compressive failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
3. EF_22T: tensile failure strain in transverse b-direction
4. EF_22C: compressive failure strain in transverse b-direction
5. EF_12: in-plane shear failure strain in ab-plane
6. EF_33T: tensile failure strain in transverse c-direction
7. EF_33C: compressive failure strain in transverse c-direction
8. EF_23: out-of plane shear failure strain in bc-plane
9. EF_31: out-of plane shear failure strain in ca-plane
Thus, the load curve to define these values must have either five (shells) or nine (solids) entries in its definition. You may input a load curve with nine entries for shells, but LS-DYNA ignores the last four entries. The ignored abscissa values need to be ascending, such as 1.0, 2.0, , 9.0.

Material axes option (see *MAT_002 for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element (see Figure 0-1). The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a, and c is the normal vector. Then an angle BETA, which you set in the elements keyword input or the input for this keyword, rotates a and b about c.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: | AOPT | is a coordinate system ID(see *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（见 *MAT_002 的完整说明）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由图 0 - 1 所示的单元节点确定。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方输入的向量 a 和 d 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定（见图 0-1）。实体单元的平面是中面，位于单元连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后，在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置的 BETA 角会使 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Load curve ID, which defines orientation dependent failure strains.
The ordinate values in the load-curve define the various failure strains, in the following order:
1. EF_11T: tensile failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
2. EF_11C: compressive failure strain in longitudinal a-direction
3. EF_22T: tensile failure strain in transverse b-direction
4. EF_22C: compressive failure strain in transverse b-direction
5. EF_12: in-plane shear failure strain in ab-plane
6. EF_33T: tensile failure strain in transverse c-direction
7. EF_33C: compressive failure strain in transverse c-direction
8. EF_23: out-of plane shear failure strain in bc-plane
9. EF_31: out-of plane shear failure strain in ca-plane
Thus, the load curve to define these values must have either five (shells) or nine (solids) entries in its definition. You may input a load curve with nine entries for shells, but LS-DYNA ignores the last four entries. The ignored abscissa values need to be ascending, such as 1.0, 2.0, , 9.0.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

EQ.2: Switch material axes a and b after BETA rotation

EQ. - 3: Switch material axes a and c before BETA rotation

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

Load curve (or table) ID with a meaning that depends on MODEL:
MODEL.LE.0: Load curve ID defining yield stress as a function of volumetric strain, r (see Figure 0-1).
MODEL.GE.1:Load curve, table ID, or 3D table ID. If specifying a load curve ID, the load curve defines uniaxial yield stress under compression, σ_c, as a function of equivalent plastic strain. If specifying a table ID, each strain rate references a load curve ID that gives uniaxial yield stress as a function of equivalent plastic strain. If specifying a 3D table ID, uniaxial yield stress is given as a function of history variable #8 (3D table), strain rate (table), and equivalent plastic strain (curve).

MODEL.GE.1：载荷曲线、表 ID 或 3D 表 ID。如果指定载荷曲线 ID，该载荷曲线定义等效塑性应变下的单轴压缩屈服应力 σ_c。如果指定表 ID，每个应变率引用一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出等效塑性应变下的单轴屈服应力。如果指定 3D 表 ID，单轴屈服应力给出为历史变量 #8（3D 表）、应变率（表）和等效塑性应变（曲线）的函数。

拉伸应力截断值（仅适用于 MODEL = 0 的情况）。为获得更符合实际的仿真结果，强烈建议设置一个非零的正数值。

Rate sensitivity via damping coefficient (.05 < recommended value < .50). Only available for MODEL = 0.
通过阻尼系数体现的速率敏感性（0.05 < 推荐值 < 0.50）。仅适用于 MODEL = 0。

Choice of material model formulation:
EQ.0:Original approach (default),
EQ.1: Elliptical yield surface in p - q space with symmetric tension - compression behavior(isotropic hardening),
EQ.-1: Same as MODEL = 0, but with a potentially wrong stress response in unloading. A bug fix for MODEL = 0 in R17 may change results, so this can be seen as a fallback option for obtaining the old behavior.
EQ.2: Elliptical yield surface in p - q space with asymmetric tension - compression behavior(volumetric hardening).
材料模型公式的选择：
EQ.0：原始方法（默认）。
EQ.1：p-q 空间中的椭圆屈服面，拉伸—压缩行为对称（各向同性硬化）。
EQ.-1：与 MODEL = 0 相同，但卸载应力响应可能错误；R17 对 MODEL = 0 的错误修复可能改变结果，可作为获得旧行为的后备选项。
EQ.2：p-q 空间中的椭圆屈服面，拉伸—压缩行为不对称（体积硬化）。

Stiffness coefficient for contact interface stiffness.  If undefined, the maximum slope in the stress-strain curve is used.  When the maximum slope is taken for the contact, the time step size for this material is reduced for stability.  In some cases, Δt may be significantly smaller, so defining a reasonable stiffness is recommended.
接触界面刚度的刚度系数。如果未定义，则使用应力-应变曲线中的最大斜率。当接触使用最大斜率时，为保证稳定性，该材料的时间步长会减小。在某些情况下，Δt 可能显著变小，因此建议定义合理的刚度。

Load curve ID of relaxation curve. If LCID=0 the constants beta-i are determined via a least squares fit.This model ignores the constant stress.
松弛曲线的载荷曲线 ID。若 LCID = 0，则通过最小二乘拟合来确定常数 beta-i。该模型忽略了恒定应力。

Fit parameter. In the fit, beta-1 is set to zero, beta-2 is set to BSTART, beta-3 is 10 times beta-k-2 , beta-4 is 100 times greater than beta-3 , and so on.
EQ.0: BSTART= .01 (default).
拟合参数。在拟合过程中，beta-1 设为零，beta-2 设为 BSTART，beta-3 是 beta-k-2 的 10 倍，beta-4 是 beta-3 的 100 倍，依此类推。
EQ.0：BSTART = 0.01（默认值）。

Optional ramp time for loading.
加载的可选斜坡时间。

Number of terms in fit. Currently, the maximum number is set to 6. Values of 2 are 3 are recommended, since each term used adds significantly to the cost. Caution should be exercised when taking the results from the fit. Preferably, all generated coefficients should be positive. Negative values may lead to unstable results. Once a satisfactory fit has been achieved it is recommended that the coefficients which are written into the output file be input in future runs.
Default is set to 6.
拟合项数。目前最多可设为 6。建议取 2 或 3，因为每增加一项都会显著增加计算成本。采用拟合结果时应谨慎，最好保证生成的所有系数均为正值；负值可能导致结果不稳定。获得满意拟合后，建议在后续计算中直接输入输出文件中写出的系数。默认值为 6。

Number of terms in fit. Currently, the maximum number is set to 6. Values of 2 are 3 are recommended, since each term used adds significantly to the cost. Once a satisfactory fit has been achieved it is recommended that the coefficients which are written into the output file be input in future runs.

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Load curve ID defining nonlinear damage curve.
用于定义非线性损伤曲线的载荷曲线 ID。

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Better results are obtained if NUMINT is set to 1 or a number less than one half of the number of through thickness points. For example, if four through thickness points are used, NUMINT should not exceed 2, even for fully integrated shells which have 16 integration points.
单元删除前必须失效的沿厚度方向积分点数量（若该值为零，则所有积分点都必须失效）。不建议采用要求所有积分点均失效的默认设置，因为发生大应变的单元往往不会被删除：大多数积分点失效后，节点纤维的转动会限制其余有效积分点的应变。将 NUMINT 设为 1，或设为小于沿厚度方向积分点总数一半的数值，可获得更好的结果。例如，若沿厚度方向采用 4 个积分点，则 NUMINT 不应超过 2；即使完全积分壳单元共有 16 个积分点，也是如此。

First effective plastic strain value (optional if SIGY is defined). At least 2 points should be defined. The first point must be zero corresponding to the initial yield stress.
WARNING: If the first point is nonzero the yield stress is extrapolated to determine the initial yield. If this option is used SIGY and ETAN are ignored and may be input as zero.
第 1 个有效塑性应变值（若已定义 SIGY，则此项可选）。至少应定义两个数据点；第一个点必须为零，对应初始屈服应力。
警告：若第一个点不为零，则通过外推确定初始屈服应力。使用此选项时忽略 SIGY 和 ETAN，可输入为零。

Second effective plastic strain value (optional if SIGY is defined). At least 2 points should be defined. The first point must be zero corresponding to the initial yield stress.
第 2 个有效塑性应变值（若已定义 SIGY，则可选）。至少应定义 2 个数据点；第一个点必须为零，对应初始屈服应力。

Material identification. A unique number has to be used.

Mass density.
质量密度。

Young's modulus.
杨氏模量。

Optional Young's modulus used in the computation of sound speed. This will influence the time step, contact forces, hourglass stabilization forces, and numerical damping(DAMP).
If TBID  0, , the time step is based on a stiffness of
max(KCON,E,max.current slope of stress-strain curve).
The max.current slope is taken from the three principal directions.The tensile(negative) portion of stress - strain curves is included in this evaluation if TFLAG = 1.
计算声速时使用的可选杨氏模量。该值会影响时间步长、接触力、沙漏稳定化力和数值阻尼（DAMP）。若 TBID ≠ 0，则时间步长基于刚度 max(KCON, E, 当前应力—应变曲线的最大斜率)。最大当前斜率取自三个主方向；若 TFLAG = 1，应力—应变曲线的拉伸（负值）部分也纳入计算。

Tension cut-off stress.
拉伸截断应力。

Failure option after cutoff stress is reached:
EQ.0.0: tensile stress remains at cut-off value (default),
EQ.1.0: tensile stress is reset to zero.
EQ.2.0: The element is eroded.
达到截止应力后的失效选项：
EQ.0.0：拉伸应力保持在截止值（默认值），
EQ.1.0：拉伸应力重置为零。
EQ.2.0：单元发生侵蚀。

Viscous coefficient to model damping effects (0.05 < recommended value < 0.50; default is 0.05).
用于模拟阻尼效应的黏性系数（0.05 < 推荐值 < 0.50；默认值为 0.05）。

Table ID (see *DEFINE_TABLE) for nominal stress as a function of strain data at a given strain rate. If the table ID is provided,
Cards 3 and 4 may be left blank and the input curves will be used directly in the model. The Table ID can be positive or negative (see Remark 6 below).
If TBID < 0, enter |"TBID" | on the *DEFINE_TABLE keyword. For keyword option PATH_DEPENDENT, TBID defines a
3D table for nominal stress, giving it as a function of volumetric change 1-J (TABLE_3D), strain rate (TABLE), and nominal strain (CURVE).
表 ID（参见 *DEFINE_TABLE），给出给定应变率下名义应力随应变变化的数据。若提供表 ID，卡片 3 和 4 可留空，模型直接使用输入曲线。表 ID 可正可负（见备注 6）。若 TBID < 0，在 *DEFINE_TABLE 中输入 |TBID|；PATH_DEPENDENT 选项下，TBID 定义名义应力三维表，为体积变化 1-J（TABLE_3D）、应变率（TABLE）和名义应变（CURVE）的函数。

Toggle to turn bulk viscosity off or on (see Remark 1):
LT.1.0: No bulk viscosity(recommended)
GE.1.0: Bulk viscosity active.
关闭或开启体积黏性的切换标志（参见备注 1）：LT.1.0=无体积黏性（推荐）；GE.1.0=启用体积黏性。

EQ.0.0: true constant strain rate (default),

EQ.1.0：工程应变率。

Optional load curve ID defining pressure versus volumetric strain.

EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle FANG on this keyword or BETA on the *ELEMENT_SHELL_{OPTION} input.

EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedra. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or with FANG on this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle rotation depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是其中的材料方向部分）。纤维方向取决于此坐标系（见备注 1）。
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面的法向量旋转本关键字中的 FANG 或 *ELEMENT_SHELL_{选项} 输入中的 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。

EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 编号（CID 见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Better results are obtained if NUMINT is set to 1 or a number less than one half of the number of through thickness points. For example, if four through thickness points are used, NUMINT should not exceed 2, even for fully integrated shells which have 16 integration points.
单元删除前必须失效的沿厚度方向积分点数量（若该值为零，则所有积分点都必须失效）。不建议采用要求所有积分点均失效的默认设置，因为发生大应变的单元往往不会被删除：大多数积分点失效后，节点纤维的转动会限制其余有效积分点的应变。将 NUMINT 设为 1，或设为小于沿厚度方向积分点总数一半的数值，可获得更好的结果。例如，若沿厚度方向采用 4 个积分点，则 NUMINT 不应超过 2；即使完全积分壳单元共有 16 个积分点，也是如此。

EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Number of integration points which must fail before element deletion. If zero, all points must fail. This option applies to shell elements only. For the case of one point shells, NUMINT should be set to a value that is less than the number of through thickness integration points. Nonphysical stretching can sometimes appear in the results if all integration points have failed except for one point away from the midsurface. This is due to the fact that unconstrained nodal rotations will prevent strains from developing at the remaining integration point. In fully integrated shells, similar problems can occur.
单元删除前必须失效的积分点数。若为零，则所有积分点均须失效。此选项仅适用于壳单元。对于单点壳单元，NUMINT 应小于沿厚度方向的积分点数。若除中面以外的一个积分点外其余积分点均已失效，结果中有时会出现非物理拉伸；这是因为无约束的节点转动会使剩余积分点无法继续产生应变。完全积分壳单元也可能出现类似问题。

EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Failure flag.
LT.0.0: User defined failure subroutine is called to determine failure. This is subroutine named, MATUSR_103, in DYN21.F.
EQ.0.0: Failure is not considered. This option is recommended if failure is not of interest since many calculations will be saved.
GT.0.0: Plastic strain to failure. When the plastic strain reaches this value, the element is deleted from the calculation.
失效标志。
LT.0.0：调用用户定义的失效子程序来确定是否发生失效。该子程序名为 MATUSR_103，位于 DYN21.F 文件中。
EQ.0.0：不考虑失效情况。如果无需分析失效过程，建议选择此选项，这样可以节省大量计算资源。
GT.0.0：导致失效的塑性应变值。当塑性应变达到该数值时，该单元将从计算中移除。

Number of integration points which must fail before element deletion. If zero, all points must fail. This option applies to shell elements only. For the case of one point shells, NUMINT should be set to a value that is less than the number of through thickness integration points. Nonphysical stretching can sometimes appear in the results if all integration points have failed except for one point away from the midsurface. This is due to the fact that unconstrained nodal rotations will prevent strains from developing at the remaining integration point. In fully integrated shells, similar problems can occur.
单元删除前必须失效的积分点数。若为零，则所有积分点均须失效。此选项仅适用于壳单元。对于单点壳单元，NUMINT 应小于沿厚度方向的积分点数。若除中面以外的一个积分点外其余积分点均已失效，结果中有时会出现非物理拉伸；这是因为无约束的节点转动会使剩余积分点无法继续产生应变。完全积分壳单元也可能出现类似问题。

EQ. - 4: Switch material axes b and c before BETA rotation
EQ. - 3: Switch material axes a and c before BETA rotation
EQ. - 2: Switch material axes a and b before BETA rotation

BETA, from a line in the plane of the element defined by the cross product of the vector v with the normal to the plane of the element.
LT.0.0: the absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number (CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES,
*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR). Available with the R3 release of Version 971 and later.

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由绕单元法向旋转的角度确定；BETA 取自向量 v 与单元平面法向的叉积所定义的单元平面内的一条线。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 编号（CID 见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES、*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM 或 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR）。适用于 Version 971 的 R3 版本及更高版本。

The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

Unloading option (see Figure 0-1):
EQ.0.0: loading and unloading follow loading curve
EQ.1.0: loading follows loading curve, unloading follows unloading curve. The unloading curve ID if undefined is taken as the loading curve.
EQ.2.0: loading follows loading curve, unloading follows unloading stiffness, KT or KR, to the unloading curve.
The loading and unloading curves may only intersect at the origin of the axes.
EQ.3.0: quadratic unloading from peak displacement value to a permanent offset.
卸载选项（见图 0-1）：
EQ.0.0：加载和卸载均沿载荷曲线。
EQ.1.0：加载沿载荷曲线，卸载沿卸载曲线；若未定义卸载曲线 ID，则使用载荷曲线。
EQ.2.0：加载沿载荷曲线，卸载沿卸载刚度 KT 或 KR 卸载到卸载曲线。载荷曲线与卸载曲线只能在坐标轴原点相交。
EQ.3.0：从峰值位移到永久偏移进行二次卸载。

Offset factor between 0 and 1.0 to determine permanent set upon unloading if the UNLDOPT=3.0. The permanent sets in compression and tension are equal to the product of this offset value and the maximum compressive and tensile displacements, respectively.
当 UNLDOPT = 3.0 时，该值为 0 到 1.0 之间的系数，用于确定卸载后的永久变形量。压缩状态与拉伸状态下的永久变形量分别等于该系数值与最大压缩位移及最大拉伸位移的乘积。

Damping factor for stability. Values in the neighborhood of unity are recommended. This damping factor is properly scaled to eliminate time step size dependency. Also, it is active if and only if the local stiffness is defined.
稳定性阻尼因子。建议取接近 1 的值。该阻尼因子经过适当缩放，以消除对时间步长的依赖，且仅当定义了局部刚度时才激活。

Formulation flag:
EQ.0: displacement formulation which is used in all other models
EQ.1: linear strain formulation. The displacements and velocities are divided by the initial length of the beam.
EQ.2: a displacement formulation to simulate the buckling behavior of crushable frames.
公式标志：
EQ.0：所有其他模型使用的位移公式。
EQ.1：线性应变公式，位移和速度除以梁的初始长度。
EQ.2：用于模拟可压溃框架屈曲行为的位移公式。

Load curve ID defining translational force resultant along local r-axis versus relative translational displacement.
If zero, no stiffness related forces are generated for this degree of freedom. The loading curves must be defined from the most negative displacement to the most positive displacement. The force does not need to increase montonically. The curves in this input are linearly extrapolated when the displacement range falls outside the curve definition.

如果为零，则不会为该自由度生成与刚度相关的力。加载曲线必须从最负位移定义到最正位移。力不必单调增加。当位移范围超出曲线定义范围时，此输入中的曲线按线性方式外推。

Unloading option (Also see Figure 20.34 in the User's manual):

Offset to determine a permanent set upon unloading if the UNLDOPT=3.0. The permanent sets in compression and tension are equal to the product of this offset value and the maximum compressive and tensile displacements, respectively.
如果 UNLDOPT=3.0，确定卸载后永久变形的偏移量。压缩和拉伸的永久变形分别等于该偏移量与最大压缩位移、最大拉伸位移的乘积。

Damping factor for stability. Values in the neighborhood of unity are recommended. This damping factor is properly scaled to eliminate time step size dependency. Also, it is active if and only if the local stiffness is defined.
稳定性阻尼因子。建议取接近 1 的值。该阻尼因子经过适当缩放，以消除对时间步长的依赖，且仅当定义了局部刚度时才激活。

Load curve ID defining translational force resultant along the axis versus relative translational displacement. If zero, no stiffness related forces are generated for this degree of freedom. The loading curves must be defined from the most negative displacement to the most positive displacement. The force does not need to increase montonically for the loading curve. The curves in this input are extrapolated when the displacement range falls outside the curve definition.
定义沿该轴的平移合力随相对平移位移变化的载荷曲线 ID。如果为 0，则不为该自由度生成刚度相关力。曲线必须从最负位移到最正位移定义，力不必单调增加；位移超出曲线定义范围时按线性外推。

Load curve ID defining translational force resultant along the axis versus relative translational displacement during unloading. The force values defined by this curve must increase monotonically from the most negative displacement to the most positive displacement. For UNLDOPT=1.0, the slope of this curve must equal or exceed the loading curve for stability reasons. This is not the case for UNLDOPT=2.0.  For loading and unloading to follow the same path simply set LCIDTU=LCIDT.
定义卸载期间沿该轴平移合力随相对平移位移变化的载荷曲线 ID。曲线力值必须从最负位移到最正位移单调增加。UNLDOPT=1.0 时，为稳定起见曲线斜率必须大于或等于载荷曲线；UNLDOPT=2.0 时无此要求。要使加载和卸载沿同一路径，设置 LCIDTU=LCIDT。

Load curve ID defining translational damping force resultant along local the axis versus relative translational velocity.
用于定义沿局部坐标轴方向的平动阻尼合力与相对平动速度之间关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Load curve ID or Table ID.
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate, See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.Fields C, P, LCSR, EPS1 - EPS8, and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a Table ID is defined.Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，它定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系。若定义 EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8，则忽略这些字段。
表格数据：表 ID 为每个应变率值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出相应应变率下应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系；参见图示。当应变率低于最小值时，使用最低应变率对应的应力—等效塑性应变曲线；同样，当应变率超过最大值时，使用最高应变率对应的曲线。如果定义表 ID，则忽略字段 C、P、LCSR、EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8。默认在离散应变率之间进行线性插值；调用 LOG_INTERPOLATION 选项时使用对数插值。
对数定义的表格：在离散应变率之间调用对数插值的另一种方式如下。如果表中第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值表示应变率的自然对数。由于表在内部离散为等间距表值，当最低与最高应变率相差多个数量级时，从精度角度看，让表值表示应变率的自然对数是合理的。调用对数插值会带来额外计算成本。

EQ.2: Perform the error calculation based on the true stress-strain curve from uniaxial tension, specified by HLCID.
The corrections will be made to the cyclic load curve, both in the loading and unloading portions. Since, in some cases where loading is more complex,

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,
LCA<0:Damage curve giving shear stress multiplier as function of the shear strain component. This curve definition is optional and may be used if damage is desired. if SHDFLG=0 (the dafault), the damage value multiplies the stress every time step and the stress is updated incrementally. The damage curve should be set to unity until failure begins. After failure the value should drop to 0.999 or 0.99 or any number between zero and one depending on how many steps are needed to zero the stress. Alternatively, if SHDFLG=1.0, the damage value is treated as a factor that scales the shear stress component to the undamaged value.
LCA>0:shear stress versus shear strain. For the corotational solid elements, types 0 and 9, engineering strain is expected, but for all other solid element formulations a shear strain based on the deformed configuration is used. (default LCS=LCA). Each component of shear stress may have its own load curve.
载荷曲线 ID，参见 *DEFINE_CURVE。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

LCA>0:sigma-bc versus shear strain-bc. For the corotational solid elements, types 0 and 9, engineering strain is expected, but for all other solid element formulations a shear strain based on the deformed configuration is used. (default LCBC=LCS).
载荷曲线 ID，参见 *DEFINE_CURVE，
LCA < 0：用于给出 bc 剪应力乘数随 bc 剪应变分量的变化关系的损伤曲线。此曲线定义为可选项，仅在需要考虑损伤效应时使用，详情请参阅上述的 LCS。
LCA > 0：sigma-bc 与剪应变-bc 的关系曲线。对于类型为 0 和 9 的共旋实体单元，预期使用工程应变；而对于所有其他实体单元算法，则采用基于变形后状态的剪应变。（默认值 LCBC = LCS）。

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Load curve ID or Table ID:
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain.If defined, QR1, CR1, QR2,and CR2 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function of effective plastic strain for that rate.See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the load curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the load curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.Logarithmic interpolation has some additional computational cost.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID：载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的关系；若已定义，忽略 QR1、CR1、QR2、CR2。表格数据：表 ID 为每个应变率指定一条载荷曲线，给出该速率下应力随等效塑性应变的关系；低于最小应变率使用最低曲线，超过最大值使用最高曲线。对数定义表：若表第一值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值为应变率自然对数；由于内部等间距离散，当速率相差数个数量级时使用自然对数可提高精度，但会增加计算开销。

Load curve ID or Table ID:
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain.If defined, QR1, CR1, QR2,and CR2 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function of effective plastic strain for that rate.See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the load curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the load curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.Logarithmic interpolation has some additional computational cost.

The modulus is recovered in compression when RECOV is equal to 0 (default). The modulus remains at the brittle damage level when RECOV is equal to 1. Partial recovery is modeled for values of RECOV between 0 and 1. Two options are available:
Option 1: Input a value between 0 and 1. Recovery is based upon the sign of the pressure invariant only.
Option 2: Input a value between 10 and 11. Recovery is based upon the sign of both the pressure and volumetric strain.   In this case, RECOV=RECOV-10, and a flag is set to request the volumetric strain check.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Type of axial force-strain, moment-curvature, and torque-twist rate curves
EQ.0.0: curve is symmetric
EQ.1.0: curve is asymmetric
For symmetric curves, all data point must be in the first quadrant and at least three data points need to be given, starting from the origin, ensued by the yield point.
For asymmetric curves, at least five data points are needed and exactly one point must be at the origin. The two points on both sides of the origin record the positive and negative yield points.
The last data point(s) has no physical meaning: it serves only as a control point for inter or extrapolation.
The curves are input by the user and treated in LS-DYNA as a linearly piecewise function. The curves must be monotonically increasing, while the slopes must be monotonically decreasing.
轴向力—应变、弯矩—曲率和扭矩—扭转率曲线的类型。
EQ.0.0：曲线为对称曲线。
EQ.1.0：曲线为非对称曲线。
对于对称曲线，所有数据点必须位于第一象限，且至少给出三个数据点，从原点开始，随后为屈服点。
对于非对称曲线，至少需要五个数据点，且必须恰有一个点位于原点。原点两侧的两个点分别记录正、负屈服点。
最后一个或多个数据点没有物理意义，仅作为内插或外推的控制点。
曲线由用户输入，并在 LS-DYNA 中作为线性分段函数处理。曲线必须单调递增，而斜率必须单调递减。

Formulation of model. FORM=0 gives the original model developed by Fung, which always relaxes to a zero stress state as time approaches infinity, and FORM=1 gives the alternative model, which relaxes to the quasi-static elastic response. In general, the two formulations won't give the same responses. Formulation, FORM=-1, is an improvement on FORM=0 where the instantaneous elastic response is used in the viscoelastic stress update, not just in the relaxation, as in FORM=0. Consequently, the constants for the elastic response do not need to be scaled
模型公式。FORM = 0 给出 Fung 开发的原始模型；当时间趋于无穷大时，该模型总是松弛到零应力状态。FORM = 1 给出替代模型；该模型松弛到准静态弹性响应。通常，两种公式不会产生相同响应。FORM = -1 是 FORM = 0 的改进：在黏弹性应力更新中使用瞬时弹性响应，而不像 FORM = 0 那样只在松弛过程中使用。因此，无需对弹性响应常数进行缩放。

Hysteretic unloading factor betwen 0 and 1, (default=1, i.e., no energy dissipation).
介于 0 与 1 之间的滞回卸载因子，（默认值为 1，即无能量耗散）。

B, decay constant to model creep in unloading.
B：用于模拟卸载过程中蠕变行为的衰减常数。

Viscous coefficient (.05< recommended value </.50) to model damping effects
LT.0.0: |DAMP| is the load curve ID, which defines the damping constant as a function of the maximum strain in compression defined as: Emax = max(1-lambda1, 1-lambda2, 1-lambda3). In tension, the damping constant is set to the value corresponding to the strain at 0. The abcissia should be defined from 0 to 1.
用于模拟阻尼效应的黏性系数（推荐值范围为 0.05 至 0.50）
LT.0.0：|DAMP| 为载荷曲线 ID，该参数根据压缩状态下的最大应变来确定阻尼常数，其计算公式为：Emax = max(1-lambda1, 1-lambda2, 1-lambda3)。在拉伸状态下，阻尼常数则取对应于应变值为 0 时的数值。横坐标应设定在 0 到 1 之间。

Shape factor for unloading. Active for nonzero values of the hysteretic unloading factor. Values less than one reduces the energy dissipation and greater than one increases dissipation.
卸载形状因子。当滞回卸载因子为非零值时该参数生效。小于 1 的值降低能量耗散，大于 1 的值增加能量耗散。

Failure option after the cutoff stress is reached:

达到截止应力后的失效选项：

EQ.1.0：拉伸应力重置为零。

Bulk viscosity activation flag:
EQ.0.0: no bulk viscosity (recommended),
EQ.1.0: bulk viscosity active.
体黏性激活标志：
EQ.0.0：关闭体黏性（推荐），

用于考虑速率效应的可选杨氏松弛模量 Ed。

Optional decay constant, B1.
可选的衰减常数，B1。

Stiffness coefficient for contact interface stiffness. If undefined the maximum slope in stress vs. strain curve is used. When the maximum slope is taken for the contact, the time step size for this material is reduced for stability. Load curve or table ID giving the yield stress as a function of plastic strain.   These curves should be obtained from quasi-static and (optionally) dynamic uniaxial tensile tests.  This input is mandatory, and the material model will not work unless at least one tensile stress-strain curve is given.  If LCID-T is a table ID, the table values are plastic strain rates, and a curve of yield stress versus plastic strain must be given for each of those strain rates.  If the first value in the table is negative, LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of plastic strain rate. When the highest plastic strain rate is several orders of magnitude greater than the lowest, it is recommended that the natural log of plastic strain rate be input in the table.  See Remark 4.
给出屈服应力随塑性应变变化的载荷曲线或表 ID。这些曲线应由准静态和（可选的）动态单轴拉伸试验获得。该输入为必需项；除非至少给出一条拉伸应力-应变曲线，否则材料模型无法工作。如果 LCID-T 是表 ID，则表值为塑性应变率，并且必须针对每个应变率给出一条屈服应力-塑性应变曲线。如果表中的第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 将假定表中所有值表示塑性应变率的自然对数。当最高塑性应变率比最低值高出几个数量级时，建议在表中输入塑性应变率的自然对数。见备注 4。

Load curve or table ID giving the yield stress as a function of plastic strain.   These curves should be obtained from quasi-static and (optionally) dynamic uniaxial tensile tests.  This input is mandatory, and the material model will not work unless at least one tensile stress-strain curve is given.  If LCID-T is a table ID, the table values are plastic strain rates, and a curve of yield stress versus plastic strain must be given for each of those strain rates.  If the first value in the table is negative, LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of plastic strain rate. Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详情请参见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的一点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；这就是 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系中的前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可以在单元关键字输入中或本关键字的输入中设置。注意，对于实体单元，材料轴是否交换取决于 MACF 的选择。交换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后，具体取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定；二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详情请参见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的一点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；这就是 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系中的前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可以在单元关键字输入中或本关键字的输入中设置。注意，对于实体单元，材料轴是否交换取决于 MACF 的选择。交换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后，具体取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定；二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 上的 CID）。
