Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface betwen the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.

EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface betwen the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向量确定。实体单元的平面是连接关系中前四个节点与后四个节点分别定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后绕 c 将 a 和 b 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在关键字输入中设置，也可在本关键字输入中设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能随 MACF 的取值而切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。该选项仅适用于实体单元。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector, v,and an originating point, P, defining the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES, *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE - _COORDINATE_VECTOR).
材料轴选项（更完整的说明见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点确定。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向量确定。实体单元的平面是连接关系中前四个节点与后四个节点分别定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后绕 c 将 a 和 b 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置，也可在本关键字输入中设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能随 MACF 的取值而切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES、*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM 或 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 上）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector, v,and an originating point, P, defining the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES, *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE - _COORDINATE_VECTOR).

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向量确定。实体单元的平面是连接关系中前四个节点与后四个节点分别定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后绕 c 将 a 和 b 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置，也可在本关键字输入中设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能随 MACF 的取值而切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。

EQ.0.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in part (a) of Figure M2-1. The a-direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element. The b-direction is orthogonal to the a-direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2, and 4. When this option is used in two-dimensional planar and axisymmetric analysis, it is critical that the nodes in the element definition be numbered counterclockwise for this option to work correctly.
EQ.1.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point in space and the global location of the element center; this is the a-direction. This option is for solid elements only.

BETA, from a line in the plane of the element defined by the cross product of the vector v with the element normal.
The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.
EQ.4.0: locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis. This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: the absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number (CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES,

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Load curve ID or Table ID. Load curve ID defining effective stress
versus effective plastic strain The table ID defines for each strain
rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic
strain for that rate, See Figure M24-1. The stress versus effective
plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the
strain rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress
versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain
rate is used if the strain rate exceeds the maximum value. NOTE:
The strain rate values defined in the table may be given as the
natural logarithm of the strain rate. If the first stress-strain curve in
the table corresponds to a negative strain rate, LS-DYNA assumes
that the natural logarithm of the strain rate value is used. Since the
tables are internally discretized to equally space the points, natural
logarithms are necessary, for example, if the curves correspond to
rates from 10.e-04 to 10.e+04.

Flag for parameter identification algorithm:
EQ.0.0: No parameter identification routine is used. The variables K, C11, C22, C33, C44, C12, C13 and C23 are interpreted as material parameters.
EQ.1.0: Parameter fit is used. The variables C11, C22, C33, C44 and K are interpreted as yield stresses in the 00, 45, 90 degree directions, the balanced biaxial tension and the 00 degree compression, respectively. NOTE: it is recommended to always check the d3hsp file to see the fitted parameters before complex jobs are submitted.
EQ.2.0: Same as EQ.1.0 but also produce contour plots of the yield surface. For each material three LS-PrePost ready xy-datafiles are created; Contour1_x, Contour2_x and Contour3_x where xequal the material numbers.
参数识别算法的标志：
EQ.0.0：不使用任何参数识别程序。变量 K、C11、C22、C33、C44、C12、C13 和 C23 被视为材料参数。
EQ.1.0：采用参数拟合方法。变量 C11、C22、C33、C44 和 K 分别被视作 00 度、45 度、90 度方向下的屈服应力，以及平衡双轴拉伸状态和 00 度压缩状态下的屈服应力。注意：在提交复杂计算任务之前，建议始终查看 d3hsp 文件以确认拟合得到的参数。

Load curve ID defining effective stress versus effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1-EPS8 and ES1-ES8 are ignored.
The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. Load curve ID or table ID
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined, EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.  The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function effective plastic strain for that rate; see Figure 0-1.  When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.  Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.  EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a table ID is defined.  Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.  Logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is assumed if the first value in the table is negative, in which case LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.  Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude. There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
Multi-Dimensional Tables.  Stress values can also depend on history variables (or external variables). The 3D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of one history variable (see HISVN) or one external variable. The 4D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of two history variable values (see HISVN) or two external variables
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，将其视为定义应力随有效塑性应变变化的关系。若已定义 EPS1 - EPS8 和 ES1 - ES8，则忽略它们。

Load curve ID or table ID
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined, EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.  The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function effective plastic strain for that rate; see Figure 0-1.  When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.  Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.  EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a table ID is defined.  Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.  Logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is assumed if the first value in the table is negative, in which case LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.  Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude. There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
Multi-Dimensional Tables.  Stress values can also depend on history variables (or external variables). The 3D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of one history variable (see HISVN) or one external variable. The 4D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of two history variable values (see HISVN) or two external variables

Load curve ID or table ID
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined, EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.  The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function effective plastic strain for that rate; see Figure 0-1.  When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.  Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.  EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a table ID is defined.  Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.  Logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is assumed if the first value in the table is negative, in which case LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.  Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude. There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
Multi-Dimensional Tables.  Stress values can also depend on history variables (or external variables). The 3D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of one history variable (see HISVN) or one external variable. The 4D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of two history variable values (see HISVN) or two external variables
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，将其视为定义应力随有效塑性应变变化的关系。若已定义 EPS1 - EPS8 和 ES1 - ES8，则忽略它们。
表格数据：表 ID 对每个应变率值给出一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出相应应变率下应力随有效塑性应变的变化，见 Figure 0-1。当应变率低于最小值或高于最大值时，分别采用最低或最高应变率对应的曲线。若定义了表 ID，则忽略 EPS1 - EPS8 和 ES1 - ES8。默认使用离散应变率之间的线性插值；调用 LOG_INTERPOLATION 选项时使用对数插值。
对数定义的表格：如果表格中的第一个值为负，则在离散应变率之间采用对数插值；此时 LS-DYNA 假定表格中的所有值均表示应变率的自然对数。
多维表格（3D/4D）：应力值还可以取决于历史变量或外部变量；3D 表格给出应力随塑性应变的变化，并将应变率表示为一个历史变量（参见 HISVN）或外部变量的函数；4D 表格使用两个历史变量值（参见 HISVN）或两个外部变量。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s while SCALE can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational time, see Figures 0-3 and 0-4. Note the increased absolute value (within a reasonable range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the Figure 0-5.
该变量可在均衡应变率效应的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 而仿真耗时很长时，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，并将 SCALE 设为 0.03，获得与 15 mm/s 相同的结果，同时大幅减少计算时间（见图 0-3 和 0-4）。成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0×dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增加不会影响应变率（见图 0-5）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION)
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。对于壳单元，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心全局位置确定，该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。通过向量 v 与法向的叉积确定 a，通过法向与 a 的叉积确定 b，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中定义局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，它们定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION)
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。对于壳单元，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心全局位置确定，该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。通过向量 v 与法向的叉积确定 a，通过法向与 a 的叉积确定 b，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中定义局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，它们定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will
take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s
while "SCALE" can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those
from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational
time, see examples and Figures in *MAT_260A for details.
Furthermore, the increased absolute value (within a reasonable
range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming
simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the examples
and Figures in *MAT_260A.
该变量可在保持应变率效应一致的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如，拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 时仿真耗时很长，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，同时把 "SCALE" 设为 0.03，得到与 15 mm/s 相同的结果并显著减少计算时间；详见 *MAT_260A 中的示例和图。
此外，成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0*dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增大通常不会影响应变率，示例和 *MAT_260A 中的图说明了这一点。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will
take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s
while "SCALE" can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those
from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational
time, see examples and Figures in *MAT_260A for details.
Furthermore, the increased absolute value (within a reasonable
range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming
simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the examples
and Figures in *MAT_260A.
该变量可在保持应变率效应一致的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如，拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 时仿真耗时很长，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，同时把 "SCALE" 设为 0.03，得到与 15 mm/s 相同的结果并显著减少计算时间；详见 *MAT_260A 中的示例和图。
此外，成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0*dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增大通常不会影响应变率，示例和 *MAT_260A 中的图说明了这一点。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by an angle(see MANGLE on Card 4).
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle.This angle may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword(see MANGLE on Card 4).
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。对于壳单元，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向旋转 MANGLE 角（见卡片 4）。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心全局位置确定，该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。通过向量 v 与法向的叉积确定 a，通过法向与 a 的叉积确定 b，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转一个角度。该角度可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置（见卡片 4 的 MANGLE）。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中定义局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，它们定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Flag to control failure of an integration point based on longitudinal (fiber) tensile failure (see Remarks 1 and 2):
LT. - 0.01: Integration point fails if any damage variable, that has a corresponding flag(DAF, DKF, or DMF) set <= 0.0, reaches 1.0. | DAF | limits the stress reduction due to damage from longitudinal tensile failure.
EQ.0.00: Integration point fails if any damage variable, that has a corresponding flag(DAF, DKF, or DMF) set <= 0.0, reaches 1.0.DAF does not limit the stress reduction due to damage from longitudinal tensile failure.

Load curve ID or Table ID.
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines the nonlinear in - plane shear stress as a function of the absolute value of in - plane shear strain(γ_ab), except in the case of logarithmically defined curves.See Remark 5 for a discussion of logarithmically defined curves.
Tabular Data.The table maps in - plane strain rate values(γ ̇_ab) to a load curve giving the in - plane shear stress as a function of the absolute value of in - plane shear strain.Note that except for in the case of logarithmically definied tables, the strain ratesand shear strains must be the absolute values(see Remark 5).For strain rates below the minimum value, the curve for the lowest defined value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the curve for the highest defined value of strain rate is used.

Percentage of layers which must fail until crashfront is initiated. E.g.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle.The angle may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword(see MANGLE).Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.

材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 与单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内、外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向的叉积确定，b 由法向与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。该角度可在单元关键字输入或本关键字的输入中设置（见 MANGLE）。材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择进行切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用该角度之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定的中心线轴定义。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Load curve ID or Table ID. The load curve ID defines effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain. The table ID defines for each plastic strain rate value a load curve ID giving the (isothermal) effective stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate in the 0 direction.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。载荷曲线 ID 定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化；表 ID 为每个塑性应变率值定义载荷曲线 ID，给出该速率下 0° 方向的（等温）等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化。

Table ID defining for each temperature value a load curve ID giving the (quasi-static) tensile yield stress as a function of plastic strain for that temperature in the 0° direction.
表 ID，为每个温度值定义一条载荷曲线，给出该温度下 0° 方向准静态拉伸屈服应力随塑性应变的变化。

Load curve or table ID giving plastic failure strain in the 0° direction. The load curve ID defines plastic failure strain as a function of triaxiality. The table ID specifies a load curve ID for each Lode parameter, giving the plastic failure strain as a function of triaxiality for that Lode parameter.
载荷曲线或表 ID，定义 0° 方向的失效塑性应变。载荷曲线 ID 定义失效塑性应变随三轴度的变化；表 ID 针对每个 Lode 参数指定载荷曲线 ID，给出该 Lode 参数下失效塑性应变随三轴度的变化。

Load curve ID defining plastic failure strain (or a scale factor for determining the plastic failure strain) as a function of plastic strain rate in the 0° direction. The curve should not extrapolate to zero; otherwise, failure may occur at low strain. If the first abscissa value in the curve corresponds to a negative strain rate, the natural logarithm of the strain rate value is assumed to be used for all abscissa values
定义载荷曲线 ID，给出 0° 方向失效塑性应变（或用于确定该失效应变的比例因子）随塑性应变率的变化。曲线不应外推至零，否则低应变下可能发生失效；若曲线首个横坐标对应负应变率，则假定所有横坐标均使用应变率的自然对数。

Load curve ID defining plastic failure strain (or a scale factor for determining the plastic failure strain) as a function of temperature in the 0° direction.
用于定义 0° 方向的失效塑性应变（或其确定比例因子）随温度变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Load curve ID, table ID, or 3D table ID giving the plastic failure strain (or a scale factor for determining the plastic failure strain) in the 0° direction. The load curve gives plastic failure strain as a function of element size. The table defines a load curve ID for each triaxiality, giving the plastic failure strain as a function of element size for that triaxiality. If referring to a three-dimensional table ID, plastic failure strain can be a function of the Lode parameter (TABLE_3D), triaxiality (TABLE), and element size (CURVE).
载荷曲线 ID、表 ID 或三维表 ID，给出 0° 方向的失效塑性应变（或用于确定该应变的比例因子）。载荷曲线给出失效塑性应变随单元尺寸的变化。该表针对每个三轴度定义一个载荷曲线 ID，从而给出该三轴度下失效塑性应变随单元尺寸的变化。若引用三维表 ID，失效塑性应变还可以取决于 Lode 参数（TABLE_3D）、三轴度（TABLE）和单元尺寸（CURVE）。

Failure option:
EQ.0.0: Isotropic failure : In this case, LCF00, LCG00, LCH00 and LCI00 define failure in any direction and Cards 8, 9 and 10 are not defined.
EQ.1.0: Orthotropic failure with original formulation. The plastic strain rate tensor is expressed in the current material system(updated for material rotation).
EQ.2.0 : Orthotropic failure with alternative formulation. The plastic strain rate tensor is expressed in the initial material system(not updated for material rotation).
失效选项：
EQ.0.0：各向同性失效；LCF00、LCG00、LCH00 和 LCI00 定义任意方向失效，不定义卡片 8、9、10。
EQ.1.0：采用原始公式的正交各向异性失效，塑性应变率张量在当前材料坐标系中表示（随材料旋转更新）。
EQ.2.0：采用替代公式的正交各向异性失效，塑性应变率张量在初始材料坐标系中表示（不随材料旋转更新）。

Table ID. The curves in this table define compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain. The table specifies a load curve ID for each plastic strain rate value, giving the (isothermal) compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain for that rate in the 00-degree direction.
表 ID。该表中的曲线定义塑性应变的压缩屈服应力。该表针对每个塑性应变率值指定一个载荷曲线 ID，给出该应变率下（等温）压缩屈服应力随塑性应变的函数，方向为 00 度。

Table ID defining for each temperature value a load curve ID giving the (quasi-static) compressive yield stress versus strain for that temperature. The curves in this table define compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain or effective plastic strain (see IFLAG).
该表为每个温度值指定一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出该温度下（准静态）压缩屈服应力随应变的关系。表中曲线将压缩屈服应力定义为塑性应变或等效塑性应变的函数（参见 IFLAG）。

Table ID. The table defines a load curve ID for each plastic strain rate value, giving the (isothermal) shear yield stress as a function of plastic strain for that rate in the 45-degree direction.
表 ID。该表针对每个塑性应变率值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，给出该应变率下（等温）剪切屈服应力随塑性应变的函数，方向为 45 度。

Table ID. The table defines a load curve ID for each temperature value, giving the (quasi-static) shear yield stress versus strain for that temperature. The load curves define shear yield stress as a function of plastic strain or effective plastic strain (see IFLAG) in the 45-degree direction.
表 ID。该表针对每个温度值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，给出该温度下（准静态）剪切屈服应力随应变的变化。载荷曲线定义 45° 方向的剪切屈服应力随塑性应变或等效塑性应变（见 IFLAG）的变化。

Flag to specify abscissa for LCCR, LCCT, LCSR, LCST:

EQ.1.0: Compressive and shear strain are given in function of effective plastic strain.

EQ.0.0：压缩屈服和剪切屈服以塑性应变的函数给出（默认）。
EQ.1.0：压缩应变和剪切应变以等效塑性应变的函数给出。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle.The angle may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword(see MANGLE).Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 与单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内、外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向的叉积确定，b 由法向与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。该角度可在单元关键字输入或本关键字的输入中设置（见 MANGLE）。材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择进行切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用该角度之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定的中心线轴定义。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Fiber dispersion parameter governs the extent to which the fiber dispersion extends to the third dimension. F = 0 and F = 1 apply to 2D splay with the normal to the membrane being in the beta and the gamma directions, respectively . F = 0.5 applies to 3D splay with transverse isotropy.
Splay will be orthotropic whenever F != 0.5. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.
纤维分散参数控制分散延伸到第三维的程度。F = 0 和 F = 1 分别对应 2D 扇出，膜法线分别沿 beta 和 gamma 方向；F = 0.5 对应具有横向各向同性的 3D 扇出。F 不等于 0.5 时扇出为正交各向异性。若 INIT = 1，则忽略此参数。

The parameter SIGMA governs the extent of dispersion, such that as SIGMA goes to zero, the material symmetry reduces to pure transverse isotropy. Conversely, as SIGMA becomes large, the material symmetry becomes isotropic in the plane. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.
参数 SIGMA 控制分散程度：SIGMA 趋近于 0 时，材料对称性退化为纯横向各向同性；SIGMA 变大时，材料在平面内趋于各向同性。若 INIT=1，则忽略该参数。

Fiber dispersion parameter governs the extent to which the fiber dispersion extends to the third dimension. F = 0 and F = 1 apply to 2D splay with the normal to the membrane being in the beta and the gamma directions, respectively . F = 0.5 applies to 3D splay with transverse isotropy.
Splay will be orthotropic whenever F != 0.5. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.
纤维分散参数控制分散延伸到第三维的程度。F = 0 和 F = 1 分别对应 2D 扇出，膜法线分别沿 beta 和 gamma 方向；F = 0.5 对应具有横向各向同性的 3D 扇出。F 不等于 0.5 时扇出为正交各向异性。若 INIT = 1，则忽略此参数。

The parameter SIGMA governs the extent of dispersion, such that as SIGMA goes to zero, the material symmetry reduces to pure transverse isotropy. Conversely, as SIGMA becomes large, the material symmetry becomes isotropic in the plane. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.
参数 SIGMA 控制分散程度：SIGMA 趋近于 0 时，材料对称性退化为纯横向各向同性；SIGMA 变大时，材料在平面内趋于各向同性。若 INIT=1，则忽略该参数。

MU is the isotropic shear modulus that models elastin
MU 为用于模拟弹性蛋白的各向同性剪切模量。

Bulk modulus for the hydrostatic pressure
静水压力的体积模量。

ACT = 1 indicates that an active model will be used that acts in the mean fiber-direction. The active model, like the passive model, will be dispersed by SIGMA and F, or if INIT = 1, with the *INITIAL_FIELD_SOLID keyword
ACT = 1 表示使用沿平均纤维方向作用的主动模型。该模型与被动模型一样会按 SIGMA 和 F 进行分散；若 INIT = 1，则使用 *INITIAL_FIELD_SOLID 关键字。

INIT = 1 indicates that the anisotropy eigenvalues will be given by *INITIAL_FIELD_SOLID variables in the global coordinate system
INIT = 1 表示各向异性特征值由全局坐标系中的 *INITIAL_FIELD_SOLID 变量给出。

Parameter describing which softening algorithm that shall be used.
EQ.1: Strain based Mullins effect from Qi and Boyce, see theory section
below for details
M1 = A (Qi recommends 3.5)
M2 = B (Qi recommends 18.0)

M4 = vs (between 0 and 1 and less than vss)

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
材料轴选项（参见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC 中“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Bulk modulus. To get almost incompressible behavior set this to one or two orders of magnitude higher than MU. Note that the Poisson's ratio should be kept at a realistic value.

Parameter describing which softening algorithm that shall be used.
EQ.1: Strain based Mullins effect from Qi and Boyce, see theory section
below for details
M1 = A (Qi recommends 3.5)
M2 = B (Qi recommends 18.0)
M3 = Z (Qi recommends 0.7)
M4 = vs (between 0 and 1 and less than vss)
M5 = vss (between 0 and 1 and greater than vs)
EQ.2: Energy based Mullins, a modified version of Roxburgh and Ogden model. M1 > 0, M2 > 0 and M3 > 0 must be set. See Theory section for details.
用于指定应采用何种软化算法的参数。
EQ.1：基于应变的 Mullins 效应，理论细节参见下文的理论部分。
M1 = A（Qi 建议取值为 3.5）
M2 = B（Qi 建议取值为 18.0）
M3 = Z（Qi 建议取值为 0.7）
M4 = vs（取值范围为 0 到 1 之间，且小于 vss）
M5 = vss（取值范围为 0 到 1 之间，且大于 vs）
EQ.2：基于能量的 Mullins 效应，为 Roxburgh 和 Ogden 模型的改进版本。必须设定 M1 > 0、M2 > 0 以及 M3 > 0，具体细节参见理论部分。

EQ.3：4 参数应变硬化模型，必须设置 K1、K2、S1 和 S2。详见理论部分。

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Tensile strength, f_t.
GT.0.0: constant value
LT.0.0: Load curve ID = |FT|, which gives tensile strength as a function of effective strain rate (RFILTF is recommended). If used with FTSCL > 0, |FT| specifies a curve for tensile strength vs. strain rate, and FTSCL scales the strength values from that curve as long as the material is intact. If cracked, neighbors get non-scaled values from that curve. RATENL is set to zero in that case. Logarithmic interpolation between strain rates is assumed if the first abscissa value in the curve is negative; in this case, all the abscissa values are assumed to represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.
Note that a spatially - varying scale factor can be applied to FT through * INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL by setting history variable #13 or through the STOCHASTIC keyword option by using* DEFINE_STOCHASTIC_VARIATION.This scale factor scales FT regardless of RATENL.As a result, depending on the value of RATENL, both this scale factor and FTSCL may scale FT.

Material axes option (see *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0 : Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1,2,and 4,as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.EQ.1.0 : Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point in space and the global location of the element center; this is the a-direction.

The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface, defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedra. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a, and c is the normal vector. DTYP is interpreted digit-wise as follows:
DTYP=[NM]=M+10*N.EQ.0: damage is accumulated, but there is no coupling to flow stress and no failure.
M.EQ.1: damage is accumulated, and element failure occurs for D=1. Coupling of damage to flow stress depending on parameters, see GISSMO Damage Model below.
N.EQ.0: equivalent plastic strain is the driving quantity for the damage. (To be more precise, it's the history variable that LS-PrePost blindly labels as plastic strain. What this history variable actually represents depends on the material model.)
N.GT.0: the Nth additional history variable is the driving quantity for damage. These additional history variables are the same ones flagged by the *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY keywords NEIPS and NEIPH fields. For example, for solid elements with *MAT_187, setting N=6 causes volumetric plastic strain to be the driving quantity for the GISSMO damage.

EQ.0：累积损伤，但不与流动应力耦合，也不发生失效。

N.EQ.0：等效塑性应变是损伤的驱动量。（更准确地说，这是 LS-PrePost 不加区分地标记为塑性应变的历史变量；该历史变量的实际含义取决于材料模型。）
N.GT.0：第 N 个附加历史变量是损伤的驱动量。这些附加历史变量与 *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY 关键字中的 NEIPS 和 NEIPH 字段所标记的变量相同。例如，对于使用 *MAT_187 的实体单元，将 N=6 设置为以体积塑性应变作为 GISSMO 损伤的驱动量。

Mid-plane failure option for shell elements.
If active, then critical strain is only checked at the mid-plane integration point, i.e., an odd number for NIP should be used.
The other integration points compute their damage, but no coupling to the stresses is done first.
As soon as the mid-plane IP reaches ECRIT/DCRIT, then all the other IP's are also checked.
Those of them that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses.
Those who are still below critical still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.0.0: Inactive,
EQ.1.0: Active.

EQ.1.0：激活。

LT.0.0 : | LCREGD | is a table ID(regularization factor as a function of element size curves indexed by triaxiality) or a 3D table ID(regularization factor as function of Lode parameter, triaxiality,and element size).This table provides an alternative to the use of SHRF and BIAXF for defining the effect of triaxiality on element size regularization of equivalent plastic strain to failure.
载荷曲线 ID 或表格 ID，用于定义与单元尺寸相关的等效失效塑性应变正则化因子：
GT.0.0：载荷曲线 ID（正则化因子随单元尺寸变化的函数），或表格 ID（正则化因子以有效应变率为索引的单元尺寸曲线的函数）。

Flag for governing the behavior of instability measure, F, and fading exponent, FADEXP (see Remarks):
EQ.0: F is incrementally updated,and FADEXP, if from a table, is allowed to vary.
EQ.1: F is incrementally updated,and FADEXP is kept constant after F = 1.nEQ.2: F is only 0 or 1 (after ECRIT is reached),and FADEXP, if from a table, is allowed to vary.
EQ.3: F is only 0 or 1 (after ECRIT is reached),and FADEXP is kept constant after F = 1.
控制失稳度量 F 和衰减指数 FADEXP 行为的标志（参见备注）：
EQ.0：F 增量更新；若 FADEXP 来自表格，则允许其变化。
EQ.1：F 增量更新；F = 1 后 FADEXP 保持不变。
EQ.2：达到 ECRIT 后 F 仅取 0 或 1；若 FADEXP 来自表格，则允许其变化。
EQ.3：达到 ECRIT 后 F 仅取 0 或 1；F = 1 后 FADEXP 保持不变。

Load curve or table with ID |LCSOFT| giving the soft reduction factor for failure strain in crashfront elements. Crashfront elements are elements that are direct neighbors of failed (deleted) elements. A load curve specifies the soft reduction factor as a function of triaxiality. A table gives the soft reduction factor as a function of triaxiality (curve) and element size (table). The sign of LCSOFT determines which strains are scaled:
EQ.0: Inactive
GT.0: Plastic failure strain, e_f(LCSDG),and critical plastic strain, e_(p,loc) (ECRIT), will be scaled by LCSOFT.
LT.0: Only plastic failure strain, e_f(LCSDG), will be scaled by LCSOFT.
SOFT is ignored when LCSOFT is active.
载荷曲线或表 ID |LCSOFT|，给出崩溃前沿单元失效应变的软化缩减因子。崩溃前沿单元是失效（删除）单元的直接邻居。载荷曲线给出软化缩减因子随三轴度的变化；表给出软化缩减因子随三轴度（曲线）和单元尺寸（表）的变化。LCSOFT 的符号决定缩放哪些应变：
EQ.0：不激活。
GT.0：失效塑性应变 e_f（LCSDG）和临界塑性应变 e_(p,loc)（ECRIT）均由 LCSOFT 缩放。
LT.0：仅失效塑性应变 e_f（LCSDG）由 LCSOFT 缩放。
LCSOFT 激活时忽略 SOFT。

Load curve ID defining failure strain scaling factor for LCSDG vs. strain rate. If the first strain rate value in the curve is negative,
it is assumed that all strain rate values are given as natural logarithm of the strain rate. The curve should not extrapolate to zero or failure may occur at low strain.
GT.0: scale ECRIT, too
LT.0: do not scale ECRIT.
载荷曲线 ID，定义 LCSDG 的失效应变比例因子随应变率变化的关系。如果曲线中的第一个应变率值为负，则假定所有应变率值均为应变率的自然对数。曲线不应外推到 0，否则低应变下可能发生失效。
GT.0：同时缩放 ECRIT
LT.0：不缩放 ECRIT。

Reduction factor for regularization for shear stress states. This parameter can be defined between -1.0 and +1.0. See remarks below.
用于剪切应力状态正则化的折减因子。该参数的取值范围可在-1.0 至+1.0 之间设定，具体细节请参见下方备注。

Reduction factor for regularization for biaxial stress states. This parameter can be defined between -1.0 and +1.0. See remarks below.
双轴应力状态正则化的折减因子。取值范围为 -1.0 至 +1.0，详见下方备注。

Load curve ID defining damage limit values as a function of triaxiality. Damage can be restricted to values less than 1.0 to prevent further stress reduction and failure for certain triaxialities..
用于定义损伤极限值与三轴度之间关系的载荷曲线 ID。为防止在特定三轴度条件下应力进一步降低并导致结构失效，可将损伤值限制在 1.0 以下。

Mid-plane failure option for shell elements.
If active, then critical strain is only checked at the mid-plane integration point, i.e., an odd number for NIP should be used.
The other integration points compute their damage, but no coupling to the stresses is done first.
As soon as the mid-plane IP reaches ECRIT/DCRIT, then all the other IP's are also checked.
Those of them that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses.
Those who are still below critical still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.0.0: Inactive,
EQ.1.0: Active.
壳单元中面失效选项。激活时，仅在中面积分点检查临界应变，因此 NIP 应采用奇数。其他积分点会计算其损伤，但在此之前不与应力耦合。中面 IP 达到 ECRIT/DCRIT 后，才检查所有其他 IP；已经超过临界值的积分点立即开始降低应力，仍低于临界值的积分点只有达到自身判据后才与应力耦合。
EQ.0.0：不激活。
EQ.1.0：激活。

History variable used to evaluate the 3D table LCSDG:
GT.0.0: constant value
LT.0.0: the constant value found at position  where  is the location in the history array of *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL/SOLID.
用于 3D 表 LCSDG 求值的历史变量：
GT.0.0：常数值。
LT.0.0：历史数组中由 *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL/SOLID 对应位置处的常数值。

Softening reduction factor for failure strain in crashfront elements. Crashfront elements are elements that are direct neighbors of failed (deleted) elements.
EQ.0.0: inactive
GT.0.0: plastic failure strain,  (LCSDG),and critical plastic strain,  (ECRIT), will be scaled by SOFT.
LT.0.0: only plastic failure strain,  (LCSDG), will be scaled by | SOFT |.
崩溃前沿单元（crashfront）中失效应变的软化缩减因子。崩溃前沿单元（crashfront）是失效（删除）单元的直接邻居。
EQ.0.0：不激活
GT.0.0：失效塑性应变（LCSDG）和临界塑性应变（ECRIT）均由 SOFT 缩放。
LT.0.0：仅失效塑性应变（LCSDG）由 | SOFT | 缩放。

Option to use a bending indicator instead of the Lode parameter. If active (> 0), the expression 'bending indicator" replaces the term 'Lode parameter" everywhere in this manual page. We adopted the bending indicator from *MAT_258 (compare with variable Ω). LP2BI > 0 is only available for shell elements and requires NUMFIP = 1.
EQ.0.0: Inactive.
EQ.1.0: Active.Constant regularization(LCREGD) applied.
EQ.2.0: Active.Regularization(LCRGED) fully applied under pure membrane loading(Ω = 0) but not at all under pure bending(Ω = 1).Linear interpolation in between.
使用弯曲指标代替 Lode 参数的选项。若激活（> 0），本手册页中“Lode 参数”一词均由“弯曲指标”取代。弯曲指标取自 *MAT_258（参见变量 Ω）。LP2BI > 0 仅适用于壳单元，并要求 NUMFIP = 1。
EQ.0.0：不激活。
EQ.1.0：激活，应用常规正则化（LCREGD）。
EQ.2.0：激活；纯膜加载（Ω = 0）时完全应用正则化（LCRGED），纯弯曲（Ω = 1）时完全不应用，中间情况采用线性插值。

First triaxiality value for optional "tub-shaped" regularization. See Remark 1.
可选“管状”正则化的第一个三轴度值。参见备注 1。

Second triaxiality value for optional "tub-shaped" regularization. See Remark 1
可选“管状”正则化的第二个三轴度值。参见备注 1。

Material identification for which this erosion definition applies. A unique number or label must be specified.
适用于该侵蚀定义的材料标识。必须指定一个唯一的编号或标签。

DTYP is interpreted digit-wise as follows:
DTYP=[NM]=M+10*N.EQ.0: damage is accumulated, but there is no coupling to flow stress and no failure.
M.EQ.1: damage is accumulated, and element failure occurs for D=1. Coupling of damage to flow stress depending on parameters, see GISSMO Damage Model below.
N.EQ.0: equivalent plastic strain is the driving quantity for the damage. (To be more precise, it's the history variable that LS-PrePost blindly labels as plastic strain. What this history variable actually represents depends on the material model.)
N.GT.0: the Nth additional history variable is the driving quantity for damage. These additional history variables are the same ones flagged by the *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY keywords NEIPS and NEIPH fields. For example, for solid elements with *MAT_187, setting N=6 causes volumetric plastic strain to be the driving quantity for the GISSMO damage.
DTYP 按位解释如下：
DTYP=[NM]=M+10*N。
EQ.0：累积损伤，但不与流动应力耦合，也不发生失效。
M.EQ.1：累积损伤，并在 D=1 时发生单元失效。损伤与流动应力的耦合取决于参数，参见下方 GISSMO 损伤模型。
N.EQ.0：等效塑性应变是损伤的驱动量。（更准确地说，这是 LS-PrePost 不加区分地标记为塑性应变的历史变量；该历史变量的实际含义取决于材料模型。）
N.GT.0：第 N 个附加历史变量是损伤的驱动量。这些附加历史变量与 *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY 关键字中的 NEIPS 和 NEIPH 字段所标记的变量相同。例如，对于使用 *MAT_187 的实体单元，将 N=6 设置为以体积塑性应变作为 GISSMO 损伤的驱动量。

Reference element size, for which an additional output of damage will be generated.
This is necessary to ensure the applicability of resulting damage quantities when transferred to different mesh sizes.
用于生成额外损伤输出的参考单元尺寸。
这是为了确保在将所得损伤量转换到不同网格尺寸时，其有效性。

Number or percentage of failed integration points prior to element deletion (default value is 1). NUMFIP does not apply to higher order solid element types 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, and 29, rather see the variable VOLFRAC. Also, when the material is a composite defined with *PART_COMPOSITE with different materials through-the-thickness, do not use NUMFIP; use *DEFINE_ELEMENT_EROSION instead.
GT.0.0: Number of integration points which must fail before element is deleted.
LT.0.0: Applies only to shells. |NUMFIP| is the percentage of layers which must fail before element fails.
For shell formulations with 4 integration points per layer, the layer is considered failed if any of the integration points in the layer fails
单元删除前必须失效的积分点数量或百分比（默认值为 1）。NUMFIP 不适用于高阶实体单元类型 24、25、26、27、28 和 29，应参见变量 VOLFRAC。此外，当材料通过 *PART_COMPOSITE 定义且厚度方向上使用不同材料时，不要使用 NUMFIP；应改用 *DEFINE_ELEMENT_EROSION。
GT.0.0：单元删除前必须失效的积分点数量。
LT.0.0：仅适用于壳单元。|NUMFIP| 为单元失效前必须失效的层数百分比。
对于每层有 4 个积分点的壳公式，如果该层中任一积分点失效，则认为该层失效

Volume fraction required to fail before element deletion. The default is 0.5. It is used for higher-order solid element types 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, and 29, and all isogeometric solids and shell elements. See Remark 3.
单元删除前必须达到失效条件的体积分数。默认值为 0.5。
该参数用于高阶实体单元类型 24、25、26、27、28 和 29，以及所有等几何实体单元和壳单元。参见备注 3。

Scale factor applied to the element size of tetrahedral elements when obtaining the regularization factor with LCREGD. To achieve similar results with hexahedral and tetrahedral element meshes, a value of 2.0 is a good starting point.
使用 LCREGD 获取正则化因子时施加于四面体单元尺寸的比例因子。为使六面体和四面体单元网格获得相近结果，2.0 是一个良好的起始值。

Failure strain curve/table or function:
GT.0.0: Load curve ID or table ID.As a load curve, it defines equivalent plastic strain to failure as a function of triaxiality.As a table, it defines for each Lode parameter value(between - 1 and 1) a load curve ID giving the equivalent plastic strain to failure as a function of triaxiality for that Lode parameter value.With HISVN.NE.0, a 3D table can be used, where failure strain is a function of the history variable(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).With HISVN = 0, a 3D table introduces thermal effects, that is, failure strain is a function of temperature(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).As a 4D table, failure strain is a function of strain rate(TABLE_4D), temperature(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).
LT.0.0: |LCSDG| is the ID of a function(*DEFINE_FUNCTION) with the arguments triaxiality eta. Lode parameter L, plastic strain rate ep, temperature T, history variable HISVN ,and element size l_e: f(eta,L,ep,T,HISVN,l_e).Note that the sequence of the arguments is important, not their names.
失效应变曲线/表格或函数：
GT.0.0：载荷曲线 ID 或表格 ID。作为载荷曲线时，定义等效失效塑性应变随三轴度变化的函数。作为表格时，对于每个 Lode 参数值（介于 - 1 和 1 之间），定义一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出该 Lode 参数值下等效失效塑性应变随三轴度变化的函数。HISVN.NE.0 时，可使用 3D 表格，此时失效应变是历史变量（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。HISVN = 0 时，3D 表格引入热效应，此时失效应变是温度（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。作为 4D 表格时，失效应变是应变率（TABLE_4D）、温度（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。
LT.0.0：|LCSDG| 为函数（*DEFINE_FUNCTION）的 ID，其参数为三轴度 eta、Lode 参数 L、塑性应变率 ep、温度 T、历史变量 HISVN 和单元尺寸 l_e：f(eta,L,ep,T,HISVN,l_e)。注意，参数的顺序很重要，参数名并不重要。

Critical plastic strain (material instability); see below.
LT.0.0: |ECRIT| is either a load curve ID defining critical equivalent plastic strain versus triaxiality or a table ID defining critical equivalent plastic strain as a function of triaxiality and Lode parameter(as in LCSDG).With HISVN=0, a 3D table can be used, where critical strain is a function of the history variable(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).With HISVN=0, a 3D table introduces thermal effects, that is, critical strain is a function of temperature(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).As a 4D table, critical strain is a function of strain rate(TABLE_4D), temperature(TABLE_3D), Lode parameter(TABLE),and triaxiality(CURVE).
EQ.0.0: Fixed value DCRIT defining critical damage is read(see below).
GT.0.0: Fixed value for stress - state independent critical equivalent plastic strain
临界塑性应变（材料失稳）；参见下文。
LT.0.0：|ECRIT| 可以是载荷曲线 ID，用于定义临界等效塑性应变随三轴度变化的关系；也可以是表格 ID，用于定义临界等效塑性应变随三轴度和 Lode 参数变化的关系（如 LCSDG）。HISVN=0 时，可使用 3D 表格，此时临界应变是历史变量（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。HISVN=0 时，3D 表格引入热效应，此时临界应变是温度（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。作为 4D 表格时，临界应变是应变率（TABLE_4D）、温度（TABLE_3D）、Lode 参数（TABLE）和三轴度（CURVE）的函数。
EQ.0.0：读取定义临界损伤的固定值 DCRIT（见下文）。
GT.0.0：与应力状态无关的临界等效塑性应变固定值

损伤阈值（临界损伤）。若 ECRIT 给出临界塑性应变载荷曲线或固定值，则忽略此输入。

DTYP is interpreted digit-wise as follows:
DTYP=[NM]=M+10*N.EQ.0: damage is accumulated, but there is no coupling to flow stress and no failure.

N.EQ.0: equivalent plastic strain is the driving quantity for the damage. (To be more precise, it's the history variable that LS-PrePost blindly labels as plastic strain. What this history variable actually represents depends on the material model.)
N.GT.0: the Nth additional history variable is the driving quantity for damage. These additional history variables are the same ones flagged by the *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY keywords NEIPS and NEIPH fields. For example, for solid elements with *MAT_187, setting N=6 causes volumetric plastic strain to be the driving quantity for the GISSMO damage.

EQ.0：累积损伤，但不与流动应力耦合，也不发生失效。

When any of the failure values on these cards are set to the exclusion number,

to prevent a material from developing tensile pressure, the user could specify an unusual value for
the exclusion number, e.g., 1234, set MNPRES to 0.0, and set all the remaining failure values to 1234.

Load curve ID, table ID, or 3d table ID. Load curve defines the Forming Limit Diagram, where minor engineering strains in percent are defined as abscissa values and major engineering strains in percent are defined as ordinate values. Table defines for each strain rate (LCFLD > 0) or for each shell thickness (LCFLD < 0) an associated FLD curve. The 3D table defines major strain as a function of temperature (TABLE_3D), strain rate (TABLE), and minor strain (CURVE). The forming limit diagram is shown in the relevant figure. When defining the curve, list pairs of minor and major strains, starting with the leftmost point and ending with the rightmost point. This criterion is only available for shell elements.

The exclusion number, which applies to the failure values defined on Cards 1, 2, and 7.
When any of the failure values on these cards are set to the exclusion number,
the associated failure criterion is not invoked. Or in other words, only the failure values not set to the exclusion number are invoked.
The default value of EXCL is 0.0, which eliminates all failure criteria from consideration that have their constants left blank or set to 0.0. As an example,
to prevent a material from developing tensile pressure, the user could specify an unusual value for
the exclusion number, e.g., 1234, set MNPRES to 0.0, and set all the remaining failure values to 1234.
However, use of an exclusion number may be considered nonessential since the same effect
could be achieved without use of the exclusion number by setting MNPRES to a very small negative value.
适用于卡片 1、2 和 7 上定义的失效值的排除编号。

EXCL 的默认值为 0.0；这会排除所有常数留空或设置为 0.0 的失效判据。例如，为防止材料产生拉伸压力，用户可以指定一个不常用的排除编号（例如 1234），将 MNPRES 设置为 0.0，并将其余所有失效值设置为 1234。
不过，使用排除编号可能并非必要，因为不使用排除编号也能获得相同效果：将 MNPRES 设置为一个非常小的负值。

Mid-plane failure option for shell elements and GISSMO. If active, then critical strain is only checked at the mid-plane integration point, i.e., an odd number for NIP should be used.
The other integration points compute their damage, but no coupling to the stresses is done first.
As soon as the mid-plane IP reaches ECRIT/DCRIT, then all the other IP's are also checked.
Those of them that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses.
Those who are still below critical still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.0.0: Inactive,
EQ.1.0: Active.. Those of the non-mid-plane IPs that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses. Those still below the critical value still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.2.0: active.All of the non - mid - plane IPs immediately start to reduce the stresses.NUMFIP is active.
EQ.3.0: active.Same as 2 but when D = 1 is reached in the middle integration point, the element is eroded instantaneously.NUMFIP is disregarded.
EQ.4.0: active.Damage and failure is applied only on the midpoint.When D = 1 on the midpoint, the element is eroded.NUMFIP is disregarded.Integration points away from the midplane see no stress reduction and no failure

The exclusion number, which applies to the failure values defined on Cards 1, 2, and 7.
When any of the failure values on these cards are set to the exclusion number,
the associated failure criterion is not invoked. Or in other words, only the failure values not set to the exclusion number are invoked.
The default value of EXCL is 0.0, which eliminates all failure criteria from consideration that have their constants left blank or set to 0.0. As an example,
to prevent a material from developing tensile pressure, the user could specify an unusual value for
the exclusion number, e.g., 1234, set MNPRES to 0.0, and set all the remaining failure values to 1234.
However, use of an exclusion number may be considered nonessential since the same effect
could be achieved without use of the exclusion number by setting MNPRES to a very small negative value.
适用于卡片 1、2 和 7 上定义的失效值的排除编号。
当这些卡片上的任一失效值被设置为排除编号时，与其关联的失效判据不会被调用。换言之，只有未设置为排除编号的失效值才会被调用。
EXCL 的默认值为 0.0；这会排除所有常数留空或设置为 0.0 的失效判据。例如，为防止材料产生拉伸压力，用户可以指定一个不常用的排除编号（例如 1234），将 MNPRES 设置为 0.0，并将其余所有失效值设置为 1234。
不过，使用排除编号可能并非必要，因为不使用排除编号也能获得相同效果：将 MNPRES 设置为一个非常小的负值。

Mid-plane failure option for shell elements and GISSMO. If active, then critical strain is only checked at the mid-plane integration point, i.e., an odd number for NIP should be used.
The other integration points compute their damage, but no coupling to the stresses is done first.
As soon as the mid-plane IP reaches ECRIT/DCRIT, then all the other IP's are also checked.
Those of them that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses.
Those who are still below critical still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.0.0: Inactive,
EQ.1.0: Active.. Those of the non-mid-plane IPs that are already above their critical value immediately start to reduce the stresses. Those still below the critical value still do not couple, only if they reach their criterion.
EQ.2.0: active.All of the non - mid - plane IPs immediately start to reduce the stresses.NUMFIP is active.
EQ.3.0: active.Same as 2 but when D = 1 is reached in the middle integration point, the element is eroded instantaneously.NUMFIP is disregarded.
EQ.4.0: active.Damage and failure is applied only on the midpoint.When D = 1 on the midpoint, the element is eroded.NUMFIP is disregarded.Integration points away from the midplane see no stress reduction and no failure
壳单元和 GISSMO 的中面失效选项。启用后仅在中面积分点检查临界应变，应使用奇数个 NIP。其他积分点计算损伤但初始不与应力耦合；中面 IP 达到 ECRIT/DCRIT 后检查全部其他 IP，已超过临界值者立即降低应力，低于临界值者在达到自身准则前不耦合。
EQ.0.0：未激活。EQ.1.0：激活，已超过临界值的非中面 IP 立即降低应力，其余仅在达到自身准则后耦合。EQ.2.0：激活，所有非中面 IP 立即降低应力，NUMFIP 有效。EQ.3.0：同 EQ.2，但中面 D=1 时单元立即侵蚀，忽略 NUMFIP。EQ.4.0：仅在中点施加损伤和失效；中点 D=1 时单元侵蚀，忽略 NUMFIP；远离中面的积分点不降低应力也不失效。

EQ.0.0: Erosion occurs when one of the damage parameters computer reaches unity, the damage tensor components
are based on the individual damage parameters d1 to d3.

If D1 reaches 1.0, stresses are set to zero and the integration point is no longer able to sustain any load. If D2=1.0, no action is taken, and the integration point is still mechanically active. 用于根据三轴度定义损伤极限值的载荷曲线 ID。为防止特定三轴度下应力进一步降低并导致失效，可将损伤值限制在 1.0 以下。

Mid-plane failure option for shell elements. If active, then critical strain is only checked at the mid-plane integration point, meaning an odd number for NIP should be used. Damage is computed at the other integration points, but no coupling to the stresses is done first. As soon as the mid-plane IP reaches ECRIT/DCRIT, then all the other IPs are also checked (exception: MIDFAIL = 4).
EQ.0.0: Inactive
EQ.1.0: Active.The stresses immediately begin to reduce for non - mid - plane IPs that are already above their critical value.Coupling only occurs for IPs that reach their criterion.
EQ.2.0: Active.The stresses immediately begin to reduce for all the non - mid - plane IPs.NUMFIP is active
EQ.3.0: Active.Same as 2, but when D = 1 is reached in the middle integration point, the element is eroded instantaneously.NUMFIP is disregarded.
EQ.4.0: Active.Damage and failure is applied only on the midpoint.When D = 1 on the midpoint, the element is eroded.NUMFIP is disregarded.Integration points away from the midplane see no stress reduction and no failure.
壳单元中面失效选项。启用后仅在中面积分点检查临界应变，因此 NIP 应为奇数。其他积分点计算损伤，但初始不与应力耦合；中面 IP 达到 ECRIT/DCRIT 后检查所有其他 IP（MIDFAIL=4 除外）。
EQ.0.0：未激活。EQ.1.0：激活，已超过临界值的非中面 IP 立即降低应力，只有达到自身准则的 IP 才耦合。EQ.2.0：激活，所有非中面 IP 立即降低应力，NUMFIP 有效。EQ.3.0：同 EQ.2，但中面达到 D=1 时单元立即侵蚀，忽略 NUMFIP。EQ.4.0：仅在中点施加损伤和失效；中点 D=1 时单元侵蚀，忽略 NUMFIP；远离中面的积分点不降低应力，也不失效。

There are 4 possible cases:
1. If MULO = 0.0, then inviscid fluid is assumed.
2. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI = 0.0 or is not defined, then this is the traditional constant dynamic viscosity coefficient mu.
3. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI > 0.0, then MULO and MUHI are lower and upper viscosity limit values for a power-law-like variable viscosity model.
4. If MULO is negative (for example, MULO = -1), then a user input data load curve (with LCID = 1) defining dynamic
viscosity as a function of equivalent strain rate is used.

There are 4 possible cases:
1. If MULO = 0.0, then inviscid fluid is assumed.
2. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI = 0.0 or is not defined, then this is the traditional constant dynamic viscosity coefficient mu.
3. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI > 0.0, then MULO and MUHI are lower and upper viscosity limit values for a power-law-like variable viscosity model.
4. If MULO is negative (for example, MULO = -1), then a user input data load curve (with LCID = 1) defining dynamic
viscosity as a function of equivalent strain rate is used.
共有 4 种情况：
1. MULO = 0.0：假定为无黏性流体。
2. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI = 0.0 或未定义：传统恒定动态黏度系数 μ。
3. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI > 0.0：MULO、MUHI 为幂律型变黏度模型的黏度下限和上限。
4. MULO 为负（如 -1）：使用 LCID = 1 的用户输入载荷曲线定义动态黏度随等效应变率的变化。

Material axes option (see Figure 0-1 and the Material Directions section):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. The a - direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element.The b - direction is orthogonal to the a - direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2,and 4. When this option is used in two - dimensional planar and axisymmetric analysis, it is critical that the nodes in the element definition be numbered counterclockwise for this option to work correctly.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element(see Figure 0 - 1).The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: |AOPT| is a coordinate system ID(see *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（参见图 0-1 和“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由图 0-1 所示的单元节点确定。a 方向从单元节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。在二维平面和轴对称分析中使用此选项时，单元定义中的节点必须按逆时针编号，才能保证选项正确工作。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述输入的向量 a 和 d 确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定（参见图 0-1）。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：|AOPT| 为坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element(see Figure 0 - 1).The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: |AOPT| is a coordinate system ID(see *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（参见图 0-1 和“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由图 0-1 所示的单元节点确定。a 方向从单元节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。在二维平面和轴对称分析中使用此选项时，单元定义中的节点必须按逆时针编号，才能保证选项正确工作。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述输入的向量 a 和 d 确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定（参见图 0-1）。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：|AOPT| 为坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Load curve ID or Table ID:
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain.If defined, QR1, CR1, QR2,and CR2 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function of effective plastic strain for that rate.See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the load curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the load curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.Logarithmic interpolation has some additional computational cost.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID：载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的关系；若已定义，忽略 QR1、CR1、QR2、CR2。表格数据：表 ID 为每个应变率指定一条载荷曲线，给出该速率下应力随等效塑性应变的关系；低于最小应变率使用最低曲线，超过最大值使用最高曲线。对数定义表：若表第一值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值为应变率自然对数；由于内部等间距离散，当速率相差数个数量级时使用自然对数可提高精度，但会增加计算开销。

Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function of effective plastic strain for that rate.See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the load curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the load curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.Logarithmic interpolation has some additional computational cost.
