Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详情请参见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的一点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；这就是 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，类似于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系中的前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可以在单元关键字输入中或本关键字的输入中设置。注意，对于实体单元，材料轴是否交换取决于 MACF 的选择。交换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后，具体取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定；二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 上的 CID）。

Number of integration points which must fail before element deletion. If zero, all points must fail. This option applies to shell elements only. For the case of one point shells, NUMINT should be set to a value that is less than the number of through thickness integration points. Nonphysical stretching can sometimes appear in the results if all integration points have failed except for one point away from the midsurface. This is due to the fact that unconstrained nodal rotations will prevent strains from developing at the remaining integration point. In fully integrated shells, similar problems can occur.
单元删除前必须失效的积分点数。若为零，则所有积分点均须失效。此选项仅适用于壳单元。对于单点壳单元，NUMINT 应小于沿厚度方向的积分点数。若除中面以外的一个积分点外其余积分点均已失效，结果中有时会出现非物理拉伸；这是因为无约束的节点转动会使剩余积分点无法继续产生应变。完全积分壳单元也可能出现类似问题。

Number of integration points which must fail before element deletion. If zero, all points must fail. This option applies to shell elements only. For the case of one point shells, NUMINT should be set to a value that is less than the number of through thickness integration points. Nonphysical stretching can sometimes appear in the results if all integration points have failed except for one point away from the midsurface. This is due to the fact that unconstrained nodal rotations will prevent strains from developing at the remaining integration point. In fully integrated shells, similar problems can occur.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface betwen the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向量确定。实体单元的平面是连接关系中前四个节点与后四个节点分别定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后绕 c 将 a 和 b 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在关键字输入中设置，也可在本关键字输入中设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能随 MACF 的取值而切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 上的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector, v,and an originating point, P, defining the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES, *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE - _COORDINATE_VECTOR).
材料轴选项（更完整的说明见 MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点确定。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向量确定。实体单元的平面是连接关系中前四个节点与后四个节点分别定义的内表面和外表面之间的中面。因此，对实体单元而言，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体单元。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后绕 c 将 a 和 b 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置，也可在本关键字输入中设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能随 MACF 的取值而切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。该选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES、*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM 或 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 上）。

MODEL.LE.0: Load curve ID defining yield stress as a function of volumetric strain, r (see Figure 0-1).
MODEL.GE.1:Load curve, table ID, or 3D table ID. If specifying a load curve ID, the load curve defines uniaxial yield stress under compression, σ_c, as a function of equivalent plastic strain. If specifying a table ID, each strain rate references a load curve ID that gives uniaxial yield stress as a function of equivalent plastic strain. If specifying a 3D table ID, uniaxial yield stress is given as a function of history variable #8 (3D table), strain rate (table), and equivalent plastic strain (curve).
载荷曲线（或表）ID，其含义取决于 MODEL：
MODEL.LE.0：定义屈服应力随体积应变 r 变化的载荷曲线 ID（见图 0-1）。
MODEL.GE.1：载荷曲线、表 ID 或 3D 表 ID。如果指定载荷曲线 ID，该载荷曲线定义等效塑性应变下的单轴压缩屈服应力 σ_c。如果指定表 ID，每个应变率引用一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出等效塑性应变下的单轴屈服应力。如果指定 3D 表 ID，单轴屈服应力给出为历史变量 #8（3D 表）、应变率（表）和等效塑性应变（曲线）的函数。

Tensile stress cutoff (only for MODEL = 0). A nonzero, positive value is strongly recommended for realistic behavior.
拉伸应力截断值（仅适用于 MODEL = 0 的情况）。为获得更符合实际的仿真结果，强烈建议设置一个非零的正数值。

Rate sensitivity via damping coefficient (.05 < recommended value < .50). Only available for MODEL = 0.
通过阻尼系数体现的速率敏感性（0.05 < 推荐值 < 0.50）。仅适用于 MODEL = 0。

Choice of material model formulation:
EQ.0:Original approach (default),
EQ.1: Elliptical yield surface in p - q space with symmetric tension - compression behavior(isotropic hardening),
EQ.-1: Same as MODEL = 0, but with a potentially wrong stress response in unloading. A bug fix for MODEL = 0 in R17 may change results, so this can be seen as a fallback option for obtaining the old behavior.
EQ.2: Elliptical yield surface in p - q space with asymmetric tension - compression behavior(volumetric hardening).
材料模型公式的选择：
EQ.0：原始方法（默认）。
EQ.1：p-q 空间中的椭圆屈服面，拉伸—压缩行为对称（各向同性硬化）。

The modulus is recovered in compression when RECOV is equal to 0 (default). The modulus remains at the brittle damage level when RECOV is equal to 1. Partial recovery is modeled for values of RECOV between 0 and 1. Two options are available:
Option 1: Input a value between 0 and 1. Recovery is based upon the sign of the pressure invariant only.
Option 2: Input a value between 10 and 11. Recovery is based upon the sign of both the pressure and volumetric strain.   In this case, RECOV=RECOV-10, and a flag is set to request the volumetric strain check.
当 RECOV = 0（默认）时，在压缩状态下恢复模量；RECOV = 1 时，模量保持在脆性损伤水平；RECOV 介于 0 和 1 之间时采用部分恢复。有两种选项：
选项 1：输入 0–1 之间的值，仅根据压力不变量的符号恢复。
选项 2：输入 10–11 之间的值，根据压力和体积应变两者的符号恢复。此时 RECOV = RECOV - 10，并设置标志以请求检查体积应变。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

Load curve or table ID. The load curve is available for ITC = 0 and 1 while the table is available for ITC = 2 and 3.
Load Curve.When LCIDT is a load curve ID, data points representing the accumulated equivalent plastic strainand the corresponding yield strength for the matrix phase are respectively given in the first columnand the second column of the corresponding load curve in *DEFINE_CURVE. If ITC = 1 is specified in Card 4, this load curve describes the matrix material in tension only.See Remark 3.
Tabular Data.If ITC = 2 or 3 is specified in Card 4, LCIDT is treated as a table ID.Data points representing different strain rates are given in one column of the corresponding table in *DEFINE_TABLE, followed by the definitions of load curves for the yield strength for the matrix phase as a function of effective plastic strain at each given strain rate value. See *DEFINE_TABLE. Linear interpolation of the yield strengths at different given strain rates is used by default. If the strain rate values fall out of range, extrapolation is not used; instead, either the first or last curve determines the yield strength as a function of effective plastic strain, which depends on whether the strain rate falls below the minimum given value or exceeds the maximum given value, respectively.If ITC = 3 is specified in Card 4, this table describes the matrix material in tension only.
Logarithmically - Defined Tables. If ITC = 2 or 3 is specified in Card 4, LCIDT refers to a table ID.In addition, if the first value in the table is negative, all data points in the table represent the natural logarithm of strain rates,and logarithmic interpolation of the yield strengths at discrete given strain rates is used.Note that this option works only when the lowest strain rate has a value less than 1.0. EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述向量确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。

The primary application of this option is to predict the break-up of axisymmetric shaped charge jets.

Maximum strain for matrix straining in tension or compression. The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum strain in the matrix direction is reached. The input value is always positive.
拉伸或压缩状态下基体应变的最大值。当基体方向达到该最大应变后，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。该输入值始终为正数。

Maximum shear strain. The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum shear strain is reached. The input value is always positive.
最大剪应变。当达到该值时，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。输入值始终为正数。

Time step size criteria for element deletion:
LT.0:no element deletion by time step size.
GT.0 and LT.0.1:element is deleted when its time step is smaller than the given value,
GT.1:element is deleted when the quotient of the actual time step and the original time step drops below the given value.
单元删除的时间步长判定标准：
LT.0：不因时间步长而删除任何单元。
GT.0 和 LT.0.1：当单元的实际时间步长小于给定值时，该单元将被删除。
GT.1：当实际时间步长与原始时间步长的比值低于给定值时，该单元将被删除。

Shear stress parameter for the nonlinear term, see Material 22.
非线性项的剪应力参数，详见材料 22。

Softening reduction factor for material strength in crashfront elements (default = 1.0). TFAIL must be greater than zero to activate this option.
碰撞前端单元中材料强度的软化折减因子（默认值为 1.0）。需使 TFAIL 的值大于零才能启用此选项。

Softening for fiber tensile strength:
EQ.0.0: tensile strength = Xt
GT:0.0: tensile strength = Xt , reduced to Xt*FBRT after failure has occurred in compressive matrix mode.
纤维抗拉强度软化：
EQ.0.0：抗拉强度为 Xt。
GT.0.0：抗拉强度初始为 Xt；发生基体压缩模式破坏后降为 Xt*FBRT。

Reduction factor for compressive fiber strength after matrix failure. The compressive strength in the fiber direction after compressive matrix failuire is reduced to: Xc=YCFAC* Yc (default YCFAC =2.0).
基体失效后纤维抗压强度的折减因子。基体发生压缩失效后，纤维方向上的抗压强度将按以下公式进行折减：Xc = YCFAC* Yc（默认值 YCFAC = 2.0）。

Maximum strain for fiber tension. (Maximum 1 = 100% strain). The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum tensile strain in the fiber direction is reached.
纤维拉伸的最大应变值。（最大值为 1 时对应 100% 的应变。）当纤维方向达到最大拉伸应变后，该单元中的对应层将被完全移除。

Maximum strain for fiber compression (Maximum -1 = 100% compression). The layer in the element is completely removed after the maximum tensile strain in the fiber direction is reached. The input value must have a negative sign.
纤维压缩的最大应变（最大值为 -1 时表示 100% 压缩）。当纤维方向达到该最大压缩应变后，单元中的对应层将被完全移除。输入值必须为负数。

有效失效应变。

拉伸纤维模式中剪切项的权重因子（0.0 ≤ BETA ≤ 1.0）。

Percentage of layers which must fail until crashfront is initiated. E.g. |PFL|=80.0, then 80 % of layers must fail until strengths are reduced in neighboring elements. Default: all layers must fail. A single layer fails if 1 in-plane IP fails (PFL>0) or if 4 in-plane IPs fail (PFL<0). (MAT_054 only).
在启动 crashfront 之前必须失效的层数百分比。例如，|PFL|=80.0，则在相邻单元的强度减小之前必须有 80% 的层失效。默认值：所有层都必须失效。如果 1 个面内 IP 失效 (PFL>0) 或 4 个面内 IP 失效 (PFL<0)，则单层失效。（仅限 MAT_054）。

损伤起始横向剪应变。（仅 MAT_054 使用）。

Transverse shear maximum damage, default=0.90. (MAT_054 only).
横向剪切最大损伤值，默认值为 0.90。（仅适用于 MAT_054）。

Fabric venting option, see *MAT_FABRIC.
EQ.1: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.2: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.3: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.4: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.5: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.6: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.7: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian, 2000]. Blockage is not considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.
EQ.8: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian 2000]. Blockage of venting or porous area due to contact is considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.
LT.0: |"FVOPT"| defines the same fabric venting options as above, but a new formula for the leakage area is used to replace the element area.

Fabric venting option, see *MAT_FABRIC.
EQ.1: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.2: Wang-Nefske formulas for venting through an orifice are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.3: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.4: Leakage formulas of Graefe, Krummheuer, and Siejak [1990] are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.5: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage is not considered.
EQ.6: Leakage formulas based on flow through a porous media are used. Blockage of venting area due to contact is considered.
EQ.7: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian, 2000]. Blockage is not considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.
EQ.8: Leakage is based on gas volume outflow versus pressure load curve [Lian 2000]. Blockage of venting or porous area due to contact is considered.
Absolute pressure is used in the porous-velocity-versus-pressure load curve, given as FAC.

Load curve ID or Table ID. Load curve ID defining effective stress versus effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1-EPS8 and ES1-ES8 are ignored. The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. 成形极限曲线的安全偏移量。该值应以百分比输入（例如输入 10，而不是 0.10）。此安全裕度将应用于由 FLDCID 定义的成形极限曲线，或应用于由 RN 和 RT 计算出的曲线。

GT.0.0: The number of element integration points that must fail before the element is deleted.By default, if one integration point has strains above the forming limit curve, the element is flagged for deletion.
LT.0.0: The element is deleted when all integration points within a relative distance of - FLDNIPF from the midsurface have failed(value between - 1.0 and 0.0).
数值积分点失效处理：

LT.0.0：当位于距中面相对距离 -FLDNIPF 内的所有积分点均已失效时，删除单元（该值介于 -1.0 和 0.0 之间）。

Tensile strength, f_t.
GT.0.0: constant value
LT.0.0: Load curve ID = |FT|, which gives tensile strength as a function of effective strain rate (RFILTF is recommended). If used with FTSCL > 0, |FT| specifies a curve for tensile strength vs. strain rate, and FTSCL scales the strength values from that curve as long as the material is intact. If cracked, neighbors get non-scaled values from that curve. RATENL is set to zero in that case. Logarithmic interpolation between strain rates is assumed if the first abscissa value in the curve is negative; in this case, all the abscissa values are assumed to represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.
Note that a spatially - varying scale factor can be applied to FT through * INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL by setting history variable #13 or through the STOCHASTIC keyword option by using* DEFINE_STOCHASTIC_VARIATION.This scale factor scales FT regardless of RATENL.As a result, depending on the value of RATENL, both this scale factor and FTSCL may scale FT.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Error calculation flag. The default value of "0" is recommended.
EQ.2: Perform the error calculation based on the true stress-strain curve from uniaxial tension, specified by HLCID.
The corrections will be made to the cyclic load curve, both in the loading and unloading portions. Since, in some cases where loading is more complex,
the accumulated plastic strain could be large (say more than 30%), the input uniaxial stress-strain curve must have enough strain range to cover
the maximum expected plastic strain. Note that this variable must be set to a value of "2" if HLCID is specified and a stress-strain curve is used.
误差计算标志；建议使用默认值 0。
EQ.2：根据 HLCID 指定的单轴拉伸真实应力—应变曲线执行误差计算，并修正循环载荷曲线的加载和卸载段。复杂加载可能导致累积塑性应变很大（例如超过 30%），因此输入单轴应力—应变曲线必须覆盖预期最大塑性应变。若指定 HLCID 并使用应力—应变曲线，此变量必须设为 2。

Uppercase B defined in Yoshida and Uemori [2002]. It is the initial size of the bounding surface. See Equations 5, 7b, 21, and 43a and section 2.5 in the paper.
Yoshida 和 Uemori [2002] 中定义的大写 B。它是包络面的初始尺寸。见论文中的方程 5、7b、21 和 43a 以及第 2.5 节。

Hardening parameter appearing in Yoshida and Uemori [2002] and Yoshida and Uemori [2003]. It gives the yield surface's radius in the deviatoric stress space. See Equations 4a, 7b, and 43a and section 2.5 in Yoshida and Uemori [2002].

Yoshida 和 Uemori [2002] 公式 43a 中的 C_1；SC1 必须大于 SC2。

Load curve ID or table ID. If this is defined, SIGY and ETAN will be ignored.
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines the nonlinear in - plane shear - stress as a function of in - plane shear - strain(r_ab). Tabular Data.The table maps in - plane strain rate values(r ̇_ab) to a load curve giving the in - plane shear - stress as a function of in - plane shear - strain.For strain rates below the minimum value, the curve for the lowest defined value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the curve for the highest defined value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Table.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。定义后忽略 SIGY 和 ETAN。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，定义非线性面内剪应力随面内剪应变（r_ab）的关系。
表格数据：表将面内应变率（ṙ_ab）映射到载荷曲线，该曲线给出面内剪应力随面内剪应变的关系；低于最小速率使用最低曲线，超过最大速率使用最高曲线。
对数定义表：若表第一值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值为应变率自然对数；内部等间距离散使得在速率相差数个数量级时采用自然对数更准确，但会增加计算开销。

Coupling factor for in-plane shear (ab-plane) damage with the fiber damage in tension: d6 = 1 - [1 - d6*(r2+))](1 - d1+ CF12)Here, d6 is the in - plane shear damage, d6* is an intermediate damage variable needed for finding the in - plane shear damage that is a function of r2+, r2+ is internal value of the constituative law representing an elastic domain threshold,and d1+ is the fiber damage in tension.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
面内剪切（ab 平面）损伤与拉伸纤维损伤的耦合因子：d6 = 1 − [1 − d6*(r2+)](1 − d1+ CF12)。其中 d6 为面内剪切损伤，d6* 为求取面内剪切损伤所需的中间损伤变量，该损伤是 r2+ 的函数；r2+ 是本构定律中表示弹性域阈值的内部值，d1+ 为拉伸纤维损伤。详见 Maimí、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Dávila [2007]。

Scaling factor on the fiber damage that is used when determining the reduced transverse shear (ca-plane) resulting from the fiber damage:c66 = (1 - d1 CF13) G_caHere, c66 is reduced transverse shear modulus in the ca - plane, G_ca is the ca shear modulus,and d1 is the fiber damage.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
根据纤维损伤确定由纤维损伤导致的约化横向剪切（ca 平面）时使用的纤维损伤缩放因子：c66 = (1 - d1 CF13) G_ca。这里 c66 是 ca 平面内约化后的横向剪切模量，G_ca 是 ca 平面剪切模量，d1 是纤维损伤。更多详情参见 Maimi、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Davila [2007]。

Scaling factor on the in-plane shear damage that is used when determining the reduced transverse shear (bc-plane) resulting from the in-plane shear damage:c55 = (1 - d6 CF23) G_bcHere, c55 is the reduced transverse shear in the bc - plane, G_bc is the bc shear modulus,and d6 is the in - plane shear damage.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
确定由面内剪切损伤导致的约化横向剪切（bc 平面）时使用的面内剪切损伤缩放因子：c55 = (1 - d6 CF23) G_bc。这里 c55 是 bc 平面内约化后的横向剪切模量，G_bc 是 bc 平面剪切模量，d6 是面内剪切损伤。更多详情参见 Maimi、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Davila [2007]。

GT.0.0: E_a, Young's modulus - longitudinal direction

Load curve ID or table ID. If this is defined, SIGY and ETAN will be ignored.
Load Curve.When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines the nonlinear in - plane shear - stress as a function of in - plane shear - strain(r_ab). Tabular Data.The table maps in - plane strain rate values(r ̇_ab) to a load curve giving the in - plane shear - stress as a function of in - plane shear - strain.For strain rates below the minimum value, the curve for the lowest defined value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the curve for the highest defined value of strain rate is used.
Logarithmically Defined Table.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rateand highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。定义后忽略 SIGY 和 ETAN。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，定义非线性面内剪应力随面内剪应变（r_ab）的关系。
表格数据：表将面内应变率（ṙ_ab）映射到载荷曲线，该曲线给出面内剪应力随面内剪应变的关系；低于最小速率使用最低曲线，超过最大速率使用最高曲线。
对数定义表：若表第一值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值为应变率自然对数；内部等间距离散使得在速率相差数个数量级时采用自然对数更准确，但会增加计算开销。

Coupling factor for in-plane shear (ab-plane) damage with the fiber damage in tension: d6 = 1 - [1 - d6*(r2+))](1 - d1+ CF12)Here, d6 is the in - plane shear damage, d6* is an intermediate damage variable needed for finding the in - plane shear damage that is a function of r2+, r2+ is internal value of the constituative law representing an elastic domain threshold,and d1+ is the fiber damage in tension.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
面内剪切（ab 平面）损伤与拉伸纤维损伤的耦合因子：d6 = 1 − [1 − d6*(r2+)](1 − d1+ CF12)。其中 d6 为面内剪切损伤，d6* 为求取面内剪切损伤所需的中间损伤变量，该损伤是 r2+ 的函数；r2+ 是本构定律中表示弹性域阈值的内部值，d1+ 为拉伸纤维损伤。详见 Maimí、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Dávila [2007]。

Scaling factor on the fiber damage that is used when determining the reduced transverse shear (ca-plane) resulting from the fiber damage:c66 = (1 - d1 CF13) G_caHere, c66 is reduced transverse shear modulus in the ca - plane, G_ca is the ca shear modulus,and d1 is the fiber damage.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
根据纤维损伤确定由纤维损伤导致的约化横向剪切（ca 平面）时使用的纤维损伤缩放因子：c66 = (1 - d1 CF13) G_ca。这里 c66 是 ca 平面内约化后的横向剪切模量，G_ca 是 ca 平面剪切模量，d1 是纤维损伤。更多详情参见 Maimi、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Davila [2007]。

Scaling factor on the in-plane shear damage that is used when determining the reduced transverse shear (bc-plane) resulting from the in-plane shear damage:c55 = (1 - d6 CF23) G_bcHere, c55 is the reduced transverse shear in the bc - plane, G_bc is the bc shear modulus,and d6 is the in - plane shear damage.See Maimi, Camanho, Mayugo,and Davila[2007] for more details.
确定由面内剪切损伤导致的约化横向剪切（bc 平面）时使用的面内剪切损伤缩放因子：c55 = (1 - d6 CF23) G_bc。这里 c55 是 bc 平面内约化后的横向剪切模量，G_bc 是 bc 平面剪切模量，d6 是面内剪切损伤。更多详情参见 Maimi、Camanho、Mayugo 和 Davila [2007]。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by an angle(see MANGLE on Card 4).

EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle.This angle may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword(see MANGLE on Card 4).

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for more complete description).
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes.The shells only the material axes are rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined a and d defined below, as with *DEFINED_COORDINATE_VECTOR.
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.The material directions are determined as follows: a is the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.

Shape factor for unloading. Active for nonzero values of the hysteretic unloading factor. Values less than one reduces the energy dissipation and greater than one increases dissipation.
卸载形状因子。当滞回卸载因子为非零值时该参数生效。小于 1 的值降低能量耗散，大于 1 的值增加能量耗散。

Failure option after cutoff stress is reached:
EQ.0.0: tensile stress remains at cut-off value (default),
EQ.1.0: tensile stress is reset to zero.
达到截止应力后的失效选项：
EQ.0.0：拉伸应力保持为截止值（默认值），
EQ.1.0：拉伸应力重置为零。

Bulk viscosity activation flag:
EQ.0.0: No bulk viscosity (default),
EQ.1.0: Bulk viscosity active.
体积黏性激活标志：
EQ.0.0：无体积黏性（默认）。
EQ.1.0：启用体积黏性。

Stiffness coefficient for contact interface stiffness.  If undefined, the maximum slope in the stress-strain curve is used.  When the maximum slope is taken for the contact, the time step size for this material is reduced for stability.  In some cases, Δt may be significantly smaller, so defining a reasonable stiffness is recommended.
接触界面刚度的刚度系数。如果未定义，则使用应力-应变曲线中的最大斜率。当接触使用最大斜率时，为保证稳定性，该材料的时间步长会减小。在某些情况下，Δt 可能显著变小，因此建议定义合理的刚度。

Load curve ID of relaxation curve. If LCID=0 the constants beta-i are determined via a least squares fit.This model ignores the constant stress.
松弛曲线的载荷曲线 ID。若 LCID = 0，则通过最小二乘拟合来确定常数 beta-i。该模型忽略了恒定应力。

Fit parameter. In the fit, beta-1 is set to zero, beta-2 is set to BSTART, beta-3 is 10 times beta-k-2 , beta-4 is 100 times greater than beta-3 , and so on.
EQ.0: BSTART= .01 (default).
拟合参数。在拟合过程中，beta-1 设为零，beta-2 设为 BSTART，beta-3 是 beta-k-2 的 10 倍，beta-4 是 beta-3 的 100 倍，依此类推。
EQ.0：BSTART = 0.01（默认值）。

Optional ramp time for loading.
加载的可选斜坡时间。

Number of terms in fit. Currently, the maximum number is set to 6. Values of 2 are 3 are recommended, since each term used adds significantly to the cost. Caution should be exercised when taking the results from the fit. Preferably, all generated coefficients should be positive. Negative values may lead to unstable results. Once a satisfactory fit has been achieved it is recommended that the coefficients which are written into the output file be input in future runs.
Default is set to 6.
拟合项数。目前最多可设为 6。建议取 2 或 3，因为每增加一项都会显著增加计算成本。采用拟合结果时应谨慎，最好保证生成的所有系数均为正值；负值可能导致结果不稳定。获得满意拟合后，建议在后续计算中直接输入输出文件中写出的系数。默认值为 6。

Load curve ID giving the magnitude of the shear modulus as a function of the frequency. LCID3 must use the same frequencies as LCID4.
给出剪切模量幅值随频率变化关系的载荷曲线 ID。LCID3 必须使用与 LCID4 相同的频率。

Load curve ID giving the phase angle of the shear modulus as a function of the frequency. LCID4 must use the same frequencies as LCID3.
给出剪切模量相位角随频率变化关系的载荷曲线 ID。LCID4 必须使用与 LCID3 相同的频率。

EQ.0：频率单位为每单位时间的周期数。

EQ.1: Radians
相位角单位标志：
EQ.0：度。
EQ.1：弧度。

第 i 项的可选衰减常数。

使用参考几何初始化应力张量。*INITIAL_FOAM_REFERENCE_GEOMETRY 定义参考几何。
EQ.0.0：关闭
EQ.1.0：开启。

单个六面体实体焊接单元的真实焊缝厚度。注意，TRUE_T 的行为取决于 TTOPT。参见 *MAT_SPOTWELD 的备注 8。

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,
LCA<0:Strong axis hardening stress as a function of the volumetric strain.

LCA > 0：sigma-bb 与法向应变分量 bb 的关系。对于类型为 0 和 9 的共旋实体单元，预期使用工程应变；而对于所有其他实体单元算法，则预期使用对数应变（默认值：LCB = LCA）。

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,
LCA<0:Weak axis hardening stress as a function of the volumetric strain.
LCA>0:sigma-cc versus normal strain component cc. For the cor otational solid elements, types 0 and 9, engineering strain is expected, but for all other solid element formulations a logarithmic strain is expected(default: LCC=LCA).
载荷曲线 ID；参见 *DEFINE_CURVE。
LCA < 0：定义弱轴硬化应力随体积应变变化的曲线。
LCA > 0：定义 σcc 随法向应变分量 εcc 的变化。对于 0 型和 9 型共旋实体单元，采用工程应变；其他实体单元算法采用对数应变（默认值：LCC = LCA）。

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,
LCA<0:Damage curve giving shear stress multiplier as function of the shear strain component. This curve definition is optional and may be used if damage is desired. if SHDFLG=0 (the dafault), the damage value multiplies the stress every time step and the stress is updated incrementally. The damage curve should be set to unity until failure begins. After failure the value should drop to 0.999 or 0.99 or any number between zero and one depending on how many steps are needed to zero the stress. Alternatively, if SHDFLG=1.0, the damage value is treated as a factor that scales the shear stress component to the undamaged value.
LCA>0:shear stress versus shear strain. For the corotational solid elements, types 0 and 9, engineering strain is expected, but for all other solid element formulations a shear strain based on the deformed configuration is used. (default LCS=LCA). Each component of shear stress may have its own load curve.
载荷曲线 ID，参见 *DEFINE_CURVE。
LCA < 0：损伤曲线给出剪应力乘数随剪应变分量的变化。该曲线可选，仅在需要损伤时使用。SHDFLG = 0（默认值）时，每个时间步都用损伤值乘以应力，并增量更新应力。失效开始前曲线值应为 1；失效后可根据应力降至零所需的步数，将值降至 0.999、0.99 或 0 与 1 之间的其他数值。SHDFLG = 1.0 时，损伤值作为相对于未损伤值缩放剪应力分量的因子。
LCA > 0：剪应力-剪应变曲线。0 型和 9 型共旋实体单元采用工程应变，其他实体单元算法采用基于变形后构形的剪应变（默认 LCS = LCA）。每个剪应力分量可使用各自的载荷曲线。

Load curve ID, see *DEFINE_CURVE,

载荷曲线 ID，参见 *DEFINE_CURVE。
LCA < 0：损伤曲线，给出 ab 方向剪切应变分量对应的 ab 方向应力乘数。此曲线为可选项，需要考虑损伤时可使用。参见上述 LCS。
LCA > 0：ab 方向应力与 ab 方向剪切应变的关系。对于 0 型和 9 型共旋实体单元，应输入工程应变；对于其他所有实体单元公式，则采用基于当前变形构形的剪切应变。（默认值：LCAB = LCS。）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

This curve definition is optional and may be used if damage is desired. if SHDFLG=0 (the dafault), the damage value multiplies the stress every time step and the stress is updated incrementally. The damage curve should be set to unity until failure begins. After failure the value should drop to 0.999 or 0.99 or any number between zero and one depending on how many steps are needed to zero the stress. Alternatively, if SHDFLG=1.0, the damage value is treated as a factor that scales the shear stress component to the undamaged value.

Load curve ID or Table ID.
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate, See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.Fields C, P, LCSR, EPS1 - EPS8, and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a Table ID is defined.Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，它定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系。若定义 EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8，则忽略这些字段。
表格数据：表 ID 为每个应变率值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出相应应变率下应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系；参见图示。当应变率低于最小值时，使用最低应变率对应的应力—等效塑性应变曲线；同样，当应变率超过最大值时，使用最高应变率对应的曲线。如果定义表 ID，则忽略字段 C、P、LCSR、EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8。默认在离散应变率之间进行线性插值；调用 LOG_INTERPOLATION 选项时使用对数插值。
对数定义的表格：在离散应变率之间调用对数插值的另一种方式如下。如果表中第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值表示应变率的自然对数。由于表在内部离散为等间距表值，当最低与最高应变率相差多个数量级时，从精度角度看，让表值表示应变率的自然对数是合理的。调用对数插值会带来额外计算成本。

Number of integration points that must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.)  For fully integrated shell formulations, each of the 4 x NIP integration points is counted individually in determining a total for failed integration points. NIP is the number of through-thickness integration points. As NUMINT approaches the total number of integration points (NIP for under-integrated shells, 4 x NIP for fully integrated shells), the chance of instability increases.LT.0.0: | NUMINT | is the percentage of integration points / layers which must fail before the shell element fails.For fully integrated shells, a methodology is used where a layer fails if one integration point failsand then the given percentage of layers must fail before the element fails.Only available for shells.

Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate, See the relevant figure. When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.Fields C, P, LCSR, EPS1 - EPS8, and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a Table ID is defined.Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.

载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：当 LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，它定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系。若定义 EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8，则忽略这些字段。
表格数据：表 ID 为每个应变率值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，该曲线给出相应应变率下应力随等效塑性应变的变化关系；参见图示。当应变率低于最小值时，使用最低应变率对应的应力—等效塑性应变曲线；同样，当应变率超过最大值时，使用最高应变率对应的曲线。如果定义表 ID，则忽略字段 C、P、LCSR、EPS1–EPS8 和 ES1–ES8。默认在离散应变率之间进行线性插值；调用 LOG_INTERPOLATION 选项时使用对数插值。
对数定义的表格：在离散应变率之间调用对数插值的另一种方式如下。如果表中第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值表示应变率的自然对数。由于表在内部离散为等间距表值，当最低与最高应变率相差多个数量级时，从精度角度看，让表值表示应变率的自然对数是合理的。调用对数插值会带来额外计算成本。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will
take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s
while "SCALE" can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those
from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational
time, see examples and Figures in *MAT_260A for details.
Furthermore, the increased absolute value (within a reasonable
range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming
simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the examples
and Figures in *MAT_260A.
该变量可在保持应变率效应一致的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如，拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 时仿真耗时很长，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，同时把 "SCALE" 设为 0.03，得到与 15 mm/s 相同的结果并显著减少计算时间；详见 *MAT_260A 中的示例和图。
此外，成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0*dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增大通常不会影响应变率，示例和 *MAT_260A 中的图说明了这一点。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will
take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s
while "SCALE" can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those
from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational
time, see examples and Figures in *MAT_260A for details.
Furthermore, the increased absolute value (within a reasonable
range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming
simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the examples
and Figures in *MAT_260A.
该变量可在保持应变率效应一致的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如，拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 时仿真耗时很长，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，同时把 "SCALE" 设为 0.03，得到与 15 mm/s 相同的结果并显著减少计算时间；详见 *MAT_260A 中的示例和图。
此外，成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0*dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增大通常不会影响应变率，示例和 *MAT_260A 中的图说明了这一点。

Material axes option (see *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC for a more complete description):
EQ.0.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2, and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES, and then rotated about the shell element normal by the angle BETA.
EQ.2.0: globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR:
EQ.3.0: locally orthotropic material axes determined by rotating the material axes about the element normal by an angle, BETA, from a line in the plane of the element defined by the cross product of the vector v with the element normal:
LT.0.0: the absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number (CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES, *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2、4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同，然后绕壳单元法向旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，先以向量 v 与单元法向量的叉积确定单元平面内的基准线，再绕单元法向量旋转 BETA 角确定材料轴。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES、*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM 或 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR）。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will
take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s
while "SCALE" can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those
from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational
time, see examples and Figures in *MAT_260A for details.
Furthermore, the increased absolute value (within a reasonable
range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming
simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the examples
and Figures in *MAT_260A.
该变量可在保持应变率效应一致的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如，拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 时仿真耗时很长，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，同时把 "SCALE" 设为 0.03，得到与 15 mm/s 相同的结果并显著减少计算时间；详见 *MAT_260A 中的示例和图。
此外，成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0*dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增大通常不会影响应变率，示例和 *MAT_260A 中的图说明了这一点。

Type of axial force-strain, moment-curvature, and torque-twist rate curves
EQ.0.0: curve is symmetric
EQ.1.0: curve is asymmetric
For symmetric curves, all data point must be in the first quadrant and at least three data points need to be given, starting from the origin, ensued by the yield point.
For asymmetric curves, at least five data points are needed and exactly one point must be at the origin. The two points on both sides of the origin record the positive and negative yield points.
The last data point(s) has no physical meaning: it serves only as a control point for inter or extrapolation.
The curves are input by the user and treated in LS-DYNA as a linearly piecewise function. The curves must be monotonically increasing, while the slopes must be monotonically decreasing.
轴向力—应变、弯矩—曲率和扭矩—扭转率曲线的类型。
EQ.0.0：曲线为对称曲线。
EQ.1.0：曲线为非对称曲线。
对于对称曲线，所有数据点必须位于第一象限，且至少给出三个数据点，从原点开始，随后为屈服点。
对于非对称曲线，至少需要五个数据点，且必须恰有一个点位于原点。原点两侧的两个点分别记录正、负屈服点。
最后一个或多个数据点没有物理意义，仅作为内插或外推的控制点。
曲线由用户输入，并在 LS-DYNA 中作为线性分段函数处理。曲线必须单调递增，而斜率必须单调递减。

Type of axial force-strain, moment-curvature, and torque-twist rate curves
EQ.0.0: curve is symmetric
EQ.1.0: curve is asymmetric
For symmetric curves, all data point must be in the first quadrant and at least three data points need to be given, starting from the origin, ensued by the yield point.
For asymmetric curves, at least five data points are needed and exactly one point must be at the origin. The two points on both sides of the origin record the positive and negative yield points.
The last data point(s) has no physical meaning: it serves only as a control point for inter or extrapolation.
The curves are input by the user and treated in LS-DYNA as a linearly piecewise function. The curves must be monotonically increasing, while the slopes must be monotonically decreasing.
轴向力—应变、弯矩—曲率和扭矩—扭转率曲线的类型。
EQ.0.0：曲线为对称曲线。
EQ.1.0：曲线为非对称曲线。
对于对称曲线，所有数据点必须位于第一象限，且至少给出三个数据点，从原点开始，随后为屈服点。

最后一个或多个数据点没有物理意义，仅作为内插或外推的控制点。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see Figure 0-1 and the Material Directions section):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in Figure 0 - 1. The a - direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element.The b - direction is orthogonal to the a - direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2,and 4. When this option is used in two - dimensional planar and axisymmetric analysis, it is critical that the nodes in the element definition be numbered counterclockwise for this option to work correctly.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors a and d input below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element(see Figure 0 - 1).The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: | AOPT | is a coordinate system ID(see *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（参见图 0-1 和“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由图 0-1 所示的单元节点确定。a 方向从单元节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向与 a 方向正交，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。在二维平面和轴对称分析中使用此选项时，单元定义中的节点必须按逆时针编号，才能保证选项正确工作。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下述输入的向量 a 和 d 确定，方式同 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定（参见图 0-1）。实体单元的平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换；交换发生在应用 BETA 之前还是之后取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由定义中心线轴的向量 v 和起点 P 确定。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：|AOPT| 为坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
