Load curve ID or Table ID.
Load curve ID defining effective stress versus effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1-EPS8 and ES1-ES8 are ignored.
The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate exceeds the maximum value. If defined C, P,curve ID, LCSR, EPS1-EPS8 and ES1-ES8 are ignored.
载荷曲线 ID 或表格 ID。
用于定义有效应力与有效塑性应变关系的载荷曲线 ID。若已定义该载荷曲线，则 EPS1-EPS8 和 ES1-ES8 均被忽略。
表格 ID 会为每个应变率值指定一个载荷曲线 ID，从而得出该应变率下的应力与有效塑性应变关系。当应变率低于最小值时，将使用对应最低应变率值的应力与有效塑性应变曲线；同理，当应变率超过最大值时，则使用对应最高应变率值的应力与有效塑性应变曲线。若已定义表格 ID，则 C、P、载荷曲线 ID、LCSR、EPS1-EPS8 和 ES1-ES8 均被忽略。

Failure flag:
LT.0.0: User defined failure subroutine is called to determine failure.
EQ.0.0: Failure is not considered. This option is recommended if failure is not of interest since many caluculations will be saved.
GT.0.0: Plastic strain to failure. When the plastic strain reaches this value, the element is deleted from the calculation.
失效标志：
LT.0.0：调用用户定义的失效子程序来确定是否发生失效。
EQ.0.0：不考虑失效情况。若无需分析失效过程，建议选择此选项，以便节省大量计算资源。
GT.0.0：达到该塑性应变值时发生失效。当塑性应变达到该数值时，该单元将从计算中移除。

Minimum time step size for automatic element deletion.
自动单元删除的最小时间步长。

Load curve ID defining effective yield stress versus effective plastic strain in compression.
用于定义压缩过程中有效屈服应力与有效塑性应变关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Load curve ID defining effective yield stress versus effective plastic strain in tension.
用于定义拉伸状态下有效屈服应力与有效塑性应变关系的载荷曲线 ID。

Optional load curve ID defining strain rate scaling effect on yield stress
when the material is in compression (compressive yield stress scaling factor vs. strain rate)
可选载荷曲线 ID，用于定义材料受压时应变率对屈服应力的缩放效应（即压缩屈服应力缩放因子随应变率的变化关系）。

Optional load curve ID defining strain rate scaling effect on yield stress
when the material is in tension (tensile yield stress scaling factor vs. strain rate).
用于定义材料处于拉伸状态时应变率对屈服应力影响的可选载荷曲线 ID（拉伸屈服应力比例因子与应变率的关系）。

Formulation for rate effects:
EQ.0.0: Total strain rate,
EQ.1.0: Deviatoric strain rate
速率效应公式：EQ.0.0=总应变率；EQ.1.0=偏应变率。

Compressive mean stress at which the yield stress follows load curve ID, LCIDC. If the pressure falls between PC and PT a weighted average of the two load curves is used.
压缩平均应力阈值；达到该值时，屈服应力按载荷曲线 ID LCIDC 确定。若压力介于 PC 与 PT 之间，则采用两条载荷曲线的加权平均值。

Tensile mean stress at which the yield stress follows load curve ID, LCIDT.
对应载荷曲线 ID LCIDT 的屈服应力所对应的拉伸平均应力。

Pressure cut-off in compression
压缩过程中的压力截断值。

Pressure cut-off in tension.
拉伸状态下的压力截断。

Pressure cut-off flag.
EQ.0.0: Inactive,
EQ.1.0: Active
压力截止标志：
EQ.0.0：停用。
EQ.1.0：启用。

Optional bulk modulus for the viscoelastic material. If nonzero a Kelvin type behavior will be obtained. Generally, K is set to zero.
黏弹性材料的可选体积模量。非零时得到 Kelvin 型行为；通常将 K 设为零。

Optional shear relaxation modulus for the ith term
第 i 项的可选剪切松弛模量。

Optional shear decay constant for the ith term
第 i 项的可选剪切衰减常数。

Load curve ID defining effective stress versus total effective strain. The stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used if the strain rate exceeds the maximum value.
载荷曲线 ID，用于定义有效应力随总有效应变的变化。当应变率低于最小值时，采用最低应变率对应的应力-有效塑性应变曲线；同理，当应变率超过最大值时，采用最高应变率对应的曲线。

Load curve ID defining strain rate scaling effect on yield stress.
用于定义应变率对屈服应力影响的比例因子对应的载荷曲线 ID。

Failure flag:
EQ.0.0: failure determined by maximum tensile strain (default),
EQ.1.0: failure determined only by tensile strain in local x direction,
EQ.2.0: failure determined only by tensile strain in local y direction.
失效标志：
EQ.0.0：根据最大拉伸应变判定失效（默认值），
EQ.1.0：仅根据局部 x 方向的拉伸应变判定失效，
EQ.2.0：仅根据局部 y 方向的拉伸应变判定失效。

Viscous damping factor in the units of [stress*time]. Typical values are 10**(-3)  Ns/mm**2 or 10**(-4)  Ns/mm**2. If set too high, instabilities can result.
单位为 [应力*time] 的黏性阻尼因子。典型值为 10**(-3) Ns/mm**2 或 10**(-4) Ns/mm**2。如果设置过高，可能导致不稳定。

Filtering factor for strain rate effects. Must be between 0 (no filtering) and 1 (infinite filtering) The filter is a simple low pass filter to remove high frequency oscillation from the strain rates before they are used in rate effect calculations. The cut off frequency of the filter is [(1 - RATEFAC)/ timestep] rad/sec.
应变率效应的过滤因子。其取值范围必须在 0（无过滤）到 1（完全过滤）之间。该过滤器为简单的低通滤波器，用于在将应变率用于应变率效应计算之前去除其中的高频振荡。该滤波器的截止频率为[(1 - RATEFAC)/ timestep] 弧度/秒。

Load curve ID giving variation of failure strain with strain rate. The points on the x-axis should be natural log of strain rate, the y-axis should be the true strain to failure. Typically this is measured by uniaxial tensile test, and the strain values converted to true strain.
给出失效应变随应变率变化的载荷曲线 ID。x 轴上的点应为应变率的自然对数，y 轴应为失效时的真应变。通常这通过单轴拉伸试验测量，并将应变值转换为真应变。

Number of integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. This option is available for shells only.
LT.0.0: |NUMINT| is percentage of integration points/layers which must fail before shell element fails.
单元被删除前必须失效的积分点数量。此选项仅适用于壳单元。
LT.0.0：|NUMINT| 是在壳单元失效前必须失效的积分点/层数百分比。

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Better results are obtained if NUMINT is set to 1 or a number less than one half of the number of through thickness points. For example, if four through thickness points are used, NUMINT should not exceed 2, even for fully integrated shells which have 16 integration points.
单元删除前必须失效的沿厚度方向积分点数量（若该值为零，则所有积分点都必须失效）。不建议采用要求所有积分点均失效的默认设置，因为发生大应变的单元往往不会被删除：大多数积分点失效后，节点纤维的转动会限制其余有效积分点的应变。将 NUMINT 设为 1，或设为小于沿厚度方向积分点总数一半的数值，可获得更好的结果。例如，若沿厚度方向采用 4 个积分点，则 NUMINT 不应超过 2；即使完全积分壳单元共有 16 个积分点，也是如此。

First effective plastic strain value (optional if SIGY is defined). At least 2 points should be defined. The first point must be zero corresponding to the initial yield stress.
WARNING: If the first point is nonzero the yield stress is extrapolated to determine the initial yield. If this option is used SIGY and ETAN are ignored and may be input as zero.
第 1 个有效塑性应变值（若已定义 SIGY，则此项可选）。至少应定义两个数据点；第一个点必须为零，对应初始屈服应力。
警告：若第一个点不为零，则通过外推确定初始屈服应力。使用此选项时忽略 SIGY 和 ETAN，可输入为零。

Second effective plastic strain value (optional if SIGY is defined). At least 2 points should be defined. The first point must be zero corresponding to the initial yield stress.
第 2 个有效塑性应变值（若已定义 SIGY，则可选）。至少应定义 2 个数据点；第一个点必须为零，对应初始屈服应力。

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Better results are obtained if NUMINT is set to 1 or a number less than one half of the number of through thickness points. For example, if four through thickness points are used, NUMINT should not exceed 2, even for fully integrated shells which have 16 integration points.
单元删除前必须失效的沿厚度方向积分点数量（若该值为零，则所有积分点都必须失效）。不建议采用要求所有积分点均失效的默认设置，因为发生大应变的单元往往不会被删除：大多数积分点失效后，节点纤维的转动会限制其余有效积分点的应变。将 NUMINT 设为 1，或设为小于沿厚度方向积分点总数一半的数值，可获得更好的结果。例如，若沿厚度方向采用 4 个积分点，则 NUMINT 不应超过 2；即使完全积分壳单元共有 16 个积分点，也是如此。

Formulation of model. FORM=0 gives the original model developed by Fung, which always relaxes to a zero stress state as time approaches infinity, and FORM=1 gives the alternative model, which relaxes to the quasi-static elastic response. In general, the two formulations won't give the same responses. Formulation, FORM=-1, is an improvement on FORM=0 where the instantaneous elastic response is used in the viscoelastic stress update, not just in the relaxation, as in FORM=0. Consequently, the constants for the elastic response do not need to be scaled
模型公式。FORM = 0 给出 Fung 开发的原始模型；当时间趋于无穷大时，该模型总是松弛到零应力状态。FORM = 1 给出替代模型；该模型松弛到准静态弹性响应。通常，两种公式不会产生相同响应。FORM = -1 是 FORM = 0 的改进：在黏弹性应力更新中使用瞬时弹性响应，而不像 FORM = 0 那样只在松弛过程中使用。因此，无需对弹性响应常数进行缩放。

Load curve ID (see *DEFINE_CURVE) describing force as a function of displacement or moment as a function of rotation relationship. The load curve must define the response in the negative and positive quadrants and pass through point Image. Negative data point(s) must come first in the curve definition, where negative values represent compression in the case of a translational spring.
LCD may also be a table ID (see *DEFINE_TABLE). The table gives for each loading rate a load curve ID defining the force-displacement (or moment-rotation) curve. Values between the data points are computed by linear interpolation. If a table ID is specified, LCR will be ignored.
载荷曲线 ID（见 *DEFINE_CURVE），描述力随位移或力矩随转角的关系。曲线必须定义负、正象限的响应并通过原点；负数据点必须先出现在曲线定义中，平移弹簧中负值表示压缩。LCD 也可为表 ID（见 *DEFINE_TABLE），该表为每个加载速率给出一个定义力—位移（或力矩—转角）曲线的载荷曲线 ID；数据点之间线性插值。若指定表 ID，则忽略 LCR。

Optional load curve describing scale factor on force or moment as a function of relative velocity or rotational velocity. The load curve most define the response in the negative and positive quadrants and pass through point (0,0).
可选载荷曲线，用于描述力或力矩随相对速度或旋转速度变化时的比例因子。该载荷曲线必须定义负、正象限中的响应，并经过点 (0,0)。

The absolute value of LCSS is a load curve ID for effective stress as a function of effective plastic or effective total strain depending on the first data point (this load curve is optional).
If the first data point has a positive ordinate value, it indicates the initial yield stress at zero plastic strain.If it is zero, it is a curve with respect to effective total strain.The first abscissa value must always be zero.
For a negative value of LCSS, negative values of SIG_ASS, SIG_ASF, SIG_SAS, and SIG_SAF indicate dependence on plastic strain; see below.
|LCSS| 是载荷曲线 ID，定义等效应力随等效塑性应变或有效总应变的变化，具体取决于第一个数据点（该载荷曲线可选）。若第一个数据点的纵坐标为正，表示零塑性应变下的初始屈服应力；若为零，则曲线以有效总应变为自变量。第一个横坐标值必须始终为零。

The absolute value of LCSSC  is a load curve ID for effective stress as a function of effective plastic or effective total strain (depending on the first data point) under compressive load (this load curve is optional).
If the first data point has a positive ordinate value, it indicates the initial yield stress at zero plastic strain.If it is zero, it is a curve with respect to effective total strain.The first abscissa value must always be zero.
A negative value of LCSSC scales the load curve with the parameter ALPHA.For example, LCSSC = -LCSS will give the same relation between compressive and tensile hardening as between compressive and tensile phase transformation stresses.
If LCSSC is undefined or zero, LCSS specifies the behavior in compression.

LCSSC 为负值时，载荷曲线按 ALPHA 缩放。例如，LCSSC = -LCSS 将使压缩/拉伸强化应力与压缩/拉伸相变应力具有相同关系。若 LCSSC 未定义或为零，则 LCSS 定义压缩行为。

Load curve ID or table ID for the forward phase change (conversion of austenite into martensite).
1. When LCID_AS is a load curve ID the curve is taken to be effective stress as a function of martensite fraction(ranging from 0 to 1).

The stress as a function of martensite fraction curve for the smallest value of the phase transition rate is used if the phase transition rate falls below the minimum value. Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内、外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向的叉积确定，b 由法向与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择进行切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).

EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内、外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向的叉积确定，b 由法向与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择进行切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用 BETA 之前或之后。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.

EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.

Number of through thickness integration points which must fail before the element is deleted. (If zero, all points must fail.) The default of all integration points is not recommended since elements undergoing large strain are often not deleted due to nodal fiber rotations which limit strains at active integration points after most points have failed. Better results are obtained if NUMINT is set to 1 or a number less than one half of the number of through thickness points. For example, if four through thickness points are used, NUMINT should not exceed 2, even for fully integrated shells which have 16 integration points.
单元删除前必须失效的沿厚度方向积分点数量（若该值为零，则所有积分点都必须失效）。不建议采用要求所有积分点均失效的默认设置，因为发生大应变的单元往往不会被删除：大多数积分点失效后，节点纤维的转动会限制其余有效积分点的应变。将 NUMINT 设为 1，或设为小于沿厚度方向积分点总数一半的数值，可获得更好的结果。例如，若沿厚度方向采用 4 个积分点，则 NUMINT 不应超过 2；即使完全积分壳单元共有 16 个积分点，也是如此。

Load curve or table ID, see *DEFINE_TABLE, defining the force versus actual change in the gauge length. If the table definition is used a family of curves are defined for discrete strain rates. The load curves should cover the complete range of expected loading, i.e., the smallest stretch ratio to the largest.

Parameter that controls how the rate effects are treated. Applicable to the table definition.
EQ.-1.-: rate effects are considered for loading either in tension or compression, but not for unloading,
EQ.0.0: rate effects are considered for compressive loading only,
EQ.1.0: rate effects are treated identically in tension and compression.
用于控制如何处理速率效应的参数。适用于表格定义。
EQ.-1.-：无论处于拉伸还是压缩加载状态，都会考虑速率效应，但卸载时不考虑；
EQ.0.0：仅对压缩加载考虑速率效应；
EQ.1.0：在拉伸和压缩状态下以相同方式处理速率效应。

EQ.0.0: true strain rate,

EQ.0.0: simple average of twelve time steps,
EQ.1.0: running average of last 12 averages.
用于确定应变率以降低数值噪声的平均选项。

EQ.0.0：十二个时间步的简单平均值，
EQ.1.0：最近 12 个平均值的滑动平均。

to the following equation with β=|"PR" | and K_m=KM (see Card 1):

GT.0.0.AND.LT.0.49：假定为泡沫材料，采用 Hill 应变能函数。PR 给出泊松比。卡片 1 上的 KM 应设置为有意义的值，因为它用于临界时间步长计算、接触罚刚度和 6 型沙漏控制。对于全积分单元，不使用选择性减缩积分。

Load curve, see *DEFINE_CURVE, defining the force versus actual
length during unloading. The unload curve should cover exactly
the same range as LC or the load curves of TBID and its end points
should have identical values, i.e., the combination of LC and
LCUNLD or the first curve of TBID and LCUNLD describes a
complete cycle of loading and unloading. See also material *MAT_ 083.
载荷曲线（参见 *DEFINE_CURVE），定义卸载过程中力随实际长度的变化。卸载曲线应与 LC 或 TBID 的载荷曲线覆盖完全相同的范围，端点值也应相同；LC 与 LCUNLD 的组合，或 TBID 第一条曲线与 LCUNLD 的组合，构成完整加载—卸载循环。另见 *MAT_083。

Hysteretic unloading factor between 0 and 1 (default = 1., i.e. no

卸载形状因子。当滞回卸载因子 HU 非零时有效。小于 1 的值降低能量耗散，大于 1 的值增加能量耗散；另见材料 *MAT_083 和图 M57-1。

Tolerance in stability check.
稳定性校核的容差。

Load curve ID or table ID (see *DEFINE_TABLE) defining the force as a function of actual change in the gauge length.
If SGL, SW, and ST are set to unity (1.0), curve LC is also engineering stress as a function of engineering strain.
If the table definition is used, a family of curves is defined for discrete strain rates. The curves should cover the complete
range of expected responses, including both compressive (negative values) and tensile (positive values) regimes. See Remark 1.
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID（见 *DEFINE_TABLE），定义力随标距实际变化的关系。若 SGL、SW、ST 均为 1.0，则 LC 也表示工程应力随工程应变的关系。使用表定义时，为离散应变率定义一族曲线；曲线应覆盖预期响应的完整范围，包括压缩（负值）和拉伸（正值）状态。参见备注 1。

Parameter that controls how the rate effects are treated. It is applicable to the table definition.
EQ.-1.0: Rate effects are considered for loading either in tension or compression, but not for unloading,

EQ.1.0: Rate effects are treated identically in tension and compression.

EQ.0.0：仅对受压加载考虑速率效应；
EQ.1.0：在拉伸和压缩中以相同方式处理速率效应。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC particularly the Material Directions section, for details). The fiber direction depends on this coordinate system (see Remark 1).
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle FANG on this keyword or BETA on the *ELEMENT_SHELL_{OPTION} input.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedra. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or with FANG on this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle rotation depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是其中的材料方向部分）。纤维方向取决于此坐标系（见备注 1）。
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面的法向量旋转本关键字中的 FANG 或 *ELEMENT_SHELL_{选项} 输入中的 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是中面，位于单元连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元的关键字输入中设置，也可通过本关键字中的 FANG 设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换。交换可能发生在角度旋转之前或之后，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 编号（CID 见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC particularly the Material Directions section, for details). The fiber direction depends on this coordinate system (see Remark 1).
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle FANG on this keyword or BETA on the *ELEMENT_SHELL_{OPTION} input.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedra. a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or with FANG on this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle rotation depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是其中的材料方向部分）。纤维方向取决于此坐标系（见备注 1）。
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元而言，材料轴随后绕壳表面的法向量旋转本关键字中的 FANG 或 *ELEMENT_SHELL_{选项} 输入中的 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是中面，位于单元连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点分别定义的内表面与外表面之间。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元的关键字输入中设置，也可通过本关键字中的 FANG 设置。请注意，对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择而交换。交换可能发生在角度旋转之前或之后，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和原点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 编号（CID 见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

There are 4 possible cases (See Remark 1):
1. If MULO = 0.0, then inviscid fluid is assumed.
2. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI = 0.0 or is not defined, then
this is the traditional constant dynamic viscosity coefficient mu.
3. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI > 0.0, then MULO and MUHI
are lower and upper viscosity limit values for a powerlaw-like variable viscosity model.
4. If MULO is negative (for example, MULO = -1), then a
user-input data load curve (with LCID = 1) defining dynamic
viscosity as a function of equivalent strain rate is used.
共有 4 种情况（见备注 1）：
1. MULO = 0.0：假定为无黏性流体。
2. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI = 0.0 或未定义：采用传统的恒定动态黏度系数 μ。
3. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI > 0.0：MULO 和 MUHI 是幂律型变黏度模型的黏度下限和上限。
4. MULO 为负（例如 MULO = -1）：使用 LCID = 1 的用户输入载荷曲线定义动态黏度随等效应变率的变化。

There are 2 possible cases:
5. If MUHI < 0.0, then the viscosity can be defined by the user in the file dyn21.F with a routine called f3dm9sph_userdefin.
The file is part of the general usermat package.
6. If MUHI > 0.0, then this is the upper dynamic viscosity
limit (default = 0.0). This is defined only if RK and RN
are defined for the variable viscosity case.
有两种可能情况：
5. 若 MUHI<0.0，用户可在 dyn21.F 文件中通过 f3dm9sph_userdefin 例程定义黏度；该文件属于通用 usermat 软件包。
6. 若 MUHI>0.0，则为动态黏度上限（默认值=0.0）；仅当为变黏度情形定义 RK 和 RN 时才定义该上限。

动力黏度系数乘数。参见备注 6。

RC.LE.0.0：使用基于上述字段的黏度模型（参见备注 6）。

可变动力黏度指数。参见备注 6。

There are 4 possible cases (See Remark 1):
1. If MULO = 0.0, then inviscid fluid is assumed.
2. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI = 0.0 or is not defined, then
this is the traditional constant dynamic viscosity coefficient mu.
3. If MULO > 0.0, and MUHI > 0.0, then MULO and MUHI
are lower and upper viscosity limit values for a powerlaw-like variable viscosity model.
4. If MULO is negative (for example, MULO = -1), then a
user-input data load curve (with LCID = 1) defining dynamic
viscosity as a function of equivalent strain rate is used.
共有 4 种情况（见备注 1）：
1. MULO = 0.0：假定为无黏性流体。
2. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI = 0.0 或未定义：采用传统的恒定动态黏度系数 μ。
3. MULO > 0.0 且 MUHI > 0.0：MULO 和 MUHI 是幂律型变黏度模型的黏度下限和上限。
4. MULO 为负（例如 MULO = -1）：使用 LCID = 1 的用户输入载荷曲线定义动态黏度随等效应变率的变化。

There are 2 possible cases:
5. If MUHI < 0.0, then the viscosity can be defined by the user in the file dyn21.F with a routine called f3dm9sph_userdefin.
The file is part of the general usermat package.
6. If MUHI > 0.0, then this is the upper dynamic viscosity
limit (default = 0.0). This is defined only if RK and RN
are defined for the variable viscosity case.
有两种可能情况：
5. 若 MUHI<0.0，用户可在 dyn21.F 文件中通过 f3dm9sph_userdefin 例程定义黏度；该文件属于通用 usermat 软件包。
6. 若 MUHI>0.0，则为动态黏度上限（默认值=0.0）；仅当为变黏度情形定义 RK 和 RN 时才定义该上限。

Variable dynamic viscosity multiplier. See Remark 6..
动力黏度系数乘数。参见备注 6。

Cross viscosity model:
RC.GT.0.0: Use the Cross viscosity model which overwrites all other options.The values of MULO, MUHI, RK,and RN are used in the Cross viscosity model.See Remark 7.
RC.LE.0.0: Use a viscosity model based on the above fields.See Remark 6.
Cross 黏度模型：
RC.GT.0.0：使用 Cross 黏度模型并覆盖其他选项；模型使用 MULO、MUHI、RK 和 RN 的值（参见备注 7）。
RC.LE.0.0：使用基于上述字段的黏度模型（参见备注 6）。

Variable dynamic viscosity exponent. See Remark 6.
可变动力黏度指数。参见备注 6。

Load curve ID (see *DEFINE_CURVE) describing force as a function of displacement or moment as a function of rotation relationship. The load curve must define the response in the negative and positive quadrants and pass through point Image. Negative data point(s) must come first in the curve definition, where negative values represent compression in the case of a translational spring.
LCD may also be a table ID (see *DEFINE_TABLE). The table gives for each loading rate a load curve ID defining the force-displacement (or moment-rotation) curve. Values between the data points are computed by linear interpolation. If a table ID is specified, LCR will be ignored.
载荷曲线 ID（见 *DEFINE_CURVE），描述力随位移或力矩随转角的关系。曲线必须定义负、正象限的响应并通过原点；负数据点必须先出现在曲线定义中，平移弹簧中负值表示压缩。LCD 也可为表 ID（见 *DEFINE_TABLE），该表为每个加载速率给出一个定义力—位移（或力矩—转角）曲线的载荷曲线 ID；数据点之间线性插值。若指定表 ID，则忽略 LCR。

Optional load curve describing scale factor on force or moment as a function of relative velocity or rotational velocity. The load curve most define the response in the negative and positive quadrants and pass through point (0,0).
可选载荷曲线，用于描述力或力矩随相对速度或旋转速度变化时的比例因子。该载荷曲线必须定义负、正象限中的响应，并经过点 (0,0)。

ID of a load curve defining stress scale factors vs. strain rates; determined from experiments. An example of the curve can be found in Figure 0-2. Furthermore, strain rates are stored in history variable #5. Strain rate scale factors are stored in history variable #6. To turn on the variables for viewing in LS-PrePost, set NEIPS to at least "6" in *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY. It is very useful to know what levels of strain rates, and strain rate scale factors in a particular simulation. Once d3plot files are opened in LS-PrePost, individual element time history can be plotted via menu option Post -> History, or a color contour of the entire part can be viewed with the menu option Post -> FriComp -> Misc.
定义应力比例因子随应变率变化的载荷曲线 ID，由试验确定。示例见图 0-2。应变率存储在历史变量 #5 中，应变率比例因子存储在历史变量 #6 中。要在 LS-PrePost 中查看这些变量，请在 *DATABASE_EXTENT_BINARY 中将 NEIPS 至少设为 6。打开 d3plot 后，可通过 Post → History 绘制单个单元的时间历程，或通过 Post → FriComp → Misc 查看整个部件的彩色云图。

This variable can be used to speed up the simulation while equalizing the strain rate effect, useful especially in cases where the pulling speed or punch speed is slow. For example, if the pulling speed is at 15 mm/s but running the simulation at this speed will take a long time, the pulling speed can be increased to 500 mm/s while SCALE can be set to 0.03, giving the same results as those from 15 mm/s, but with the benefit of greatly reduced computational time, see Figures 0-3 and 0-4. Note the increased absolute value (within a reasonable range) of mass scaling -1.0*dt2ms frequently used in forming simulation does not affect the strain rates, as shown in the Figure 0-5.
该变量可在均衡应变率效应的同时加快仿真，尤其适用于拉伸速度或冲头速度较慢的情况。例如拉伸速度为 15 mm/s 而仿真耗时很长时，可将速度提高到 500 mm/s，并将 SCALE 设为 0.03，获得与 15 mm/s 相同的结果，同时大幅减少计算时间（见图 0-3 和 0-4）。成形仿真中常用的质量缩放 -1.0×dt2ms 的绝对值在合理范围内增加不会影响应变率（见图 0-5）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION)
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。对于壳单元，材料轴随后绕壳表面法向旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心全局位置确定，该方向为 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系中前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。通过向量 v 与法向的叉积确定 a，通过法向与 a 的叉积确定 b，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在单元关键字输入中设置。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中定义局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，它们定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Load curve ID, table ID, or 3D table ID giving the plastic failure strain (or a scale factor for determining the plastic failure strain) in the 0° direction. The load curve gives plastic failure strain as a function of element size. The table defines a load curve ID for each triaxiality, giving the plastic failure strain as a function of element size for that triaxiality. If referring to a three-dimensional table ID, plastic failure strain can be a function of the Lode parameter (TABLE_3D), triaxiality (TABLE), and element size (CURVE).
载荷曲线 ID、表 ID 或三维表 ID，给出 0° 方向的失效塑性应变（或用于确定该应变的比例因子）。载荷曲线给出失效塑性应变随单元尺寸的变化。该表针对每个三轴度定义一个载荷曲线 ID，从而给出该三轴度下失效塑性应变随单元尺寸的变化。若引用三维表 ID，失效塑性应变还可以取决于 Lode 参数（TABLE_3D）、三轴度（TABLE）和单元尺寸（CURVE）。

Failure option:
EQ.0.0: Isotropic failure : In this case, LCF00, LCG00, LCH00 and LCI00 define failure in any direction and Cards 8, 9 and 10 are not defined.
EQ.1.0: Orthotropic failure with original formulation. The plastic strain rate tensor is expressed in the current material system(updated for material rotation).
EQ.2.0 : Orthotropic failure with alternative formulation. The plastic strain rate tensor is expressed in the initial material system(not updated for material rotation).
失效选项：
EQ.0.0：各向同性失效；LCF00、LCG00、LCH00 和 LCI00 定义任意方向失效，不定义卡片 8、9、10。
EQ.1.0：采用原始公式的正交各向异性失效，塑性应变率张量在当前材料坐标系中表示（随材料旋转更新）。
EQ.2.0：采用替代公式的正交各向异性失效，塑性应变率张量在初始材料坐标系中表示（不随材料旋转更新）。

Table ID. The curves in this table define compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain. The table specifies a load curve ID for each plastic strain rate value, giving the (isothermal) compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain for that rate in the 00-degree direction.

Table ID defining for each temperature value a load curve ID giving the (quasi-static) compressive yield stress versus strain for that temperature. The curves in this table define compressive yield stress as a function of plastic strain or effective plastic strain (see IFLAG).

Table ID. The table defines a load curve ID for each plastic strain rate value, giving the (isothermal) shear yield stress as a function of plastic strain for that rate in the 45-degree direction.
表 ID。该表针对每个塑性应变率值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，给出该应变率下（等温）剪切屈服应力随塑性应变的函数，方向为 45 度。

Table ID. The table defines a load curve ID for each temperature value, giving the (quasi-static) shear yield stress versus strain for that temperature. The load curves define shear yield stress as a function of plastic strain or effective plastic strain (see IFLAG) in the 45-degree direction.
表 ID。该表针对每个温度值定义一个载荷曲线 ID，给出该温度下（准静态）剪切屈服应力随应变的变化。载荷曲线定义 45° 方向的剪切屈服应力随塑性应变或等效塑性应变（见 IFLAG）的变化。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle.The angle may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword(see MANGLE).Note that the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying the angle depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是“材料方向”部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的点 P 与单元中心的全局位置确定；该方向为 a 方向。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面法向确定。实体单元平面是由连接关系前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内、外表面之间的中面。因此，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向的叉积确定，b 由法向与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向。随后 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。该角度可在单元关键字输入或本关键字的输入中设置（见 MANGLE）。材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择进行切换；根据 MACF 的值，切换可能发生在应用该角度之前或之后。
EQ.4.0：在柱坐标系中局部正交各向异性，材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定的中心线轴定义。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值是坐标系 ID 号（CID 位于 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION）。

Load curve ID or table ID
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined, EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.  The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function effective plastic strain for that rate; see Figure 0-1.  When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.  Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.  EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a table ID is defined.  Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.  Logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is assumed if the first value in the table is negative, in which case LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.  Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude. There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
Multi-Dimensional Tables.  Stress values can also depend on history variables (or external variables). The 3D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of one history variable (see HISVN) or one external variable. The 4D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of two history variable values (see HISVN) or two external variables

Load curve ID or table ID
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it is taken as defining stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined, EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.  The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress as a function effective plastic strain for that rate; see Figure 0-1.  When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.  Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value the stress as a function of effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.  EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a table ID is defined.  Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.  Logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is assumed if the first value in the table is negative, in which case LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.  Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude. There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
Multi-Dimensional Tables.  Stress values can also depend on history variables (or external variables). The 3D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of one history variable (see HISVN) or one external variable. The 4D table gives stress versus plastic strain as a function of strain rates as a function of two history variable values (see HISVN) or two external variables

Fiber dispersion parameter governs the extent to which the fiber dispersion extends to the third dimension. F = 0 and F = 1 apply to 2D splay with the normal to the membrane being in the beta and the gamma directions, respectively . F = 0.5 applies to 3D splay with transverse isotropy.
Splay will be orthotropic whenever F != 0.5. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.
纤维分散参数控制分散延伸到第三维的程度。F = 0 和 F = 1 分别对应 2D 扇出，膜法线分别沿 beta 和 gamma 方向；F = 0.5 对应具有横向各向同性的 3D 扇出。F 不等于 0.5 时扇出为正交各向异性。若 INIT = 1，则忽略此参数。

The parameter SIGMA governs the extent of dispersion, such that as SIGMA goes to zero, the material symmetry reduces to pure transverse isotropy. Conversely, as SIGMA becomes large, the material symmetry becomes isotropic in the plane. This parameter is ignored if INIT = 1.

Damping coefficient for tensor viscosity which acts in both tension and compression. Recommended values vary between 0.05 to 0.10. If zero, tensor viscosity is not used, but bulk viscosity is used instead. Bulk viscosity creates a pressure as the element compresses that is added to the normal stresses, which can have the effect of creating transverse deformations when none are expected.
用于拉伸与压缩状态的张量黏性的阻尼系数。推荐值在 0.05 至 0.10 之间。若该值为零，则不使用张量黏性，而是改用体黏性。体黏性会在单元受压时产生压力，并叠加到正应力上，从而可能在原本不会出现横向变形的情况下引发此类变形。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Damping coefficient for tensor viscosity which acts in both tension and compression. Recommended values vary between 0.05 to 0.10. If zero, tensor viscosity is not used, but bulk viscosity is used instead. Bulk viscosity creates a pressure as the element compresses that is added to the normal stresses, which can have the effect of creating transverse deformations when none are expected.
用于拉伸与压缩状态的张量黏性的阻尼系数。推荐值在 0.05 至 0.10 之间。若该值为零，则不使用张量黏性，而是改用体黏性。体黏性会在单元受压时产生压力，并叠加到正应力上，从而可能在原本不会出现横向变形的情况下引发此类变形。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Damping coefficient for tensor viscosity which acts in both tension and compression. Recommended values vary between 0.05 to 0.10. Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.

EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.

EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Load curve ID or Table ID. Load curve ID defining effective stress
versus effective plastic strain The table ID defines for each strain
rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic
strain for that rate, See Figure M24-1. The stress versus effective
plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used if the
strain rate falls below the minimum value. Likewise, the stress
versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain
rate is used if the strain rate exceeds the maximum value. NOTE:
The strain rate values defined in the table may be given as the
natural logarithm of the strain rate. If the first stress-strain curve in
the table corresponds to a negative strain rate, LS-DYNA assumes
that the natural logarithm of the strain rate value is used. Since the
tables are internally discretized to equally space the points, natural
logarithms are necessary, for example, if the curves correspond to
rates from 10.e-04 to 10.e+04.

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

Material axes option (see MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC, particularly the Material Directions section, for details):
EQ.0.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes 1, 2,and 4, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES.For shells only, the material axes are then rotated about the normal vector to the surface of the shell by the angle BETA.
EQ.1.0: Locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point, P, in spaceand the global location of the element center; this is the a - direction.This option is for solid elements only.
EQ.2.0: Globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR
EQ.3.0: Locally orthotropic material axes determined by a vector v and the normal vector to the plane of the element.The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively.Thus, for solid elements, AOPT = 3 is only available for hexahedrons.a is determined by taking the cross product of v with the normal vector, b is determined by taking the cross product of the normal vector with a,and c is the normal vector.Then aand b are rotated about c by an angle BETA.BETA may be set in the keyword input for the element or in the input for this keyword.Note that for solids, the material axes may be switched depending on the choice of MACF.The switch may occur before or after applying BETA depending on the value of MACF.
EQ.4.0: Locally orthotropic in a cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v,and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis.This option is for solid elements only.
LT.0.0: The absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number(CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION).
材料轴选项（详见 *MAT_OPTIONTROPIC_ELASTIC，尤其是材料方向部分）：
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由单元节点 1、2 和 4 确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES 相同。仅对壳单元：随后将材料轴绕壳表面的法向量旋转 BETA 角。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由空间中的点 P 和单元中心的全局位置确定，这定义了 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性；材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和单元平面的法向量确定。实体单元的平面是由单元连接关系的前四个节点和后四个节点定义的内表面与外表面之间的中面。因此，对于实体单元，AOPT = 3 仅适用于六面体。a 由 v 与法向量的叉积确定，b 由法向量与 a 的叉积确定，c 为法向量。然后将 a 和 b 绕 c 旋转 BETA 角。BETA 可在该单元的关键字输入或本关键字输入中设置。对于实体单元，材料轴可能根据 MACF 的选择发生切换；切换可在应用 BETA 之前或之后发生，取决于 MACF 的值。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性；材料轴由向量 v 和起始点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID 数字（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_OPTION 中的 CID）。

General expression which is evaluated, having the result stored in PRMRn. The standard rules regarding operator precedence are obeyed, and nested parentheses are allowed. The expression can reference previously defined parameters (with or without the leading &).  The expression can be continued on multiple lines simply by leaving the first 10 characters of the continuation line blank.

Attachment node set ID. This option should be used very cautiously and applies only to rigid bodies. This set must include all interacting nodes if the rigid body is in contact.

Shear correction factor which scales the transverse shear stress.  The shell formulations in LS-DYNA, with the exception of the BCIZ and DK elements, are based on a first order shear deformation theory that yields constant transverse shear strains which violates the condition of zero traction on the top and bottom surfaces of the shell.  The shear correction factor is attempt to compensate for this error.
用于缩放横向剪应力的剪切修正因子。LS-DYNA 的壳单元算法（BCIZ 和 DK 单元除外）基于一阶剪切变形理论；该理论得到恒定的横向剪应变，不满足壳单元上下表面零牵引力条件。剪切修正因子用于补偿这一误差。

Location of reference surface, available for thin shells only.  If nonzero, the offset distance from the plane of the nodal points to the reference surface of the shell in the direction of the shell normal vector is a value:
offset = -0.50xNLOCx(average  shell  thickness).
This offset is not considered in the contact subroutines unless CNTCO is set to 1 or 3 in *CONTROL_SHELL.Alternatively, the offset can be specified by using the OFFSET option in the *ELEMENT_SHELL input section.
EQ.1.0: Top surface,
EQ.0.0: Mid - surface(default),
EQ. - 1.0: Bottom surface.
仅适用于薄壳的参考面位置。非零时，节点平面到壳参考面沿壳法向的偏移为 offset = -0.50 × NLOC ×（平均壳厚度）。除非 *CONTROL_SHELL 中 CNTCO 设为 1 或 3，否则接触子程序不考虑此偏移。也可在 *ELEMENT_SHELL 输入段中使用 OFFSET 选项指定偏移。
EQ.1.0：顶面。
EQ.0.0：中面（默认）。
EQ.-1.0：底面。

静态摩擦系数。

Dynamic coefficient of friction.
动态摩擦系数。

指数衰减系数。

Viscous friction coefficient.
黏性摩擦系数。

Optional contact thickness. For SOFT = 2, it applies to solids, shells, and beams. For SOFT = 0 and 1 and Mortar contacts, it only applies to shells and beams.
However, for the MPP version only, OPTT does affect the contact behavior of solid elements for SOFT = 0 and 1 but not by changing the contact thickness.
In the case of MPP with SOFT = 0 and 1 for solids, OPTT overrides the thickness of the solid elements used for the calculation of the
contact penetration release (see the relevant table) but does not affect the contact thickness. This is not available in SMP.
OPTT does not affect the contact thickness when applied to the parts on the tracked side (SURFA) of an AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE contact.
However, it affects the contact thickness of this type of contact's reference side (SURFB).
可选接触厚度。SOFT=2 时适用于实体、壳和梁；SOFT=0、1 以及 Mortar 接触时仅适用于壳和梁。仅对 MPP 版本而言，OPTT 会影响 SOFT=0、1 的实体单元接触行为，但不是通过改变接触厚度实现。在 MPP 的实体 SOFT=0、1 情况下，OPTT 覆盖用于计算接触穿透释放的实体单元厚度（参见相关表），但不影响接触厚度；SMP 不支持此功能。将 OPTT 应用于 AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE 接触的跟踪侧（SURFA）部件时不影响接触厚度，但会影响该接触类型参考侧（SURFB）的接触厚度。

Scale factor on default tracked surface penalty stiffness for this part ID whenever it appears in the contact definition. If zero, SSF is taken as unity.
该部件 ID 出现在接触定义中时，默认跟踪表面罚刚度的比例因子。若为 0，则 SSF 取 1。

Flag to exclude beam-to-beam contact from the same PID for CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL. The global default may be set using CPARM8 on MPP1 of *CONTACT_?_MPP.
EQ.0: Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1: Flag is set.
EQ.2: Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 has the additional effect of permitting contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
对于 CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL，排除同一 PID 中梁—梁接触的标志。全局默认值可通过 *CONTACT_?_MPP 的 MPP1 上 CPARM8 设置。
EQ.0：未设置（默认）。
EQ.1：已设置。
EQ.2：已设置；CPARM8 = 2 还允许 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触处理点焊（类型 9）梁，否则该接触会完全忽略点焊梁。

Attachment node set ID. This option should be used very cautiously and applies only to rigid bodies. The attachment point nodes are updated each cycle whereas other nodes in the rigid body are updated only in the output databases. All loads seen by the rigid body must be applied through this nodal subset or directly to the center of gravity of the rigid body. This set must include all interacting nodes if the rigid body is in contact.
EQ.0: All nodal updates are skipped for this rigid body. The null option can be used if the rigid body is fixed in space or if the rigid body does not interact with other parts, e.g., the rigid body is only used for some visual purpose (default).
附件节点集 ID。必须谨慎使用，且仅适用于刚体。每个循环更新附件点节点，刚体中的其他节点仅在输出数据库中更新。刚体承受的所有载荷都必须通过此节点子集施加，或直接施加到刚体重心。刚体处于接触状态时，此集合必须包含所有相互作用节点。
EQ.0：跳过该刚体的所有节点更新。如果刚体固定在空间中或不与其他部件相互作用（例如仅用于可视化），可使用空选项（默认）。

Optional contact thickness. For SOFT = 2, it applies to solids, shells, and beams. For SOFT = 0 and 1 and Mortar contacts, it only applies to shells and beams.
However, for the MPP version only, OPTT does affect the contact behavior of solid elements for SOFT = 0 and 1 but not by changing the contact thickness.
In the case of MPP with SOFT = 0 and 1 for solids, OPTT overrides the thickness of the solid elements used for the calculation of the
contact penetration release (see the relevant table) but does not affect the contact thickness. This is not available in SMP.
OPTT does not affect the contact thickness when applied to the parts on the tracked side (SURFA) of an AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE contact.
However, it affects the contact thickness of this type of contact's reference side (SURFB).

Part initialization for gravity loading. This option initializes hydrostatic pressure in the part due to gravity acting on an overburden material. This option applies to brick elements only and must be used with the *LOAD_DENSITY_DEPTH option:
EQ.0: all parts initialized,
EQ.1: only current material initialized.
用于重力加载的部件初始化。该选项用于根据作用在覆盖层材料上的重力，为部件中的静水压力进行初始化。此选项仅适用于砖单元，且必须与 *LOAD_DENSITY_DEPTH 选项一起使用：
EQ.0：所有部件均进行初始化，
EQ.1：仅对当前材料进行初始化。

Indicate if this part is adapted. See also *CONTROL_ADAPTIVITY.
LT.0: R-adaptive remeshing for 2-D solids, |ADPOPT| gives the load curve ID that defines the element size as a function of time.
EQ.0:Adaptive remeshing is inactive for this part ID.
EQ.1: h - adaptivity for 3D shells and for shell / solid / shell sandwich composites.
EQ.2: r - adaptive remeshing for 2D solids, 3D tetrahedrons and 3D EFG.For a more detailed description of 3D r - adaptivity, see Volume IV of the Keyword Users Manual(Multiscale Solvers).

指示该部件是否进行自适应。另见 *CONTROL_ADAPTIVITY。
LT.0：二维实体的 R 自适应重新划分网格，|ADPOPT| 给出定义单元尺寸随时间变化的载荷曲线 ID。

Attachment node set ID. This option should be used very cautiously and applies only to rigid bodies. The attachment point nodes are updated each cycle whereas other nodes in the rigid body are updated only in the output databases. All loads seen by the rigid body must be applied through this nodal subset or directly to the center of gravity of the rigid body. This set must include all interacting nodes if the rigid body is in contact.
EQ.0: All nodal updates are skipped for this rigid body. The null option can be used if the rigid body is fixed in space or if the rigid body does not interact with other parts, e.g., the rigid body is only used for some visual purpose (default).
附件节点集 ID。必须谨慎使用，且仅适用于刚体。每个循环更新附件点节点，刚体中的其他节点仅在输出数据库中更新。刚体承受的所有载荷都必须通过此节点子集施加，或直接施加到刚体重心。刚体处于接触状态时，此集合必须包含所有相互作用节点。
EQ.0：跳过该刚体的所有节点更新。如果刚体固定在空间中或不与其他部件相互作用（例如仅用于可视化），可使用空选项（默认）。

In the case of MPP with SOFT = 0 and 1 for solids, OPTT overrides the thickness of the solid elements used for the calculation of the
contact penetration release (see the relevant table) but does not affect the contact thickness. This is not available in SMP.

EQ.2: r - adaptive remeshing for 2D solids, 3D tetrahedrons and 3D EFG.

EQ.0: The merged rigid body is repositioned (default),
EQ.1: The merged rigid body is not repositioned.

EQ.0：重新定位合并刚体（默认值），
EQ.1：不重新定位合并刚体。

静态摩擦系数。

Dynamic coefficient of friction.
动态摩擦系数。

Exponential decay coefficient.
指数衰减系数。

Viscous friction coefficient.
黏性摩擦系数。

Optional contact thickness. For SOFT = 2, it applies to solids, shells, and beams. For SOFT = 0 and 1 and Mortar contacts, it only applies to shells and beams.
However, for the MPP version only, OPTT does affect the contact behavior of solid elements for SOFT = 0 and 1 but not by changing the contact thickness.
In the case of MPP with SOFT = 0 and 1 for solids, OPTT overrides the thickness of the solid elements used for the calculation of the
contact penetration release (see the relevant table) but does not affect the contact thickness. This is not available in SMP.
OPTT does not affect the contact thickness when applied to the parts on the tracked side (SURFA) of an AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE contact.
However, it affects the contact thickness of this type of contact's reference side (SURFB).
可选接触厚度。SOFT=2 时适用于实体、壳和梁；SOFT=0、1 以及 Mortar 接触时仅适用于壳和梁。仅对 MPP 版本而言，OPTT 会影响 SOFT=0、1 的实体单元接触行为，但不是通过改变接触厚度实现。在 MPP 的实体 SOFT=0、1 情况下，OPTT 覆盖用于计算接触穿透释放的实体单元厚度（参见相关表），但不影响接触厚度；SMP 不支持此功能。将 OPTT 应用于 AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE 接触的跟踪侧（SURFA）部件时不影响接触厚度，但会影响该接触类型参考侧（SURFB）的接触厚度。

Optional thickness scale factor in automatic contact (scales the true thickness). This option applies only
to contact with shell elements.The true thickness is the element thickness of the shell elements.
自动接触中的可选厚度比例因子（缩放实际厚度）；仅适用于与壳单元接触。实际厚度为壳单元厚度。

Scale factor on default tracked surface penalty stiffness for this part ID whenever it appears in the contact definition. If zero, SSF is taken as unity.
该部件 ID 出现在接触定义中时，默认跟踪表面罚刚度的比例因子。若为 0，则 SSF 取 1。

Flag to exclude beam-to-beam contact from the same PID for CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL.  This applies only to MPP.  Global default may be set using CPARM8 on *CONTACT__MPP Optional Card.
EQ.0: Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1: Flag is set.
EQ.2: Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 has the additional effect of permitting contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
对于 CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL，排除同一 PID 中梁—梁接触的标志。仅适用于 MPP；全局默认值可通过 *CONTACT__MPP 可选卡片上的 CPARM8 设置。
EQ.0：未设置（默认）。
EQ.1：已设置。
EQ.2：已设置；CPARM8 = 2 还允许 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触处理点焊（类型 9）梁，否则该接触会完全忽略点焊梁。

Attachment node set ID. This option should be used very cautiously and applies only to rigid bodies. The attachment point nodes are updated each cycle whereas other nodes in the rigid body are updated only in the output databases. All loads seen by the rigid body must be applied through this nodal subset or directly to the center of gravity of the rigid body. This set must include all interacting nodes if the rigid body is in contact.
EQ.0: All nodal updates are skipped for this rigid body. The null option can be used if the rigid body is fixed in space or if the rigid body does not interact with other parts, e.g., the rigid body is only used for some visual purpose (default).
附件节点集 ID。必须谨慎使用，且仅适用于刚体。每个循环更新附件点节点，刚体中的其他节点仅在输出数据库中更新。刚体承受的所有载荷都必须通过此节点子集施加，或直接施加到刚体重心。刚体处于接触状态时，此集合必须包含所有相互作用节点。
EQ.0：跳过该刚体的所有节点更新。如果刚体固定在空间中或不与其他部件相互作用（例如仅用于可视化），可使用空选项（默认）。

EQ.1.0: no sliding after contact, 0.0 < FRIC < 1.0: Coulomb friction coefficient,
EQ.2.0: node is welded after contact with frictionless sliding. Welding occurs if and only if the normal value of the impact velocity exceeds the critical value specified by WVEL,
EQ.3.0: node is welded after contact with no sliding. Welding occurs if and only if the normal value of the impact velocity exceeds the critical value specified by WVEL.
界面摩擦：
EQ.0.0：接触后实现无摩擦滑动，
EQ.1.0：接触后不发生滑动，0.0 < FRIC < 1.0：库仑摩擦系数，
EQ.2.0：接触后节点发生焊接且伴随无摩擦滑动。仅当冲击速度的法向值超过 WVEL 规定的临界值时才会发生焊接，
EQ.3.0：接触后节点发生焊接且不发生滑动。仅当冲击速度的法向值超过 WVEL 规定的临界值时才会发生焊接。

Critical normal velocity at which nodes weld to wall (FRIC = 2.0 or 3.0).
节点与壁面发生粘接的临界法向速度（FRIC = 2.0 或 3.0）。

x-coordinate of head of edge vector l.
边向量 l 端点的 x 坐标。

y-coordinate of head of edge vector l.
边向量 l 端点的 y 坐标。

z-coordinate of head of edge vector l.
边向量 l 端点的 z 坐标。

Length of l edge.
EQ.0.0: defines an infinite size plane.
l 边的长度。
EQ.0.0：定义无限大的平面。

Length of m edge.
EQ.0.0: defines an infinite size plane.
m 边的长度。
EQ.0.0：定义无限大的平面。

Total mass of stonewall.
石墙的总质量。

Initial velocity of stonewall in direction of defining vector, n.
石墙沿定义向量 n 方向的初始速度。

Node set ID containing tracked nodes, see *SET_NODE_OPTION.
EQ.0: All nodes are tracked for interacting with the rigid wall.
包含跟踪节点的节点集 ID，详见 *SET_NODE_OPTION。
EQ.0：跟踪所有节点，以判断其与刚性墙是否发生相互作用。

Node set ID containing nodes that exempted as tracked nodes, see *SET_NODE_OPTION.
包含不作为追踪节点处理的节点的节点集 ID；参见 *SET_NODE_OPTION。

All nodes in box are included as tracked nodes for the interacting with ther rigid wall, see *DEFINE_BOX. If options NSID or NSIDEX are active then only the subset of nodes activated by these options are checked to see if they are within the box.
盒体内所有节点均作为与刚性墙相互作用的跟踪节点，参见 *DEFINE_BOX。若启用 NSID 或 NSIDEX，则仅检查这些选项激活的节点子集是否位于盒体内。

All nodes within a normal offset distance, OFFSET, to the rigid wall are included as tracked nodes for the rigid wall. If options NSID, NSIDEX, or BOXID are active then only the subset of nodes activated by these options are checked to see if they are within the offset distance.
距离刚性墙法向偏移距离 OFFSET 范围内的所有节点，都会被作为该刚性墙的追踪节点。如果启用了 NSID、NSIDEX 或 BOXID 选项，则仅会检查这些选项所激活的节点子集，以判断其是否处于偏移距离范围内。

Birth time of rigid wall.  The time values of the load curves that control the motion of the wall are offset by the birth time.
刚性墙的激活时间。控制墙体运动的载荷曲线时间值以该激活时间为偏移量。

Death time of rigid wall.  At this time the wall is deleted from the calculation
刚性墙的终止时间。达到该时间后，该墙将从计算中删除。

Stiffness scaling factor. If RWKSF is also specified in *CONTROL_ CONTACT, the stiffness is scaled by the product of the two values.
刚度比例因子。若在 *CONTROL_CONTACT 中也指定 RWKSF，则刚度按两个数值的乘积缩放。

x-coordinate of tail of any outward drawn normal vector, n, originating on wall (tail) and terminating in space (head).
任一向外法向量 n 的尾点 x 坐标。该向量从壁面（尾点）指向空间（头点）。

y-coordinate of tail of normal vector n.
法向量 n 尾部的 y 坐标。

x-coordinate of head of normal vector n

y-coordinate of head of normal vector n.
法向量 n 的头部在 y 轴上的坐标。

z-coordinate of head of normal vector n.
法向量 n 端点的 z 坐标。

Name of an input file that contains the mesh information (nodal coordinates, element connectivity) of the RVE model.
Note that this keyword variable should be of the format "XXX.k", where file name extension ".k" is included.
The finite element mesh given in this file is used for the spatial discretization of the material microstructures,
and it does not involve any special 'control nodes' or 'control elements'
包含 RVE 模型网格信息（节点坐标、单元连接关系）的输入文件名称。
请注意，该关键字变量的格式应为“XXX.k”，其中必须包含“.k”作为文件扩展名。
该文件中的有限元网格用于材料微观结构的空间离散化，且不涉及任何特殊的“控制节点”或“控制单元”。

Type of input:
EQ.0: RVE boundary conditions are fully defined by two factors: (1) the parameter BC of this input card,and (2) the mesh information in the file specified in MESHFILE.When running an RVE simulation, the solver automatically creates a file named rve_[basename].k.This file contains all the necessary information(e.g., dummy nodes, displacement constraints, etc.) for boundary condition enforcement.
EQ.1: You provide a file named rve_[basename].k to specify the boundary condition keywords(e.g. *CONSTRAINED_MULTIPLE_GLOBAL, *BOUNDARY_SPC_NODE, etc.) and dummy nodes for enforcing RVE boundary conditions.We do not recommend this option since it is usually nontrivial to manually define all the keywords for RVE boundary conditions.If the file rve_[basename].k is not found when running RVE simulations, then the solver creates rve_[basename].k based on the parameter BC and the mesh information in the file specified with MESHFILE.
输入类型：
EQ.0：RVE 边界条件完全由两个因素定义：(1) 此输入卡片的参数 BC；(2) MESHFILE 指定文件中的网格信息。运行 RVE 仿真时，求解器会自动创建名为 rve_[basename].k 的文件。该文件包含施加边界条件所需的全部信息（例如虚拟节点、位移约束等）。
EQ.1：由用户提供名为 rve_[basename].k 的文件，用于指定边界条件关键字（例如 *CONSTRAINED_MULTIPLE_GLOBAL、*BOUNDARY_SPC_NODE 等）和用于施加 RVE 边界条件的虚拟节点。不建议使用此选项，因为手动定义 RVE 边界条件所需的全部关键字通常并不简单。如果运行 RVE 仿真时找不到 rve_[basename].k 文件，则求解器会根据参数 BC 以及 MESHFILE 指定文件中的网格信息创建 rve_[basename].k。

Type of output:
EQ.1: RVE homogenization results will be written out to a file named rveout.Please refer to the keyword *DATABASE_RVE.
输出类型：
EQ.1：RVE 均质化结果将写入名为 rveout 的文件。请参见关键字 *DATABASE_RVE。

Type of the given RVE mesh (ignored unless BC = 0 or 2);:
EQ. 0: The mesh is non-matching for PDBC.
EQ. 1: The mesh is PDBC-matching. This variable is effective only when the user chooses to impose PDBC by setting BC=0.
When the mesh is PDBC-matching, the nodal distributions on the RVEs opposite sides match well with each other.
For instance, let us consider two opposite surfaces (surface A, and surface B) that are both perpendicular to the X-axis,
for any FEM node on surface A, if we draw a straight line that is parallel to the X-axis, then the intersection
point of this line with surface B must also be an FEM node. For such PDBC-matching meshes, an efficient
direct nearest neighbor search algorithm can be used for the PDBC imposition, so a PDBC-matching mesh is preferred if
users would like to impose the periodic displacement boundary condition for RVE analysis. However, it is not always straightforward
to create PDBC-matching meshes for RVE models if very complex material micro-structures exist. In this case,
IMATCH=0 can be chosen to impose PDBC on a non-matching mesh by employing a projection-based constraint imposition method.
给定 RVE 网格的类型（除非 BC=0 或 2，否则忽略）：

Starting time for the fully implicit ISPG iterations. Before TSTART, only 10 ISPG iterations are done in each thermal-structural implicit step with one-way coupling (no forces from the fluid are returned to the structure) to guarantee that the fluid moves with the solid boundaries. After TSTART, the ISPG algorithm performs full iterations in the two-way coupled thermal-structural implicit analysis. This option is very useful for cases where the structural simulation time is very long (e.g., in seconds or minutes) while the reflow process to a steady state is very short. With this option, the full ISPG iterations start from TSTART, saving e some computational resources.
全隐式 ISPG 迭代的开始时间。在 TSTART 之前，每个热—结构隐式步仅执行 10 次 ISPG 迭代，并采用单向耦合（不将流体力返回结构），以保证流体随固体边界移动。TSTART 之后，ISPG 算法在双向耦合的热—结构隐式分析中执行完整迭代。对于结构仿真时间很长（例如数秒或数分钟）而回流过程达到稳态很短的情况，此选项非常有用；完整 ISPG 迭代从 TSTART 开始，可节省计算资源。

Reset the implicit structural time step size to DT_IMP after TSTART. Because the solder reflow process is very fast, a small implicit structural time step size is needed. Generally, the value of DT_IMP should be around 10~50 times of ISPG time step size to guarantee convergence of the solution if the gravity-driven simulation is deployed.This field is optional
TSTART 之后将隐式结构时间步长重置为 DT_IMP。由于焊料回流过程非常快，需要较小的隐式结构时间步长。通常，如果采用重力驱动仿真，DT_IMP 应约为 ISPG 时间步长的 10~50 倍，以保证解收敛。此字段为可选。

Define the z coordinate of the cutting plane for evaluating the reaction forces between all the solders and the structure. If RCFORCH is nonzero, two files are generated in the working folders: fpdcpl_u.txt and fpdcpl_l.txt. The first file contains the reaction force history of the solders that are above the cutting plane, while the second file contains the reaction force history of those below the cutting plane.
定义切割平面的 z 坐标，用于计算所有焊料与结构之间的反力。如果 RCFORCH 非零，则在工作文件夹中生成两个文件：fpdcpl_u.txt 和 fpdcpl_l.txt。第一个文件包含位于切割平面上方焊料的反力历史，第二个文件包含位于切割平面下方焊料的反力历史。

The time step size scaling factor for ISPG iteration. We recommend a value between 0.1~0.5. Large DTSCL may cause contact detection issues.
ISPG 迭代的时间步长比例因子。建议取值在 0.1 至 0.5 之间。过大的 DTSCL 值可能会导致接触检测问题。

Treatment of through thickness strain (see Remark 7).
LT.0: Same as IDOF = 3 but the contact pressure is averaged over a time - IDOF in order to reduce noise and thus improve stability.
EQ.1: The thickness field is continous across the element edges for metalforming applications. This is the default.
EQ.2: The thickness field is discontinous across the element edges. This is necessary for crashworthiness applications due to shell intersections, sharp included angles, and non-smooth deformations.This option applies to element types 25, 26 and 27. This is the default for these element types.
EQ.3:The thickness strain is governed by the stress from contact and pressure loads, meaning that the strain is adjusted for the through thickness stress to equilibrate the contact and load pressure. Please note that it is assumed that the pressure is positive, i.e., acting towards the shell surface. Thus, vacuum loads cannot be used with this option.
