Treatment of through thickness strain (see Remark 7).
LT.0: Same as IDOF = 3 but the contact pressure is averaged over a time - IDOF in order to reduce noise and thus improve stability.
EQ.1: The thickness field is continous across the element edges for metalforming applications. This is the default.

Applies to cohesive solid elements -19,20, -21 and 22. COHOFF specifies the relative location of the cohesive layer. It must be a number between -1 and 1. A value of -1 will place it on the bottom face of the cohesive element, while a value of +1 will place it on the top face. This parameter is preferably used when the cohesive element connects shells with different thicknesses. In this case, the cohesive layer should not be located exactly between the bottom and top layer, which is the default location (COHOFF = 0).
适用于黏聚实体单元 -19、20、-21 和 22。COHOFF 指定黏聚层相对位置，范围 -1 至 1；-1 位于底面，+1 位于顶面。该参数适合连接不同厚度壳的黏聚单元，此时黏聚层不应恰好位于底层和顶层中间（默认位置 COHOFF = 0）。

Applies to cohesive solid elements -19,20, -21 and 22. COHOFF specifies the relative location of the cohesive layer. It must be a number between -1 and 1. A value of -1 will place it on the bottom face of the cohesive element, while a value of +1 will place it on the top face. This parameter is preferably used when the cohesive element connects shells with different thicknesses. In this case, the cohesive layer should not be located exactly between the bottom and top layer, which is the default location (COHOFF = 0).
适用于黏聚实体单元 -19、20、-21 和 22。COHOFF 指定黏聚层相对位置，范围 -1 至 1；-1 位于底面，+1 位于顶面。该参数适合连接不同厚度壳的黏聚单元，此时黏聚层不应恰好位于底层和顶层中间（默认位置 COHOFF = 0）。

Gasket thickness for converting ELFORM 19, 20, 21 and 22 to gasket elements and use with *MAT_COHESIVE_GASKET
将 ELFORM 19、20、21 和 22 转换为垫片单元时的垫片厚度，用于配合 *MAT_COHESIVE_GASKET。

Normalized dilation parameters of the kernel function in X, Y and Z directions. The normalized dilation parameters of the kernel function are introduced to provide the smoothness and compact support properties on the construction of the mesh-free shape functions. Values between 1.0 and 1.5 are recommended. Values smaller than 1.0 are not allowed. Larger values will increase the computation time and sometimes result in a divergence problem.
核函数在 X、Y、Z 方向的归一化膨胀参数。引入这些参数是为了在构造无网格形函数时提供光滑性和紧支撑特性。建议取 1.0–1.5。小于 1.0 的值不允许；更大的值会增加计算时间，有时导致发散。

EQ.XY:    xy-shear component for shells, thick shells, and solids
EQ.YY:    y-normal component for shells, thick shells, and solids

Entity to be traced:
EQ.ANGLE: Angle between two lines. The fields I1 and I2 are node numbers defining the 1st line, while I3 and I4 are node numbers defining the 2nd line.
EQ.BNDOUT: Boundary condition energy as reported in file bndout I1 is the ID as defined in *BOUNDARY_RESCRIBED_MOTION
EQ.CURVE: The value of a time-dependent curve defined by *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION or *DEFINE_CURVE. I1 is the curve ID.
EQ.CVBAG: Information reported in ABSTAT for control volume airbag I1, including
I0.EQ.TEMP: airbag temperature
I0.EQ.VOL: airbag volume
EQ.EMROGO: Information about Rogowsky coil I1 (see *EM_CIRCUIT_ROGO), including:
I0.EQ.CRNT: Current
I0.EQ.CRNTRTE: Current rate
I0.EQ.FX: Electromotive force along x
I0.EQ.FY: Electromotive force along y
I0.EQ.FZ: Electromotive force along z
EQ.ICVOL: Information reported in ICVOUT for incompressible control volume I1, see *DEFINE_CONTROL_VOLUME, including
I0.EQ.PRES: Temperature of control volume
I0.EQ.VOL: Volume of control volume
EQ.JNTSTG:    Information reported in JNTFORC for general stiffness joint I1, see CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED, including
I0.EQ.PHI:    rotation φ in degree
I0.EQ.PHIR:    rate of rotation φ
I0.EQ.THETA:    rotation θ in degree
I0.EQ.THETAR:    rate of rotation θ
I0.EQ.IPSI:    rotation ψ in degree.
I0.EQ.PSIR:    rate of rotation ψ
EQ.MATSUM: Information reported in MATSUM for part set I1, including:
I0.EQ.ADDMASS: Added mass
I0.EQ.ERODEIE: Eroded internal energy
I0.EQ.ERODEKE: Eroded kinetic energy
I0.EQ.HOURGLASS:    Hourglass energy
I0.EQ.INTERNAL: Internal energy
I0.EQ.KINETIC: Kinetic energy
EQ.NFAILE: Number of failed elements of type I0 in set I1. I0, element type, can be  SOLID
for solid elements,  SHELL  for thin shell elements,  TSHELL  for thick shell elements,
BEAM  for beam elements or  DISC  for discrete elements. I1 is the related element set
number. If undefined, the failure of all elements of type I0 will be traced
EQ.PULLEY:    Information about beam pulley I1, including:
I0.EQ.SLIP:    Slippage
I0.EQ.WRAP : Wrap angle
I0.EQ.FN : Normal contact force
I0.EQ.FBM1 : Force in the  element on side 1
I0.EQ.FBM2 : Force in the element on side 2
EQ.RETRACTOR: Information about seat belt retractor I1, including:
I0.EQ.PULLRATE: Pull - out rate, default
I0.EQ.PULLOUT: Total pull-out
I0.EQ.FORCE: Force of the attached belt.
EQ.RIGIDBODY: Kinematics of a rigid body with id I1. The I2 field specifies which kinematical component to be traced.
It may be set to TX, TY, or TZ for X, Y, and Z translations and to RX, RY, or RZ
for the X, Y, and Z components of the rotation. The I3 field specifies the kinematics type: D
for displacement, V for velocity and A for acceleration. Output is calculated with respect
to the global coordinate system when the I4 field is set to  0 , its default value; the local
rigid-body coordinate system is used when I4 is set to  1 .
EQ.SLIPRING: Information about seat belt:
I0.EQ.SLIP: Slippage.
I0.EQ.WRAP: Wrap angle,theta.
I0.EQ.SKEW: Skew angle, alpha.
I0.EQ.FC: Friction coefficient.
I0.EQ.FN: Normal contact force.
I0.EQ.FSB1: Force of element on side 1.
I0.EQ.FSB2: Force of element on side 2.
EQ.TIME: Current analysis time.
跟踪的实体：
EQ.ANGLE：两条线之间的角度。I1 和 I2 是定义第一条线的节点编号，I3 和 I4 是定义第二条线的节点编号。
EQ.BNDOUT：bndout 文件中报告的边界条件能量。I1 是 *BOUNDARY_RESCRIBED_MOTION 中定义的 ID。
EQ.CURVE：由 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION 或 *DEFINE_CURVE 定义的时间相关曲线的值。I1 为曲线 ID。

EQ.BNDOUT：bndout 文件中报告的边界条件能量。I1 是 *BOUNDARY_RESCRIBED_MOTION 中定义的 ID。
EQ.CURVE：由 *DEFINE_CURVE_FUNCTION 或 *DEFINE_CURVE 定义的时间相关曲线的值。I1 为曲线 ID。
EQ.CVBAG：控制体积气囊 I1 在 ABSTAT 中报告的信息，包括：
I0.EQ.TEMP：气囊温度
I0.EQ.VOL：气囊体积
EQ.EMROGO：Rogowsky 线圈 I1 的信息（参见 *EM_CIRCUIT_ROGO），包括：
I0.EQ.CRNT：电流
I0.EQ.CRNTRTE：电流变化率
I0.EQ.FX：沿 x 的电动势
I0.EQ.FY：沿 y 的电动势
I0.EQ.FZ：沿 z 的电动势
EQ.ICVOL：不可压缩控制体积 I1 在 ICVOUT 中报告的信息，参见 *DEFINE_CONTROL_VOLUME，包括：
I0.EQ.PRES：控制体积的温度
I0.EQ.VOL：控制体积的体积
EQ.JNTSTG：通用刚度接头 I1 在 JNTFORC 中报告的信息，参见 CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED，包括：
I0.EQ.PHI：角度 φ（单位：度）
I0.EQ.PHIR：角度 φ 的变化率
I0.EQ.THETA：角度 θ（单位：度）
I0.EQ.THETAR：角度 θ 的变化率
I0.EQ.IPSI：角度 ψ（单位：度）。
I0.EQ.PSIR：角度 ψ 的变化率
EQ.MATSUM：MATSUM 中报告的部件集 I1 信息，包括：
I0.EQ.ADDMASS：附加质量
I0.EQ.ERODEIE：侵蚀内能
I0.EQ.ERODEKE：侵蚀动能
I0.EQ.HOURGLASS：沙漏能
I0.EQ.INTERNAL：内能
I0.EQ.KINETIC：动能
EQ.NFAILE：集合 I1 中类型 I0 的失效单元数量。I0（单元类型）可以是 SOLID（实体单元）、SHELL（薄壳单元）、TSHELL（厚壳单元）、BEAM（梁单元）或 DISC（离散单元）。I1 是相关单元集编号。如果未定义，则跟踪所有类型为 I0 的单元失效。
EQ.PULLEY：梁滑轮 I1 的信息，包括：
I0.EQ.SLIP：滑移
I0.EQ.WRAP：包角
I0.EQ.FN：法向接触力
I0.EQ.FBM1：侧 1 单元中的力
I0.EQ.FBM2：侧 2 单元中的力
EQ.RETRACTOR：安全带卷收器 I1 的信息，包括：
I0.EQ.PULLRATE：拉出速率，默认值
I0.EQ.PULLOUT：总拉出量
I0.EQ.FORCE：连接安全带的力。
EQ.RIGIDBODY：ID 为 I1 的刚体运动学。I2 字段指定要跟踪的运动学分量。
它可设为 TX、TY 或 TZ，表示 X、Y、Z 平移，也可设为 RX、RY 或 RZ，表示绕 X、Y、Z 的转动分量。I3 指定运动学类型：D 表示位移，V 表示速度，A 表示加速度。当 I4 设为 0（默认值）时，输出相对于全局坐标系计算；当 I4 设为 1 时，使用刚体局部坐标系。
EQ.SLIPRING：安全带信息：
I0.EQ.SLIP：滑移。
I0.EQ.WRAP：包角 theta。
I0.EQ.SKEW：偏斜角 alpha。
I0.EQ.FC：摩擦系数。
I0.EQ.FN：法向接触力。
I0.EQ.FSB1：侧 1 单元中的力。
I0.EQ.FSB2：侧 2 单元中的力。
EQ.TIME：当前分析时间。

Sensor ID.
传感器 ID。

For an accelerometer sensor, these fields are the nodes defining the accelerometer.  If CTYPE = TEMP, then the temperature at NODE1 will be output. If both NODE1 and NODE2 are defined, then the difference in temperature between these two nodes will be output.
When the keyword option SET is active, NODE1 is a node set ID.If NODE2 is needed, it must be a node set of the same length as NODE1 with SETOPT defined, but it can be either a node or node set without SETOPT defined.
When the SET option is active but SETOPT is not defined, determining the status of a related *SENSOR_SWITCH depends on the sign of NODE1.See Remark 2 for details
对于加速度计传感器，这些字段定义加速度计所用节点。若 CTYPE = TEMP，则输出 NODE1 处的温度；若同时定义 NODE1 和 NODE2，则输出两节点的温差。当 SET 关键字选项激活时，NODE1 是节点集 ID。若需要 NODE2，定义 SETOPT 时它必须是与 NODE1 长度相同的节点集；未定义 SETOPT 时，它可以是节点或节点集。当 SET 激活但未定义 SETOPT 时，相关 *SENSOR_SWITCH 的状态取决于 NODE1 的符号。详情见备注 2。

OPTION.EQ.ALL: All discrete elements will be included in the set.See Remark 1.
OPTION..EQ.ELEM: Discrete elements E1...E7 will be included. See Remark 1.

OPTION.EQ.PART: Discrete elements from parts E1...E7 will be included in the current set.See Remark 1.
OPTION.EQ.DPART: Discrete elements from parts E1...E7 previously added will be excluded from the current set.See Remark 1.
OPTION.EQ.BOX:Elements inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included. See *DEFINE_BOX. See Remark 1.
OPTION.EQ.DBOX:Previously added elements that are inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.See Remark 1.
OPTION.EQ.SET:Elements of discrete element sets E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.See Remark 1.

EQ.ALL: All nodes will be included in the set.
EQ.BRANCH: Nodes inside tree branches E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  (see *SET_PART_TREE)
EQ.DBRANCH: Previously added nodes that are inside tree branches E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.BOX: Nodes inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  (see *DEFINE_BOX)
EQ.DBOX: Previously added nodes that are inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.NODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.
EQ.DNODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3, ... if previously added will be excluded.
EQ.PART: Nodes of parts E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.
EQ.DPART: Nodes that have been previously added and are of parts E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh. To include all nodes in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank. This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SET_NODE: Nodes from node sets with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be included.
EQ.DSET_NODE: Nodes that have been previously added and are from node sets with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
EQ.SET_XXXX: Include nodal points of element sets defined by *SET_XXXX, where XXXX could be SHELL, SOLID, BEAM, TSHELL, or DISCRETE.
EQ.SET_PART: Include nodal points in part sets E1, ..., E7.
EQ.VOL: Nodes inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  See *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
EQ.DVOL: Previously added nodes that are inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.ALL：所有节点都将包含在集合中。
EQ.BRANCH：树分支 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中（参见 *SET_PART_TREE）。
EQ.DBRANCH：之前添加且位于树分支 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。
EQ.BOX：框 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中（参见 *DEFINE_BOX）。
EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。
EQ.NODE：节点 E1、E2、E3、… 将包含在集合中。
EQ.DNODE：如果节点 E1、E2、E3、… 之前已添加，则将其排除。
EQ.PART：部件 E1、E2、E3、… 的节点将包含在集合中。
EQ.DPART：之前添加且属于部件 E1、E2、E3、… 的节点将被排除。
EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX。它们是 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。若要包含 E1 定义的 S-ALE 网格中的所有节点，将 E2–E7 设为零或留空。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的节点。E1 给出 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -x、+x、-y、+y、-z、+z 面。例如，将这六个值设为 1，会把属于这些面上所有表面段的节点包含在节点集中。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某个段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段。因此，该集合包含属于外部和内部边界的表面段节点。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6 和 E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN 和 ZMAX。它们是 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向节点局部坐标的最小值和最大值。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SET_NODE：将包含来自节点集 E1、…、E7（其 ID 为 E1、…、E7）的节点。
EQ.DSET_NODE：将排除之前添加且来自节点集 E1、…、E7 的节点。
EQ.SET_XXXX：包含由 *SET_XXXX 定义的单元集的节点，其中 XXXX 可以是 SHELL、SOLID、BEAM、TSHELL 或 DISCRETE。
EQ.SET_PART：包含部件集 E1、…、E7 中的节点。
EQ.VOL：接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中。参见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
EQ.DVOL：之前添加且位于接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。

EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

EQ.ALL: All nodes will be included in the set.
EQ.BRANCH: Nodes inside tree branches E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  (see *SET_PART_TREE)

EQ.PART: Nodes of parts E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.

EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX。它们是 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。

EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6 和 E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN 和 ZMAX。它们是 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向节点局部坐标的最小值和最大值。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。

EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

EQ.ALL: All nodes will be included in the set.
EQ.BRANCH: Nodes inside tree branches E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  (see *SET_PART_TREE)
EQ.DBRANCH: Previously added nodes that are inside tree branches E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.BOX: Nodes inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  (see *DEFINE_BOX)
EQ.DBOX: Previously added nodes that are inside boxes E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.NODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.
EQ.DNODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3, ... if previously added will be excluded.
EQ.PART: Nodes of parts E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.
EQ.DPART: Nodes that have been previously added and are of parts E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
EQ.SET_NODE: Nodes from node sets with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be included.
EQ.DSET_NODE: Nodes that have been previously added and are from node sets with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
EQ.SET_XXXX: Include nodal points of element sets defined by *SET_XXXX, where XXXX could be SHELL, SOLID, BEAM, TSHELL, or DISCRETE.
EQ.SET_PART: Include nodal points in part sets E1, ..., E7.
EQ.VOL: Nodes inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3, ... will be included.  See *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
EQ.DVOL: Previously added nodes that are inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
EQ.ALL：所有节点都将包含在集合中。
EQ.BRANCH：树分支 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中（参见 *SET_PART_TREE）。
EQ.DBRANCH：之前添加且位于树分支 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。
EQ.BOX：框 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中（参见 *DEFINE_BOX）。
EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。
EQ.NODE：节点 E1、E2、E3、… 将包含在集合中。
EQ.DNODE：如果节点 E1、E2、E3、… 之前已添加，则将其排除。
EQ.PART：部件 E1、E2、E3、… 的节点将包含在集合中。
EQ.DPART：之前添加且属于部件 E1、E2、E3、… 的节点将被排除。
EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX。它们是 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的节点。E1 给出 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -x、+x、-y、+y、-z、+z 面。例如，将这六个值设为 1，会把属于这些面上所有表面段的节点包含在节点集中。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某个段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段。因此，该集合包含属于外部和内部边界的表面段节点。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格中框内的节点。E1 是 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）。E2、E3、E4、E5、E6 和 E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN 和 ZMAX。它们是 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向节点局部坐标的最小值和最大值。此选项仅适用于 S-ALE 网格。可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC 和 SALEBOXL 一起使用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项一起使用。详见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SET_NODE：将包含来自节点集 E1、…、E7 的节点。
EQ.DSET_NODE：将排除之前添加且来自节点集 E1、…、E7 的节点。
EQ.SET_XXXX：包含由 *SET_XXXX 定义的单元集的节点，其中 XXXX 可以是 SHELL、SOLID、BEAM、TSHELL 或 DISCRETE。
EQ.SET_PART：包含部件集 E1、…、E7 中的节点。
EQ.VOL：接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将包含在集合中。参见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
EQ.DVOL：之前添加且位于接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的节点将被排除。

Flag to activate an element coordinate system:
EQ.0:The forces are applied in the global directions.
EQ.1:The forces are applied in a local system attached to the element. The system is consistent with DIREC=1 and CTYPE=12 in *CONSTRAINED_LAGRANGE_IN_SOLID.
For CTYPE=11, LOCAL is always 1 and the -axis is aligned with the element normal while the -axis passes through the element center and the first node in the element connectivity
(*ELEMENT_BEAM in 2D or *ELEMENT_SHELL in 3D)
激活单元坐标系的标志：
EQ.0：力沿全局方向施加。
EQ.1：力沿附着于单元的局部坐标系施加。该坐标系与 *CONSTRAINED_LAGRANGE_IN_SOLID 中 DIREC=1、CTYPE=12 一致。
对于 CTYPE=11，LOCAL 始终为 1；一条轴与单元法向对齐，另一条轴穿过单元中心和单元连接中的第一个节点（2D 中 *ELEMENT_BEAM，3D 中 *ELEMENT_SHELL）。

*DEFINE_VECTOR IDs to define a specific coordinate system. VECID1 and VECID2 give the x- and y-direction respectively.
The z-vector is a cross product of VECID1 and VECID2. If this latter is not
orthogonal to VECID1, its direction will be corrected with a cross- product of z- and x-vectors. The vectors are stored as isoparametric.
使用 *DEFINE_VECTOR ID 定义特定坐标系。VECID1 和 VECID2 分别给出 x 和 y 方向。
z 向量是 VECID1 与 VECID2 的叉积。如果后者不与 VECID1 正交，则使用 z 向量与 x 向量的叉积修正其方向。向量按等参数形式存储。

ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be excluded.
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application.
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for single surface contact of solid elements to prevent negative volumes.
PSLDFi: Generate segments from the ith face of solid parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for face definition.
SALEBOXL Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX, respectively.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.To include all segments in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank.  This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SEG : Create a segment with node IDs E1, E2, E3, and E4.
SET : Segments of segment sets(*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be included.
SET_SHELL : Generate segments from shell elements in shell sets created with* SET_SHELL_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SLDIO : Generate segments for solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SET_SLDFi : Generate segments from the ith face of solid elements in the solid element sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.See Table 0 - 1 below for face definitions.
SET_TSHELL : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Only exterior segments are generated.
SET_TSHIO : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SHELL : Generate segments for shell elements with IDs of E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.
VOL : Generate segments inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX option for other details.See* DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
VOL_SHELL : Generate segments from shells inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7
VOL_SLDIO : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SLDIO for other details.
VOL_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SOLID for other details.
所有外部段将包含在集合中。
BOX：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的框内生成属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。对于壳单元，每个壳生成一个段；对于实体单元，仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。
BOX_SHELL：同上，但仅对壳单元生成，每个壳生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：同上，同时生成外部段和单元间段。
BOX_SOLID：同上，但仅生成外部实体单元的段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：同 BRANCH，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时可用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
DBOX：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的壳相关段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的实体相关段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的部件中的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除属于 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）的段。
DVOL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的壳相关段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的实体相关段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。定义牵引载荷的二维段时，PART 也可指梁部件。
PART_IO：同 PART，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部段，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有表面段包含在段集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面段。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：使用节点 ID E1、E2、E3、E4 创建段。
SET：包含段集（*SET_SEGMENT）ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段。
SET_SHELL：从使用 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建的壳集中的壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体集中的实体单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从实体集中的实体单元生成段，同时生成外部和内部段；实体集由 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建，ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDFi：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体单元集中的第 i 个面生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；面定义参见下表 0-1。

SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX 选项和 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。

ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be excluded.
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application.
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for single surface contact of solid elements to prevent negative volumes.
PSLDFi: Generate segments from the ith face of solid parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for face definition.
SALEBOXL Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX, respectively.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SEG : Create a segment with node IDs E1, E2, E3, and E4.
SET : Segments of segment sets(*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be included.
SET_SHELL : Generate segments from shell elements in shell sets created with* SET_SHELL_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.

SET_SLDFi : Generate segments from the ith face of solid elements in the solid element sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.See Table 0 - 1 below for face definitions.
SET_TSHELL : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Only exterior segments are generated.
SET_TSHIO : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SHELL : Generate segments for shell elements with IDs of E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.
VOL : Generate segments inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX option for other details.See* DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.

VOL_SLDIO : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SLDIO for other details.
VOL_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SOLID for other details.

SET：包含段集（*SET_SEGMENT）ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段。

VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。

ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be excluded.
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application.
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for single surface contact of solid elements to prevent negative volumes.
PSLDFi: Generate segments from the ith face of solid parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for face definition.
SALEBOXL Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX, respectively.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.To include all segments in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank.  This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

BOX_SHELL：同上，但仅对壳单元生成，每个壳生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：同上，同时生成外部段和单元间段。

DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除属于 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）的段。
DVOL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的段。

ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be excluded.
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application.
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for single surface contact of solid elements to prevent negative volumes.
PSLDFi: Generate segments from the ith face of solid parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for face definition.
SALEBOXL Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX, respectively.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

VOL_SLDIO : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SLDIO for other details.

所有外部段将包含在集合中。
BOX：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的框内生成属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。对于壳单元，每个壳生成一个段；对于实体单元，仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。
BOX_SHELL：同上，但仅对壳单元生成，每个壳生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：同上，同时生成外部段和单元间段。
BOX_SOLID：同上，但仅生成外部实体单元的段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：同 BRANCH，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时可用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
DBOX：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的壳相关段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的实体相关段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的部件中的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除属于 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）的段。
DVOL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的壳相关段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的实体相关段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。定义牵引载荷的二维段时，PART 也可指梁部件。
PART_IO：同 PART，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有表面段包含在段集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面段。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：使用节点 ID E1、E2、E3、E4 创建段。
SET：包含段集（*SET_SEGMENT）ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段。
SET_SHELL：从使用 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建的壳集中的壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体集中的实体单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从实体集中的实体单元生成段，同时生成外部和内部段；实体集由 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建，ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDFi：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体单元集中的第 i 个面生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SET_TSHELL：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；仅生成外部段。
SET_TSHIO：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；同时生成外部和内部段。
SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX 选项和 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。

SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.To include all segments in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank.  This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.

所有外部段将包含在集合中。
BOX：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的框内生成属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。对于壳单元，每个壳生成一个段；对于实体单元，仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。
BOX_SHELL：同上，但仅对壳单元生成，每个壳生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：同上，同时生成外部段和单元间段。
BOX_SOLID：同上，但仅生成外部实体单元的段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：同 BRANCH，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时可用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
DBOX：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的壳相关段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的实体相关段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的部件中的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除属于 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）的段。
DVOL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的壳相关段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的实体相关段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。定义牵引载荷的二维段时，PART 也可指梁部件。
PART_IO：同 PART，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部段，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有表面段包含在段集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面段。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：使用节点 ID E1、E2、E3、E4 创建段。
SET：包含段集（*SET_SEGMENT）ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段。
SET_SHELL：从使用 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建的壳集中的壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体集中的实体单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从实体集中的实体单元生成段，同时生成外部和内部段；实体集由 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建，ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDFi：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体单元集中的第 i 个面生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SET_TSHELL：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；仅生成外部段。
SET_TSHIO：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；同时生成外部和内部段。
SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX 选项和 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。

ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, ..., E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be excluded.
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, ..., and E7 will be excluded.

PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application.
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well. Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.To include all segments in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank.  This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SEG : Create a segment with node IDs E1, E2, E3, and E4.
SET : Segments of segment sets(*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3... will be included.
SET_SHELL : Generate segments from shell elements in shell sets created with* SET_SHELL_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SLDIO : Generate segments for solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SET_SLDFi : Generate segments from the ith face of solid elements in the solid element sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.See Table 0 - 1 below for face definitions.
SET_TSHELL : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Only exterior segments are generated.
SET_TSHIO : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SHELL : Generate segments for shell elements with IDs of E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.
VOL : Generate segments inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX option for other details.See* DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
VOL_SHELL : Generate segments from shells inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7
VOL_SLDIO : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SLDIO for other details.
VOL_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SOLID for other details.
所有外部段将包含在集合中。
BOX：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的框内生成属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。对于壳单元，每个壳生成一个段；对于实体单元，仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。
BOX_SHELL：同上，但仅对壳单元生成，每个壳生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：同上，同时生成外部段和单元间段。
BOX_SOLID：同上，但仅生成外部实体单元的段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：同 BRANCH，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时可用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
DBOX：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的壳相关段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的框内的实体相关段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的部件中的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除属于 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）的段。
DVOL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的壳相关段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除位于 ID 为 E1、…、E7 的接触体积内的实体相关段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；壳单元每壳一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且朝外的段。定义牵引载荷的二维段时，PART 也可指梁部件。
PART_IO：同 PART，另生成部件内的单元间段；有时用于实体单元单面接触以防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部段，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有表面段包含在段集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面段。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：使用节点 ID E1、E2、E3、E4 创建段。
SET：包含段集（*SET_SEGMENT）ID 为 E1、E2、E3、… 的段。
SET_SHELL：从使用 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建的壳集中的壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体集中的实体单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从实体集中的实体单元生成段，同时生成外部和内部段；实体集由 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建，ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDFi：从使用 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建的实体单元集中的第 i 个面生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；面定义参见下表 0-1。
SET_TSHELL：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；仅生成外部段。
SET_TSHIO：从使用 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建的厚壳集中的厚壳单元生成段；ID 为 E1、E2、E3，E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性；同时生成外部和内部段。
SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX 选项和 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成属性为 E4、E5、E6、E7 的段；其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。

OPTION.EQ.PART: Shell elements from parts E1...E7 will be included in the current set,
OPTION.EQ.DPART: Shell elements from parts E1...E7 previously added will be excluded from the current set,
OPTION.EQ.BOX: Shell elements inside boxes E1...E7 will be included in the current set,

OPTION.EQ.SALECPT:Elements inside a box for a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4,and E5 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN,and JMAX, respectively.They are the minimumand the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh. To include all shells in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2-E7 to zero or leave them blank. This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALEFAC to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC:Elements on the face of a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, and E5 correspond to the - X, +X, -Y, and +Y faces, respectively.Assigning 1 to these 4 values would include all the boundary elements at these faces in the shell element set.This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALECPT to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
Note on trimmed mesh using *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM: An element is taken as a surface element as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.
For trimmed mesh, all those surface elements facing that direction are picked up, at both exterior and interior boundaries.
Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details
OPTION.EQ.SET:Elements of beam element sets E1, E2, E3, ... will be included
OPTION.EQ.DSET: Previously added elements that are members of beam element sets E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
OPTION.EQ.ALL：所有壳单元都将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.ELEM：壳单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DELEM：之前添加的壳单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.PART：来自部件 E1...E7 的壳单元将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DPART：之前添加的来自部件 E1...E7 的壳单元将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.BOX：框内的壳单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框内的壳单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.SALECPT：二维结构化 ALE 网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX，即各方向节点索引的最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部壳，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALEFAC 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：二维结构化 ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y 表面。将这 4 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有边界单元包含在壳单元集中。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。
对于使用 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM 的裁剪网格：只要单元沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面单元。对于裁剪网格，将选取外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面单元。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SET：梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 中的单元将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DSET：之前添加且属于梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 的单元将被排除。

This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALEFAC to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC:Elements on the face of a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, and E5 correspond to the - X, +X, -Y, and +Y faces, respectively.Assigning 1 to these 4 values would include all the boundary elements at these faces in the shell element set.This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALECPT to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
Note on trimmed mesh using *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM: An element is taken as a surface element as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.
For trimmed mesh, all those surface elements facing that direction are picked up, at both exterior and interior boundaries.
Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details
OPTION.EQ.SET:Elements of beam element sets E1, E2, E3, ... will be included
OPTION.EQ.DSET: Previously added elements that are members of beam element sets E1, E2, E3, ... will be excluded.
OPTION.EQ.ALL：所有壳单元都将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.ELEM：壳单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DELEM：之前添加的壳单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.PART：来自部件 E1...E7 的壳单元将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DPART：之前添加的来自部件 E1...E7 的壳单元将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.BOX：框内的壳单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框内的壳单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.SALECPT：二维结构化 ALE 网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX，即各方向节点索引的最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部壳，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALEFAC 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：二维结构化 ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y 表面。将这 4 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有边界单元包含在壳单元集中。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。
对于使用 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM 的裁剪网格：只要单元沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面单元。对于裁剪网格，将选取外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面单元。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。

OPTION.EQ.SALECPT:Elements inside a box for a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4,and E5 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN,and JMAX, respectively.They are the minimumand the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALEFAC to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC:Elements on the face of a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, and E5 correspond to the - X, +X, -Y, and +Y faces, respectively.Assigning 1 to these 4 values would include all the boundary elements at these faces in the shell element set.This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALECPT to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.
Note on trimmed mesh using *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM: An element is taken as a surface element as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.
For trimmed mesh, all those surface elements facing that direction are picked up, at both exterior and interior boundaries.
Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details

OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：二维结构化 ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y 表面。将这 4 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有边界单元包含在壳单元集中。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。

OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：二维结构化 ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y 表面。将这 4 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的所有边界单元包含在壳单元集中。该选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT 一起生成壳集，但不得与其他 _GENERAL 选项同用。
对于使用 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM 的裁剪网格：只要单元沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面单元。对于裁剪网格，将选取外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面单元。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SET：梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 中的单元将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DSET：之前添加且属于梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 的单元将被排除。

OPTION.EQ.ALL：所有实体单元都将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.BOX：框内的实体单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框内的实体单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.ELEM：实体单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DELEM：之前添加的实体单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.PART：来自部件 E1...E7 的实体单元将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DPART：之前添加的来自部件 E1...E7 的实体单元将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即由 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部实体单元，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的全部边界单元包含在实体单元集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要单元沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面单元，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面单元。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SET：梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 中的单元将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DSET：之前添加且属于梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 的单元将被排除。
VOL：接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的单元将包含在集合中，参见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
DVOL：之前添加且位于接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的单元将被排除。

OPTION.EQ.ALL：所有实体单元都将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.BOX：框内的实体单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DBOX：之前添加且位于框内的实体单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.ELEM：实体单元 E1...E7 将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DELEM：之前添加的实体单元 E1...E7 将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.PART：来自部件 E1...E7 的实体单元将包含在当前集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DPART：之前添加的来自部件 E1...E7 的实体单元将从当前集合中排除。
OPTION.EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即由 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向节点局部坐标最小值和最大值。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格框内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即各方向的节点索引最小值和最大值。要包含 E1 指定 S-ALE 网格中的全部实体单元，将 E2…E7 设为 0 或留空。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 表面。将这 6 个值设为 1 会把这些表面的全部边界单元包含在实体单元集中。该选项仅用于 S-ALE 网格；可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 同用，但不得与其他 GENERAL 选项同用。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要单元沿指定方向没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面单元，因此集合包含外部和内部边界上朝向该方向的全部表面单元。参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
OPTION.EQ.SET：梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 中的单元将包含在集合中。
OPTION.EQ.DSET：之前添加且属于梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 的单元将被排除。
VOL：接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的单元将包含在集合中，参见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
DVOL：之前添加且位于接触体积 E1、E2、E3、… 内的单元将被排除。
